bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Slip your arms into them, and voila! You’re kept afloat!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isuot sa mga braso mo, at ayan! Lulutang ka na!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: It's Mabel! She tied a string to herself, binding herself to you. Now she's riding securely in your pack.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Si Mabel 'yan! Itinali niya ang sarili sa iyo gamit ang isang pisi. Ligtas na siyang nakasakay sa bag mo ngayon.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: You know what they say. One critter’s lace, is another critter’s bondage rope~!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Alam mo naman ang kasabihan. Sintasin para sa isang nilalang, tali sa paggapos para sa iba~!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Issue 68. Mint condition! Save for a recent stain… definitely not saliva.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isyu 68. Parang bago! Maliban sa bagong mantsa… talagang hindi laway.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Wear this in icy places, and cold can’t even touch you! Looks super styley too.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isuot ito sa mayayelong lugar, at hindi ka maaabot ng lamig! Napakaporma rin tingnan.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A box of Finley's stuff he left with his old roommates. Looks like some papers, paintbrushes, and a few bedroom toys.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang kahon ng mga gamit ni Finley na naiwan sa mga dati niyang kasama sa tirahan. Mukhang may mga papel, pinsel, at ilang laruan para sa kuwarto.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A sturdy building material, just perfect for reinforcing heavy structures like the town bridge…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang matibay na materyales sa pagtatayo, sakto para patibayin ang mabibigat na estruktura tulad ng tulay ng bayan…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A glass jar containing the "seed of a wolf." A tribe of forest mice asked you to obtain it for a peculiar ceremony...
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang garapong salamin na may "binhi ng lobo." Ipinakuha ito sa iyo ng isang tribo ng mga daga sa gubat para sa kakaibang seremonya...

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: It’s got all the right curves, and just enough girth to really fill ya up!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Tamang-tama ang mga kurba, at sapat ang kapal para mapuno ka talaga!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A classic, practical tool for excavating and outdoor projects. Surprisingly, shovels are hard to come by in this forest!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang klasiko at praktikal na kasangkapan para sa paghuhukay at mga gawaing panlabas. Nakapagtatakang ang hirap makahanap ng pala sa gubat na ito!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies that makes a great lantern. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang garapon ng malilikot na alitaptap na mahusay gawing parol. Gusto mong panoorin ang nangyayari sa loob, pero napakabilis nilang gumalaw!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang garapon ng malilikot na alitaptap. Gusto mong panoorin ang nangyayari sa loob, pero napakabilis nilang gumalaw!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Central Forest fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Tatawagin ng kampanang ito si Penny sa dapuan ng mabilisang paglalakbay sa Gitnang Gubat!
Kampana ng Paglalakbay sa Gitnang Gubat
Kampana ng Paglalakbay sa Gitnang Gubat

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A bottle of ’Sugar’ … an ingredient Scarlett's never been out of her entire life!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang bote ng ’Asukal’ … sangkap na ni minsan ay hindi naubusan si Scarlett sa buong buhay niya!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Some warm fluffy wool from Finley. Perfect sweater-making material!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mainit at malambot na lana mula kay Finley. Perpektong materyales para sa paggawa ng sweter!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A musty piece of wood to the layman. A blank canvas to the artisan.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang pirasong kahoy na amoy-kulob para sa karaniwang nilalang. Isang blangkong kambas para sa alagad ng sining.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Peter. The wearer might spot "very interesting things…"
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Regalo ni Peter. Baka may makitang "napakakawili-wiling mga bagay…" ang nagsusuot nito.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A heavy package for Scarlett. Contains two ball gags, one riders crop, two pairs of handcuffs and a full range of anal plugs…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang mabigat na pakete para kay Scarlett. May dalawang busal na bola, isang latigong pangkabayo, dalawang pares ng posas at isang kumpletong hanay ng mga pasak sa puwit…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Sweet and delicious! You’d snack on these all day if you could!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Matamis at masarap! Kung puwede lang, maghapon mong memeryendahin ang mga ito!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: (Usable) A series of steamy photographs of Melody from a secret modeling session in Maverick's back-room studio.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: (Nagagamit) Isang serye ng maiinit na litrato ni Melody mula sa lihim na sesyon ng pagmomodelo sa estudyo sa likod ng tindahan ni Maverick.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang garapon ng malilikot na alitaptap. Gusto mong panoorin ang nangyayari sa loob, pero napakabilis nilang gumalaw!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Sharp and shiny, these salutary scissors are suitable for all sorts of shearing shenanigans.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Matalim at makinang, mainam ang gunting na ito para sa sari-saring kalokohang paggugupit.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A light package for Augustus. Contains an ancient relic of some sort.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang magaan na pakete para kay Augustus. May laman itong isang uri ng sinaunang relikya.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: To our weary traveler~ Get well soon! We are excited to meet you! The next page is a mess of signatures and paw prints.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Para sa pagod naming manlalakbay~ Magpagaling ka agad! Sabik na kaming makilala ka! Puno ng mga lagda at bakas ng lapa ang susunod na pahina.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Scarlett. This nifty atlas helps travelers navigate the forest! Activate it with [M] or [Select].
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Regalo ni Scarlett. Tinutulungan ng mapang ito ang mga manlalakbay na maglibot sa gubat! Buksan gamit ang [M] o [Select].

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Lake fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Tatawagin ng kampanang ito si Penny sa dapuan ng mabilisang paglalakbay sa Lawa!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A handy notebook that gives you access to the Critter Log, the Quest Log, and Gossiping with Critters!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang kapaki-pakinabang na kuwaderno na nagbibigay-daan sa Talaan ng mga Nilalang, Talaan ng mga Misyon, at Kuwentuhan kasama ang mga Nilalang!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang walang-lamang garapong salamin. Kung ano-anong masasayang bagay ang puwede mong ilagay rito!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: During some Adventures, your other items are stored in the background. You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Sa ilang Pakikipagsapalaran, pansamantalang itinatabi ang iba mong gamit. Makikita mo ulit ang mga ito kapag natapos ang Pakikipagsapalaran!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Mountain fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Tatawagin ng kampanang ito si Penny sa dapuan ng mabilisang paglalakbay sa Bundok!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A scrumptious red apple from the tree near the northern mountains.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang napakasarap na pulang mansanas mula sa puno malapit sa kabundukan sa hilaga.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Plains fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Tatawagin ng kampanang ito si Penny sa dapuan ng mabilisang paglalakbay sa Kapatagan!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Tournament legal, professional-grade, wood and carbon fiber. A proper endgame-spanker.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Pinapayagan sa mga torneo, pangpropesyonal ang kalidad, gawa sa kahoy at carbon fiber. Tunay na pampalo sa puwit para sa huling yugto ng laro.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang walang-lamang garapong salamin. Kung ano-anong masasayang bagay ang puwede mong ilagay rito!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Expert Craftsmanship, a touch of Southern Comfort, and a heavy dose of Adult Innovation.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Dalubhasang Pagkakagawa, bahid ng Southern Comfort, at maraming Makabagong Ideyang Pangmatanda.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Part of a cookie Mabel couldn't finish. It's as sweet as the others, but moreso because you got to share it with her.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Bahagi ng kukis na hindi naubos ni Mabel. Kasingtamis ng iba, pero mas matamis dahil napagsaluhan ninyo.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Friendship cookies! Piping fresh and ready to go. These sugary snacks will surely help break the ice!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Mga kukis ng pagkakaibigan! Bagong-bago at handa nang ihatid. Siguradong makakatulong ang matatamis na ito para tunawin ang yelo sa pagitan nila!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Fully Adjustable, Customizable. Recommended use with silicone toys only.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Lubos na Naaayos at Naaangkop. Inirerekomendang gamitin lamang kasama ng mga laruang silicone.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Augustus. It might help to decipher glyphs around the forest.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Regalo ni Augustus. Baka makatulong sa pag-unawa sa mga glipo sa paligid ng gubat.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Maverick. It's definitely broken, but it’s still an amusing conversation piece.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Regalo ni Maverick. Siguradong sira, pero nakakaaliw pa ring pag-usapan.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A professional camera with a wide angle lens. Essential equipment for any kind of studio photography.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang propesyonal na kamerang may wide-angle na lente. Mahalagang kagamitan para sa anumang uri ng potograpiya sa estudyo.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A special friendship cookie for Finley to help his old roommates make amends. The icing spells out "We're Sorry".
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Isang espesyal na kukis ng pagkakaibigan para kay Finley, para makatulong sa paghingi ng tawad ng mga dati niyang kasama sa tirahan. Nakasulat sa icing ang "We're Sorry" ("Humihingi Kami ng Tawad").

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Ollie. It doesn't seem particularly lucky, but it was still thoughtful of him!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Regalo ni Ollie. Parang hindi naman talaga masuwerte, pero nakakatuwa pa rin ang pag-alala niya sa iyo!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Money! Cash! Pesos! Collect enough of these coins and you can buy ALL the nifty goodies at The Musky Mustelid…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Pera! Salapi! Piso! Mag-ipon ka ng sapat na barya at mabibili mo ang LAHAT ng magagandang paninda sa The Musky Mustelid…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Got some explorin’ to do! Not sure what I want yet -- but I'm sure you can help me find it!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: May tutuklasin pa ako! Hindi ko pa alam kung ano'ng gusto ko -- pero sigurado akong matutulungan mo akong mahanap 'yon!
Pag-uusisa ni Maverick

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Gather some critters for sexy shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Magtipon ng ilang nilalang para sa mga seksing kalokohan sa piitan sa ibabang palapag ng bahay ng mga kuneho.
Mga Piitan at Katas

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Mabel remember what really happened during her last Blessing of the Bells.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Tulungan si Mabel na maalala kung ano talaga ang nangyari noong huli niyang Pagpapala ng mga Kampana.
Kasinglinaw ng Kampana

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Thanks for helping out today, Red. The critters and I really appreciate it!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Salamat sa pagtulong ngayon, Red. Pinahahalagahan namin 'yon ng mga nilalang!
Pag-abot ng Lapa

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Track down an elusive wolf to collect an important ingredient for the mouse ceremony.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Hanapin ang mailap na lobo para makakuha ng mahalagang sangkap para sa seremonya ng mga daga.
Nagtatanong para sa Kaibigan

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Melody has an idea where you might find an extra greeting card from last year's Blessing. See if you can track it down!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: May ideya si Melody kung saan ka maaaring makahanap ng sobrang kard ng pagbati mula sa Pagpapala noong nakaraang taon. Subukang hanapin ito!
Mga Pagbati sa Panahon ng Pagdiriwang

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Wind from the Big Storm scattered Melody's photoshoot photos around in the forest! Help Maverick find them all.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Ikinalat ng hangin ng Malaking Bagyo sa buong gubat ang mga litrato mula sa pictorial ni Melody! Tulungan si Maverick na mahanap ang lahat.
Mga Alaala ni Melody

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: What exactly is the Blessing Of The Bells? See if some of the forest critters can tell you more!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Ano nga ba ang Pagpapala ng mga Kampana? Alamin kung may maikukuwento pa ang ilang nilalang sa gubat!
Pinagbubuklod ng Kampana

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Sonny, ya familiar with PlayBear? I’d love to get my paws on a copy!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Anak, alam mo ba ang Playbear? Gustong-gusto kong makakuha ng isang kopya!
Mga Isyu ni Bucky

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Join Mabel's tribe in an ancient ceremony to quell the "spirit of the forest."
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Samahan ang tribo ni Mabel sa isang sinaunang seremonya para payapain ang "espiritu ng gubat."
Ritwal ng Pagtawid

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: I need a new toy, but not just ANY toy, it has to NOT look like a toy. Understand?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kailangan ko ng bagong laruan, pero hindi BASTA laruan. Kailangan HINDI ito mukhang laruan. Naiintindihan mo?
Bagong Laruan ni Charlotte

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Check up on the critters after yesterday's big storm!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kumustahin ang mga nilalang pagkatapos ng malaking bagyo kahapon!
Pagkumusta Pagkatapos ng Ulan

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Search the forest for a light source to visit Mabel's folks.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Humanap sa gubat ng ilaw para makadalaw sa mga kababayan ni Mabel.
Pagkalantad sa Liwanag

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Maverick's been harvesting Oliver's seed and carrying it away. But why? And why does he need so much?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kinokolekta ni Maverick ang binhi ni Oliver at dinadala iyon palayo. Pero bakit? At bakit napakarami niyang kailangan?
Ang Mahiwagang Tagpuan

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Trade Ollie some apples for a ride across the Plains.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Ipagpalit kay Ollie ang ilang mansanas para makasakay patawid ng Kapatagan.
Isang Mansanas Bawat Araw

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Find the plant and bring back some special 'seed' for Scarlett.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Hanapin ang halaman at mag-uwi ng espesyal na 'binhi' para kay Scarlett.
Kailangan ng Binhi

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Deliver cookies from Charlotte to all the forest critters.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Ihatid ang mga kukis ni Charlotte sa lahat ng nilalang sa gubat.
Dosena at Isa

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Go find a few critters Scarlett wants you to meet.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Hanapin ang ilang nilalang na gustong ipakilala sa iyo ni Scarlett.
Pagkilala sa Iyo

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source:
While you're playing an Adventure, your other quests are stored in the background.

You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target:
Habang nasa Pakikipagsapalaran ka, pansamantalang itinatabi ang ibang misyon mo.

Makikita mo ulit ang mga ito kapag natapos ang Pakikipagsapalaran!
Nasaan ang mga misyon ko?

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Bucky gather building materials to fix the town bridge.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Tulungan si Bucky na magtipon ng mga materyales sa pagtatayo para kumpunihin ang tulay ng bayan.
Tubig sa Ilalim ng Tulay

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: There's a rope-oriented bondage I’d like to try! Can you help me find ropes my size?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: May gusto akong subukang paggapos gamit ang tali! Matutulungan mo ba akong humanap ng mga taling angkop sa laki ko?
Munting Panali

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: It's the ladies' turn! Gather a few frisky females for more shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Mga babae naman! Magtipon ng ilang malalanding babae para sa dagdag na kalokohan sa piitan sa ibabang palapag ng bahay ng mga kuneho.
Mga Piitan at Katas 2

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Meet the critters and fetch some sugar for Scarlett.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kilalanin ang mga nilalang at kumuha ng asukal para kay Scarlett.
Asukal at Pampalasa

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help the coyotes knit you a cozy warm sweater.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Tulungan ang mga coyote na gawan ka ng komportable at mainit na niniting na sweter.
Mainit at Komportable

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Maverick deliver some curious items to the forest critters.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Tulungan si Maverick na maghatid ng ilang kakaibang bagay sa mga nilalang sa gubat.
Pagbibilang ng Paninda

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Finley close the loop with his old roommates.

ds:100:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, honey, I’ve been craving panda… Think you can help?
ds:100:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kasi, mahal, nananabik ako sa panda… Matutulungan mo ba ako?

ds:100:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What a day! Thanks so much for helping out, sweetie~!
ds:100:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Grabe ang araw na 'to! Maraming salamat sa pagtulong, mahal~!

ds:100:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]… oh me? You didn’t get to help me out? Nonsense! I’m happy seeing my neighbors happy!
ds:100:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]… oh, ako? Hindi mo ako natulungan? Kalokohan! Masaya akong makitang masaya ang mga kapitbahay ko!

ds:100:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]If you aren’t too tired… There is definitely something you can help me out with…
ds:100:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kung hindi ka pa pagod… May isang bagay talagang puwede mong maitulong sa akin…

ds:105:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I should visit this area more often. It’s very relaxing and I love the river ambiance!
ds:105:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dapat mas madalas akong dumalaw rito. Napakarelaks at gusto ko ang himig ng ilog!

ds:105:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey, I don’t know if you eat fish… but the fish here… don’t like to be eaten… This was news to me.
ds:105:117:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Uy, hindi ko alam kung kumakain ka ng isda… pero ang mga isda rito… ayaw nilang kainin sila… Bago 'to para sa 'kin.

ds:106:124:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm… part of me wants to update my dam into something a bit more presentable…
ds:106:124:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmm… may bahagi sa 'king gustong ayusin ang dam ko para maging mas presentable…

ds:106:125:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A lot of the woodwork around town was done by me!
ds:106:125:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ako ang gumawa ng marami sa mga gawang-kahoy sa bayan!

ds:106:126:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But the other part of me digs the rustic feel!
ds:106:126:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero gusto naman ng ibang bahagi ko ang payak na dating!

ds:106:127:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m just happy to see my work appreciated!
ds:106:127:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Masaya lang akong pinahahalagahan ang gawa ko!

ds:106:128:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]These old bones can’t quite keep up these days!
ds:106:128:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi na gaanong makasabay ang matatandang butong 'to ngayon!

ds:106:129:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]*Yawwwwn* ah… I could go for a nap right about now…

ds:107:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s hard work running a shop, Red! Hard but gratifyin’.
ds:107:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mahirap magpatakbo ng tindahan, Red! Mahirap, pero nakalulugod.

ds:107:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]They’d love to fool around with you!

ds:107:118:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re always lookin’ for a good pair of paws to help out though! Keep us in mind!
ds:107:118:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero lagi kaming naghahanap ng mahusay na pares ng lapa para tumulong! Alalahanin mo kami!

ds:107:119:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Remind me to introduce you to the gang later!
ds:107:119:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ipaalala mong ipakilala kita sa barkada mamaya!

ds:108:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Red! You’ve got a cute butt. Just sayin’. The view down here is great.
ds:108:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Red! Ang kyut ng puwit mo. Sinasabi ko lang. Ang ganda ng tanawin dito sa ibaba.

ds:108:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]By the way, if you wanted to try that sounding stuff… I’m your mouse~!
ds:108:117:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Siya nga pala, kung gusto mong subukan ang pagpasok sa uretra… Ako ang daga mo~!

ds:10:19:Dialogue Text.target: Ano ang iisipin ng nanay mo?

ds:10:22:Dialogue Text.source: Is this the collapse of society and civilization as we know it?
ds:10:22:Dialogue Text.target: Ito na ba ang pagbagsak ng lipunan at sibilisasyong nakikilala natin?

ds:111:9:Menu Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, how can I help you?

ds:112:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Uy, iho, ano'ng dala mo para sa 'kin?

ds:115:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m kidding, you know you’re always welcome inside.
ds:115:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Biro lang, alam mong lagi kang malugod na tatanggapin sa loob.

ds:115:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]HOWEVER, I haven’t had a chance to tidy up. So you can’t come in yet.
ds:115:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]PERO, hindi pa ako nakapagliligpit. Kaya hindi ka pa puwedeng pumasok.

ds:115:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Red sweetie, I’m being serious, you can’t go inside.
ds:115:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Red, mahal, seryoso ako, hindi ka puwedeng pumasok.

ds:115:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I refuse to play your childish games!
ds:115:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ayokong makipagsabayan sa mga pambata mong laro!

ds:115:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… *Her glare pierces your heart and soul*
ds:115:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]… *Tumatagos sa puso at kaluluwa mo ang matalim niyang tingin*

ds:115:9:Dialogue Text.source: The overwhelming amount of guilt stops you from entering the house.
ds:115:9:Dialogue Text.target: Dahil sa matinding bigat sa konsensiya mo, hindi ka makapasok sa bahay.

ds:116:131:Dialogue Text.source: Trespassing? You’re not that kinda panda.
ds:116:131:Dialogue Text.target: Pagpasok nang walang pahintulot? Hindi ka ganyang uri ng panda.

ds:117:11:Dialogue Text.source: Wouldn’t wanna be this bridge right now!
ds:117:11:Dialogue Text.target: Ayaw mong maging tulay na 'to ngayon!

ds:117:12:Dialogue Text.source: When this bridge grew up, it could be anything.
ds:117:12:Dialogue Text.target: Noong lumaki ang tulay na 'to, maaari itong maging kahit ano.

ds:117:13:Dialogue Text.source: Is it still called a bridge if it doesn’t function as one?
ds:117:13:Dialogue Text.target: Tulay pa rin ba kung hindi gumaganang tulay?

ds:117:4:Dialogue Text.source: It seems there has been an incline in bridge-related violence in these parts.
ds:117:4:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang dumami ang karahasang may kinalaman sa mga tulay sa lugar na 'to.

ds:118:133:Dialogue Text.source: FADE TO BLACK, FADE IN TO THE SCENE
ds:118:133:Dialogue Text.target: FADE TO BLACK, FADE IN TO THE SCENE

ds:118:134:Dialogue Text.source: He was definitely my first in terms of big partners!
ds:118:134:Dialogue Text.target: Siya talaga ang una kong malaking kapareha!

ds:118:135:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm that stretched feeling, with his hulking weight over me…
ds:118:135:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, 'yong pakiramdam na banat na banat ka, habang nakadagan sa 'yo ang napakabigat niyang katawan…

ds:118:136:Dialogue Text.source: It was exhilarating really! And I loved the challenge!
ds:118:136:Dialogue Text.target: Talagang nakakakilig sa tindi! At gustong-gusto ko ang hamon!

ds:118:137:Dialogue Text.source: Over time, I was finally able to hilt him. GOSH what a good feeling!
ds:118:137:Dialogue Text.target: Kalaunan, naipasok ko rin siya hanggang puno. NAKU, ang sarap ng pakiramdam!

ds:118:138:Dialogue Text.source: PAUSE/SHOW THE IMAGE CLEARLY, WHEN THE PLAYER HITS A BUTTON, FADE TO BLACK AND GO BACK TO THE GAME.
ds:118:138:Dialogue Text.target: PAUSE/SHOW THE IMAGE CLEARLY, WHEN THE PLAYER HITS A BUTTON, FADE TO BLACK AND GO BACK TO THE GAME.

ds:119:138:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal, will ya give us a minute?
ds:119:138:Dialogue Text.target: Rascal, puwede mo ba kaming iwan sandali?

ds:119:139:Dialogue Text.source: Peter likes his post coitus cuddles!
ds:119:139:Dialogue Text.target: Gusto ni Peter ang yakapan pagkatapos magtalik!

ds:119:2:Dialogue Text.target: *hingal hingal* Wow, mahal, ang galing mo!

ds:119:321:Dialogue Text.source: Come on in honey. Take a seat on the bed…
ds:119:321:Dialogue Text.target: Pasok ka, mahal. Maupo ka sa kama…

ds:119:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ooh, are we doing sex stuff?
ds:119:322:Dialogue Text.target: Ooh, may gagawin ba tayong malaswa?

ds:119:323:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, yes. How’s that for a proper thank you
ds:119:323:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, oo. 'Yan ang maayos na pasasalamat, ano?

ds:119:325:Dialogue Text.source: But I’m probably a bit too big for you…
ds:119:325:Dialogue Text.target: Pero malamang masyado akong malaki para sa 'yo…

ds:119:326:Dialogue Text.source: Hah, Rascal… The critters here will surprise you with what they are capable of.
ds:119:326:Dialogue Text.target: Hah, Rascal… Magugulat ka sa kayang gawin ng mga nilalang dito.

ds:119:327:Dialogue Text.source: That said, I’ll just be doing some mouth stuff.
ds:119:327:Dialogue Text.target: Pero bibig ko lang naman ang gagamitin ko.

ds:119:328:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve been wanting to see what ya got going on down there…
ds:119:328:Dialogue Text.target: Matagal ko nang gustong makita kung anong meron ka diyan sa ibaba…

ds:119:329:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, and look how excited you are already…
ds:119:329:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, at tingnan mo, sabik na sabik ka na…

ds:119:330:Dialogue Text.source: Ah hah… I blame the recent plant activities…
ds:119:330:Dialogue Text.target: Ah hah… Dahil 'to sa mga ginawa namin ng halaman kamakailan…

ds:119:331:Dialogue Text.source: Lay back, let me get a taste…

ds:119:332:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal lays back and lets the eager bunny get to work…
ds:119:332:Dialogue Text.target: Humiga si Rascal at hinayaang magsimula ang sabik na kuneho…

ds:11:18:Dialogue Text.source: Whoa! Is there something hidden here??

ds:120:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve let all of the critters know you’re awake.
ds:120:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sinabihan ko na ang lahat ng nilalang na gising ka na.

ds:120:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well, almost all of them, but word travels fast here…
ds:120:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Halos lahat pala. Pero mabilis kumalat ang balita rito…

ds:120:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So tell me. What is it you’re here for?
ds:120:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O, sabihin mo. Ano'ng ipinunta mo rito?

ds:120:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Mmmm. I think I know what you’re gettin’ at.
ds:120:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Mmmm. Parang alam ko na ang ibig mong sabihin.

ds:120:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, you’re not the first fella comin’ ‘round here to sleep around!
ds:120:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, hindi ikaw ang unang dumayo rito para makipagtalik kung kani-kanino!

ds:120:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I can imagine what you may have heard about our little town…
ds:120:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Maiisip ko kung ano ang narinig mo tungkol sa munting bayan namin…

ds:120:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But unfortunately, it doesn’t quite live up to the rumors.
ds:120:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero sa kasamaang-palad, hindi ito tulad ng mga kuwento.

ds:120:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’see, we’ve all got things to do and lives to lead.
ds:120:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kasi, may mga gawain at sariling buhay din kaming lahat.

ds:120:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Can’t possibly expect us to be bangin’ about all day!
ds:120:166:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi mo naman maaasahang magkantutan kami buong araw!

ds:120:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Who’ll put dinner on the table? Who’ll fetch supplies for the town? Who’ll fix the broken bridge?
ds:120:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sino'ng maghahanda ng hapunan? Sino'ng kukuha ng mga panustos para sa bayan? Sino'ng magkukumpuni ng sirang tulay?

ds:120:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See, we’re just a town like anywhere else.
ds:120:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kaya bayan lang din kami, tulad ng iba.

ds:120:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]THOUGH that’s not to say we don’t have our fun!
ds:120:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]PERO hindi ibig sabihing hindi kami nagsasaya!

ds:120:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]In fact! Now that I know that’s what you’re after, I can fill everyone else in…
ds:120:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa katunayan! Ngayong alam ko na kung ano'ng pakay mo, masasabi ko na sa iba…

ds:120:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh, let me fill ya in on how things work around here.
ds:120:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]O, ipapaliwanag ko muna kung paano ang mga bagay-bagay rito.

ds:120:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you see this above a critter’s head, it means they have something important to tell ya!
ds:120:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kapag nakita mo ito sa ibabaw ng ulo ng isang nilalang, ibig sabihin may mahalaga siyang sasabihin sa 'yo!

ds:120:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]If you see this, it means they’re waiting on you for something.
ds:120:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kapag ito naman, may hinihintay siyang gawin mo.

ds:120:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you see this, it means you’ve got something for them!
ds:120:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kapag ito, may dala kang bagay para sa kanya!

ds:120:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Lastly, when you see this, it means a critter has more to say on the topic.
ds:120:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]At sa huli, kapag nakita mo ito, may gusto pang sabihin ang nilalang tungkol sa paksa.

ds:120:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sometimes this is where the juicy stuff is!
ds:120:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Minsan, dito lumalabas ang mga makakatas na kuwento!

ds:120:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, tama na muna ang daldal ko!

ds:120:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?
ds:120:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Bakit hindi ka maglibot at kilalanin ang iba pa rito?

ds:120:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]While you’re out and about, pick me up some sugar from Maverick!
ds:120:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Habang naglilibot ka, ikuha mo ako ng asukal kay Maverick!

ds:120:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Straight to the point! You’re my kinda panda dear~
ds:120:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Diretso sa punto! Ikaw ang klaseng pandang gusto ko, mahal~

ds:120:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And by the looks of ya down below, you’re just my size too!
ds:120:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At sa nakikita ko sa ibaba mo, saktong-sakto rin ang laki mo para sa akin!

ds:120:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]He’s the otter by the river. You’ll know him when ya see em!
ds:120:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Siya ang otter sa tabi ng ilog. Makikilala mo siya agad pag nakita mo!

ds:120:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?
ds:120:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Bakit hindi ka maglibot at kilalanin ang iba pa rito?

ds:121:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ohhh, look, I’m not on “good terms” with the fella that lives on that island.
ds:121:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ohhh, kasi, hindi kami “magkasundo” ng nakatira sa islang 'yon.

ds:121:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But this is an urgent matter… The town’s needs come first…
ds:121:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero kailangang-kailangan na ito… Unahin ang bayan…

ds:121:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Unless… You learn how to swim by then?

ds:121:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Nooo no. I’ll do it, I’ll do it…

ds:121:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hehe, it’s a bit old fashioned I suppose…

ds:121:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, Rascal – didja’ get the wood I need?
ds:121:197:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kumusta, Rascal—nakuha mo ba ang kahoy na kailangan ko?

ds:121:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Y’know, I recall there being some on the island in the middle of the lake.
ds:121:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Alam mo, may natatandaan akong ilang piraso sa isla sa gitna ng lawa.

ds:121:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That might be enough to get us going here.
ds:121:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Baka sapat na 'yon para makapagsimula tayo rito.

ds:121:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh but… you can’t swim that huh…

ds:121:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The big ole’ gator and I used to date some time ago.
ds:121:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nagkarelasyon kami noon ng malaking alligator na 'yon.

ds:121:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero hindi kami gaanong bagay, alam mo 'yon?

ds:121:205:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some things change, while other things don’t…
ds:121:205:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May mga bagay na nagbabago, may mga hindi…

ds:121:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve never been one to confront emotional or social problems.
ds:121:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ako mahilig humarap sa mga problemang emosyonal o panlipunan.

ds:121:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m more of the: “bury things deep down until they disappear forever” kinda guy, y’know?
ds:121:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mas ako 'yung tipong: “ibaon sa kaibuturan hanggang mawala nang tuluyan,” alam mo 'yon?

ds:122:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Red! What’s shakin’? How can I be of service?

ds:122:154:Dialogue Text.source:
Can you swim across the lake
to the island for me?
ds:122:154:Dialogue Text.target:
Malalangoy mo ba ang lawa
papunta sa isla para sa akin?

ds:122:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]BUT, why would I swim FOR you? When I can HELP you swim across that lake instead?!
ds:122:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]PERO bakit ako lalangoy PARA sa 'yo, kung MATUTULUNGAN naman kitang makalangoy patawid ng lawa?!

ds:122:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well, I won’t technically help you. I’m not gonna teach you or anything.
ds:122:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero hindi talaga kita tutulungan. Hindi kita tuturuan o ano pa.

ds:122:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No. Instead. I’ve got a couple of floaties for sale!
ds:122:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi. Sa halip, may ipinagbibili akong pares ng mga salbabidang isinusuot!

ds:122:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See, you slip your arms into them, and voila! You’re kept afloat!
ds:122:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isuot mo sa mga braso, at ayan! Lulutang ka na!

ds:122:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So long as they don’t… pop… you should be fine…
ds:122:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Basta hindi… pumutok… ayos ka lang siguro…

ds:122:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ahem, So we got a deal or what?

ds:122:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll sell em to ya for 2 coins!

ds:122:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well JUST THIS ONCE, I’ll settle for a trade! Because we’re buds, Red.
ds:122:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sige, NGAYON LANG, papayag ako sa palitan! Dahil magkaibigan tayo, Red.

ds:122:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]What do you have that might interest me, Red?
ds:122:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ano'ng mayroon ka na baka magustuhan ko, Red?

ds:122:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red, my guy. I do not do sexual favors as business transactions!
ds:122:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Red, pare. Hindi ako nakikipagpalitan ng seksuwal na pabor para sa negosyo!

ds:122:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I keep work and pleasure very separate, you understand, my friend.
ds:122:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Magkahiwalay para sa akin ang trabaho at sarap. Naiintindihan mo, kaibigan?

ds:122:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero sa totoo lang, wala itong gaanong silbi sa akin.

ds:122:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]HOWEVER, a skilled craftsman can make me something with that!
ds:122:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]GAYUNMAN, may mahusay na manggagawang makakagawa ng bagay mula riyan para sa akin!

ds:122:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Tell ya what Red – Tell Bucky to make me "somethin’ fun" with that.
ds:122:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ganito, Red—Sabihin mo kay Bucky na gawan ako ng "isang masayang bagay" mula riyan.

ds:122:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Once he has, I’ll trade ya for these floaties!
ds:122:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kapag natapos niya, ipagpapalit ko sa 'yo ang mga salbabidang ito!

ds:123:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, what can I do for ya?

ds:123:159:Dialogue Text.source: Can you sculpt “something fun” for Maverick?
ds:123:159:Dialogue Text.target: Puwede ka bang umukit ng “isang masayang bagay” para kay Maverick?

ds:123:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I know exactly what tickles that critter!
ds:123:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alam na alam ko kung ano'ng nagpapakilig sa nilalang na 'yon!

ds:123:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Give me some time, and I’ll whip something out in a jiffy!
ds:123:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bigyan mo ako ng kaunting oras at may mailalabas ako agad!

ds:123:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Give me some time, and I’ll whip something out in a jiffy!

ds:124:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O Red! May dala ka para sa akin?

ds:124:178:Dialogue Text.source: Yes, What do you think of this toy?
ds:124:178:Dialogue Text.target: Oo. Ano'ng tingin mo sa laruang ito?

ds:124:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh wow. Yes, this is truly the work of a craftsman.
ds:124:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]O wow. Oo, tunay itong gawa ng isang dalubhasang manggagawa.

ds:124:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]*Sniff sniff* Mmm, it’s got that new dildo smell, Red - ya gotta get a whiff!
ds:124:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]*Singhot singhot* Mmm, amoy bagong dildo, Red—kailangan mong amuyin!

ds:124:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh man what a beauty… I can’t wait to put this in places.
ds:124:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]O pare, ang ganda… Sabik na akong ipasok ito kung saan-saan.

ds:124:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well! A deal is a deal Red, one pair of swimfloaties coming right up!
ds:124:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]O siya! Usapan ay usapan, Red. Heto na ang isang pares ng mga salbabidang isinusuot!

ds:124:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red do you have much experience with toys?
ds:124:187:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Red, marami ka bang karanasan sa mga laruan?

ds:124:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re cut from the same cloth my friend, very good very good.
ds:124:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Magkapareho tayo ng hilig, kaibigan. Magaling, magaling.

ds:124:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Bucky’s The best in the business, I promise!
ds:124:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Si Bucky ang pinakamagaling sa larangang ito, pangako!

ds:124:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve never seen such care and creativity in craftsmanship!
ds:124:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wala pa akong nakitang ganoong pag-iingat at pagkamalikhain sa paggawa!

ds:124:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The old chap’s got that going for sure!
ds:124:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Iyan ang tiyak na lamang ng matandang 'yon!

ds:124:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s actually a little difficult to get items from him.
ds:124:193:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Medyo mahirap ngang makakuha ng mga bagay mula sa kanya.

ds:124:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh, you gotta give these things a shot, Red! they’ll change your life!
ds:124:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]O, kailangan mong subukan ang mga ito, Red! Mababago ang buhay mo!

ds:124:196:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Giving or receiving, your life, will be changed.
ds:124:196:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagbibigay man o tumatanggap, mababago ang buhay mo.

ds:124:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I should introduce you to some of my friends later!
ds:124:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dapat ipakilala kita sa ilan kong kaibigan mamaya!

ds:124:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]We get up to all sorts of shenanigans.

ds:124:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He’s the only crafter we got, so he manages all of the town and critter’s needs.
ds:124:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siya lang ang tagalikha rito, kaya inaasikaso niya ang pangangailangan ng buong bayan at ng mga nilalang.

ds:124:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mula sa mga gusali at pagkukumpuni ng bahay…

ds:124:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]to dinky little trinkets to shove up your butt!
ds:124:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]hanggang sa munting abubot na isasaksak sa puwit mo!

ds:125:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Haha, not yet my friend. We’ll find you something.
ds:125:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Haha, hindi pa, kaibigan. Makakahanap tayo ng bagay para sa iyo.

ds:125:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you ever want to talk history or culture, I’m happy to assist.
ds:125:193:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kung nais mong pag-usapan ang kasaysayan o kultura, ikalulugod kong tumulong.

ds:125:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]A majority of the critters here are uh… not so interested in the past.
ds:125:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Karamihan sa mga nilalang dito ay ah… hindi gaanong interesado sa nakaraan.

ds:125:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That’s my main passion, so things have been… a bit lonely…
ds:125:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Iyon ang pangunahing hilig ko, kaya medyo… malungkot…

ds:125:196:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh. Before I forget, I’ve got a slab of wood here for you.
ds:125:196:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]O. Bago ko makalimutan, may tabla akong kahoy dito para sa iyo.

ds:125:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And help yourself to the pile over there.
ds:125:197:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At kumuha ka rin sa bunton doon.

ds:125:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good to see you here, welcome to my little abode!
ds:125:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ikinagagalak kitang makita rito. Maligayang pagdating sa munting tahanan ko!

ds:125:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I realized all too late that we didn’t properly introduce ourselves.
ds:125:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Huli ko nang napagtanto na hindi pala tayo maayos na nakapagpakilala.

ds:125:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]philosopher, scholar, and student to the world and its histories. At your service.
ds:125:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]pilosopo, iskolar, at mag-aaral ng mundo at ng mga kasaysayan nito. Handang maglingkod.

ds:125:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And whose rump did I have the pleasure of ferrying?
ds:125:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]At kaninong puwit naman ang ikinagalak kong maitawid?

ds:125:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]O! Tingnan kung sino'ng tinubuan ng palikpik!

ds:125:207:Dialogue Text.source:
Rascal Redtail, Fluffy, Red… and…
I don’t have any cool titles.
ds:125:207:Dialogue Text.target:
Rascal Redtail, Fluffy, Red… at…
Wala akong magagandang titulo.

ds:126:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Is that all the wood we need? Sure looks like it!
ds:126:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Iyan na ba ang lahat ng kahoy na kailangan? Mukha nga!

ds:126:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just in time too! The blueprint is all finished up.

ds:126:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nothing left now but to get to it!

ds:126:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks so much for your help Rascal!

ds:127:260:Dialogue Text.source: Camera pans over. Pans back and auto-walk to them. Scarlett:
ds:127:260:Dialogue Text.target: Camera pans over. Pans back and auto-walk to them. Scarlett:

ds:127:263:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Smells like you’ve been fooling around a bit!

ds:127:267:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]We were actually just talking about you and your promiscuity!
ds:127:267:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ikaw at ang pakikipagtalik mo sa iba't ibang kapareha ang pinag-uusapan namin!

ds:127:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I mean, you’ve only been here a short time, and you’ve already been a tremendous help to all the critters around.
ds:127:268:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kasi, sandali ka pa lang dito, pero napakalaki na ng naitulong mo sa lahat ng nilalang sa paligid.

ds:127:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But honestly, you’ve done a lot more than that.
ds:127:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero sa totoo lang, higit pa roon ang nagawa mo.

ds:127:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Scarlett and I were talking, and we’ve been more inspired than ever to sleep around again!
ds:127:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nag-uusap kami ni Scarlett, at mas inspirado kami kaysa dati na makipagtalik ulit sa iba't ibang kapareha!

ds:127:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s been a hot minute since I’ve fooled around – and seeing you spark a fire in all these folks has me rearing to go!
ds:127:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Matagal-tagal na rin mula nang huli akong nagkulitan. At nang makita kitang nagpasiklab ng apoy sa lahat ng nilalang na 'to, sabik na rin ako!

ds:127:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Absolutely! I know we’re not alone in the thought either.
ds:127:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo naman! Alam kong hindi lang kami ang nakaisip niyan.

ds:127:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve heard a few critters have already been hooking up!
ds:127:275:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Balita ko, may ilang nilalang nang nagtatagpo para magtalik!

ds:127:278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hah, malalaman mo rin sa lalong madaling panahon!

ds:127:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Actually, Bucky and I were just arranging some plans!
ds:127:279:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sa katunayan, may mga plano nga kami ni Bucky!

ds:127:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maverick was looking for you. Be sure to drop by his shop!
ds:127:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hinahanap ka ni Maverick. Dumaan ka sa tindahan niya!

ds:127:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s right! Bucky and I were just arranging some plans!
ds:127:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tama! May mga plano nga kami ni Bucky!

ds:127:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See Peter’s quite adventurous! He really enjoys getting tied up, and blind folded, right?
ds:127:288:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kasi, malakas ang loob ni Peter sa pagsubok! Gustong-gusto niyang nakatali at may takip sa mata, di ba?

ds:127:289:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perfect opportunity to do a little switch-a-Roo!

ds:127:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I can’t wait! He’s gonna be so surprised once he feels my paws instead of hers!
ds:127:291:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sabik na ako! Magugulat siya kapag mga lapa ko ang naramdaman niya sa halip na mga lapa ni Scarlett!

ds:127:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Peter is such a cute submissive critter, I’m excited to get to fool around with him again!

ds:127:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You two are super cute together that’s for sure!
ds:127:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ang kyut ninyong dalawa kapag magkasama, tiyak 'yan!

ds:127:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Whew~! All this talk Is making me excited! I gotta calm down!
ds:127:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Whew~! Nasasabik ako sa usapang ito! Kailangan kong kumalma!

ds:127:296:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho. All of this and so much more is thanks to you Rascal!
ds:127:296:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basta, lahat ng ito at marami pang iba ay dahil sa 'yo, Rascal!

ds:127:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’ll probably be seein’ more critters visiting each other too!
ds:127:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Malamang mas marami ka ring makikitang nilalang na dumadalaw sa isa't isa!

ds:128:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ay Red! How can I help ya?

ds:128:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Picking up some Sugar? Sure thing, bud!
ds:128:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kukuha ka ng Asukal? Oo naman, pare!

ds:128:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]OH SCARLETT HUH? Haha! Sure, right. “Sugar.” Yeah I’ll get ya some “Sugar!”
ds:128:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]O, KAY SCARLETT PALA? Haha! Sige, oo. “Asukal.” Ikukuha kita ng “Asukal!”

ds:128:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]*inaabutan ka ng isang bote ng pampadulas*

ds:128:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She didn’t tell ya? Haha, that lady’s never been out of sugar her entire life.
ds:128:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hindi niya sinabi sa 'yo? Haha, ni minsan sa buong buhay niya, hindi pa siya naubusan ng asukal.

ds:128:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]“Sugar” is code for lube! But it’s more of an inside joke than anything.
ds:128:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]“Asukal” ang kodigo para sa pampadulas! Pero biro-biro lang namin 'yan.

ds:128:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But yeah. That’s what she wants! Trust me.
ds:128:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Pero oo. Ito ang gusto niya! Magtiwala ka.

ds:129:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hello dear~ Did you get that sugar?
ds:129:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kumusta, mahal~ Nakuha mo ba ang asukal?

ds:129:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh… Oooooh naku, hahaha! Oo nga pala!

ds:129:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How could I forget about our secret code!
ds:129:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Paano ko nakalimutan ang lihim naming kodigo!

ds:129:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s very good of him, but I actually did need sugar…
ds:129:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ang bait naman niya, pero totoong asukal talaga ang kailangan ko…

ds:129:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh well! Could always use more lube!
ds:129:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayos lang! Palaging magagamit ang dagdag na pampadulas!

ds:129:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll just talk to him myself once I’m done with the chores here.
ds:129:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ako na mismo ang kakausap sa kanya pag natapos ko ang mga gawain dito.

ds:129:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s a funny story how that “code” ended up coming about.
ds:129:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Nakakatawa ang kuwento kung paano nagsimula ang “kodigong” 'yon.

ds:129:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See, my husband is a bit shy, especially when it comes to anything regarding sex.
ds:129:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kasi, medyo mahiyain ang asawa ko, lalo na pag tungkol sa sex.

ds:129:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]He hates it when I ask him to gather supplies, or pick something up from the neighbors.
ds:129:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ayaw na ayaw niya kapag pinapakuha ko siya ng mga panustos, o pinapakuha ng kung ano sa mga kapitbahay.

ds:129:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So I decided to make the code!

ds:129:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]“Sugar” is lubricant, “Spices” are toys, “Something nice” is how we refer to certain gear!
ds:129:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]“Asukal” ang pampadulas, “Mga Pampalasa” ang mga laruan, at “Isang Magandang Bagay” ang tawag namin sa ilang kagamitan!

ds:129:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a whole thing, I think I got most of the town acquainted, oh hohoho~!
ds:129:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mahaba-habang usapan 'yan. Sa palagay ko, alam na ng halos buong bayan, oh hohoho~!

ds:12:19:Dialogue Text.source: Just for today while the excavation is in process.
ds:12:19:Dialogue Text.target: Ngayong araw lamang habang isinasagawa ang paghuhukay.

Understand that this is for your own safety!
                 -Gator

ds:130:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve actually got another task if you’re up for it, dear!
ds:130:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May isa pa nga akong ipapagawa kung gusto mo, mahal!

ds:130:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Naubusan lang ako ng espesyal na pataba para sa hardin ko.

ds:130:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Makakakuha ka ba ng dagdag para sa akin?

ds:130:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]East of here is the Deep Woods.
ds:130:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nasa silangan mula rito ang Kaloob-looban ng Gubat.

ds:130:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It’s dense with trees, so it’s pretty dark, but stay on the trail and you’ll be OK!
ds:130:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Makapal ang mga puno roon kaya medyo madilim, pero sundan mo lang ang landas at magiging ayos ka!

ds:130:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There’s a… umm… special critter who "supplies" my fertilizer…
ds:130:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May… umm… espesyal na nilalang na "nagsusuplay" ng pataba ko…

ds:130:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now, its methods are a bit… invasive…

ds:130:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But if you’re visiting our town, you simply have to "experience" this flower!
ds:130:166:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero kung dumadalaw ka sa bayan namin, kailangan mo talagang "maranasan" ang bulaklak na ito!

ds:130:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]O ah… Gusto mo ba ang sa puwit?

ds:130:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once ya find the flower, just present your rear to it, and it’ll do the rest!
ds:130:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pag nahanap mo ang bulaklak, iharap mo lang ang puwit mo at ito na ang bahala!

ds:130:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh, definitely no better critter to start with than this flower!
ds:130:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Wala nang mas mabuting nilalang para sa unang subok kaysa sa bulaklak na ito!

ds:130:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You’re in for a treat, trust me!
ds:130:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May masarap na naghihintay sa 'yo, maniwala ka!

ds:130:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This critter will change your mind, trust me! You won’t regret it!
ds:130:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mababago ng nilalang na ito ang isip mo, maniwala ka! Hindi ka magsisisi!

ds:130:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A little goes a long way, but do try to hold the stuff in…
ds:130:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Malaki ang nagagawa ng kaunti nito, pero subukan mong pigiling lumabas ang laman…

ds:130:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Haha, this will all make more sense as it happens, you’ll see!
ds:130:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Haha, maiintindihan mo rin ang lahat habang nangyayari, tingnan mo!

ds:130:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’d go myself, but having you go is making me excited…
ds:130:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ako sana ang pupunta, pero nasasabik akong ikaw ang pupunta…

ds:130:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m trying not to spoil the experience!

ds:130:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I won’t mince words, dear - You’re about to get fucked by a flower!
ds:130:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hindi na ako magpapaligoy-ligoy, mahal—Kakantutin ka ng isang bulaklak!

ds:130:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It’s a bit dark but stay on the path and you’ll be fine!
ds:130:187:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Medyo madilim, pero sundan mo lang ang landas at magiging ayos ka!

ds:130:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The plant is East of here in the woods.
ds:130:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nasa Silangan mula rito ang halaman, sa gubat.

ds:130:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t keep me waiting too long, dear!
ds:130:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Huwag mo akong paghintayin nang matagal, mahal!

Haha, ok enough about me.
Do you two hang out often?

Haha, o sige, tama na ang tungkol sa akin.

ds:133:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]When are you gonna get it on?

ds:133:277:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I gotta keep up the stretching, if he’s as big as you say.
ds:133:277:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero kailangan ko pang magpaunat kung kasinlaki nga siya ng sabi mo.

I’m sure that could be arranged.
Whattya say Mabel?

Siguradong magagawan natin 'yan ng paraan.
Ano sa tingin mo, Mabel?

ds:133:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]When did you first come to me, a couple years ago?
ds:133:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kailan ka unang lumapit sa akin, mga dalawang taon na ba?

ds:133:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t be fooled, Mabel is as lazy as it comes.

ds:133:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Anyways, we meet up pretty often and I show him the ropes!
ds:133:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Basta, madalas kaming magkita at tinuturuan ko siya!

ds:133:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Being such an intimate and uh… arousing topic – we’ve gotten into all sorts of naughty shenanigans with each other.

ds:133:304:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hmm, well just the other day, she pegged me with a toy half the size of her!

ds:133:307:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh but remember a couple weeks ago, when ya got both paws deep in me?

ds:133:310:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Reminds me of when ya got your tail way up in me.

ds:135:316:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Ahahaha! I’ll never forget the look on your face then!

ds:135:318:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! You’d be making a face too with something that big in ya!

ds:135:319:Dialogue Text.source: Hey! What are ya guys laughing at?

ds:135:321:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah, just reminiscing some good ole’ times.
ds:135:321:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah, ginugunita lang ang masasayang araw noon.

ds:135:322:Dialogue Text.source:
Oh? You guys seem
to be getting along now.

How do you two get it on?

ds:135:328:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Usually Bucky likes to ride me. But really we did all sorts of positions…

ds:135:330:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Best of all is when I’m in his mouth!

ds:135:333:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]In fact, you can join us while we celebrate!
ds:135:333:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa katunayan, samahan mo kami sa pagdiriwang!

ds:135:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Heh, you do get a kick out of that eh?

ds:135:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah there’s a lot of room in there… and I’m pretty gentle…
ds:135:342:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oo, maluwag sa loob… at maingat naman ako…

ds:135:344:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s an absolute THRILL! You gotta try it sometime!
ds:135:344:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Talagang NAKAKAKILABOT sa sarap! Subukan mo minsan!

ds:135:345:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s right! Ole Bucky and I have buried the hatchet!
ds:135:345:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tama! Nagkasundo na kami ng matandang Bucky!

ds:135:346:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We won’t be getting back together of course, but we’re going to be mature about the past, and move forward.
ds:135:346:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siyempre, hindi na kami magkakabalikan, pero haharapin namin ang nakaraan nang may sapat na pag-iisip, at magpapatuloy.

ds:135:349:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See, we’ve been talking and we’ve come to realize that, though we aren’t right for each other, things definitely didn’t have to get bad between us.
ds:135:349:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nag-usap kami at napagtanto naming kahit hindi kami bagay sa isa't isa, hindi naman kailangang sumama ang samahan namin.

ds:135:350:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]In the heat of the moment, it can be a tough pill to swallow… But the time apart has really helped us see clearly.
ds:135:350:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kapag mainit ang ulo, mahirap tanggapin… Pero nakatulong ang panahon na magkahiwalay kami para makita iyon nang malinaw.

ds:135:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Now frankly, I’m just glad to have my friend back!
ds:135:351:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ngayon, sa totoo lang, masaya lang akong nakabalik ang kaibigan ko!

ds:135:353:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s soooo warm and squishy! Once ya get him drooling, it’s a real mess!
ds:135:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Napakainit at napakalambot! Kapag naglaway na siya, talagang basang-basa ka!

ds:135:358:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, it was quite lonely. I don’t really have much in common with the younger folks these days…
ds:135:358:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa totoo lang, napakalungkot noon. Wala na akong gaanong pagkakatulad sa mga mas bata sa panahon ngayon…

ds:135:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And if I’m gonna be honest too… I’ve really missed that big ole tongue of yours…
ds:135:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At kung aamin din ako… Talagang na-miss ko 'yang malaki mong dila…

ds:135:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh? You missed me regaling the world’s histories to you?
ds:135:363:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh? Na-miss mong makinig sa mga salaysay ko ng kasaysayan ng mundo?

ds:135:367:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, I know ole’ chap. I’ve missed that little rump of yours as well…
ds:135:367:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, alam ko, kaibigan. Na-miss ko rin 'yang maliit mong puwit…

ds:135:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Er.. Ahem! Sorry Rascal… Didn’t mean to get all mushy in front of you…
ds:135:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Er… Ahem! Pasensiya, Rascal… Hindi namin sinasadyang maglambingan sa harap mo…

ds:135:370:Dialogue Text.source:
Not a problem!
I’ll let ya guys get to it!
ds:135:370:Dialogue Text.target:
Walang problema!
Maiwan ko na kayo!

ds:136:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So back to the original idea then?

ds:136:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I definitely think that’s our lightning in a bottle!
ds:136:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa tingin ko talaga, 'yon ang kakaibang ideyang magpapayaman sa atin!

ds:136:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Wanna hear our next million dollar idea? Don’t steal it!
ds:136:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Gusto mong marinig ang susunod naming ideyang milyong dolyar ang halaga? Huwag mong nakawin!

ds:136:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ya ever get tired getting off to the same old same old?

ds:136:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, we should add a matching service as well! We can take notes of kinks, and offer to hook up others interested in similar stuff!
ds:136:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, magdagdag din tayo ng serbisyong naghahanap ng kapareha! Itatala natin ang mga kink, tapos pagtutugmain ang mga interesado sa magkatulad na bagay!

ds:136:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh that’s good stuff right there! Perhaps we could set up meets for the more popular kinks! We can even feature guests who’re enthusiasts!
ds:136:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Magandang ideya 'yan! Baka puwede tayong mag-organisa ng mga pagtitipon para sa mga mas sikat na kink! Mag-imbita pa tayo ng mga bisitang mahilig doon!

ds:136:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That would be a great way for folks to learn about new experiences!
ds:136:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Magandang paraan 'yon para malaman nila ang tungkol sa mga bagong karanasan!

ds:136:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Something tells me, they might just turn into orgies…

ds:136:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Want some spice in your love life?

ds:136:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Look no further! The Kink Finders have your back!
ds:136:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Huwag ka nang lumayo! Bahala sa 'yo ang mga Tagahanap ng Kink!

ds:136:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]See Red, Mabel and I spitball project ideas every so often. We wanted to figure out something that could capitalize on the current trend in the forest!
ds:136:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ganito kasi, Red, paminsan-minsan nagpapalitan kami ni Mabel ng mga ideya para sa proyekto. Naisip naming samantalahin ang kasalukuyang uso sa gubat!

ds:136:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks to you, Critters have been sleeping around more these days!
ds:136:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dahil sa 'yo, mas madalas nang makipagtalik sa iba't ibang kapareha ang mga nilalang!

ds:136:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And what better way to make some extra coin, than offering a related service!
ds:136:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]At ano pa bang mas magandang paraan para kumita ng dagdag kaysa mag-alok ng kaugnay na serbisyo!

ds:136:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We figure there’s bound to be some sexual avenues some critters have been wanting to explore, or are curious about, but were never able to.
ds:136:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siguradong may mga gawaing seksuwal na gustong subukan ng ilang nilalang, o gusto nilang malaman, pero hindi pa nila nagawa.

ds:136:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Or kinks they didn’t even know existed!

ds:136:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah Maverick didn’t know what sounding was until just a moment ago!

ds:136:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I still don’t believe it! That can’t be a thing, no way!

ds:136:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]OK, Let’s move forward with the idea. We’ll need to come up with the logistics next… Are we charging folks for our consultation time?

ds:136:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hmm good question… That would certainly make things a lot more fun…

ds:136:197:Dialogue Text.source: OK! I’ll let you guys get to it.

ds:136:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sounds good! We got plenty of kinks to iron out. Pun intended.
ds:136:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ayos! Marami pang baluktot na kailangang ituwid sa plano—at tuklasin sa kama. Sinadya kong paglaruan ang salita.

ds:139:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know, we were also talking a bit about some stuff Penny wants to experiment with…

ds:139:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Come on darling, you can hide me under those feathers, and I can do my work right here~ No one will suspect a thing!

ds:139:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Penny Plume’s Ride and Spoon? Penny Plume’s Ride and Poon?

ds:139:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hehe, so you know how our wonderful Penny here is quite the service girl, right? Married to her work and being so useful…

ds:139:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Baw I dunno… it probably sounds stupid…

ds:1444:994:Dialogue Text.source: N-no… Equines have a lot of pre…
ds:1444:994:Dialogue Text.target: H-hindi… Maraming paunang likido ang mga kauri ng kabayo…

ds:1444:995:Dialogue Text.source: Makes sense, gotta lube this thing up!
ds:1444:995:Dialogue Text.target: May punto, kailangan ng pampadulas sa laki nito!

ds:1444:996:Dialogue Text.source: Sorry folks, I’ll watch where I’m aiming this thing…
ds:1444:996:Dialogue Text.target: Pasensiya na, mga kasama, iingatan ko kung saan ko itututok 'to…

ds:1444:997:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah get it in her mouth next time!
ds:1444:997:Dialogue Text.target: Oo, sa bibig niya sa susunod!

ds:144:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, may punto ka, maliit kong kaibigan. May punto.

ds:144:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Today marks my 5th year of changing my life.
ds:144:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ngayon ang ika-5 taon mula nang baguhin ko ang buhay ko.

ds:144:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So this is a commemorative piece! Ya feel me?
ds:144:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya isang paggunita ang likhang ito! Naiintindihan mo?

ds:144:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, that’s half the beauty of it, bud!
ds:144:166:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Haha, iyan ang kalahati ng ganda nito, pare!

ds:144:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m always painting something, so be sure to stop by soon!
ds:144:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lagi akong may ipinipinta, kaya dumalaw ka ulit!

ds:144:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can show you more of my work!
ds:144:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maipapakita ko pa sa 'yo ang ibang gawa ko!

ds:144:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You’re just in time to see my newest piece!
ds:144:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Saktong dumating ka para makita ang pinakabago kong likha!

ds:144:174:Dialogue Text.source: *Camera moves over to the art piece for a few seconds, then returns to the two talking*
ds:144:174:Dialogue Text.target: *Camera moves over to the art piece for a few seconds, then returns to the two talking*

ds:144:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Mmmhm. She’s a beaut. This one’s called, Epiphany.
ds:144:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mmmhm. Ang ganda niya. Pagkamulat ang pangalan nito.

ds:144:177:Dialogue Text.source: Ram - Finley Clovenhoof Clefthoof (Finley the Fluffy? Self proclaimed chill name?)
ds:144:177:Dialogue Text.target: Ram - Finley Clovenhoof Clefthoof (Finley the Fluffy? Self proclaimed chill name?)

ds:144:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ay! Lil’ guy! Welcome to my little slice of paradise~!
ds:144:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O! Maliit kong kaibigan! Maligayang pagdating sa munting paraiso ko~!

ds:144:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The name is Finley, and whom do I have the pleasure of speaking to?
ds:144:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Finley ang pangalan ko. Ikinagagalak kitang makausap—ano naman ang pangalan mo?

ds:145:196:Dialogue Text.source: *Maybe you can hear the bunny coming in, or something. A window opening*
ds:145:196:Dialogue Text.target: *Maybe you can hear the bunny coming in, or something. A window opening*

ds:145:198:Dialogue Text.source: She comes closer to the bed as Red stirs.
ds:145:198:Dialogue Text.target: She comes closer to the bed as Red stirs.

ds:145:201:Dialogue Text.source: Red begins to wake, he sits up on the bed.
ds:145:201:Dialogue Text.target: Red begins to wake, he sits up on the bed.

ds:145:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You’ve been out for quite a while, dear.

ds:145:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Please take it easy and relax all you need.
ds:145:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huwag kang magpakapagod. Magpahinga ka hangga't kailangan mo.

ds:145:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Why, you’ve found yourself in our quaint little town.
ds:145:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nandito ka sa payapa naming munting bayan.

ds:145:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The parts here are called The Forest of Love.
ds:145:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang lugar na ito ay tinatawag na Ang Gubat ng Pag-ibig.

ds:145:215:Dialogue Text.source: Oh perfect! Exactly where I want to be!
ds:145:215:Dialogue Text.target: Ay, sakto! Dito mismo ang gusto kong puntahan!

ds:145:216:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh? You were searching for this place?
ds:145:216:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Talaga? Hinahanap mo ang lugar na ito?

ds:145:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’re a bit off the beaten path, but you’re here now!
ds:145:218:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Medyo tago ang lugar namin, pero nandito ka na ngayon!

ds:145:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You’ve even got a few get-well gifts and flowers waiting for ya on the table!
ds:145:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May ilang regalo at bulaklak pang naghihintay sa 'yo sa mesa para gumaling ka!

ds:145:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We don’t often get visitors, especially the uh… passin’ out kind…
ds:145:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bihira kaming magkaroon ng bisita, lalo na 'yung ah… mga hinihimatay…

ds:145:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But we do our best to do right by our travelers!
ds:145:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero ginagawa namin ang makakaya para alagaan ang mga manlalakbay!

ds:145:227:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Actually I was hoping you’d fill us in there!
ds:145:227:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sa totoo lang, umaasa akong ikaw ang magpapaliwanag sa amin!

ds:145:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Last night as the sun was setting, our resident hawk was doing her patrol - and saw you collapsed!
ds:145:228:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kahapon, habang palubog ang araw, nagpapatrulya ang babaeng lawin namin dito—at nakita kang nakabulagta!

ds:145:230:Dialogue Text.source:
I uh… maybe haven’t slept
for a day… or 2…
ds:145:230:Dialogue Text.target:
Ako ay ah… baka hindi pa ako natutulog
nang isang araw… o 2…

ds:145:234:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Come now, you couldn’t have just taken a nap under a tree or something? Sheesh!
ds:145:234:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Naman, hindi ka na lang sana umidlip sa ilalim ng puno o kung saan? Hay naku!

ds:145:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You had us worried sick! Kids these days, I swear.
ds:145:236:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sobrang nag-alala kami! Mga kabataan talaga ngayon, naku.

ds:145:238:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ahh nothing to be sorry about dear. I’m just glad you’re OK.
ds:145:238:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ahh, walang dapat ihingi ng tawad, mahal. Masaya lang akong ayos ka.

ds:145:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s some food and water I’ve prepared just a bit ago. Please help yourself to them!
ds:145:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May inihanda akong pagkain at tubig kanina. Kumain at uminom ka lang!

ds:145:240:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll let the others know you’re doing OK, and you can come on out whenever you’re ready.
ds:145:240:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sasabihin ko sa iba na ayos ka na. Lumabas ka lang kapag handa ka na.

ds:145:250:Dialogue Text.source: *Quick fade to black* (bunny needs to leave)
ds:145:250:Dialogue Text.target: *Quick fade to black* (bunny needs to leave)

ds:145:259:Dialogue Text.target: Hmmm… parang pamilyar ang batong ito…

ds:145:266:Dialogue Text.source: I think I’ve been here before…

ds:146:14:Dialogue Text.source: An assortment of fruits and veggies. Would you like to eat it?
ds:146:14:Dialogue Text.target: Iba't ibang prutas at gulay. Gusto mong kainin?

ds:146:17:Dialogue Text.source: Delicious! Definitely fresh! You would eat this all day if you could!
ds:146:17:Dialogue Text.target: Masarap! Tiyak na sariwa! Kakain ka nito buong araw kung maaari!

ds:146:18:Dialogue Text.source: … Oh? There appears to be a package of chocolates!
ds:146:18:Dialogue Text.target: … Oh? Mukhang may isang pakete ng mga tsokolate!

ds:146:20:Dialogue Text.source: A pleasant assortment of wildflowers. It’s an awfully kind gesture for a stranger.
ds:146:20:Dialogue Text.target: Isang magandang bungkos ng mga ligaw na bulaklak. Napakabait na kilos para sa isang di-kilala.

ds:146:22:Dialogue Text.source: To our weary traveler~ Get well soon! We are excited to meet you! The next page is a mess of signatures and paw prints.
ds:146:22:Dialogue Text.target: Sa aming pagod na manlalakbay~ Pagaling ka agad! Sabik na kaming makilala ka! Puno ng mga pirma at bakas ng lapa ang susunod na pahina.

ds:147:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmm, these days, I just go with the flow.
ds:147:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hmm, ngayon, sumasabay na lang ako sa agos.

ds:147:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]When I was more active, I had a lot more lady partners.
ds:147:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Noong mas aktibo ako, mas marami akong kaparehang babae.

ds:147:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But then I’d go on a guy kick from time to time.
ds:147:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero may mga panahong lalaki naman ang hilig ko.

ds:147:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I actually did a lot of group activities back then, probably why I’m so flexible.
ds:147:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Marami rin akong ginawang panggrupong aktibidad noon, marahil kaya ako madaling makibagay.

ds:148:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This is a little somethin’ you pick up on the track.
ds:148:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isa itong munting bagay na natututuhan sa takbuhan.

ds:148:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See, critters have all sorts of unique shapes ‘n forms, yeah?
ds:148:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kasi, kung ano-ano ang natatanging hugis at anyo ng mga nilalang, di ba?

ds:148:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We can be nimble and quick in our own way.
ds:148:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Maaari tayong maging maliksi at mabilis sa sarili nating paraan.

ds:148:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Some of us can jump, some of us can run.
ds:148:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang iba sa atin ay kayang tumalon, ang iba ay kayang tumakbo.

ds:148:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But you my friend, you look like you can ROLL.
ds:148:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero ikaw, kaibigan, mukhang kaya mong GUMULONG.

ds:148:205:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It might seem a bit funny, but we gotta work with what we got! It’s survival!
ds:148:205:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Baka medyo nakakatawa, pero gamitin natin ang mayroon tayo! Para mabuhay!
