ds:148:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]O para mas madali, o kahit ano.

ds:148:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let’s see it Red! Give us a couple good rolls!
ds:148:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ipakita mo, Red! Gumulong ka nang maayos, mga dalawang beses!

ds:148:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m a marathon athlete traveling and training!
ds:148:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Atleta ako sa maraton, naglalakbay at nagsasanay!

ds:148:212:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You must be that “Red” fella I keep hearing about!
ds:148:212:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ikaw siguro ang “Red” na lagi kong naririnig!

ds:148:215:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Keep up that rolling and I’ll see ya for the next race!
ds:148:215:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ipagpatuloy mo ang paggulong at magkita tayo sa susunod na karera!

ds:148:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s a good lad. First to the end of this grassy stretch wins!
ds:148:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ganyan nga. Panalo ang unang makarating sa dulo ng damuhang ito!

ds:148:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, sa susunod na lang, pare! Sa susunod!

ds:148:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah pare, hindi ka man lang nagsisikap!

ds:148:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m gonna teach you somethin, and we can have another go next time, yeah?
ds:148:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May ituturo ako sa 'yo, tapos subukan natin ulit sa susunod, ha?

ds:148:227:Dialogue Text.source: Player prompted to Press button to roll. Roll 3 times (Lock camera? If Red moves too far, have the Squirrel call after him and return him or something.)
ds:148:227:Dialogue Text.target: Player prompted to Press button to roll. Roll 3 times (Lock camera? If Red moves too far, have the Squirrel call after him and return him or something.)

ds:148:228:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]O! Magandang porma! Akin na ang lapa mo, pare!

ds:148:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Ah, say mate. I may have broken a big racer rule.
ds:148:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Ah, pare. Baka may nilabag akong malaking tuntunin sa karera.

ds:148:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t race if you aren’t on a first-name basis!
ds:148:230:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Huwag makipagkarera kung hindi pa kayo magkakilala sa pangalan!

ds:148:232:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let’s see it Red! Give us a couple good rolls!
ds:148:232:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ipakita mo, Red! Gumulong ka nang maayos, mga dalawang beses!

ds:149:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh you know me, dear. I’m not picky at all.
ds:149:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh, kilala mo ako, mahal. Hindi ako mapili.

ds:149:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll always have a soft spot for you boys, of course!
ds:149:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Siyempre, may espesyal na puwang sa puso ko ang mga lalaki!

ds:149:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I can get down with anyone!
ds:149:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero kaya kong makipagtalik sa kahit sino!

ds:149:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Gusto ko lang magpapilipit ng mga nilalang!

ds:150:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero sa seks, handa ako sa kahit ano!

ds:150:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Perhaps I’m just super open minded, but I think it’s because I’ve been in the game for so long.
ds:150:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Baka napakabukas lang ng isip ko, pero sa tingin ko, dahil napakatagal ko na sa larong 'to.

ds:150:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can appreciate almost anything these days!
ds:150:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Halos kahit ano, kaya kong pahalagahan ngayon!

ds:150:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Scarlett has had a ton of fun pegging me in the past, and she’s been known to surprise me with some male partners from time to time!
ds:150:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Napakasaya ni Scarlett sa pegging sa 'kin noon, at paminsan-minsan, sinusorpresa niya ako ng ilang kaparehang lalaki!

ds:150:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I suppose I’m bi? Really anything Scarlett plans, I’m into.
ds:150:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bi yata ako? Anumang plano ni Scarlett, gusto ko.

ds:150:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Perhaps I’m just Scarlett-Sexual – That’s a thing, right?
ds:150:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Baka Scarlett-Seksuwal lang ako – May ganoon, di ba?

ds:151:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m good with whatever. So long as they can keep up.
ds:151:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayos sa 'kin ang kahit ano. Basta kayang sumabay.

ds:151:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I think I lean more towards female partners…
ds:151:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero sa tingin ko, mas nakahilig ako sa mga kaparehang babae…

ds:152:168:Dialogue Text.source: BEAVER LORE UNLOCKED - Dildos made out of wood?
ds:152:168:Dialogue Text.target: BEAVER LORE UNLOCKED - Dildos made out of wood?

ds:152:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s got all the right curves, and just enough girth to really fill ya up!
ds:152:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tamang-tama ang mga kurba, at sapat ang kapal para mapuno ka talaga!

ds:152:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So what’s the deal, you give him a toy and he’ll fetch the wood?
ds:152:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya ano'ng usapan, bibigyan mo siya ng laruan at kukunin niya ang kahoy?

ds:152:182:Dialogue Text.source: No, I’m trading the toy for a pair of floaties!
ds:152:182:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi, ipinagpapalit ko ang laruan sa isang pares ng mga salbabidang isinusuot!

ds:152:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah, Red, I feel bad for making you go through all this for me.
ds:152:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah Red, nahihiya ako na pinadaan kita sa lahat ng ito para sa akin.

ds:152:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can’t tell you how much I appreciate it!
ds:152:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ko masabi kung gaano ko pinahahalagahan 'yon!

ds:152:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure those floaties will come in handy, but I feel I asked a lot of you.
ds:152:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sigurado akong magagamit mo ang mga salbabidang 'yon, pero parang sobra ang hiningi ko sa 'yo.

ds:152:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll be sure to make it up to you somehow!
ds:152:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Titiyakin kong makakabawi ako sa 'yo kahit papaano!

ds:153:19:Dialogue Text.source: One could only guess what it might mean.
ds:153:19:Dialogue Text.target: Mahuhulaan lang kung ano ang maaaring kahulugan.

ds:154:18:Dialogue Text.source: A monument of some sort, covered by mysterious inscriptions and strange glyphs.
ds:154:18:Dialogue Text.target: Isang uri ng monumento, puno ng mahiwagang inskripsiyon at kakaibang glipo.

ds:154:19:Dialogue Text.source: One can only guess what it might mean.
ds:154:19:Dialogue Text.target: Mahuhulaan lang kung ano ang maaaring kahulugan.

ds:156:18:Dialogue Text.source: A broom to keep the workshop neat and tidy.
ds:156:18:Dialogue Text.target: Walis para panatilihing malinis at maayos ang pagawaan.

ds:157:18:Dialogue Text.source: Paint, to give wooden carvings a splash of color.
ds:157:18:Dialogue Text.target: Pintura, para bigyan ng kulay ang mga ukit na kahoy.

ds:158:18:Dialogue Text.target: Hmmmm, ano kaya ang nasa ilalim nito?

ds:159:18:Dialogue Text.source: A nice big stack of building materials.
ds:159:18:Dialogue Text.target: Isang magandang malaking tumpok ng mga materyales na pangtayo.

ds:15:128:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maligayang pagdating sa Serbisyo ko sa Paglalakbay!

ds:15:82:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maligayang pagdating sa Serbisyo ko sa Paglalakbay!

ds:15:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Come back… next game update or something…
ds:15:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bumalik ka… sa susunod na update ng laro o ganoon…

ds:160:18:Dialogue Text.source: This workbench has surely seen a lot of use!
ds:160:18:Dialogue Text.target: Tiyak na napakadalas nang gamitin ang mesang-gawaan na 'to!

ds:161:18:Dialogue Text.source: A sturdy wooden masterpiece in the making!
ds:161:18:Dialogue Text.target: Isang matibay na obra maestrang kahoy na ginagawa!

ds:162:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, I’m more of a lady’s man.

ds:162:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I’ve been known to fool around from time to time…

ds:162:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Why Red, you wanna get it on?

ds:162:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I can’t fraternize with the clients during business hours, that’s very unprofessional.
ds:162:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hindi ako puwedeng makipaglandian sa mga kliyente sa oras ng negosyo, napakadi-propesyonal.

ds:162:277:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi ba mas parang magkatrabaho tayo?

ds:162:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]What kind of boss would I be!

ds:162:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But in all seriousness, we’ll have to fool around sometime. I can introduce you to some friends later.
ds:162:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero seryoso, kailangan nating maglaro minsan. Maipakikilala kita sa ilang kaibigan mamaya.

ds:163:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m definitely into guys! Especially the larger ones!
ds:163:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tiyak na gusto ko ang mga lalaki! Lalo na ang mas malalaki!

ds:163:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can appreciate a lady’s touch for sure.
ds:163:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mapahahalagahan ko naman ang haplos ng isang babae.

ds:163:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But there’s something about a guy that you can’t quite replace!
ds:163:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero may kung ano sa lalaki na hindi mapalitan!

ds:164:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The sweetest lil’ guy anyone could ask for!
ds:164:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang pinakamagiliw na munting lalaking mahihiling ng kahit sino!

ds:164:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]He’s a fancy folk from far away - but he couldn’t resist my classic country charm!
ds:164:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sosyal siya, mula sa malayo - pero hindi niya nalabanan ang klasikong alindog ko bilang probinsiyana!

ds:164:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nagpakasal kami ilang dekada na ang nakalipas…

ds:164:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1](Dalawampu't pitong taon, pero sino ba ang nagbibilang)

ds:164:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And have been happily together ever since!

ds:164:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nagtatrabaho siyang tagapangalap at tagamanman ng bayan!

ds:164:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He basically scrounges up whatever odds and ends that he can find.
ds:164:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nangangalap siya ng anumang sari-saring bagay na mahanap niya.

ds:164:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maverick gathers stuff that floats from the river, and my husband gathers stuff on land.
ds:164:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tinitipon ni Maverick ang mga lumulutang mula sa ilog, at ang asawa ko naman, sa lupa.

ds:164:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He’ll be away for days at a time though…
ds:164:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero ilang araw siyang nawawala sa bawat lakad…

ds:164:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though, he should be coming back soon!

ds:165:145:Dialogue Text.source: I noticed there’s a crib in your house?
ds:165:145:Dialogue Text.target: Napansin kong may kuna sa bahay mo?

ds:165:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yes, it’s hard to get rid of something so precious!
ds:165:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, mahirap itapon ang isang bagay na napakahalaga!

ds:165:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I wouldn’t imagine you’ve had critters of your own?
ds:165:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi ko maisip na may mga sarili ka nang anak?

ds:165:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha, yes I figured a youngin’ like yourself wouldn’t be strapped down yet.
ds:165:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, oo, naisip kong hindi pa nakatali ang isang binatang tulad mo.

ds:165:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve had a few litters over the years, but I don’t plan on having any more.
ds:165:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa paglipas ng mga taon, ilang beses na akong nanganak ng magkakasabay na mga anak, pero wala na akong balak pang manganak.

ds:165:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gettin’ pretty old these days, haha…

ds:165:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So I just mother all the critters here!
ds:165:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya inaaruga ko na lang na parang ina ang lahat ng nilalang dito!

ds:165:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Lahat kayong mas bata sa akin, kahit paano!

ds:166:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I grew up on a farm, so some of the old habits die hard.
ds:166:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lumaki ako sa bukid, kaya mahirap alisin ang ilang lumang nakasanayan.

ds:166:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Plus, once you’ve lived on fresh produce, you can’t go back!
ds:166:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Isa pa, kapag nasanay ka sa sariwang ani, hindi ka na makababalik!

ds:167:161:Dialogue Text.target: May alam kang makakatas na balita?

ds:167:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And so many critters talk to me about everything, so I’m VERY in the know!
ds:167:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At napakaraming nilalang ang kumakausap sa 'kin tungkol sa lahat, kaya NAPAKARAMI kong alam!

ds:167:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Word gets around here quickly, and I’m probably mostly to blame…
ds:167:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mabilis kumalat ang balita rito, at malamang, ako ang may pinakamalaking kasalanan…

ds:167:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gustong-gusto ko lang ang makakatas na detalye!

ds:167:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I probably have too much time on my hands…

ds:167:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Fortunately, this makes me a great resource!
ds:167:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Buti, dahil dito, napakahusay kong mapagkukunan ng impormasyon!

ds:167:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]If ya need help or information on anything, I can probably help!
ds:167:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kung may kailangan kang tulong o impormasyon sa kahit ano, malamang makatutulong ako!

ds:168:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We don’t really have a ‘leader’ or anything.

ds:168:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I tend to take on a majority of the responsibilities or mishaps.
ds:168:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero ako ang madalas sumasalo sa karamihan ng responsibilidad o aberya.

ds:168:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Like organizing events, or if our town is having problems, or whatever.
ds:168:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Gaya ng pag-oorganisa ng mga gawain, o kapag may problema ang bayan natin, o anuman.

ds:168:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Like when the critters found you! They brought you to me!
ds:168:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gaya nang makita ka ng mga nilalang! Dinala ka nila sa 'kin!

ds:168:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some say I’m good at organizin’ ‘n seeing the big picture…
ds:168:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sabi ng ilan, mahusay akong mag-organisa at makita ang kabuuan…

ds:168:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I just like to think I’m taking care of my family!
ds:168:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero gusto ko lang isipin na inaalagaan ko ang pamilya ko!

ds:169:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]He and I have been neighbors forever. He’s so helpful and handy!
ds:169:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Napakatagal na naming magkapitbahay. Napakamatulungin at napakahusay niya!

ds:169:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve had him over many times to fix up the house! He’s always happy to be of service.
ds:169:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maraming beses ko na siyang pinapunta para magkumpuni ng bahay! Lagi siyang masayang tumulong.

ds:169:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Despite him favoring the male critters, he used to swing with my husband and I back in the day!
ds:169:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kahit mas gusto niya ang mga lalaking nilalang, dati rin siyang nakikisalo ng kapareha sa aming mag-asawa!

ds:169:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s clear he was in it more for my husband, but he was a gentleman to me all the same!
ds:169:193:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Malinaw na mas para sa asawa ko siya roon, pero maginoo pa rin siya sa 'kin!

ds:169:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]All this talk has got me craving beaver…
ds:169:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa dami ng kuwentuhan, nananabik tuloy ako sa beaver…

ds:169:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]…at hindi puki ang ibig kong sabihin!

ds:16:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Must be losin’ my damn marbles.
ds:16:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Tila nasisiraan na ako ng bait.

ds:16:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What the Devil?! Did you just WALK across that water???
ds:16:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ano ito?! LUMAKAD ka ba sa ibabaw ng tubig???

ds:16:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This has to be some sort of dream!
ds:16:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tiyak na isang uri ito ng panaginip!

ds:16:82:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What the Devil?! Did you just WALK across that water???
ds:16:82:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ano ito?! LUMAKAD ka ba sa ibabaw ng tubig???

ds:16:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This has to be some sort of dream!
ds:16:83:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tiyak na isang uri ito ng panaginip!

ds:16:88:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nope. I will not speak to you. You are a figment of my imagination.
ds:16:88:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hindi. Hindi kita kakausapin. Isa kang likha ng aking guniguni.

ds:170:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Aww isn’t that plant just the cutest lil thing?
ds:170:197:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aww, hindi ba napakakyut na munting bagay ng halamang 'yon?

ds:170:198:Dialogue Text.source: All it wants to do is please and be pleased!
ds:170:198:Dialogue Text.target: Ang gusto lang, magpasarap at masarapan!

ds:170:200:Dialogue Text.source: You can rub under its chin, (Er… bulb?) and it coos and purrs. Ah I can’t handle it!
ds:170:200:Dialogue Text.target: Mahihimas mo ang ilalim ng baba nito, (Er… bulbo?) at humuhuni at umuungol ito nang mahina. Ah, hindi ko kaya!

ds:170:202:Dialogue Text.source: It actually has quite the submissive side…
ds:170:202:Dialogue Text.target: May panig din itong mahilig magpaubaya ng kontrol…

ds:170:204:Dialogue Text.source: The first few times I visited the plant, it was doing all the pluggin’.
ds:170:204:Dialogue Text.target: Sa unang ilang pagdalaw ko sa halaman, ito ang gumagawa ng lahat ng pagpasok.

ds:170:205:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But one day, I accidentally pulled a little leaf off?
ds:170:205:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero isang araw, hindi ko sinasadyang nabunot ang isang munting dahon?

ds:170:206:Dialogue Text.source: And it immediately went into a more submissive mode!
ds:170:206:Dialogue Text.target: At agad itong lumipat sa paraang mas nagpapaubaya ng kontrol!

ds:170:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]At first I thought I hurt the poor fella, but it was churring and purring even more!
ds:170:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Noong una, akala ko nasaktan ko ang kawawa, pero lalo pa itong humuhuni at kumukurungkong!

ds:170:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Once in the submissive mode, it presents a lil flower receptacle area.
ds:170:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kapag nagpapaubaya na ng kontrol, inihaharap nito ang munting bahaging sisidlang bulaklak.

ds:170:209:Dialogue Text.source: Oozing and wet with anticipation, it’s… adorable.
ds:170:209:Dialogue Text.target: Tumutulo at basa sa pananabik, ito ay… kaibig-ibig.

ds:170:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]First time, I just gave it the good ole’ rubbin, which it loved.
ds:170:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa unang beses, hinimas ko lang nang mabuti, na gustong-gusto nito.

ds:170:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Then I started getting more venturous putting my whole paw inside! It shivered and coo’d!
ds:170:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapos, naging mas mapangahas ako at ipinasok ang buong lapa ko! Nanginig ito at humuni!

ds:170:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Nowadays, I’ll take a strap-on to the ole’ plant, and go to town!
ds:170:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ngayon, dinadalhan ko ng strap-on ang halaman, at todo-todo!

ds:170:215:Dialogue Text.source: It gets all cuddly afterward too. Ah!

ds:170:216:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oops. Libog na libog na tuloy ako.

ds:170:217:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Anywho, give that a try with the plant next time ya see em!
ds:170:217:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Basta, subukan mo 'yon sa halaman sa susunod mong pagkakita!

ds:171:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Penny is a hoot! I love that girl!
ds:171:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Napakasaya ni Penny! Mahal ko ang babaeng 'yon!

ds:171:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Her and I go pretty far back, I remember when she had her first clutch of eggs!
ds:171:221:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Matagal na kaming magkakilala, naaalala ko pa ang una niyang pangkat ng mga itlog!

ds:171:222:Dialogue Text.source: Being a parent is never easy, and your first will be the hardest.
ds:171:222:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi madaling maging magulang, at ang una ang magiging pinakamahirap.

ds:171:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I helped her a lot when it came to watching the kids!
ds:171:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Malaki ang naitulong ko sa pagbabantay sa mga bata!

ds:171:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now a days, we’ll have our occasional gal’ time hanging out.
ds:171:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ngayon, paminsan-minsan kaming tumatambay nang kaming mga babae lang.

ds:171:225:Dialogue Text.source: We’re big gossip buddies, since she’s also seeing all the critters everyday.
ds:171:225:Dialogue Text.target: Talagang magkabarkada kami sa kuwentuhan, dahil araw-araw din niyang nakikita ang lahat ng nilalang.

ds:171:227:Dialogue Text.source: Penny and I used to have our flings all the time!
ds:171:227:Dialogue Text.target: Dati, lagi kaming naglalaro ni Penny!

ds:171:228:Dialogue Text.source: She’s got a lil’ get-away nest up in the mountains here, with a gorgeous view…
ds:171:228:Dialogue Text.target: May munting takasang pugad siya sa kabundukan dito, na napakaganda ng tanawin…

ds:171:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’d go up there on summer nights and cuddle under the stars…
ds:171:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Umaakyat kami roon sa mga gabi ng tag-araw at nagyayakapan sa ilalim ng mga bituin…

ds:171:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]One thing leads to another, and I’m tossing tongues with a beak! Who’d a thought!
ds:171:230:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tuloy-tuloy ang mga pangyayari, at nakikipaglaplapan ako sa isang tuka! Sino ang mag-aakala!

ds:171:231:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Then before ya know it, I’ve got my arm deep in cloaca!
ds:171:231:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapos, bago mo namalayan, malalim na ang braso ko sa kloaka!

ds:171:232:Dialogue Text.source: Now that’s a trip, let me tell you haha! Very strong muscles down there!
ds:171:232:Dialogue Text.target: Matinding karanasan 'yon, sinasabi ko sa 'yo, haha! Napakalakas ng mga kalamnan sa ibaba!

ds:171:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Could never quite tell if I was in the right hole or not…
ds:171:233:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi ko matukoy kung nasa tamang butas ako o hindi…

ds:171:234:Dialogue Text.source: …Though with Penny it seems like any hole is the right hole!
ds:171:234:Dialogue Text.target: …Pero kay Penny, mukhang anumang butas ay tamang butas!

ds:171:236:Dialogue Text.source: I could use more gal time…
ds:171:236:Dialogue Text.target: Gusto ko pang maglaan ng oras na kaming mga babae lang…

ds:172:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Heh, I’m as gay as they come, Rascal!

ds:172:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Not to say I don’t know my way around a female…
ds:172:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi sa hindi ako marunong sa babae…

ds:172:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But I definitely prefer the company of males!
ds:172:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero tiyak na mas gusto ko ang mga lalaki!

ds:173:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I prefer male partners most of the time.
ds:173:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mas gusto ko ang mga kaparehang lalaki sa karamihan ng pagkakataon.

ds:173:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Of course, I’m open to anyone wanting to experience my… unique attributes…
ds:173:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Siyempre, bukas ako sa sinumang nais makaranas ng aking… natatanging katangian…

ds:173:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But especially regarding romantic partners, it’s male for me!
ds:173:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Ngunit lalo na pagdating sa pag-ibig, lalaki para sa akin!

ds:174:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo naman, ako ang tagakumpuni rito sa paligid!

ds:174:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m in charge of a buncha maintenance, and general improvements.
ds:174:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ako ang namamahala sa maraming pagpapanatili at pangkalahatang pagpapahusay.

ds:174:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a tough job, but very satisfying!
ds:174:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mahirap na trabaho, pero napakasarap sa pakiramdam!

ds:174:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A majority of the things in town were done by yours truly!
ds:174:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ako mismo ang gumawa ng karamihan sa mga bagay sa bayan!

ds:175:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve been in the dildo making business for years!
ds:175:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ilang taon na ako sa negosyo ng paggawa ng dildo!

ds:175:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a very fun process, and very SATISFYING afterward!

ds:175:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s been a little bit since I’ve spent some time on sculptures though…
ds:175:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero medyo matagal-tagal na mula nang gumawa ako ng mga eskultura…

ds:175:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve been doing mainly larger projects for the town these days.
ds:175:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mas malalaking proyekto para sa bayan ang ginagawa ko ngayon.

ds:175:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It sure would be nice to get back into it that’s for sure…

ds:175:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Maverick’s toy was such a blast to make!

ds:176:148:Dialogue Text.source: I take it you like anal?
ds:176:148:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang gusto mo ang seks sa puwit?

ds:176:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s just say mahogony isn’t my favorite type of wood… heh…
ds:176:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabihin na lang nating hindi mahogany ang paborito kong uri ng kahoy… heh…

ds:176:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]As you could guess, I’ve made a large variety of my own toys.
ds:176:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Gaya ng mahuhulaan mo, nakagawa na ako ng iba't ibang sarili kong laruan.

ds:176:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]BUT - My favorite is when someone’s going down on me.
ds:176:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]PERO - Ang paborito ko, kapag may nagpapasarap sa 'kin gamit ang bibig.

ds:176:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The bigger the boys, the better too! Get in there real deep!
ds:176:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mas malalaking lalaki, mas mabuti rin! Malalim talaga ang pasok!

ds:177:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Me and the gator had a thing a while ago.
ds:177:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May namagitan sa 'min ng alligator noong nakaraan.

ds:177:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Other than that, I’ve been with a lot of bears in the past!
ds:177:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bukod doon, marami na akong nakasamang oso noon!

ds:177:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Somethin’ ‘bout those big ole critters gets me going…
ds:177:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May kung ano sa malalaking nilalang na 'yon na nagpapagana sa 'kin…

ds:177:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho, I’ve done my fair share of dating and mating back in the day…
ds:177:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basta, marami na akong pakikipagtipan at pakikipagtalik noong araw…

ds:177:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]but it has been a lil while…

ds:177:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Napakatagal, haha! Lampas na ako sa takda!

ds:178:157:Dialogue Text.source: You’re cute without the Earrings too!
ds:178:157:Dialogue Text.target: Kyut ka rin kahit walang Hikaw!

ds:179:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I live in the woods to the East of here.

ds:179:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I usually come into town to visit or run errands for the tribe. Er… Family.
ds:179:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Karaniwan, pumupunta ako sa bayan para dumalaw o mag-asikaso ng mga utos ng tribo. Er… Pamilya.

ds:179:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve been eyeing this cute little clearing with some rocks.
ds:179:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tinitingnan ko 'yung kyut na munting maluwang na lugar na may ilang bato.

ds:179:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Could make for a really nice burrow…

ds:180:175:Dialogue Text.target: Mabel ba talaga ang pangalan mo?

ds:180:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]My… People aren’t exactly… Like the rest of you. They’re umm. More old fashioned, I suppose.
ds:180:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang… Mga kababayan ko ay hindi… Gaya n'yong iba. Sila ay, umm. Mas makaluma, siguro.

ds:180:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Liiiiike, they worship the fire… Eeeeek, it’s embarrassing…
ds:180:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Paraaang, sumasamba sila sa apoy… Iiiiik, nakakahiya…

ds:180:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Perhaps… Honestly I like to separate myself from them a majority of the time. That’s why I’m here so often.
ds:180:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Marahil… Sa totoo lang, gusto kong humiwalay sa kanila nang madalas. Kaya lagi akong nandito.

ds:180:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There’s so much more to the world, even this small town is so much bigger than where I’m from!
ds:180:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Napakarami pa sa mundo, kahit ang munting bayang 'to, mas malaki kaysa sa pinanggalingan ko!

ds:180:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Eh! I’m sorry, this probably sounds very lame.

ds:180:184:Dialogue Text.source:
Not at all, the world IS big,
you should explore it if you want.
ds:180:184:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi naman, MALAKI ang mundo,
dapat mong tuklasin kung gusto mo.

ds:180:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah! You get me! That’s the plan for sure!

ds:181:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I suppose that’s not something that matters to me a whole lot!

ds:181:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Doesn’t matter what someone has between their legs, so long as I’m comfortable and a fond of them!
ds:181:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi mahalaga kung ano ang nasa pagitan ng mga binti ng isang tao, basta komportable ako at gusto ko siya!

ds:181:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It can sometimes take me a bit to cozy up though… But I suppose that’s more for romance…
ds:181:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero minsan, matagal bago ako mapalagay… Pero mas sa pag-ibig yata 'yon…

ds:182:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yessir! Proud owner and sole proprietor of the Musky Mustelid!
ds:182:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo naman! Ipinagmamalaki kong ako ang nag-iisang may-ari ng The Musky Mustelid!

ds:182:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re just across the river in that building, see?
ds:182:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nandoon lang kami sa gusaling iyon sa kabilang pampang ng ilog, kita mo?

ds:182:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Recently refurbished too! Thanks to the good ole Bucky!
ds:182:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bagong ayos din! Salamat sa mabuting Bucky!

ds:182:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]His best work yet, I gotta say!

ds:182:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Once the bridge is up, you can give it a proper gander.
ds:182:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kapag ayos na ang tulay, matitingnan mo nang mabuti.

ds:183:143:Dialogue Text.source: Isn’t that name… kind of gross?
ds:183:143:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi ba medyo… nakakadiri ang pangalan?

ds:183:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Red! Are you hating on my store?!
ds:183:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Red! Kinukutya mo ba ang tindahan ko?!

ds:183:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok I’ll admit, it was a much better name when it was a bar…
ds:183:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sige, aaminin ko, mas magandang pangalan 'yon noong bar pa…

ds:183:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But it turns out, none of the critters here are much for drinking!
ds:183:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero hindi pala gaanong mahilig uminom ang mga nilalang dito!

ds:183:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I sold more random Knick knacks and food than I did beer.
ds:183:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mas marami akong naibentang kung anu-anong abubot at pagkain kaysa serbesa.

ds:183:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So I changed our wares and became a general shop!
ds:183:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kaya pinalitan ko ang paninda at ginawa itong tindahan ng sari-saring gamit!

ds:183:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now I sell all sorts of random things I’ve found, and regulate trade around the town!
ds:183:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ngayon, binebenta ko ang kung anu-anong nakikita ko, at pinamamahalaan ang kalakalan sa bayan!

ds:183:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Gotta stay flexible in dire times, Red!
ds:183:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kailangang marunong makibagay sa mahirap na panahon, Red!

ds:184:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s a keepsake for the first job I ever worked!

ds:184:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]A critter should take no greater pride than in their work!
ds:184:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Walang dapat higit na ipagmalaki ng isang nilalang kaysa sa gawa niya!

ds:184:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]My first gig was delivery! And I was damned good at it too!
ds:184:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Paghahatid ang una kong trabaho! At napakahusay ko roon!

ds:184:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve probably started seven or so more ventures since then.
ds:184:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Malamang, mga pito pang negosyo ang nasimulan ko mula noon.

ds:184:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Bawat isa, mas matagumpay kaysa sa nauna!

ds:184:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But keep the hat around to remember the simpler times.
ds:184:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero itinatago ko ang sumbrero para alalahanin ang mas payak na panahon.

ds:185:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m always thinking of ways to provide a service!
ds:185:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lagi akong nag-iisip ng mga paraan para magbigay ng serbisyo!

ds:185:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5](and make a little extra coin on the side.)
ds:185:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5](at kumita ng kaunting dagdag na barya.)

ds:185:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The shop is my 7th venture! Though, it’s technically the 6th repurposed.
ds:185:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ika-7 kong negosyo ang tindahan! Pero teknikal, binagong gamit lang ng ika-6.

ds:185:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I came from a family of Clam Shuckers hence the name.
ds:185:166:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Galing ako sa pamilya ng mga Tagabukas ng Tulya, kaya ganoon ang pangalan.

ds:185:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And all day every day was gathering and shucking clams. It was the worst.
ds:185:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At buong araw, araw-araw, pangangalap at pagbubukas lang ng tulya. Napakasama.

ds:185:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I needed to spread my webs y’know?
ds:185:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kailangan kong ibuka ang mga paang may lamad ko, alam mo?

ds:185:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Plenty of problems to fix, systems to innovate, and coin to make!
ds:185:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Maraming problemang aayusin, sistemang babaguhin, at baryang kikitain!

ds:185:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Like my first gig for example, Delivery! The idea came from the clam business.
ds:185:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Gaya ng una kong negosyo, Paghahatid! Galing sa negosyo ng tulya ang ideya.

ds:185:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Critters would always come to us for clams.
ds:185:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Laging pumupunta sa amin ang mga nilalang para sa mga tulya.

ds:185:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But what if WE came to THEM?
ds:185:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero paano kung KAMI ang pumunta sa KANILA?

ds:185:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And not just for clams, but anything!
ds:185:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At hindi lang para sa tulya, kundi kahit ano!

ds:185:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That was where I got my big start, and I’ve only grown since then.
ds:185:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Doon talaga nagsimula ang pag-asenso ko, at tuloy-tuloy na mula noon.

ds:185:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This little town caught my interest for a number of reasons.
ds:185:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maraming dahilan kaya nakuha ng munting bayang 'to ang interes ko.

ds:185:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s also been the testing grounds for my newest business ventures!
ds:185:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dito ko rin sinusubukan ang mga pinakabago kong negosyo!

ds:185:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Though, it’s not been all glam and success, Red, no sir.
ds:185:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero hindi puro kinang at tagumpay, Red, hindi nga.

ds:185:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Don’t even ask me about Clam Coin…
ds:185:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Huwag mo nang itanong ang Clam Coin…

ds:186:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh man, Red - didn’t I tell ya not to ask me about Clam Coin?
ds:186:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naku, Red - hindi ba sinabi kong huwag mong itanong ang Clam Coin?

ds:186:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a long story, are you sure you want to know?
ds:186:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mahabang kuwento, sigurado kang gusto mong malaman?

ds:186:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That’s what I thought, Red. Don’t open the wound that is Clam Coin.
ds:186:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]'Yan ang akala ko, Red. Huwag mong buksan ang sugat na Clam Coin.

ds:186:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Aight, well now you’re in for it.

ds:186:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Back when delivering was booming - I was still working closely with clams. So I decided, instead of normal trades and deals - why not make a coin.
ds:186:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Noong lumalakas ang paghahatid - malaki pa rin ang bahagi ng mga tulya sa negosyo ko. Kaya naisip ko, sa halip na karaniwang palitan at kasunduan - bakit hindi gumawa ng barya.

ds:186:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This coin can have a “fixed value” and can stand in and be traded for a clam.
ds:186:187:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maaaring may “tiyak na halaga” ang baryang 'to at magsilbing kapalit at maipagpalit sa isang tulya.

ds:186:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well I didn’t make too many clam coins at first. There was maybe… 20 or so in circulation.
ds:186:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi ako gumawa ng maraming clam coin sa una. Parang may… 20 o ganoon ang umiikot.

ds:186:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s a lot more to critters than simple values. This ain’t no 1 + 1 Red, no no no.
ds:186:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Higit pa sa simpleng halaga ang mga nilalang. Hindi 'to 1 + 1, Red, hindi, hindi.

ds:186:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Because everyone wanted these dang coins, Red. Everyone.
ds:186:193:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dahil gusto ng lahat ang lintik na mga baryang 'to, Red. Lahat.

ds:186:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So I had to make more coins.
ds:186:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya kinailangan kong gumawa pa ng barya.

ds:186:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So here I am, slaving away, making coins. Meanwhile, we’ve got a buncha different Critters wanting coins for different reasons.
ds:186:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya heto ako, kayod nang kayod, gumagawa ng barya. Samantala, may kung anu-anong Nilalang na gustong magkaroon ng barya sa iba't ibang dahilan.

ds:186:196:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Critters that actually use the coin to redeem clams. Critters that want the coin just to HAVE it.
ds:186:196:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mga nilalang na talagang nagpapalit ng barya para makakuha ng tulya. Mga nilalang na gusto lang MAGKAROON ng barya.

ds:186:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And a profit indeed did they sell them at.
ds:186:197:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]At kumita nga talaga sila sa pagbebenta.

ds:186:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I didn’t realize it, but I’m giving these clam coins away with the intention that critters will be redeeming 1 clam for them.
ds:186:198:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi ko namalayan, pero ibinibigay ko ang mga clam coin sa layuning ipapalit ng mga nilalang sa 1 tulya.

ds:186:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yet some are turning a single clam coin into much more - 2, 3, 5x the clams worth in value!
ds:186:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero may ilan na ginagawa ang isang clam coin na mas mataas ang halaga - 2, 3, 5x ng halaga ng tulya!

ds:186:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Red I kid you not, some of the very neighbors here have a PROBLEM with finances.
ds:186:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Red, hindi ako nagbibiro, may ilan sa mga kapitbahay rito na may PROBLEMA sa pananalapi.

ds:186:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I don’t wanna name names Red… But a certain “Cotton Tail?” Yeah. She did not come out on top of Clam Coin.
ds:186:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ayokong magbanggit ng pangalan, Red… Pero isang “Cotton Tail?” Oo. Hindi siya ang nanalo sa Clam Coin.

ds:186:270:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a good thing we don’t have real currencies or some critters would be homeless, definitely.
ds:186:270:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Buti wala tayong tunay na mga salapi, kung hindi, may mga nilalang na mawawalan ng bahay, tiyak.

ds:186:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Critters could trade goods for clam coins, and then whenever they want, redeem the clam coins for clams! Easy. Dare I say revolutionary?
ds:186:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maaaring ipagpalit ng mga nilalang ang paninda sa mga clam coin, at kahit kailan nila gusto, ipapalit ang mga clam coin sa mga tulya! Madali. Masasabi ko bang rebolusyonaryo?

ds:186:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And finally, critters who recognize the inflated value of these coins, and have them just to resell the coins at a profit.
ds:186:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At sa huli, mga nilalang na nakapansing lumobo ang halaga ng mga baryang 'to, at nagtatabi para ibenta uli nang may tubo.

ds:187:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hmm, sa tingin ko, halos straight ako…

ds:187:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Er well, I don’t mind male partners, just most of what I have experience with is ladies…
ds:187:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Er, wala naman akong tutol sa mga kaparehang lalaki, karamihan lang ng karanasan ko ay sa mga babae…

ds:187:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, I guess word gets around with the ladies here when you have… some larger assets…
ds:187:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, mabilis yatang kumalat sa mga babae rito ang balita kapag mayroon kang… mas malalaking ari-arian…

ds:187:136:Dialogue Text.source: Hah! Well don’t rub it in!

ds:187:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isa pa, malaki rin naman ang sa 'yo!

ds:188:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Only the greatest athlete you’ve ever seen!

ds:188:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ve placed first in my species countless times!
ds:188:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hindi mabilang ang pagiging una ko sa espesye ko!

ds:188:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Really, countless! I’ve lost count, I have!
ds:188:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Talagang hindi mabilang! Hindi ko na mabilang!

ds:188:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But it’s not about winning, mate - It’s about the growth!
ds:188:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero hindi lang tungkol sa panalo, pare - tungkol sa pag-unlad!

ds:188:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I trained, I learned. I met the right critters who’d help me grow!
ds:188:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nagsanay ako, natuto. Nakilala ko ang tamang mga nilalang na tutulong sa 'king umunlad!

ds:188:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Every step has been a challenge - but it’s welcoming those challenges that makes success.
ds:188:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bawat hakbang, isang hamon - pero ang pagtanggap sa mga hamong 'yon ang nagdudulot ng tagumpay.

ds:189:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Part of training is adapting to different terrains!
ds:189:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bahagi ng pagsasanay ang pag-angkop sa iba't ibang lupain!

ds:189:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See, competitions can happen anywhere, so one must be prepared!
ds:189:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maaaring ganapin ang paligsahan kahit saan, kaya dapat handa!

ds:189:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s important for a competitor to experience and conquer all sorts of terrains.
ds:189:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mahalaga para sa kalahok na maranasan at mapagtagumpayan ang lahat ng uri ng lupain.

ds:189:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Like this area, it’s quite high in altitude!

ds:189:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The air is thinner up here, so pacing is all the more important.
ds:189:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mas manipis ang hangin dito sa itaas, kaya mas mahalagang tantiyahin ang bilis.

ds:189:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Not to mention the dry climate! Which is great for climbing and gripping around.
ds:189:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bukod pa sa tuyong klima! Maganda para sa pag-akyat at pagkapit.

ds:189:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can use everything in my kit without worry!
ds:189:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Magagamit ko ang lahat ng kakayahan ko nang walang alalahanin!

ds:189:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh, and the fans are extra friendly here…
ds:189:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oh, at napakapalakaibigan ng mga tagahanga rito…

ds:18:82:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Red! Hey I got a favor to ask.

ds:18:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard of a rope-oriented bondage that I’d like to try out!
ds:18:83:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May narinig akong paggapos na gumagamit ng tali na nais kong subukan!

ds:18:85:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Problem is I can’t seem to find any ropes that are my size, but comfortable enough.
ds:18:85:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang problema, wala akong makitang taling angkop sa laki ko ngunit sapat na komportable.

ds:18:86:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you can keep an eye out for me?

ds:18:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Any luck on that rope? I’d imagine something like a yarn… or twine…
ds:18:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May suwerte ka ba sa taling iyon? Iniisip ko, katulad ng sinulid… o pisi…

ds:18:88:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I tried fishing-wire, that wasn’t a great idea…
ds:18:88:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sinubukan ko ang linya ng pamingwit, hindi magandang ideya iyon…

ds:190:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Have ya been Gossiping with the critters?
ds:190:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nakikipagkuwentuhan ka na ba sa mga nilalang?

ds:190:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s so many little fun stories to hear!

ds:190:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Not to mention, you can learn a ton about everyone!
ds:190:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bukod pa roon, napakarami mong malalaman tungkol sa lahat!

ds:190:136:Dialogue Text.target: Puwede ko silang tanungin ng kahit ano?

ds:190:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah honestly, the critters are pretty open.
ds:190:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo, sa totoo lang, bukas naman ang mga nilalang.

ds:190:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They might be a lil’ shy, but we’re all here for the same reason.
ds:190:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maaaring medyo mahiyain sila, pero pare-pareho naman ang dahilan kung bakit narito tayo.

ds:190:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Just ask and they’ll be happy to open up!
ds:190:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Magtanong ka lang at masaya silang magbubukas ng loob!

ds:195:135:Dialogue Text.source: How long have you been painting?

ds:195:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh man lil guy, it’s been… ages.

ds:195:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ever since I was a lil’ lamb I’ve been messing with paints!
ds:195:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mula pa noong munting tupa ako, naglalaro na ako ng pintura!

ds:195:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I didn’t take it seriously until I was a proper adult though.
ds:195:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero hindi ko sineryoso hanggang sa ganap na akong adulto.

ds:195:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Then as the years passed, I took it a bit TOO seriously…
ds:195:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapos, sa paglipas ng mga taon, medyo SOBRA ko nang sineryoso…

ds:195:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Fast forward a decade or so and here I am now!
ds:195:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lumipas ang isang dekada o ganoon, at heto na ako ngayon!

ds:195:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Living the dream buddy, livin the dream!
ds:195:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Buhay na pangarap, pare, buhay na pangarap!

ds:196:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah lil’ guy! You would NOT want to meet the old Finley.
ds:196:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo, maliit kong pare! HINDI mo gugustuhing makilala ang dating Finley.

ds:196:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I used to paint landscapes as my main gig.
ds:196:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mga tanawin ang pangunahing ipinipinta ko noon.

ds:196:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Critters would pay top dollar! I made quite a name for myself!
ds:196:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Malaki ang bayad ng mga nilalang! Nakilala talaga ang pangalan ko!

ds:196:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Finley the Fantastic! You may have heard of me…
ds:196:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Finley na Kahanga-hanga! Baka narinig mo na…

ds:196:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And without diving too deep into it, it became a bit of a drag.
ds:196:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At nang hindi na masyadong palalimin, medyo naging pabigat.

ds:196:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eventually, I became a huge ball of stress!
ds:196:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa huli, naging isang malaking bunton ako ng stress!

ds:196:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll do the occasional Plen’ Air once in a while.
ds:196:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Paminsan-minsan, nagpipinta ako sa labas, sa harap ng mismong tanawin.

ds:196:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I don’t work with clients anymore.
ds:196:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero hindi na ako nagtatrabaho para sa mga kliyente.

ds:196:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now, I paint for me, ya dig?
ds:196:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ngayon, nagpipinta ako para sa 'kin, nakuha mo?

ds:197:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You’d like to know more about this piece?
ds:197:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gusto mo pang malaman ang tungkol sa obrang 'to?

ds:197:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]As I said, 5 Years ago, I changed my life.
ds:197:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gaya ng sabi ko, 5 Taon na ang nakalipas, binago ko ang buhay ko.

ds:197:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s when I decided to stop painting for others.
ds:197:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Doon ko piniling tumigil sa pagpipinta para sa iba.

ds:197:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]For so long, I always painted for a purpose.
ds:197:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa napakatagal na panahon, lagi akong nagpipinta para sa isang layunin.

ds:197:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]There was always a reason behind a stroke of paint, or the position of a tree.
ds:197:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Laging may dahilan sa likod ng isang hagod ng pintura, o puwesto ng isang puno.

ds:197:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I was very good, but I longed for something more.
ds:197:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Napakahusay ko, pero may hinahanap pa akong higit.

ds:197:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And that’s when I realized that I wasn’t painting for the sake of art, or myself.
ds:197:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Doon ko napagtantong hindi ako nagpipinta para sa sining, o para sa sarili ko.

ds:197:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Every year on this day, I paint SOMETHING for no other reason but to paint.
ds:197:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bawat taon sa araw na 'to, nagpipinta ako ng KUNG ANO nang walang ibang dahilan kundi magpinta.

ds:197:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That is the meaning behind this piece: the lack of purpose, due to decades of needing one.
ds:197:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iyon ang kahulugan ng obrang 'to: ang kawalan ng layunin, dahil ilang dekadang kailangan ko 'yon.

ds:198:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Every year around this time, the Coyote gals’ pay me a visit, and trim my wool.
ds:198:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bawat taon sa ganitong panahon, dinadalaw ako ng mga babaeng Coyote at ginugupitan ng lana.

ds:198:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Keeps me cooler during the season, and gives my fellow creatives some supplies!
ds:198:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mas presko ako sa panahong 'to, at nabibigyan ng panustos ang kapwa ko malikhaing nilalang!

ds:198:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But since the bridge has been out, They haven’t had the opportunity to come by.
ds:198:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero dahil sira ang tulay, wala silang pagkakataong dumaan.

ds:198:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s been a drag for sure, but it is what it is.

ds:198:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I spend a lot of time in the shade when I can.

ds:198:174:Dialogue Text.source: Why not go up the mountain?
ds:198:174:Dialogue Text.target: Bakit hindi ka umakyat sa bundok?

ds:198:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok lil’ guy, between you and me…
ds:198:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sige, maliit kong pare, sa atin lang…

ds:198:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]there’s a couple critters up there that I used to live with.
ds:198:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]may dalawang nilalang doon na dati kong kasama sa tirahan.

ds:198:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Cool critters, but not exactly… Chill, ya feel me?
ds:198:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Astig na mga nilalang, pero hindi gaanong… Relaks, nauunawaan mo?

ds:199:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah man, you’re bound to meet them if you stick around!
ds:199:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, pare, tiyak na makikilala mo kung mananatili ka!

ds:199:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]One’s a fox and one’s a bear.

ds:199:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Quite the pair if you ask me!

ds:199:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May nakasama ka na ba sa tirahan, Rascal?

ds:199:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Then you know how it goes man.
ds:199:187:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kung ganoon, alam mo kung paano, pare.

ds:199:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Some folks are great as friends, but absolutely terrible roommates.
ds:199:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]May mga taong napakahusay na kaibigan, pero napakasamang kasama sa tirahan.

ds:199:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Take it from me, man. It’s the dream.

ds:19:82:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Red! Hey I got a favor to ask.

ds:19:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard of a rope-oriented bondage that I’d like to try out!
ds:19:83:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May narinig akong paggapos na gumagamit ng tali na gusto kong subukan!

ds:19:85:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Problem is I can’t seem to find any ropes that are my size, but comfortable enough.
ds:19:85:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang problema, wala akong makitang taling angkop sa laki ko pero sapat na komportable.

ds:19:86:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you can keep an eye out for me?

ds:19:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Any luck on that rope? I’d imagine something like a yarn… or twine…
ds:19:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May suwerte ka ba sa taling 'yon? Iniisip ko, parang sinulid… o pisi…

ds:19:88:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I tried fishing-wire, that wasn’t a great idea…
ds:19:88:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sinubukan ko ang linya ng pamingwit, hindi magandang ideya 'yon…

ds:200:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh heh, I’m a bottom through and through!
ds:200:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, heh, bottom ako mula ulo hanggang paa!

ds:200:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I can take charge, for sure. But I’m most comfortable when I’m receiving!
ds:200:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kaya kong manguna, siyempre. Pero pinakakomportable ako kapag tumatanggap!

ds:201:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]“This place is full of critters banging 24/7” etcetera etcetera.
ds:201:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]“Puno ang lugar na ito ng mga nilalang na nagtatalik 24/7,” at iba pa.

ds:201:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well the rumors aren’t entirely false, they are, however, mistimed.
ds:201:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hindi naman lubusang mali ang mga usap-usapan, mali lamang ang panahon.

ds:201:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Rumors carry some weight, you see. To some extent, they are often built on truth.
ds:201:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]May bigat ang mga usap-usapan. Sa isang antas, madalas silang nakabatay sa katotohanan.

ds:201:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though as you’ve seen around you, that doesn’t particularly seem to be the case now.
ds:201:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ngunit gaya ng nakikita mo sa paligid, hindi ganoon ang kalagayan ngayon.

ds:201:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And I’ve lived here many years, and I can assure you, it’s quite the normal town.
ds:201:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Maraming taon na akong nakatira rito, at matitiyak kong karaniwang bayan ito.

ds:201:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The history of these parts goes quite deep.
ds:201:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Napakalalim ng kasaysayan ng mga pook na ito.

ds:202:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You may have spotted a few runes/glyphs here ‘n there yes?
ds:202:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Maaaring may nakita ka nang ilang runa/glipo sa paligid, oo?

ds:202:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Some of the critters have taken a few as souvenirs, I’ve got quite a few myself.
ds:202:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kumuha ang ilang nilalang bilang alaala, at marami rin ako.

ds:202:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]To the West of here is an even larger collection of ancient history.
ds:202:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa kanluran nito ay may mas malaking kalipunan ng sinaunang kasaysayan.

ds:202:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]The ruins have scriptures, symbols, and signs of architecture from long before our time.
ds:202:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]May mga kasulatan, simbolo, at bakas ng arkitektura ang mga guho mula pa bago ang ating panahon.

ds:202:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]A lot remains unclear about the history here…
ds:202:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Marami pa ring malabo sa kasaysayan dito…

ds:202:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But the fact remains that this place was something special.
ds:202:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ngunit nananatiling katotohanan na espesyal ang lugar na ito.

ds:203:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve done a fair share of transcribing the writings, as best as I can at least.
ds:203:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Marami na akong kinopya sa mga sulatin, sa abot ng makakaya ko, kahit paano.

ds:203:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It appears their language had something more to it than simply speech…
ds:203:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Mukhang may higit pa sa simpleng pagsasalita ang kanilang wika…

ds:203:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I believe the scriptures are not complete on their own… but simply, an aid.
ds:203:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naniniwala akong hindi kumpleto ang mga kasulatan nang mag-isa… kundi isang pantulong lamang.

ds:203:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So without the missing pieces, what we end up having is a small fraction of the story.
ds:203:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kaya kung wala ang nawawalang mga bahagi, napakaliit na bahagi lamang ng kuwento ang mayroon tayo.

ds:203:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Unfortunately, the few things I have gathered basically confirm the rumors.
ds:203:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa kasamaang-palad, pinatutunayan ng ilang nakalap ko ang mga usap-usapan.

ds:203:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Critters of all kinds gathered here to share delight in pleasures of the flesh.
ds:203:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nagtipon dito ang lahat ng uri ng nilalang upang pagsaluhan ang mga ligaya ng laman.

ds:203:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Is there something more we aren’t seeing?
ds:203:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May higit pa bang hindi natin nakikita?

ds:203:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]There was almost a system involved. Intent.

ds:203:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So I believe it was some method of paying tribute… or worship…
ds:203:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kaya naniniwala akong isang paraan ito ng pagpupugay… o pagsamba…

ds:204:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No doubt you’ve seen a few reoccurring glyphs around.
ds:204:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Walang dudang may nakita ka nang ilang paulit-ulit na glipo sa paligid.

ds:204:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]These, I’ve gathered, are representations of areas.
ds:204:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa nakalap ko, mga larawan ang mga ito ng mga lugar.

ds:204:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The nearby surrounding biomes of the town no doubt.
ds:204:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Walang dudang ang mga biyomang nakapaligid sa bayan.

ds:204:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But what is their significance? What is the purpose?
ds:204:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ngunit ano ang kabuluhan? Ano ang layunin?

ds:204:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Perhaps it was merely an early indication of cartography?
ds:204:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Marahil, isa lamang maagang palatandaan ng paggawa ng mapa?

ds:204:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The problem is we don’t know how primitive, or even advanced, this society was.
ds:204:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang problema, hindi natin alam kung gaano kakulang sa pag-unlad, o gaano kaasenso, ang lipunang ito.

ds:204:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Investigating the surrounding areas has proved fruitless in this matter.
ds:204:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Walang naibungang sagot sa bagay na ito ang pagsisiyasat sa paligid.

ds:205:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Barnaby and I - Er Bucky as you know him, are the eldest in town.
ds:205:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kami ni Barnaby - Er, Bucky ang pagkakakilala mo sa kaniya, ang pinakamatatanda sa bayan.

ds:205:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But when we arrived, the inhabitants were clueless of the history here.
ds:205:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ngunit pagdating namin, walang alam ang mga naninirahan tungkol sa kasaysayan dito.

ds:205:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]In fact, “The Forest of Love” wasn’t even the name of this area.
ds:205:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa katunayan, hindi pa “Ang Gubat ng Pag-ibig” ang pangalan ng pook na ito.

ds:205:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The rumors formed, and the name was derived from the rumors.
ds:205:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nabuo ang mga usap-usapan, at mula sa mga ito ang pangalan.

ds:205:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]From what I’ve gathered, the original name of the area is in a tongue long forgotten.
ds:205:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa nakalap ko, nasa isang matagal nang nakalimutang wika ang orihinal na pangalan ng pook.

ds:205:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I believe the mysteries of this area go much beyond generations.
ds:205:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naniniwala akong lampas sa mga henerasyon ang mga hiwaga ng lugar na ito.

ds:205:185:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It takes a long time for a culture to establish, die out, and be nearly forgotten.
ds:205:185:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Matagal bago maitatag ang kultura, maglaho, at halos malimutan.

ds:205:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mga panahon ang usapan. Mga siglo. Marahil, libu-libong taon!

ds:206:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Him and I were mates some time ago.

ds:206:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]We have our differences, and Barnaby wasn’t particularly too keen on a lot of mine…
ds:206:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]May mga pagkakaiba kami, at marami sa mga katangian ko ang hindi gaanong gusto ni Barnaby…

ds:206:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See, I’m quite dedicated to my studies.

ds:206:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Barnaby is a fine fellow, but he was never one to handle social conflicts too well.
ds:206:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mabuting lalaki si Barnaby, ngunit hindi siya mahusay humarap sa alitan sa kapwa.

ds:206:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And I’m not exactly one to talk about my own needs or wants too often…
ds:206:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]At hindi rin naman ako madalas magsalita tungkol sa sarili kong pangangailangan o kagustuhan…

ds:206:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll take a book over a critter any day!
ds:206:197:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pipiliin ko ang libro kaysa sa nilalang anumang araw!

ds:207:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]When it comes to other folks, I really just want them to take the lead.
ds:207:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pagdating sa iba, gusto ko talagang sila ang manguna.

ds:207:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Though, a lot of that might be due to some insecurities I have with my uh, body parts…
ds:207:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero baka marami roon ay dahil sa mga pangamba ko sa aking, uh, mga bahagi ng katawan…

ds:207:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A lot of folks see a beak and sharp claws, and don’t want that going near their sensitive bits…
ds:207:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Marami ang nakakakita ng tuka at matatalas na kuko, at ayaw nilang lumapit ang mga 'yon sa maseselang bahagi nila…

ds:207:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I’m very gentle and have a lot of finesse!

ds:207:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I mean, I’ve been using them on myself for years, you pick up a thing or two, bahaw!
ds:207:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Parang, ilang taon ko nang ginagamit sa sarili ko, may natututuhan ka rin, bahaw!

ds:207:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Gayunman, nauunawaan ko ang pangamba ng iba.

ds:207:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Plus, I really don’t mind other critters doing most of the work!
ds:207:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Isa pa, wala talaga akong tutol na ibang nilalang ang gumagawa ng karamihan!

ds:208:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]When I’m able to, I love being in control and giving critters the attention they deserve!
ds:208:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kapag kaya ko, gustong-gusto kong kumontrol at bigyan ang mga nilalang ng pansing nararapat sa kanila!

ds:208:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Other times, I’m happy to go along for the ride!
ds:208:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa ibang pagkakataon, masaya akong sumabay na lang!

ds:208:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Really just depends! I like for the bigger partner to take the reins.
ds:208:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Depende talaga! Gusto kong ang mas malaking kapareha ang manguna.

ds:208:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But likewise, I’m happy to take the reins for smaller partners! Like with our little Mabel!
ds:208:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero ganoon din, masaya akong manguna para sa mas maliliit na kapareha! Gaya ng munting Mabel natin!

ds:209:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Bahaw! Got a ring to it dont’cha think? Thought of it myself!
ds:209:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bahaw! Ang sarap pakinggan, di ba? Ako ang nakaisip!

ds:209:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]These parts are home to a lot of critters, big and small.
ds:209:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tahanan ang mga pook na 'to ng maraming nilalang, malalaki at maliliit.

ds:209:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Naturally, gettin’ around can be quite a task for the smaller folks!
ds:209:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Siyempre, mahirap maglibot para sa mas maliliit!

ds:209:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve been in business since I started flying really!
ds:209:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nagnegosyo na talaga ako mula nang magsimulang lumipad!

ds:209:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Keeps me busy, and puts a smile on critter’s faces!
ds:209:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pinananatili akong abala, at nagpapangiti sa mga nilalang!

ds:209:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Besides. I do kinda owe it to Scarlett…
ds:209:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Isa pa. Medyo may utang ako kay Scarlett…

ds:209:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It also helps me maintain this slender figure! Bawhawhaw!
ds:209:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Nakatutulong din para mapanatili ang balingkinitan kong katawan! Bawhawhaw!

ds:20:24:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, I got nothin’ witty to say here. You can’t go this way yet.
ds:20:24:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, wala akong maisip na matalinong sabihin dito. Hindi ka pa puwede rito.

ds:210:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]These babies? I never go anywhere without ‘em!
ds:210:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ang mga 'to? Hindi ako umaalis nang wala!

ds:210:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Admittedly, I hardly use ‘em. They’re mainly for bad weather.
ds:210:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aaminin kong bihira kong gamitin. Para talaga sa masamang panahon.

ds:210:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But it’s been nothin’ but gorgeous these days!

ds:210:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Still! These babies stay on my head.
ds:210:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Gayunman! Nananatili sa ulo ko ang mga 'to.

ds:210:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’re almost like a good luck charm!

ds:211:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This is how I carry smaller critters! Allows for multiple passengers as well!
ds:211:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dito ko binubuhat ang mas maliliit na nilalang! Puwede rin ang maraming pasahero!

ds:211:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See this basket is actually from my own chicks!
ds:211:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Galing talaga ang basket na 'to sa sarili kong mga inakay!

ds:211:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve kept it around as a lil’ keep sake…

ds:211:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But who knew it’d also serve another purpose one day!
ds:211:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero sino ang nakaaalam na may iba palang paggagamitan balang araw!

ds:212:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But heh, when they left the nest… it was pretty hard to handle…
ds:212:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero heh, nang umalis sila sa pugad… napakahirap harapin…

ds:212:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Not my best of moments, I was a mess! Bahawhaw!
ds:212:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hindi ko pinakamagandang sandali, gulong-gulo ako! Bahawhaw!

ds:212:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]My babies have been out exploring the world for a while now.
ds:212:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Matagal-tagal nang nagtutuklas ng mundo ang mga anak ko.

ds:212:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope they’ve found a nice place to settle down…
ds:212:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sana nakahanap na sila ng magandang lugar na matitirhan…

ds:212:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I also hope they’d visit me every once in a while! Bahawhaw!
ds:212:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sana dumalaw din sila sa 'kin paminsan-minsan! Bahawhaw!

ds:213:133:Dialogue Text.source: What do you like to do to unwind?
ds:213:133:Dialogue Text.target: Ano ang gusto mong gawin para magrelaks?

ds:213:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Always end a good work out with a cooldown stretch, mate!
ds:213:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Laging tapusin ang magandang ehersisyo sa pag-uunat para magpalamig, pare!

ds:213:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I enjoy a certain KIND of "cooldown stretch"…
ds:213:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]May isang URI ng "pag-uunat para magpalamig" na gusto ko…

ds:213:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Nothing like a friend to help "loosen" me up after a hard days work.
ds:213:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Walang katulad ang kaibigang tutulong "paluwagin" ako pagkatapos ng mahirap na araw.

ds:213:140:Dialogue Text.target: Sige! Akala ko, hindi mo na itatanong!

ds:213:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Let’s find a nice place out of the sun…
ds:213:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Humanap tayo ng magandang lugar na wala sa araw…

ds:213:143:Dialogue Text.source: Ah, sorry, I can’t just yet. Rain check!
ds:213:143:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, pasensiya, hindi pa ako puwede. Sa ibang pagkakataon!

ds:213:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sige, pare, sa susunod na lang, siguro.

ds:213:146:Dialogue Text.source: //FADE TO BLACK, PLAY SQUIRREL SEX SCENE//
ds:213:146:Dialogue Text.target: //FADE TO BLACK, PLAY SQUIRREL SEX SCENE//

ds:214:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, I’m pretty submissive most of the time!
ds:214:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam mo, madalas akong nagpapaubaya ng kontrol!

ds:214:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Even when I’m “on top” it’s in a gentle and loving way.
ds:214:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kahit kapag ako ang “top,” mahinahon at mapagmahal ang paraan.

ds:214:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I guess I can do both, but I tend to be submissive either way.
ds:214:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya ko yata ang pareho, pero alinman doon, madalas akong nagpapaubaya ng kontrol.

ds:214:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Though if you’d ask my wife, she’d say I’m a bottom, for sure, hah!
ds:214:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero kung tatanungin mo ang asawa ko, sasabihin niyang bottom ako, tiyak, ha!

ds:215:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Definitely enough for my little garden here, thank you so much dear!
ds:215:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sobra pa para sa munting hardin ko. Maraming salamat, mahal!

ds:215:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]GOSH, well I can’t just let you have all the fun!
ds:215:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]NAKU, hindi puwedeng ikaw lang ang magsasaya!

ds:215:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m going to have to pay a visit to that lil flower very soon!
ds:215:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kailangan ko nang dalawin ang munting bulaklak na 'yon sa lalong madaling panahon!

ds:216:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! The mice in these parts… live a bit differently.
ds:216:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo! Ang mga daga rito… medyo iba ang pamumuhay.

ds:216:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Perhaps it’s because we generally keep to ourselves.
ds:216:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Baka dahil karaniwan, hindi kami gaanong nakikihalubilo sa iba.

ds:216:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Or maybe it’s because we’re a bit isolated…

ds:216:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But we tend to have a more… uhh, "simple" kind of lifestyle?
ds:216:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero madalas, mas… uhh, "payak" ang pamumuhay namin?

ds:216:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But we all enjoy having a good time, right? We’re critters all the same!
ds:216:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero gusto naman nating lahat na magsaya, di ba? Mga nilalang din kaming tulad n'yo!

ds:216:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly it’s been a bit of a headache and I’m constantly disagreeing with them.
ds:216:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa totoo lang, medyo sakit sa ulo at lagi akong hindi sumasang-ayon sa kanila.

ds:216:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But they are my family! So you learn to live with em!
ds:216:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero pamilya ko sila! Kaya natututo kang makisama!

ds:217:135:Dialogue Text.source: … Why are you staring at me like that?
ds:217:135:Dialogue Text.target: … Bakit ganyan ang titig mo sa 'kin?

ds:217:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well, looks like I can fit snuggly in your paws…
ds:217:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mukhang kasya ako nang komportable sa mga lapa mo…

ds:217:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And judging by what you’re packing down there…
ds:217:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At batay sa dala mo riyan sa ibaba…

ds:217:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I can make it fit~

ds:217:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Let’s say what’s on our mind and run with it!
ds:217:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sabihin natin ang nasa isip at ituloy!

ds:217:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Alas, I am in the middle of something at the moment…

ds:218:18:Dialogue Text.source: Yikes, it's way too dark and spooky up ahead! Better turn around…
ds:218:18:Dialogue Text.target: Naku, napakadilim at nakakatakot sa unahan! Mabuting bumalik…

ds:219:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Same. Though I tend to be a bit more on the sub side of things.
ds:219:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ako rin. Pero mas nakahilig ako sa pagpapaubaya ng kontrol.

ds:219:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah yes, I tend to dom it up when I can.
ds:219:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, oo, madalas akong kumokontrol kapag kaya.

ds:219:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Vi, you can be pretty dominant too though.
ds:219:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Pero Vi, kaya mo ring maging mapagkontrol.

ds:219:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I suppose I meant, compared to you.
ds:219:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siguro, kumpara sa 'yo ang ibig kong sabihin.

ds:220:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I never properly thanked you for getting that fertilizer for me!
ds:220:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hindi pa kita napapasalamatan nang maayos sa pagkuha ng pataba para sa akin!

ds:220:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I know the plant doesn’t always keep their partner’s needs in mind…
ds:220:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Alam kong hindi laging isinasaalang-alang ng halaman ang pangangailangan ng kapareha niya…

ds:220:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So I’ve got just the way to thank you!
ds:220:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya alam ko ang tamang paraan para magpasalamat sa 'yo!

ds:220:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’ll have to come with me though…

ds:220:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh but while we were fooling around, looks like Bucky has started construction!
ds:220:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]O, pero habang nagkukulitan tayo, mukhang nagsimula nang magtayo si Bucky!

ds:220:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We'll have to do that again sometime soon, dear!
ds:220:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dapat ulitin natin 'yon sa lalong madaling panahon, mahal!

ds:221:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once ya find the flower, just present your rear to it, and it’ll do the rest!
ds:221:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pag nahanap mo ang bulaklak, iharap mo lang ang puwit mo at ito na ang bahala!

ds:222:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh Rascal! Just who I wanted to see!
ds:222:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]O Rascal! Ikaw mismo ang gusto kong makita!

ds:222:159:Dialogue Text.source:
Umm, I’m nff… in the middle of
running an… “errand” for Scarlett.
ds:222:159:Dialogue Text.target:
Umm, nff… may tinatapos pa akong
isang… “utos” ni Scarlett.

ds:222:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]DID SHE MAKE YOU VISIT THE PLANT???

ds:222:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]MAN I wish I was there to see that!

ds:222:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I bet it stuffed you good, huh?

ds:222:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maybe go grab a drink or something sometime…
ds:222:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Uminom tayo o gumawa ng kung ano minsan…
