ds:275:156:Dialogue Text.target: Pinasasarap niya ang pakiramdam ng mga hayop, anuman ang hugis at laki, at kinokolekta ang kanilang “mga alay.”

ds:275:157:Dialogue Text.source: This must’ve been quite a process! The scriptures mentions critters of all forms.
ds:275:157:Dialogue Text.target: Tiyak na matinding proseso ito! Binabanggit ng mga kasulatan ang lahat ng anyo ng nilalang.

ds:275:158:Dialogue Text.source: Canines, felines, equines, avians, reptilians, really critters of every origin.
ds:275:158:Dialogue Text.target: Mga kaanak ng aso, pusa, kabayo, mga ibon, reptilya, tunay na mga nilalang ng bawat pinagmulan.

ds:275:159:Dialogue Text.source: And these rituals would go on for hours! Quite impressive stamina, really!
ds:275:159:Dialogue Text.target: At ilang oras tumatagal ang mga ritwal na ito! Kahanga-hanga ang tibay, talaga!

ds:276:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Since you seem so curious about some of these runes and the history here, I wanted to give you something.
ds:276:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dahil tila napakamausisa mo sa ilan sa mga runang ito at sa kasaysayan dito, may nais akong ibigay sa iyo.

ds:276:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This was a guide I made to help in translation.
ds:276:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isa itong gabay na ginawa ko upang makatulong sa pagsasalin.

ds:276:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a little out dated, but it gets the job done for most of the smaller fragments here and there.
ds:276:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Medyo luma na, ngunit sapat para sa karamihan ng maliliit na piraso sa paligid.

ds:276:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You’ve no doubt come across little relics, this should help you decipher them!
ds:276:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Walang dudang may nakita ka nang maliliit na relikya, dapat makatulong ito sa pag-unawa sa mga ito!

ds:277:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But uh… that would make some… things… kinda weird, right?
ds:277:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero uh… medyo magiging kakaiba ang ilang… bagay… kung ganoon, di ba?

ds:277:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]We’ve been hanging with each other for as long as I can remember.
ds:277:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Mula pa sa pinakamaaga kong naaalala, lagi na tayong magkasama.

ds:277:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, as far as I think back, you’ve always been there…
ds:277:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo, kahit gaano kalayo ang balikan ko sa alaala, lagi kang naroon…

ds:278:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah that pretty much sums it up.

ds:279:132:Dialogue Text.source: But you paid me for that!
ds:279:132:Dialogue Text.target: Pero binayaran mo ako para roon!

ds:279:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]True true. But I’m just that kinda guy, y’know?
ds:279:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Totoo, totoo. Pero ganyan lang talaga ako, alam mo?

ds:279:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Besides, I have this thing that is just PERFECT for you.
ds:279:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Isa pa, may bagay akong TAMANG-TAMA para sa 'yo.

ds:279:142:Dialogue Text.source:
Why not just give this
to me once it’s fixed?
ds:279:142:Dialogue Text.target:
Bakit hindi mo na lang ibigay
sa 'kin kapag ayos na?

ds:279:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Don’t ya see the sentimental value packed inside this lil’ baby?
ds:279:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hindi mo ba nakikita ang halagang sentimental na laman ng munting 'to?

ds:279:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s more than a broken radio… it’s YOUR broken radio!
ds:279:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Higit pa 'to sa sirang radyo… sirang radyo MO 'to!

ds:279:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Besides… it was taking up inventory space.
ds:279:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Isa pa… kumukuha ng espasyo sa imbentaryo.

ds:279:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I just gotta hook you up, since you helped me out quite a bit recently.
ds:279:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kailangan kitang bigyan, dahil malaki ang naitulong mo sa 'kin nitong huli.

ds:279:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]For real though, consider this part one of two!
ds:279:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero seryoso, isipin mong ito ang una sa dalawa!

ds:279:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]… As soon as I find that other missing piece…
ds:279:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]… Kapag nakita ko na ang nawawalang isang piraso…

ds:27:18:Dialogue Text.source: Oof, it's even colder up here!
ds:27:18:Dialogue Text.target: Uff, mas malamig pa rito sa itaas!

ds:280:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Problem is… I don’t recall who made this order…
ds:280:198:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ang problema… Hindi ko maalala kung sino ang umorder nito…

ds:280:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think during all of this bridge business, the slip has gotten misplaced…
ds:280:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa tingin ko, sa dami ng nangyari sa tulay, naiwala ang resibo…

ds:280:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I can’t remember for the life of me!
ds:280:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kahit anong isip ko, hindi ko maalala!

ds:280:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a real mess Red, not a good look at all. No sir.
ds:280:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ang gulo talaga, Red, nakakahiyang tingnan. Talaga.

ds:280:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]To help me save a bit of face… Can you find out who it’s for?
ds:280:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Para hindi naman ako gaanong mapahiya… Maaari mo bang alamin kung kanino 'to?

ds:280:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ask around, I’m sure someone will be able to help!

ds:280:207:Dialogue Text.target: Natapos ko na ang isa pang paghatid!

ds:280:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Excellent! You’re really saving my butt here, man.
ds:280:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Galing! Sinasalba mo talaga ako rito, pare.

ds:280:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So there’s one last package that needs to be delivered…
ds:280:209:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May isa pang huling paketeng kailangang ihatid…

ds:280:284:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Get goin’ Red! Don’t make the customer wait!
ds:280:284:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Alis na, Red! Huwag mong paghintayin ang kostumer!

ds:281:224:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:281:224:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:281:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May kilala ba? Asawa ko nga ang isa!

ds:281:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But where did she run off to…

ds:282:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I know we haven’t known each other for too long…
ds:282:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Alam kong hindi pa tayo matagal na magkakilala…

ds:282:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But you’ve been very nice to me, and helped set some things in motion.
ds:282:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero napakabait mo sa 'kin, at natulungan mong umusad ang ilang bagay.

ds:282:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And uh… well… I appreciate it a lot. Thank you!
ds:282:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At uh… buweno… Talagang nagpapasalamat ako. Salamat!

ds:282:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh and, it hasn’t been worn or anything!
ds:282:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ay, at hindi pa 'to naisuot o anuman!

ds:282:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I just kept it around as a good luck charm… Not that… it was particularly lucky or anything…
ds:282:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Itinago ko lang bilang anting-anting sa suwerte… Hindi naman… sa talagang nagdala ito ng suwerte o anuman…

ds:283:228:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:283:228:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:283:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hm! Yeah, actually, I think Scarlett was looking for one.
ds:283:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hm! Oo, sa katunayan, sa tingin ko, naghahanap si Scarlett.

ds:284:232:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:284:232:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:284:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Bawha! You betcha! It was Dustin for sure!

ds:284:234:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I was just giving him a ride a second ago! He’s at the lake.
ds:284:234:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kahahatid ko lang sa kanya! Nasa lawa siya.

ds:284:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Okay! Dustin should be around here somewhere. Maybe check on the south shore!
ds:284:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sige! Dapat nandito lang si Dustin. Subukan mo sa timog na pampang!

ds:285:198:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:285:198:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:285:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I don’t really know folks too much yet, so I’m probably not the one to ask…
ds:285:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi ko pa gaanong kilala ang mga tagarito, kaya malamang hindi ako ang dapat tanungin…

ds:286:202:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:286:202:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:286:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh sure! Bucky has been looking for one for a while now.
ds:286:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo naman! Matagal nang naghahanap si Bucky.

ds:286:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]He’s just South of here. We just finished a cup of tea together.
ds:286:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nasa timog lang siya mula rito. Katatapos lang naming magtsaa.

ds:287:206:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:287:206:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:287:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]However, I could use a haircut… heh.

ds:288:211:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:288:211:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:288:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooooh yeah! That’s us! We need a shovel!
ds:288:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oooooh oo! Kami 'yon! Kailangan namin ng pala!

ds:288:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nope. Sorry Rascal, we can’t help you.
ds:288:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hindi. Pasensiya na, Rascal, wala kaming maitutulong sa 'yo.

ds:289:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Wow! This sounds like a ton of work! Let me know if I can help!
ds:289:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Aba! Mukhang napakaraming trabaho niyan! Sabihin mo kung may maitutulong ako!

ds:289:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Quite ambitious! I’d be happy to lend a paw too!
ds:289:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Malaki ang balak mo! Masaya rin akong mag-abot ng lapa!

ds:289:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks mates! But putting it together is part of the training!
ds:289:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Salamat, mga pare! Pero bahagi ng pagsasanay ang paggawa nito!

ds:289:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Though perhaps havin’ ya clear out some trees wouldn’t be a bad idea…
ds:289:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bagaman baka magandang magpatulong sa inyo sa pag-alis ng ilang puno…

ds:289:205:Dialogue Text.target: Kumusta kayong lahat, ano'ng ginagawa n'yo?

ds:289:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s curious we haven’t found more shovels…
ds:289:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nakapagtatakang wala pa tayong nakikitang ibang pala…

ds:289:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ll let Peter know to keep an eye out next time he’s out.
ds:289:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Sasabihan ko si Peter na maghanap din sa susunod niyang paglabas.

ds:289:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]If I’m out training, I’ll be sure to keep an eye out too!
ds:289:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kapag nasa labas ako at nagsasanay, maghahanap din ako!

ds:289:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I got the OK a bit ago from Scarlett here, but just got crackin’ on it.
ds:289:218:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Matagal-tagal na akong pinayagan ni Scarlett dito, pero ngayon lang ako nakapagsimula.

ds:289:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And sorry if we put you on the spot!
ds:289:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]At pasensiya na kung nailagay ka namin sa alanganin!

ds:289:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be able to do extensive workout routines! With proper flat ground and no potential hazards to worry about!
ds:289:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Makagagawa ako ng malawak na mga ehersisyo! May patag na lupa at walang posibleng panganib na aalalahanin!

ds:289:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Could even run a course for ya guys, if ya’d like!
ds:289:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Maaari pa akong magpatakbo ng pagsasanay para sa inyo, kung gusto n'yo!

ds:289:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Whattya say? Wanna sweat and lose some pounds?
ds:289:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ano sa tingin n'yo? Gustong magpawis at magbawas ng timbang?

ds:289:227:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ll be honest dear, I don’t think I could keep up!
ds:289:227:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sa totoo lang, mahal, sa tingin ko hindi ko kayang sumabay!

ds:289:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, sorry sonny! I’m a bit past my prime for that sorta thing!
ds:289:230:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, pasensiya na, iho! Medyo lampas na ako sa kalakasan ko para sa ganyan!

ds:289:235:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I should be able to make a few courses of varying intensities, so everyone can have a go!
ds:289:235:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dapat makagawa ako ng ilang pagsasanay na iba-iba ang tindi, para masubukan ng lahat!

ds:289:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But that’s a bit away… First thing’s first! Gotta make it!
ds:289:236:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero matagal pa 'yon… Unahin ang dapat! Kailangan munang gawin!

ds:289:238:Dialogue Text.source: Oh right! I’ve got a Shovel!
ds:289:238:Dialogue Text.target: Oo nga pala! May Pala ako!

ds:289:240:Dialogue Text.source: Yeaaah, I’m not sure if that’s my thing…
ds:289:240:Dialogue Text.target: Yaaaah, hindi ako sigurado kung hilig ko 'yan…

ds:289:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy come on now, I bet ya’ve been rollin’ about all day, huh?
ds:289:241:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hoy, sige na, tiyak na buong araw ka nang gumugulong-gulong, ano?

ds:289:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I can teach ya some more secrets if ya come train!
ds:289:242:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Maituturo ko pa sa 'yo ang ibang sikreto kung magsasanay ka!

ds:289:244:Dialogue Text.source: Errr, but it’s a shop order. From Maverick.
ds:289:244:Dialogue Text.target: Errr, pero order 'to sa tindahan. Kay Maverick.

ds:289:246:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! I ordered one a bit ago!

ds:289:255:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I needed one to tend to the garden. I was out here grabbing some herbs I’d like to grow at home.
ds:289:255:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kailangan ko para sa hardin. Nandito ako para kumuha ng ilang halamang gusto kong palaguin sa bahay.

ds:289:256:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Lots of general spices that’s handy for all of the critters…
ds:289:256:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Maraming karaniwang pampalasang kapaki-pakinabang sa lahat ng nilalang…

ds:289:258:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And I’ve got a new project underway…

ds:289:259:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I need to dig up a bunch of clay, and I’m basically stuck until I get a shovel…
ds:289:259:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kailangan kong maghukay ng maraming luwad, at wala talaga akong magawa hangga't wala akong pala…

ds:289:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I need it for the training grounds…
ds:289:261:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At kailangan ko para sa lugar ng pagsasanay…

ds:289:265:Dialogue Text.source: I think Scarlett should have it.
ds:289:265:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin ko, kay Scarlett dapat mapunta.

ds:289:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’ll be as quick as I can! Then I can pass it along!
ds:289:268:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Bibilisan ko hangga't kaya! Pagkatapos, maipapasa ko na!

ds:289:270:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sounds good, I can help with the garden if ya’d like!
ds:289:270:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ayos 'yan, matutulungan kita sa hardin kung gusto mo!

ds:289:271:Dialogue Text.source: I think Bucky should have it.
ds:289:271:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin ko, kay Bucky dapat mapunta.

ds:289:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ya sure? I don’t mean to step on any toes…

ds:289:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nonsense! Where would be without your help!
ds:289:275:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kalokohan! Nasaan kaya kami kung wala ang tulong mo!

ds:289:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]You can do what you need to, then pass it along.
ds:289:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Gawin mo muna ang kailangan mo, saka mo ipasa.

ds:289:277:Dialogue Text.source: I think Dustin should have it.
ds:289:277:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin ko, kay Dustin dapat mapunta.

ds:289:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah? I’ll be quick with it! Then I can pass it along!
ds:289:279:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Talaga? Bibilisan ko! Pagkatapos, maipapasa ko na!

ds:289:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m quite excited to see your project come along.
ds:289:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabik na akong makitang umusad ang proyekto mo.

ds:289:285:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Hmmm, well, there’s not too much of a rush on my end.
ds:289:285:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Hmmm, wala naman akong gaanong hinahabol na oras.

ds:289:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The season just started after all, plenty of time for things to grow!
ds:289:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kasisimula lang naman ng panahon, marami pang oras para lumago ang mga halaman!

ds:289:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And, I wouldn’t mind a good excuse to take a break!
ds:289:288:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At ayos sa 'kin na may magandang dahilan para magpahinga!

ds:289:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hulling all this junk!
ds:289:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayos sa 'kin! Kailangan ko ng pahinga pagkatapos buhatin ang lahat ng kalat na 'to!

ds:289:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hauling all this junk!
ds:289:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayos sa 'kin! Kailangan ko ng pahinga pagkatapos buhatin ang lahat ng kalat na 'to!

ds:289:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m excited to see it too! Always happy to see more craftsman critters!
ds:289:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sabik na rin akong makita! Laging nakakatuwang may iba pang nilalang na bihasa rin sa paggawa!

ds:289:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Let me know if you need any help!
ds:289:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sabihin mo kung kailangan mo ng tulong!

ds:289:296:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]My back is a bit sore after fixing up that bridge…
ds:289:296:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Medyo masakit ang likod ko matapos kumpunihin ang tulay…

ds:289:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Appreciate it mates! There’s heaps to do, so this’ll will help a lot!
ds:289:301:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Salamat, mga pare! Napakaraming gagawin, kaya malaking tulong 'to!

ds:289:302:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]After I’m done, I’ll pass it along!

ds:28:20:Dialogue Text.source: But at least it’s a nice day.
ds:28:20:Dialogue Text.target: Pero kahit paano, maganda ang araw.

ds:290:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Did you figure out who the shovel was for?
ds:290:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nalaman mo ba kung kanino ang pala?

ds:290:200:Dialogue Text.source: Sort of… a few critters needed it…
ds:290:200:Dialogue Text.target: Medyo… May ilang nilalang na nangangailangan…

ds:290:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh no. I messed that up big time.

ds:290:202:Dialogue Text.source: But it’s ok! We figured it out.
ds:290:202:Dialogue Text.target: Pero ayos na! Napagkasunduan na namin.

ds:290:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Damn, you really saved my rump this time!
ds:290:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Grabe, sinalba mo talaga ang puwit ko ngayon!

ds:290:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]If the customer is happy, I’m happy!
ds:290:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kung masaya ang kostumer, masaya rin ako!

ds:290:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And it’s all thanks to you, Red!

ds:290:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now it’s time to show my thanks!
ds:290:209:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oras na para ipakita ko ang pasasalamat ko!

ds:290:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’m a business man through and through, so your time will be compensated, absolutely.
ds:290:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Negosyante ako hanggang buto, kaya babayaran ang oras mo, siyempre naman.

ds:290:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Given how long this took you, how many tasks you completed, your expertise in the field…
ds:290:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Batay sa tagal ng ginugol mo, dami ng natapos mong gawain, husay mo sa larangan…

ds:290:214:Dialogue Text.source: Sounds a little low there, bud…

ds:290:216:Dialogue Text.source: RECEIVE 7 or 10 COINS (this doesn’t really matter)
ds:290:216:Dialogue Text.target: RECEIVE 7 or 10 COINS (this doesn’t really matter)

ds:290:217:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now that that’s all taken care of, welcome to my shop!
ds:290:217:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ngayong tapos na ang lahat, maligayang pagdating sa tindahan ko!

ds:290:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Thanks to you, I’ve had the time to reorganize and set this baby up!
ds:290:218:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dahil sa 'yo, nagkaoras akong mag-ayos at ihanda 'to!

ds:290:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And now that you have some cash, we can talk business!
ds:290:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]At ngayong may pera ka na, makapagnenegosyo na tayo!

ds:290:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Let me know if anything catches your interest!

ds:290:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh and, if you just want to hang out, I’ll be here!
ds:290:221:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ay, at kung gusto mo lang tumambay, nandito ako!

ds:290:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I may be running a business, but we’re still buds, Red!
ds:290:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]May negosyo nga ako, pero magkaibigan pa rin tayo, Red!

ds:290:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kaya lapitan mo lang ako kahit kailan!

ds:290:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What! Are you honestly hard balling me here, Red?
ds:290:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ano! Ganyan ka talaga katigas makipagtawaran, Red?

ds:290:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I suppose you did save my butt.

ds:291:197:Dialogue Text.source: WHEN PLAYER STARTS TO WALK AWAY, THE RAM WILL CALL OUT.
ds:291:197:Dialogue Text.target: WHEN PLAYER STARTS TO WALK AWAY, THE RAM WILL CALL OUT.

ds:291:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Gah, I can’t handle this. Just go for it.
ds:291:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Gah, hindi ko na kaya. Gawin mo na.

ds:291:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Try to stick with the top layers!
ds:291:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Subukan mong sa mga panlabas na patong lang!

ds:292:274:Dialogue Text.source: Oh, this is quite a comfy ride!

ds:292:275:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, are you sure I trimmed enough here?
ds:292:275:Dialogue Text.target: Hmm, sigurado ka bang sapat na ang ginupit ko rito?

ds:292:278:Dialogue Text.source: More importantly, squeeze that bad boy in there.
ds:292:278:Dialogue Text.target: Mas mahalaga, isiksik mo na 'yang sandata mo roon.

ds:292:283:Dialogue Text.source: Whew! I needed that, thanks lil buddy.
ds:292:283:Dialogue Text.target: Hay! Kailangan ko 'yon, salamat, munting kaibigan.

ds:292:285:Dialogue Text.target: Ako nga ang dapat magpasalamat sa sarap!

ds:292:286:Dialogue Text.source: … Say, you sure I cut enough off?
ds:292:286:Dialogue Text.target: … Pero sigurado kang sapat na ang ginupit ko?

ds:292:288:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah man, to be honest I don’t want you cutting much closer.
ds:292:288:Dialogue Text.target: Oo, pare, sa totoo lang ayokong lumapit pa ang gupit mo.

ds:293:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A lil, welcome gift and personal favorite of mine!
ds:293:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Munting regalo ng pagtanggap at personal kong paborito!

ds:293:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This lil’ baby has helped me get an eye for spotting out various interesting things!
ds:293:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nakatulong sa 'kin ang munting 'to na makapansin ng sari-saring kawili-wiling bagay!

ds:293:138:Dialogue Text.source: Wait, do you need this to see?
ds:293:138:Dialogue Text.target: Sandali, kailangan mo ba 'to para makakita?

ds:293:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See I’ve got a fancy pair of specs now. I haven’t used that lil guy in years.
ds:293:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May maganda na akong salamin ngayon. Ilang taon ko nang hindi ginagamit 'yan.

ds:293:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But it served me well, so take care of it!
ds:293:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero malaki ang naitulong sa 'kin, kaya alagaan mo!

ds:294:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Ah, you’d like to hear more about Lanora, eh?
ds:294:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Ah, gusto mo pang marinig ang tungkol kay Lanora, ano?

ds:294:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Fortunately, I do have another passage I can share!
ds:294:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mabuti at mayroon pa akong isang bahaging maibabahagi!

ds:294:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]As previously discussed, there were many group-oriented events, involving critters of all shapes and sizes.
ds:294:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Gaya ng natalakay, maraming pagtitipong panggrupo, na kinasasangkutan ng mga nilalang ng lahat ng hugis at laki.

ds:294:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This passage reveals that there were also smaller, private events. Likely for the most devout? A right of passage, perhaps?
ds:294:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ibinubunyag ng bahaging ito na mayroon ding mas maliliit at pribadong pagtitipon. Marahil para sa pinakamatatapat? Isang ritwal ng pagpasok sa bagong yugto, marahil?

ds:294:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, from what I gather, Lanora would occasionally choose two disciples, often male.
ds:294:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basta, sa nakalap ko, paminsan-minsa'y pumipili si Lanora ng dalawang alagad, madalas ay lalaki.

ds:294:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They’d escort her across the forest, through the darkest of woods, all the way to the top of a mountain. There they would find a hidden cave.
ds:294:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Inihahatid nila siya sa gubat, sa pinakamadilim na kakahuyan, hanggang sa tuktok ng bundok. Doon, may natatagpuan silang lihim na kuweba.

ds:294:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once in the cave, the disciples and Lanora would engage in a union of the body.
ds:294:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pagdating sa kuweba, pinag-iisa ng mga alagad at ni Lanora ang kanilang mga katawan.

ds:294:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That is to say, they got… uh… Down and dirty…
ds:294:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ibig sabihin, sila ay… uh… Nagtatalik nang mapusok…

ds:294:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]This particular scripture goes on and on.

ds:294:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Like half of the glyphs are about how they switch sides, fill her holes, bathe her in their… *ahem* well, you know…
ds:294:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Halos kalahati ng mga glipo ay tungkol sa pagpapalitan nila ng panig, pagpuno sa mga butas niya, pagpapaligo sa kanya ng kanilang… *ehem* alam mo na…

ds:294:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, I can’t imagine what sort of worship this was…
ds:294:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hindi ko maisip kung anong uri ng pagsamba ito…

ds:294:174:Dialogue Text.source: Are you sure this was a form of worship?
ds:294:174:Dialogue Text.target: Sigurado kang isang uri ito ng pagsamba?

ds:294:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well certainly! These inscriptions are rare, you see. Especially for their time.
ds:294:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siyempre! Bihira ang mga inskripsiyong ito. Lalo na sa kanilang panahon.

ds:294:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Writing and record-keeping was a niche task. Only certain learned critters were scribes. So typically, only important events were written down.
ds:294:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Natatanging gawain ang pagsusulat at pagtatala. Ilang may pinag-aralang nilalang lamang ang mga tagasulat. Kaya karaniwan, mahahalagang pangyayari lamang ang itinatala.

ds:294:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Still, quite a saucy ritual… I can’t quite connect the dots…
ds:294:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Gayunman, napakainit na ritwal… Hindi ko mapag-ugnay ang lahat…

ds:294:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… But this Forest was indeed full of “love” before.
ds:294:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]… Ngunit tunay na puno ng “pag-ibig” ang Gubat na ito noon.

ds:294:180:Dialogue Text.source: What else do you know about the “Shrine Maiden”?
ds:294:180:Dialogue Text.target: Ano pa ang alam mo tungkol sa “Dalaga ng Dambana”?

ds:295:170:Dialogue Text.source: They shared Lanora, body and soul.
ds:295:170:Dialogue Text.target: Pinagsaluhan nila si Lanora, katawan at kaluluwa.

ds:295:171:Dialogue Text.source: One would take her from the front, and the other would take her from the back.
ds:295:171:Dialogue Text.target: Tinitira siya ng isa mula sa harap, at ng isa mula sa likod.

ds:295:172:Dialogue Text.source: Long into the night, the disciples would spend hours trying to sate Lanora.
ds:295:172:Dialogue Text.target: Hanggang sa kalaliman ng gabi, ilang oras na sinisikap ng mga alagad na busugin si Lanora.

ds:295:173:Dialogue Text.source: It’s said her lust and scent invigorated the males. Tapping into their primal natures…
ds:295:173:Dialogue Text.target: Sinasabing pinasisigla ng pagnanasa at amoy niya ang mga lalaki. Pinupukaw ang kanilang likas na pagka-hayop…

ds:296:142:Dialogue Text.source: I just finished fooling around with some friends, right?
ds:296:142:Dialogue Text.target: Katatapos ko lang makipaglaro sa ilang kaibigan, tama?

ds:296:143:Dialogue Text.source: We were cuddling together, catching our breath and enjoying the shade, y’know?
ds:296:143:Dialogue Text.target: Magkakayakap kami, naghahabol ng hininga at ninanamnam ang lilim, alam mo?

ds:296:144:Dialogue Text.source: Well across from me, I spot her…
ds:296:144:Dialogue Text.target: Tapos, sa tapat ko, nakita ko siya…

ds:296:145:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a bit shorter than you, super cute hat, rockin’ bod…
ds:296:145:Dialogue Text.target: Medyo mas maliit kaysa sa 'yo, napakakyut ng sumbrero, astig ang katawan…

ds:296:146:Dialogue Text.source: She was ridin’ this guy, giving me quite the show!
ds:296:146:Dialogue Text.target: Sinasakyan niya ang isang lalaki, nagbibigay sa 'kin ng matinding palabas!

ds:296:147:Dialogue Text.source: I thought it was just a coincidence, and then we locked eyes.
ds:296:147:Dialogue Text.target: Akala ko, nagkataon lang, tapos nagtama ang mga mata namin.

ds:296:148:Dialogue Text.source: She lifted her tail to give me the full show! I was hard again in seconds!
ds:296:148:Dialogue Text.target: Itinaas niya ang buntot para makita ko ang buong palabas! Matigas na ako uli sa ilang segundo!

ds:297:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A partner? Naw, this is a pretty solo venture.

ds:297:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why do you ask Red, you want in as a business partner?
ds:297:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Bakit mo tinatanong, Red, gusto mong pumasok bilang kasosyo sa negosyo?

ds:297:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I might be able to cut you in… but we wouldn’t be look at anything more than 7 percent…
ds:297:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Baka mabigyan kita ng bahagi… pero hindi tayo aabot sa higit sa 7 porsiyento…

ds:297:139:Dialogue Text.source:
No, I meant a
relationship partner.
ds:297:139:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi, ang ibig ko,
kapareha sa relasyon.

ds:297:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Naw, I don’t really have time for that sorta thing…
ds:297:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Wala, hindi talaga ako nagkakaoras para sa ganoon…

ds:297:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]She was absolutely inviting me to join… but uh…
ds:297:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Talagang iniimbitahan niya akong sumali… pero uh…

ds:297:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]For some reason… I couldn’t accept it…
ds:297:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa kung anong dahilan… hindi ko matanggap…

ds:297:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I dunno Red… There was something different about her…
ds:297:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ewan ko, Red… May kakaiba sa kanya…

ds:297:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I just got kinda scared that… maybe that was a path I wasn’t ready for…
ds:297:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Medyo natakot lang ako na… baka hindi pa ako handang tahakin ang landas na 'yon…

ds:297:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I just don’t have time for something serious, y’know?
ds:297:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Wala lang talaga akong oras para sa seryoso, alam mo?

ds:297:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a lot of work running a business.

ds:297:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]So it’s hard to imagine squeezing in a relationship…

ds:297:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But, that’s not to say I don’t sleep around!
ds:297:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero hindi ibig sabihin, hindi ako nakikipagtalik kung kani-kanino!

ds:297:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Heh, there’s a nice lil lagoon down the river.
ds:297:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Heh, may magandang munting laguna sa ibaba ng ilog.

ds:297:165:Dialogue Text.source:
Well maybe she didn’t want
anything serious.
ds:297:165:Dialogue Text.target:
Baka naman ayaw niya
ng anumang seryoso.

ds:297:169:Dialogue Text.source:
You should!
She seems interested, and
it might be a fun opportunity.
ds:297:169:Dialogue Text.target:
Dapat!
Mukha siyang interesado, at
baka masayang pagkakataon 'to.

ds:297:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a common place to go for a quick hook up!
ds:297:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Karaniwang puntahan para sa mabilisan na pagtatalik!

ds:297:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red, I ain’t gonna sugar coat it, it’s basically a non-stop orgy.
ds:297:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Red, hindi ko papatamisin, halos walang-tigil na orgy 'yon.

ds:297:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yep! I used to spend a lot of time there! Buncha party animals!
ds:297:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo! Madalas akong magtagal doon noon! Puro hayop na mahilig magsaya!

ds:297:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Not quite my speed these days… but I meet up with some old friends and fool around here ’n there.
ds:297:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hindi na gaanong tugma sa takbo ko ngayon… pero nakikipagkita ako sa ilang dating kaibigan at nakikipaglaro paminsan-minsan.

ds:297:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should really take ya down there sometime!

ds:297:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know… There is this one girl at the lagoon…
ds:297:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alam mo… May isang babae sa laguna…

ds:297:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm! Y’know after hearing it aloud, it seems so obvious.
ds:297:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmm! Alam mo, ngayong narinig ko nang malakas, parang napakalinaw.

ds:297:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I could always let her know what I’m looking for, I’m sure she’d understand!
ds:297:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Maaari ko namang sabihin kung ano ang hinahanap ko, tiyak na mauunawaan niya!

ds:297:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Part of me thinks I actually WANT to be serious with her…
ds:297:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Parang may bahagi ng sarili kong talagang GUSTONG maging seryoso sa kanya…

ds:297:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m serious Red! This is kinda why I was avoiding it… I don’t wanna mess it up…
ds:297:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Seryoso ako, Red! Kaya nga iniiwasan ko… Ayokong masira…

ds:297:185:Dialogue Text.source:
Mmm, I think you should talk to her.
You wouldn’t want to miss
this experience entirely, right?
ds:297:185:Dialogue Text.target:
Mmm, sa tingin ko, dapat mo siyang kausapin.
Ayaw mong tuluyang palampasin
ang karanasang 'to, di ba?

ds:297:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some flirty smiles and gestures here ’n there, but the last time I saw her…
ds:297:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May malalanding ngiti at kilos dito't doon, pero noong huli ko siyang makita…

ds:297:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m usually pretty surface level when fooling with the critters there.
ds:297:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Karaniwan, hanggang libangan lang ang pakikipaglaro ko sa mga nilalang doon.

ds:297:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think you’re right, Red! I’ll talk to her!
ds:297:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sa tingin ko, tama ka, Red! Kakausapin ko siya!

ds:297:197:Dialogue Text.source:
And thank you
for the saucy story!
ds:297:197:Dialogue Text.target:
At salamat sa
mainit na kuwento!

ds:297:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a lil’ spicy though, so be prepared!

ds:298:288:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah I’ll say! Ya practically jumped on me!
ds:298:288:Dialogue Text.target: Oo nga! Halos sinugod mo ako!

ds:298:289:Dialogue Text.source: Gus’ might be a gentle giant, but ohgosh, when all that weight is on top of you…
ds:298:289:Dialogue Text.target: Mabait na higante nga si Gus, pero naku, kapag nakadagan na sa 'yo ang buong bigat niya…

ds:298:291:Dialogue Text.source: H-hey… I know I’ve put on a few pounds…
ds:298:291:Dialogue Text.target: H-hoy… Alam kong tumaba ako nang kaunti…

ds:298:293:Dialogue Text.source: No no, I didn’t mean it that way!
ds:298:293:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi, hindi ganoon ang ibig kong sabihin!

ds:298:294:Dialogue Text.source: You’re just a lot bigger than me, and uh, heh… It’s super hot.
ds:298:294:Dialogue Text.target: Mas malaki ka lang talaga sa akin, at ano, heh… Sobrang nakakalibog.

ds:298:317:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh I see. Well, I’m glad you enjoyed it!
ds:298:317:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, ganoon pala. Masaya akong nasarapan ka!

ds:298:318:Dialogue Text.source: I uh… really enjoyed it too…

ds:298:320:Dialogue Text.source: I’d say! I’ve never seen you cum so much…
ds:298:320:Dialogue Text.target: Halata nga! Ngayon lang kita nakitang ganoon karami ang inilabas na tamod…

ds:298:333:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, well you see, I too prepped for our meet…
ds:298:333:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, naghanda rin kasi ako para sa pagkikita natin…

ds:298:334:Dialogue Text.target: Buong araw akong nagpapabitin bago labasan!

ds:298:337:Dialogue Text.source: You’re getting better at that, aren’t you?

ds:298:351:Dialogue Text.source: All the better for what happened next…
ds:298:351:Dialogue Text.target: Mas naging maganda tuloy ang sumunod na nangyari…

ds:298:355:Dialogue Text.source: See Rascal, once Gus has his fun, he insists on cleaning his own mess!
ds:298:355:Dialogue Text.target: Ganito kasi, Rascal, kapag nasiyahan na si Gus, pinipilit niyang linisin ang sarili niyang kalat!

ds:298:372:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I mean… I couldn’t leave you like that…
ds:298:372:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, kasi naman… Hindi kita puwedeng iwan nang ganoon…

ds:298:375:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh, and that tongue gets EVERYWHERE!
ds:298:375:Dialogue Text.target: Naku, at nakakarating KAHIT SAAN ang dilang 'yon!

ds:298:390:Dialogue Text.source: And uh… I swear you were suckin’ on my paws a bit…
ds:298:390:Dialogue Text.target: At ano… Sigurado akong sinipsip mo nang kaunti ang mga lapa ko…

ds:298:391:Dialogue Text.source: Is that a new thing for you?

ds:298:393:Dialogue Text.source: What can I say? I missed those lil’ beans…
ds:298:393:Dialogue Text.target: Ano'ng magagawa ko? Na-miss ko 'yang maliliit na munggo…

ds:299:377:Dialogue Text.source:
Evening gentlemen!
Out for another round?
ds:299:377:Dialogue Text.target:
Magandang gabi, mga ginoo!
Isa pang inuman?

ds:299:381:Dialogue Text.source: Post Coital drinking? Is that a thing?

ds:299:394:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ahh, I had a really good time!

ds:299:398:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I feel like we should be thanking you Rascal…

ds:299:402:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Imagine just pickin’ up and moving… I don’t think I could do it!
ds:299:402:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isipin mong bigla ka na lang aalis at lilipat… Parang hindi ko kaya!

ds:299:404:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]My path was pretty similar… Though I was fueled by the research first and foremost.
ds:299:404:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Medyo ganoon din ang landas ko… Pero pananaliksik ang una sa lahat na nagtulak sa akin.

ds:299:405:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I also intended on returning to my home at somepoint…
ds:299:405:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Balak ko ring bumalik sa tahanan ko balang araw…

ds:299:406:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But the company won me over, heh!
ds:299:406:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Pero nanaig ang mga nakasama ko rito, heh!

ds:299:408:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It’s a past time for us, that’s for sure!

ds:299:409:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though I didn’t have anything at my place…
ds:299:409:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kaso wala akong maiinom sa bahay ko…

ds:299:418:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’m sure Bucky and I would’ve come together at some point again…
ds:299:418:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sigurado akong magiging maayos din ulit kami ni Bucky balang araw…

ds:299:419:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But we feel like you really helped push things along…
ds:299:419:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero pakiramdam namin, malaki ang naitulong mo para mapabilis 'yon…

ds:299:421:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah! Your involvement kinda… I dunno. It’s helped us smooth things over a lot.
ds:299:421:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo! 'Yong pakikilahok mo, parang… ewan ko. Malaki ang naitulong para maayos ang samahan namin.

ds:299:422:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And we were lucky enough to catch you again!

ds:299:424:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do you wanna hear about the naughty stuff we were just up to?
ds:299:424:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gusto mo bang marinig ang mga kalaswaang ginawa namin kanina?

ds:299:437:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And do know we hope you’ll consider this place home one day. If you don’t already…
ds:299:437:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At sana balang araw, ituring mong tahanan ang lugar na 'to. Kung hindi mo pa itinuturing na ganoon…

ds:299:441:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal, have you ever seen alligator bits?
ds:299:441:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Rascal, nakakita ka na ba ng ari ng aligeytor?

ds:299:444:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They are quite unique! Really thick at the tip! So you gotta be ready for it.
ds:299:444:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kakaiba talaga! Napakakapal sa dulo! Kaya kailangan handa ka.

ds:299:445:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Remember Gus? You used to have to warm me up for hours before it’d pop in!
ds:299:445:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naalala mo, Gus? Dati ilang oras mo muna akong inihahanda bago naipapasok!

ds:299:453:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I mean, no one really knows how long you were planning on sticking around…
ds:299:453:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kasi walang nakakaalam kung gaano katagal mong balak manatili rito…

ds:299:454:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But if it’s up to us, we’d say forever!
ds:299:454:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero kung kami ang masusunod, habang-buhay na!

ds:299:457:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ano… ba mismo ang mga plano mo?

ds:299:458:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m honestly still surprised you can take it at all! You’re quite the impressive lil’ guy…
ds:299:458:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa totoo lang, nagugulat pa rin akong kaya mong tanggapin 'yon! Kahanga-hanga ka talagang munting kaibigan…

ds:299:463:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We didn’t have to warm ya up too much this time…
ds:299:463:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ka na namin kinailangang ihanda nang matagal ngayon…

ds:299:465:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That’s because I prepped ahead of time!
ds:299:465:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dahil naghanda na ako bago pa tayo magkita!

ds:299:476:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Wha? You uprooted, traveled abroad, with no plan?
ds:299:476:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ha? Iniwan mo ang lahat, naglakbay sa ibang bansa, nang walang plano?

ds:299:484:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Once I saw you were ready, I really couldn’t help myself…
ds:299:484:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Noong nakita kong handa ka na, hindi ko na talaga napigilan ang sarili ko…

ds:29:21:Dialogue Text.source: Wow, you really walked out here…
ds:29:21:Dialogue Text.target: Wow, naglakad ka talaga hanggang dito…

ds:29:23:Dialogue Text.source: Maybe a nice relaxing spot to rub one out?
ds:29:23:Dialogue Text.target: Baka magandang relaks na lugar para magsarili?

ds:2:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red! I’m blocking this area for a reason!
ds:2:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Red! May dahilan kaya hinaharangan ko ang lugar na 'to!

ds:2:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Seriously, for your own safety, you can’t go that way.
ds:2:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Seryoso, para sa kaligtasan mo, hindi ka puwedeng pumunta riyan.

ds:300:481:Dialogue Text.source: I couldn’t hold that thing in for long.
ds:300:481:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi ko kayang panatilihin sa loob 'yon nang matagal.

ds:301:324:Dialogue Text.source: Sure! What are you three up to?

ds:301:334:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Next time we’ll be doing some Haiku.

ds:301:338:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]One that lets us tune into our surroundings, and be present in the moment.
ds:301:338:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Na hinahayaan tayong makiramdam sa paligid, at manatili sa kasalukuyang sandali.

ds:301:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Nah man, it’s a nice change of pace.

ds:301:356:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I get the feeling you’re not used to chilling…

ds:301:357:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi na ako nakapagrelaks mula nang nandito ako…

ds:301:360:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Chill with us again next time we’re here!
ds:301:360:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Magrelaks kasama namin sa susunod na nandito tayo!

ds:302:498:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ayan na siya! Ang sumisikat na makata!

ds:302:499:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Give us a verse! Drop some lines!
ds:302:499:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bigyan mo kami ng tula! Bumanat ka ng mga taludtod!

ds:302:501:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hehe, yeah, I’m pretty curious to hear what you came up with!
ds:302:501:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hehe, oo, gustong-gusto ko nang marinig ang naisip mo!

ds:302:508:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]PFFT! Wow ok! I had a feeling it would be something like that!
ds:302:508:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]PFFT! Aba, sige! Kutob ko nang ganyan ang magiging tula mo!

ds:302:510:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yet it works pretty well! Certainly invokes some vivid imagery!
ds:302:510:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero maganda ang kinalabasan! Talagang malinaw ang larawang ipinipinta nito sa isip!

ds:302:512:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, it actually reminds me of a poem I wrote… It has similar themes…
ds:302:512:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hehe, may naaalala akong tulang sinulat ko… Magkahawig ang tema…

ds:302:516:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Gushing from your rear
Fluids running down your legs
Watering the Earth
ds:302:516:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Bulwak sa puwit
Sa binti mo'y may agos
Dilig sa lupa

ds:302:521:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok, something tells me I know exactly what inspired this one!
ds:302:521:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sige, parang alam na alam ko kung ano'ng inspirasyon nito!

ds:302:523:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh… we should probably fill you in Rascal.
ds:302:523:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hehe… Dapat siguro naming ikuwento sa 'yo, Rascal.

ds:302:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well it was one of our earlier interactions together.
ds:302:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isa ito sa mga unang beses na magkasama kami.

ds:302:528:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]By this time, we were already pretty friendly, and fooling around here and there.
ds:302:528:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Noon, malapit na kami sa isa't isa, at paminsan-minsan ay may kalikutang ginagawa.

ds:302:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Claire reaaallly wanted to try to get my tip in…
ds:302:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Gustung-gustooo ni Claire na subukang ipasok ang dulo ko…

ds:302:532:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I was wiggling around in all kinds of positions. Violet was coaxing and massaging me the whole time!
ds:302:532:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kung ano-anong posisyon ang sinubukan ko. Panay ang paghimok at pagmamasahe ni Violet sa akin!

ds:302:534:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But she got it in! It was quite impressive, really.

ds:302:536:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, after all that teasing… I was really on edge!
ds:302:536:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hehe, pagkatapos ng lahat ng panunuksong 'yon… malapit na talaga akong labasan!

ds:302:540:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Whew! Ang init naman ng haiku na 'to!

ds:302:542:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? We got a real silver tongue here.
ds:302:542:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Di ba? Ang husay ng dila ng isang 'to.

ds:302:544:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh, I’m sure you’re really thinking about his tongue right now!
ds:302:544:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Naku, sigurado akong dila niya talaga ang iniisip mo ngayon!

ds:302:546:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh… Seems that tongue can do many great things…
ds:302:546:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hehe… Mukhang maraming magagaling na nagagawa ang dilang 'yon…

ds:302:548:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Anyways, that was a good poem Oliver.

ds:302:549:Dialogue Text.source: Who knew Haiku could be sexy!
ds:302:549:Dialogue Text.target: Sinong mag-aakalang puwedeng maging seksi ang haiku!

ds:302:551:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah I think we need to focus on more sexy haiku.
ds:302:551:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oo, sa tingin ko dapat mas pagtuunan natin ang seksing haiku.

ds:302:554:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, since the first one was more about Claire, I wanted one for Violet too..
ds:302:554:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo, dahil mas tungkol kay Claire ang una, gusto kong gawan din si Violet…

ds:302:559:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Her tender lapping
Cleaning up the mess I made
I’m hard once again
ds:302:559:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Himod marahan
Kalat ko'y nililinis
Tigas ko'y balik

ds:302:562:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course, I can just about hilt Olly these days!
ds:302:562:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siyempre, halos maisagad ko na si Ollie ngayon!

ds:302:566:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hehe, baka sa loob pa ng mga dalawang buwan…

ds:302:569:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Um heh… I actually had a sequel to that last haiku…
ds:302:569:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah hehe… May kasunod pala akong tula sa huling haiku…

ds:303:322:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]OK Rascal, you’re up! What do you got for us?
ds:303:322:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O Rascal, ikaw na! Ano'ng handog mo sa amin?

ds:303:330:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I would change it to. "How lucky are we"

ds:303:334:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s very good Oliver, the feeling is quite mutual!
ds:303:334:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napakaganda, Oliver. Ganoon din ang nadarama namin!

ds:303:343:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Good Drink and Good Friends
On a lazy afternoon
How lucky am I
ds:303:343:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Tagay, barkada
Sa hapong walang gawa
Kay suwerte ko

ds:303:346:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oliver, would you like to go next? I can tell you came up with something.
ds:303:346:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oliver, gusto mo bang sumunod? Halatang may naisip ka na.

ds:303:350:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=2]Good Drink and Good Friends
On a lazy afternoon
How lucky am I
ds:303:350:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=2]Tagay, barkada
Sa hapong walang gawa
Kay suwerte ko

ds:303:355:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’m not gonna lie - that haiku was a lot lamer until you explained it.
ds:303:355:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sa totoo lang, mas baduy 'yang haiku bago mo ipinaliwanag.

ds:303:357:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, it may be a bit of a stretch, but that’s what I was thinking when writing.
ds:303:357:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo, baka medyo pilit, pero 'yon ang iniisip ko noong isinusulat ko.

ds:303:360:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re learning from the best after all!

ds:303:362:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? This idea really echos with the idea of time as a whole.
ds:303:362:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Di ba? Umaalingawngaw ang ideyang ito sa mismong diwa ng panahon.

ds:303:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Though we see time as a day to day thing, thousands of years ago, or thousands of years from now - so many things change, yet so much remains the same.
ds:303:363:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kahit araw-araw lang ang tingin natin sa panahon, libo-libong taon na ang nakaraan o libo-libong taon mula ngayon—ang daming nagbabago, pero ang dami ring nananatili.

ds:303:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]A journey without an end - yet time marches on, and flows like a river.
ds:303:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isang paglalakbay na walang wakas—pero patuloy ang panahon, umaagos na parang ilog.

ds:303:365:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s interesting to consider though, if "time" is the "river," then we are the "water."
ds:303:365:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero kawili-wiling isipin: kung ang "panahon" ang "ilog," tayo naman ang "tubig."

ds:303:366:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And does the "water" come back in the form of "rain" and "snow"?

ds:303:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s not my greatest one. But I’ve captured a few concepts in this.
ds:303:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi ito ang pinakamaganda kong tula. Pero may ilang konseptong nakapaloob dito.

ds:303:370:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See Rascal, a difficult part of traditional haiku is the split of two ideas.
ds:303:370:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kasi Rascal, isang mahirap na bahagi ng tradisyonal na haiku ang pagtatapat ng dalawang ideya.

ds:303:371:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Two ideas that contrast each other, they vibrate against each other and change the context of each other.
ds:303:371:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dalawang ideyang magkasalungat, umaalingawngaw sa isa't isa at binabago ang konteksto ng bawat isa.

ds:303:372:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The poem is meant to capture both, the phenomena of an instant of observing water, yet the realization that every droplet of water is new.
ds:303:372:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Layunin ng tula na hulihin pareho: ang sandaling pagmamasid sa tubig, at ang pagkabatid na bago ang bawat patak.

ds:303:373:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Each droplet that passes this place came from a glacier up above, and who knows, maybe it has made its way back here before.
ds:303:373:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bawat patak na dumaraan dito ay galing sa isang glasyer sa itaas. At malay natin, baka nakabalik na ito rito noon.

ds:303:375:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh damn, that’s crazy. I’ve never considered the water flowing down this river is unique…
ds:303:375:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Grabe, ang tindi. Hindi ko naisip na natatangi ang tubig na umaagos sa ilog na 'to…

ds:303:376:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Marching Forever
A journey without an end
The flowing River
ds:303:376:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Lakad nang lakad
Lakbay na walang wakas
Agos ng ilog

ds:303:383:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Most haiku reflect nature, a season, and one of the senses.
ds:303:383:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Karamihan sa haiku ay sumasalamin sa kalikasan, isang panahon ng taon, at isa sa mga pandama.

ds:303:386:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But before I start. Rascal, do you remember last time when we were chilling?
ds:303:386:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero bago ako magsimula. Rascal, naaalala mo noong huli tayong nagrelaks dito?

ds:303:389:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This was composed during that chill session. You’ll see what I mean.
ds:303:389:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nabuo ito habang nagrerelaks tayo noon. Mauunawaan mo ang ibig kong sabihin.

ds:303:392:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They’re most recognized by their 5-7-5 syllable structure.
ds:303:392:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kilala ito lalo na sa estrukturang 5-7-5 pantig.

ds:303:393:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But structure is only one piece of the puzzle.
ds:303:393:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero isang bahagi lang ng kabuuan ang estruktura.

ds:303:394:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A Haiku is a moment, an experience, if you will.
ds:303:394:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang haiku ay isang sandali, isang karanasan, kumbaga.

ds:303:396:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Today’s chill will also involve some creativity.
ds:303:396:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May halong pagkamalikhain din ang pagrerelaks natin ngayon.

ds:303:398:Dialogue Text.source: Remind me what that is, exactly?

ds:303:401:Dialogue Text.source: That’s right! I’m here to chill.

ds:303:402:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey! Looks like you’ve made it to another chill session!
ds:303:402:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]O! Nakadalo ka na naman sa pagrerelaks natin!

ds:303:407:Dialogue Text.source: Take me high above the clouds

ds:303:430:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!

ds:303:431:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you were inspired by Penny, she’d be happy to hear this!
ds:303:431:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Halatang si Penny ang inspirasyon mo. Matutuwa siyang marinig ito!

ds:303:433:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Absolutely, she’s a sap for this poetry stuff!
ds:303:433:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo naman, ang lambot ng puso niya sa mga tulang ganito!

ds:303:438:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!

ds:303:439:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I dig the commentary! And good to see you’re an advocate of the chill life!
ds:303:439:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gusto ko ang komentaryo! At mabuting malaman na kampi ka sa relaks na pamumuhay!

ds:303:441:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yo, wait, are WE the bugs?? Damn.
ds:303:441:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Uy, teka, TAYO ba ang mga insekto?? Grabe.

ds:303:449:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh, that’s what she says to most of mine…
ds:303:449:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hehe, 'yan ang sinasabi niya sa karamihan ng gawa ko…

ds:303:454:Dialogue Text.source: *This dialogue plays at the end of each ending.*
ds:303:454:Dialogue Text.target: *This dialogue plays at the end of each ending.*

ds:303:455:Dialogue Text.source:
Thanks guys!
Next chill session, I’ll have something better!
ds:303:455:Dialogue Text.target:
Salamat sa inyo!
Sa susunod na pagrerelaks natin, mas maganda na ang ihahandog ko!

ds:303:457:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo naman, pabilibin mo kami nang todo!

ds:303:460:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!

ds:303:461:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you were inspired by the bridge and your experiences in the forest. Very nice!
ds:303:461:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Halatang ang tulay at mga karanasan mo sa gubat ang inspirasyon mo. Napakaganda!

ds:304:698:Dialogue Text.source: Mabel must have really been giving it to him.
ds:304:698:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang talagang binigyan ni Mabel ng matinding sarap si Bucky.

ds:304:699:Dialogue Text.source: She can be quite resourceful with her body, y’know!
ds:304:699:Dialogue Text.target: Marami siyang naiisip na paraan para gamitin ang katawan niya, alam mo!

ds:304:701:Dialogue Text.source: And golly, what a mess! Bucky was stunned there, just gushing load after load on her face.
ds:304:701:Dialogue Text.target: At susmaryosep, ang kalat! Tulala lang si Bucky roon, sunod-sunod ang bulwak ng tamod sa mukha niya.

ds:304:702:Dialogue Text.target: Sa totoo lang, ang kyut nilang tingnan…

ds:305:268:Dialogue Text.source: You two look like you know how to party!
ds:305:268:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang sanay kayong dalawa sa party!

ds:305:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Clearly Rascal can tell a couple of party animals when he sees em!
ds:305:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Malinaw na nakikilala ni Rascal ang dalawang hayop na mahilig mag-party kapag nakita niya!

ds:305:273:Dialogue Text.source: Actually no, I was just trying to be cool.
ds:305:273:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi talaga, sinusubukan ko lang magmukhang astig.

ds:305:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah I’m not really one to party much.

ds:305:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m good with critters, but the party crowd isn’t quite my thing.
ds:305:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mahusay ako sa pakikitungo, pero hindi ko gaanong hilig ang mga barkadang puro party.

ds:305:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]God, I had to wash our clothes like, five times to get all that out!
ds:305:291:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Diyos ko, parang limang beses kong nilabhan ang mga damit natin para maalis ang lahat!

ds:305:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah next bukkake, remind me to remove my clothes.
ds:305:293:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo, sa susunod na bukkake, ipaalala mong hubarin ko ang mga damit ko.

ds:305:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal, you ever partaken in one of those?
ds:305:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Uy, Rascal, nakasali ka na ba sa ganoon?

ds:305:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, next time we’re in one we’ll be sure to call ya.
ds:305:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, sa susunod na sumali kami, siguradong tatawagin ka namin.

ds:305:298:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually, I wouldn’t mind
being in the middle of one!
ds:305:298:Dialogue Text.target:
Sa totoo lang, ayos sa 'kin
na nasa gitna ng isa!

ds:305:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh yeah? Ya wanna be covered by a buncha guys spunk?
ds:305:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, talaga? Gusto mong mabalutan ng tamod ng maraming lalaki?

ds:305:301:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, susubukan ko ang kahit ano, kahit isang beses lang…

ds:305:304:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The view from below is great, lemme tell ya~!
ds:305:304:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maganda ang tanawin mula sa ibaba, sinasabi ko sa 'yo~!

ds:305:306:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We could even clean you off afterward…

ds:305:309:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually, I was thinking
we could round up some ladies…
ds:305:309:Dialogue Text.target:
Sa totoo lang, naisip kong
maaari tayong magtipon ng ilang babae…

ds:305:312:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]A buncha ladies going to town on themselves with a dude in the middle?
ds:305:312:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Maraming babaeng nagpapasarap sa sarili na may lalaki sa gitna?

ds:305:315:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’ll need to find a buncha squirters though…
ds:305:315:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero kailangan nating humanap ng maraming bumubuga…

ds:305:323:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But sex parties? That’s a different story.

ds:305:326:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There’s some pretty active critters about a day’s hike from here.
ds:305:326:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May ilang aktibong nilalang sa layong isang araw na lakad mula rito.

ds:305:327:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The parties always delve into some sorta sex thing.
ds:305:327:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Laging nauuwi sa kung anong seks ang mga party.

ds:305:328:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They’ve been known to be pretty crazy!

ds:305:329:Dialogue Text.source:
Oh? What’s the craziest thing
you two have done?
ds:305:329:Dialogue Text.target:
Oh? Ano ang pinakamatinding
ginawa n'yong dalawa?

ds:305:331:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm, well there was that oooooone tiiiiiiiime.

ds:305:334:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]This is her favorite story, and I swear it didn’t even happen!
ds:305:334:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Paborito niyang kuwento, at sigurado akong hindi man lang nangyari!

ds:305:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, that’s because you were WAAAAY too drunk!

ds:305:341:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So as you know, Claire can be quite competitive…
ds:305:341:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gaya ng alam mo, medyo mapagpaligsahan si Claire…

ds:305:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Buuut let it be known, that Claire is a bit of a light weight when it comes to alcohol.
ds:305:342:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Perooo dapat malaman, madaling tamaan ng alak si Claire.

ds:305:347:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, one thing led to another. And, go figure, Claire gets reaaaaaally horny when she’s drunk!
ds:305:347:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Basta, tuloy-tuloy ang mga nangyari. At siyempre, libog na libooog si Claire kapag lasing!

ds:305:349:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok that’s not true! I am the same amount of horny, regardless of alcohol.
ds:305:349:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi 'yan totoo! Pareho lang ang libog ko, may alak man o wala.

ds:305:353:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok, so one thing lead to another - and I kiiiinda egged on a competition of who could get the most guys off.
ds:305:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, tuloy-tuloy ang mga nangyari - at parang hinikayat ko ang isang paligsahan kung sino ang makapagpapalabas sa pinakamaraming lalaki.

ds:305:354:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The night started off with us finding guys seperately, but I guess word got around…
ds:305:354:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sa simula ng gabi, magkahiwalay kaming naghahanap ng lalaki, pero kumalat yata ang balita…

ds:306:291:Dialogue Text.source: Soon enough we found ourselves in the middle of a bukkake!
ds:306:291:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi nagtagal, nasa gitna na kami ng bukkake!

ds:306:292:Dialogue Text.source: Been a while since we’ve gotten into that position.
ds:306:292:Dialogue Text.target: Matagal-tagal na mula nang mapunta kami sa ganoong posisyon.

ds:306:293:Dialogue Text.source: Claire, you shoulda saw the look on your face. You were in heaven.
ds:306:293:Dialogue Text.target: Claire, dapat nakita mo ang mukha mo. Nasa langit ka.

ds:307:497:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey. man! Good to see you here!

ds:307:499:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey! If it isn’t our stand-in barber!
ds:307:499:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]O! Nandito pala ang pansamantala nating barbero!

ds:307:501:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We heard you treated Finley quite well.
ds:307:501:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Balita namin, inalagaan mong mabuti si Finley.

ds:307:502:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We might have you as an apprentice!

ds:307:505:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, Rascal also gave me a special treatment afterward…
ds:307:505:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam n'yo, may espesyal ding ginawa sa akin si Rascal pagkatapos…

ds:307:511:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, apparently Rascal here appreciated my assets, and wanted to have a go back there.
ds:307:511:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, mukhang nagustuhan nitong si Rascal ang mga yaman ko, at gusto niyang tumira sa likuran.

ds:307:516:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha ok ok, my ego can only get so inflated!
ds:307:516:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha sige, sige. Baka naman sumobra ang paglaki ng ulo ko!

ds:307:517:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Anywho, he hopped on back and showed me what Red Pandas can do!
ds:307:517:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Basta, pumuwesto siya sa likod at ipinakita kung ano'ng kayang gawin ng mga pulang panda!

ds:307:518:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I had no idea they had knots!
ds:307:518:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ko alam na may mga buhol pala sila!

ds:307:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah… I’m not sure that they do…
ds:307:520:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oo… Hindi ako sigurado kung mayroon nga sila…

ds:307:525:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He’s kinda big for his size huh? Don’t suppose it caused ya too much trouble though Finley?
ds:307:525:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Medyo malaki ang sa kanya para sa katawan niya, ano? Pero siguro hindi ka naman masyadong nahirapan, Finley?

ds:307:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well I haven’t been practicing much these days - and there was no time for warming up.
ds:307:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi na ako gaanong nakakapagpraktis nitong mga huli—at wala nang oras para magpainit muna.

ds:307:530:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see! Sounds like we gotta toy around with you more often then.
ds:307:530:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Gano'n pala! Mukhang dapat ka naming paglaruan nang mas madalas.

ds:307:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, occasionally Finley’ll let us pin him down and stuff some toys up there!
ds:307:535:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, paminsan-minsan hinahayaan kami ni Finley na pigilan siyang makagalaw at pasakan ng mga laruan sa likod!

ds:307:538:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, when was the last time we even fooled around?
ds:307:538:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo nga, kailan ba tayo huling nagkulitan?

ds:307:540:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm. It was when we were gonna paint together.
ds:307:540:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mmm. Noong dapat sana'y magpipinta tayo nang magkakasama.

ds:307:541:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I had to run an errand so I was a bit late.
ds:307:541:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]May inasikaso lang ako kaya medyo nahuli.

ds:307:542:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]When I got there, I saw Claire’s got her muzzle more than half way down your shaft.
ds:307:542:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pagdating ko, nakita kong lampas kalahati na ng ari mo ang nasasakop ng nguso ni Claire.

ds:307:544:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]OOOH right! Dang, that was some time ago!

ds:307:545:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I keep telling Finley, I’m gonna deep throat him one day.
ds:307:545:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lagi kong sinasabi kay Finley, isusubo ko siya hanggang lalamunan balang araw.

ds:307:546:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So I’ll give it a shot every so often. He’s a good sport for being so willing.
ds:307:546:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya sinusubukan ko paminsan-minsan. Ang bait niyang pumayag palagi.

ds:307:548:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Who am I, to shatter the dreams of an ambitious lady.
ds:307:548:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sino ba ako para sirain ang pangarap ng isang babaeng mataas ang ambisyon.

ds:307:550:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Gosh, I still remember that pull out. That was QUITE the load Finley.
ds:307:550:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naku, naaalala ko pa 'yung paghugot mo. NAPAKARAMI ng tamod no'n, Finley.

ds:307:552:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah that was my fault. We were at it for a WHILE and I didn’t want him getting soft on me.
ds:307:552:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo, kasalanan ko 'yon. ANG TAGAL na naming ginagawa, at ayokong lumambot siya habang kasama ako.

ds:307:553:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Honestly props to him for lasting so long.
ds:307:553:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa totoo lang, saludo ako sa kanya dahil tumagal siya nang gano'n.

ds:307:557:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know the rest of that night was pretty hot too…
ds:307:557:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam n'yo, mainit din ang natitirang bahagi ng gabing 'yon…

ds:307:568:Dialogue Text.source: Wait, but I didn’t hear anything about toys.
ds:307:568:Dialogue Text.target: Teka, pero wala akong narinig tungkol sa mga laruan.

ds:307:571:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Like I said, we’re overdue for a session!
ds:307:571:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Gaya ng sabi ko, dapat matagal na natin 'yang inulit!

ds:307:572:Dialogue Text.source: Hit me up when that happens!

ds:308:566:Dialogue Text.source: Gotta say, there’s nothin’ quite like making out with Claire after she’s got a fresh load!
ds:308:566:Dialogue Text.target: Masasabi kong walang katulad ang pakikipaglaplapan kay Claire kapag katatanggap pa lang niya ng sariwang tamod!

ds:308:570:Dialogue Text.source: I had it pretty good too. Dinner and a show!
ds:308:570:Dialogue Text.target: Maganda rin ang naranasan ko. Hapunan at palabas!

ds:309:20:Dialogue Text.source: Whoa that’s a ton of dirt!

ds:309:22:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think Bucky said he could put this to use. That’ll be good.
ds:309:22:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabi yata ni Bucky, may paggagamitan siya nito. Mabuti 'yon.

ds:309:23:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Grounds almost all prepped! Then I can lay the foundation!
ds:309:23:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Halos handa na ang lupa! Tapos, mailalatag ko na ang pundasyon!

ds:309:26:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Just gotta catch my breath, and I’ll be back at it!
ds:309:26:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hahabol lang ng hininga, tapos balik-trabaho na!

ds:311:508:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, I heard you’re… um… into bigger guys?
ds:311:508:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Narinig ko kasing… um… mahilig ka sa mas malalaking lalaki?

ds:311:512:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well uh… I don’t know if you wanna try… may-
ds:311:512:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kaya ano… Hindi ko alam kung gusto mong subukan… ba-

ds:311:514:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha yes, please. Whatever you wanna do, yes please!
ds:311:514:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, oo, sige. Kahit anong gusto mong gawin, oo, sige!

ds:311:516:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Water is whatever, you guys had to REBUILD it!
ds:311:516:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Wala lang ang pagkabasa, kinailangan ninyong ITAYO ULIT!

ds:311:518:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If the forest is going to keep growing, we’ll be needing to rebuild all sorts of stuff.
ds:311:518:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kung patuloy na lalaki ang gubat, marami tayong kailangang itayong muli.

ds:311:519:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Really, it’s not a problem, and it was a matter of time anyways.
ds:311:519:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Talaga, walang problema, mangyayari rin naman 'yon balang araw.

ds:311:521:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well… I’d still like to make it up to you somehow…
ds:311:521:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero… Gusto ko pa ring makabawi sa 'yo kahit paano…

ds:311:525:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Actually, I had something else in mind…
ds:311:525:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa totoo lang, may iba akong naiisip…

ds:311:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I bet thats a sight to behold from you!

ds:311:530:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, I’d pay to see that!

ds:311:532:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh please, hah! It would be on the house, of course!

ds:311:537:Dialogue Text.source:
Hey! Good to see you’re
talking over things.

ds:311:539:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, thanks for the push! It’s always hard for me to make the first step…
ds:311:539:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo, salamat sa pagtulak! Lagi akong nahihirapang gumawa ng unang hakbang…

ds:311:541:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t worry, I know exactly how you feel, especially with you being pretty new ’n all!
ds:311:541:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Huwag kang mag-alala, alam na alam ko ang pakiramdam mo, lalo na't bago ka pa rito!

ds:311:542:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I shoulda reached out, again, I’m sorry about that!
ds:311:542:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dapat ako na ang lumapit, pasensiya na talaga roon!

ds:311:544:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh not at all, I still feel absolutely awful about the bridge!
ds:311:544:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naku, hindi, masama pa rin talaga ang loob ko tungkol sa tulay!

ds:311:545:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Is there any way I can make it up to you?

ds:311:547:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah, as I’ve said, you’ve got nothing to feel bad about!
ds:311:547:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hah, gaya ng sinabi ko, wala kang dapat ikasama ng loob!

ds:311:548:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s my shoddy craftsmanship that got you all wet in the first place.
ds:311:548:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dahil sa palpak kong pagkakagawa kaya ka nabasa noong una.

ds:311:550:Dialogue Text.source:
Speaking of which! That was
an impressive paw-free orgasm!
ds:311:550:Dialogue Text.target:
Tungkol nga pala roon! Kahanga-hanga
'yong paglabas mo nang walang lapa sa titi!

ds:311:554:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s hard for me to climax without some sorta stimulation…
ds:311:554:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hirap akong labasan nang walang kahit anong stimulasyon…

ds:311:556:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh heh! Yeah, see, I don’t have any paws to help out, so I kinda had to figure out other ways of pleasing myself…
ds:311:556:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, heh! Wala kasi akong mga lapang makakatulong, kaya kinailangan kong humanap ng ibang paraan para paligayahin ang sarili ko…

ds:311:557:Dialogue Text.source: Is that a normal thing for you?

ds:311:560:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Normally I use… ermm… well… my own mouth…
ds:311:560:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kadalasan ang gamit ko… ermm… ano… sarili kong bibig…

ds:311:562:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hey Rascal! It’s good to see you

ds:311:566:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Gosh! You’re a wizard with that tongue! Those lips too!
ds:311:566:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Naku! Mahika ang nagagawa mo sa dilang 'yan! Pati sa mga labi!

ds:311:568:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, thanks… They’re my main tool for pleasing critters…
ds:311:568:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, salamat… 'Yon ang pangunahing gamit ko para pasayahin ang mga nilalang…

ds:312:18:Dialogue Text.source: There's a bunch of glyphs carved here... No idea what it says.
ds:312:18:Dialogue Text.target: Maraming glipong nakaukit dito... Hindi ko alam ang sinasabi.

ds:313:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey Rascal! Ya ready to get some work done?

ds:314:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hah! Not much I can do with these wings.
ds:314:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hah! Wala akong gaanong magagawa gamit ang mga pakpak na ito.

ds:314:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pagsubaybay sa usad, komunikasyon, AT paghahain ng mga pampalamig!

ds:315:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal? Are you helping us here too?
ds:315:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Rascal? Tutulong ka rin ba sa amin dito?

ds:315:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Gosh! You’ve already helped so much! I feel like we’re taking advantage of you!
ds:315:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Naku! Ang dami mo nang naitulong! Parang sinasamantala na namin ang kabaitan mo!

ds:315:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You don’t have to if you don’t want to. This is our mess to fix!
ds:315:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hindi mo kailangang tumulong kung ayaw mo. Kami ang dapat mag-ayos ng gulong ito!

ds:315:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aww, kay buti ng puso mo, Rascal!

ds:315:209:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aww, kay buti ng puso mo, Rascal!

ds:316:133:Dialogue Text.source: I thought you and Bucky were on bad terms?
ds:316:133:Dialogue Text.target: Akala ko hindi kayo magkasundo ni Bucky?

ds:316:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Sorry you had to see any of that, it’s quite unbecoming for critters our age to act like that.
ds:316:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pasensiya't kinailangan mong makita iyon. Hindi bagay sa mga nilalang na kaedad namin ang kumilos nang ganoon.

ds:316:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The fact is, our conflicts should be second to our town and the well being of our neighbors!
ds:316:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ang totoo, dapat unahin ang bayan natin at ang kapakanan ng ating mga kapitbahay kaysa sa alitan namin!

ds:316:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Simply put, this is too important for me to NOT help!
ds:316:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa madaling salita, napakahalaga nito para HINDI ako tumulong!

ds:316:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]This has given us time to be adults again and start figuring stuff out.
ds:316:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagkaroon kami ng oras para muling kumilos bilang matatanda at simulan ang pag-aayos ng mga bagay-bagay.

ds:316:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Er… not to bog you down with drama or details.
