ds:316:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah… Hindi sa gusto kitang abalahin sa drama o mga detalye.

ds:316:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But don’t worry about us, I think we’ll be ok!
ds:316:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero huwag kang mag-alala sa amin. Sa tingin ko, magiging ayos kami!

ds:316:142:Dialogue Text.source: Ok. Well I’m glad you’ll be joining us!
ds:316:142:Dialogue Text.target: Sige. Masaya akong sasamahan mo kami!

ds:317:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dustin and I will be supervising Bucky’s plans!
ds:317:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kami ni Dustin ang mangangasiwa sa mga plano ni Bucky!

ds:317:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’ll be makin’ sure y’all ain’t slackin’!

ds:318:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Great! Look alive out there! We’ll be counting on ya!

ds:318:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Look alive out there! We’ll be counting on ya!

ds:31:21:Dialogue Text.source: They look tasty… too high up to reach though…
ds:31:21:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang masarap… pero masyadong mataas para maabot…

ds:31:22:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm… Do apples grow this high up in elevation?
ds:31:22:Dialogue Text.target: Hmm… Tumutubo ba ang mga mansanas sa ganito kataas na lugar?

ds:320:131:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks, and right back at ya!

ds:321:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nice work Rascal! Thanks for all your help!
ds:321:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang galing, Rascal! Salamat sa lahat ng tulong mo!

ds:321:131:Dialogue Text.source: Thank you for the wonderful refreshments!

ds:321:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh hey, I’ve got a bell for you!

ds:321:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This one’s for the perch across the river!
ds:321:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Para ito sa dapuan sa kabilang pampang ng ilog!

ds:321:210:Dialogue Text.source: Thank you for the wonderful refreshments!

ds:321:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nice work Rascal! Thanks for all your help!
ds:321:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang galing, Rascal! Salamat sa lahat ng tulong mo!

ds:322:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks again for helping out Rascal, we really appreciate it!
ds:322:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Salamat ulit sa tulong mo, Rascal. Talagang pinahahalagahan namin 'yon!

ds:322:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oooh, this’ll actually be a great opportunity for you!
ds:322:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oooh, magandang pagkakataon nga ito para sa 'yo!

ds:322:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s so many other critters to meet, so be sure to head down there tomorrow!
ds:322:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napakarami pang nilalang na makikilala, kaya pumunta ka roon bukas!

ds:322:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh, Penny said she has something for ya!
ds:322:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]O, sabi ni Penny may ibibigay siya sa 'yo!

ds:322:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks again for helping out Rascal, we really appreciate it!
ds:322:209:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Salamat ulit sa tulong mo, Rascal. Talagang pinahahalagahan namin 'yon!

ds:322:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t forget, Penny said she has something for ya!
ds:322:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Huwag kalimutan, sabi ni Penny may ibibigay siya sa 'yo!

ds:325:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now I can show you my shop! I’ll give you the tour tomorrow!
ds:325:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Maipapakita ko na sa 'yo ang tindahan ko! Ililibot kita bukas!

ds:326:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Also - be sure to stay off the bridge for now!
ds:326:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At huwag ka munang dumaan sa tulay!

ds:326:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok everyone! I think that about does it!
ds:326:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, lahat! Sa tingin ko, tapos na tayo!

ds:326:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah, it’s nice to see a days hardwork pay off!
ds:326:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, kay sarap makitang nagbubunga ang isang araw na pagsisikap!

ds:326:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I wanna thank everyone for their help!
ds:326:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Gusto kong pasalamatan ang lahat sa pagtulong!

ds:326:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And a special thanks to our guest, Rascal!
ds:326:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At espesyal na pasasalamat sa bisita nating si Rascal!

ds:326:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Aye! Remind me to get you a drink at my shop later!
ds:326:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]O! Ipaalala mong ilibre kita ng inumin sa tindahan ko mamaya!

ds:326:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ah, alright. First rounds on the house!
ds:326:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ah, sige na. Libre ang unang ikot ng inumin!

ds:326:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok everyone, let’s all get a good nights rest!
ds:326:243:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, lahat, magpahinga tayo nang mahimbing ngayong gabi!

ds:326:244:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! And don’t use the bridge just yet! We need to let it sit while the compounds dry.
ds:326:244:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O! At huwag munang gamitin ang tulay! Kailangan muna itong hayaan habang natutuyo ang mga halo.

ds:327:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I let ya sleep in, but the day’s well on its way!
ds:327:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hinayaan kitang magpakasarap sa tulog, pero mataas na rin ang araw!

ds:327:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Go check out the rest of the forest to the South!
ds:327:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tuklasin mo na ang iba pang bahagi ng gubat sa Timog!

ds:328:18:Dialogue Text.source: I don't think this is the way to go right now…
ds:328:18:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin ko, hindi ito ang dapat daanan ngayon…

ds:329:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3] Let me know if you're tired, you can stay the night!
ds:329:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3] Sabihin mo kung pagod ka na. Puwede kang dito magpalipas ng gabi!

ds:32:23:Dialogue Text.source: No Penny to be seen though.

ds:330:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! Please stay off the bridge for now!
ds:330:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Rascal! Huwag ka muna sa tulay, pakiusap!

ds:331:573:Dialogue Text.source: Evening ladies! What are you two up to?
ds:331:573:Dialogue Text.target: Magandang gabi, mga binibini! Ano'ng ginagawa ninyo?

ds:331:575:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Penny and I were just talking about setting up a date with the plant-
ds:331:575:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pinag-uusapan lang namin ni Penny na makipagtipan sa halaman-

ds:331:576:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]OH MY GOSH, I JUST REMEMBERED! Rascal recently had his own experience with the plant!
ds:331:576:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]NAKU, NAALALA KO LANG! May sarili ring karanasan si Rascal sa halaman kamakailan!

ds:331:578:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh? You’ve met our little friend in the woods?
ds:331:578:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oh? Nakilala mo na ang munting kaibigan natin sa gubat?

ds:331:579:Dialogue Text.source: I did! It got well acquainted with my rear…
ds:331:579:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Nakilalang mabuti ng halaman ang puwit ko…

ds:331:583:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Tell me, are you comfortable being on the receiving end?
ds:331:583:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sabihin mo, komportable ka bang ikaw ang pinapasukan?

ds:331:584:Dialogue Text.source: I am! I quite enjoy it!

ds:331:586:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not a big fan, but I’m flexible.
ds:331:586:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi ko masyadong gusto, pero bukas akong sumubok.

ds:331:588:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll be sure to keep that in mind!

ds:331:592:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I actually ran into Rascal JUST AFTER it all went down.
ds:331:592:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang totoo, nakasalubong ko si Rascal PAGKATAPOS NA PAGKATAPOS ng lahat.

ds:331:593:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I was gathering up my nerve to ask him out on a date - I didn’t even realize what he was up to.
ds:331:593:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nilalakasan ko ang loob kong yayain siyang makipagtipan, hindi ko man lang napansin kung ano ang ginagawa niya.

ds:331:596:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Turns out he was running an errand for Scarlett. Gathering some "fresh fertilizer," stored in Scarlett’s favorite way.
ds:331:596:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May ipinagawa pala si Scarlett sa kanya. Nangongolekta ng "sariwang pataba," na nakatago sa paboritong paraan ni Scarlett.

ds:331:599:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Baw, I see. But still, experiencing it at all is something to respect!
ds:331:599:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Baw, ganoon pala. Pero kahanga-hanga pa rin na nasubukan mo!

ds:331:601:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So he’s over there, clenching his butt cheeks, red in the face, cum oozing down his legs - I’m over there like ’Hey uhhh wanna get a drink maybe?’
ds:331:601:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya naroon siya, ipit na ipit ang mga pisngi ng puwit, pulang-pula ang mukha, umaagos ang tamod sa mga binti—tapos ako, 'Uy, uhhh, gusto mo bang uminom tayo?'

ds:331:605:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal’s so humble, he didn’t cut me off, or interrupt me. Just kindly held it in, squirming.
ds:331:605:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Napakabait ni Rascal, hindi niya ako sinabat o pinatigil sa pagsasalita. Mabait lang niyang pinigil iyon sa loob, namimilipit.

ds:331:607:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well now you GOTTA take him on a date. You made him suffer!
ds:331:607:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kailangan mo na talaga siyang i-date ngayon. Pinahirapan mo siya!

ds:331:609:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It was so funny though! If I could go back in time, I wouldn’t change a thing.
ds:331:609:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero ang nakakatawa kasi! Kung makakabalik ako sa nakaraan, wala akong babaguhin.

ds:331:612:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m sorry. I’ll make it up on our date. Drinks on me!
ds:331:612:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pasensiya na. Babawi ako sa date natin. Libre ko ang inumin!

ds:331:613:Dialogue Text.source: OK, I’ll hold you to it!

ds:331:615:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Great! I’ll move some things around and get back to you!
ds:331:615:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ayos! Aayusin ko lang ang iskedyul ko at babalikan kita!

ds:331:616:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Till then, Penny and I were making plans to visit our little plant friend…
ds:331:616:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Habang hindi pa, nagpaplano kami ni Penny na bisitahin ang munting kaibigan nating halaman…

ds:331:618:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Mabel, hearing you call anything "little" is bizarre…
ds:331:618:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mabel, ang kakatwa kapag ikaw ang nagsasabing "munti" ang kahit ano…

ds:331:620:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I got it from you! You’re always calling it "your little plant friend!"
ds:331:620:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sa 'yo ko nakuha! Lagi mong sinasabing "ang munting kaibigan mong halaman!"

ds:331:621:Dialogue Text.source: Do you see the plant often, Penny?
ds:331:621:Dialogue Text.target: Madalas ka bang pumunta sa halaman, Penny?

ds:331:624:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve been taking Mabel with me on occasion these days.
ds:331:624:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Paminsan-minsan isinasama ko si Mabel nitong mga nakaraan.

ds:331:633:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That plant really knows how to treat a lady!
ds:331:633:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Alam talaga ng halamang 'yon kung paano pasayahin ang isang babae!

ds:331:636:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That’s true! I think just about every critter has spent ample time with that plant…
ds:331:636:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Totoo! Parang halos lahat ng nilalang, matagal nang nakasama ang halamang 'yon…

ds:331:638:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]I’ve seen Scarlett and Peter there many times. I know Oliver has expressed interest. Bucky’s fooled around a few times.
ds:331:638:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Maraming beses ko nang nakita roon sina Scarlett at Peter. Alam kong interesado si Oliver. Ilang beses na ring nakipaglaro si Bucky.

ds:331:640:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I think I’ve literally seen every critter with that plant…
ds:331:640:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Parang nakita ko na talaga ang bawat nilalang kasama ang halamang 'yon…

ds:331:641:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]*cough* I may have uh… been in the area… Unnoticed… many times…
ds:331:641:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]*ubo* Baka kasi ano… nasa paligid ako… Hindi napapansin… nang maraming beses…

ds:331:642:Dialogue Text.source: Wha! Are you peeping on critters?
ds:331:642:Dialogue Text.target: Ha! Naninilip ka ba ng mga nilalang?

ds:331:644:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hey! I’m small! I can’t help if the other critters don’t notice me!
ds:331:644:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hoy! Maliit ako! Hindi ko kasalanan kung hindi ako napapansin ng ibang nilalang!

ds:331:645:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Especially in their intense throes of passion…
ds:331:645:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lalo na kapag abalang-abala sila sa pagniniig…

ds:331:649:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So what are you two gonna do on your date?

ds:331:656:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Can’t wait to stuff my mouth! I’ll be full all night!
ds:331:656:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi na ako makapaghintay na punuin ang bibig ko! Busog ako buong gabi!

ds:331:657:Dialogue Text.source: Indeed! Can’t wait to "eat out" for our picnic!
ds:331:657:Dialogue Text.target: Oo nga! Hindi na ako makapaghintay na "kumain sa labas" sa piknik natin!

ds:331:660:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t be fooled Rascal! Mabel isn’t as sweet and innocent as she looks!
ds:331:660:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Huwag kang magpaloko, Rascal! Hindi kasingbait at inosente si Mabel ng hitsura niya!

ds:331:661:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She’s been known to peep about on occasions!

ds:331:664:Dialogue Text.source:
Mabel, I hereby give you permission to peep
on any and all sexual activities I’m involved in.
ds:331:664:Dialogue Text.target:
Mabel, binibigyan kita ng pahintulot na manilip
sa lahat ng seksuwal na gawaing kasali ako.

ds:331:668:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You must, however, regale all events to Penny Plume. No details shall be left out!
ds:331:668:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pero kailangan mong isalaysay ang lahat kay Penny Plume. Walang detalyeng puwedeng alisin!

ds:332:634:Dialogue Text.source: She was all tied up, gaping after this crazy messy pull out!
ds:332:634:Dialogue Text.target: Nakatali siya, nakabuka pa matapos ang sobrang kalat na paghugot!

ds:332:635:Dialogue Text.source: I was right on her, so I could feel her twitching and squirming as she came.
ds:332:635:Dialogue Text.target: Nasa ibabaw niya mismo ako, kaya ramdam ko ang pagkibot at pamimilipit niya habang nilalabasan.

ds:332:637:Dialogue Text.source: I’m tellin’ ya! I was being tickled!

ds:332:638:Dialogue Text.source: The plant was all slurping on my talons, you’d be giggling too!
ds:332:638:Dialogue Text.target: Sinisipsip ng halaman ang mga kuko ko sa paa, mapapahagikhik ka rin!

ds:332:640:Dialogue Text.source: That’s not how I remember it!

ds:332:642:Dialogue Text.source: What about you? I seem to remember some intense shivers of pleasure when those tentacles were twisting around in ya.
ds:332:642:Dialogue Text.target: Ikaw naman? Naalala kong grabe ang panginginig mo sa sarap habang umiikot-ikot sa loob mo ang mga galamay.

ds:332:644:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, oo naman. Matindi ang paglabas ko.

ds:333:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmmm yeaah. I think this place will do just fine!
ds:333:29:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmmm oo. Sa tingin ko, ayos na ayos ang lugar na 'to!

ds:333:31:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy mate! Just preparing for the dig!

ds:333:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I needed a bit more space, so I got the OK from Scarlett to do it here!
ds:333:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kailangan ko pa ng espasyo, kaya pinayagan ako ni Scarlett na dito gawin!

ds:333:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’ll see, check up on me later!

ds:334:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just got some finishing touches, and we’ll be good to go!
ds:334:29:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kaunting panghuling ayos na lang, at handa na tayo!

ds:334:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!
ds:334:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sabik na akong ipakita sa 'yo ang inihanda ko para rito!

ds:334:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!
ds:334:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sabik na akong ipakita sa 'yo ang inihanda ko para rito!

ds:335:30:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks mate! Just wait till we get to training!
ds:335:30:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Salamat, pare! Maghintay ka lang hanggang magsanay tayo!

ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ehhh, kailangan ko munang bumawi ng lakas. Napakaraming trabaho noon.

ds:335:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!
ds:335:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero kapag handa na ako, malalaman mo!

ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ehhh, kailangan ko munang bumawi ng lakas. Napakaraming trabaho noon.

ds:335:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!
ds:335:36:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero kapag handa na ako, malalaman mo!

ds:336:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! Dang Rascal, I couldn’t touch you!

ds:336:149:Dialogue Text.source: I suppose I learn from the best!

ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah! You’re gonna be great at this! I’ll let you know when I get better routines set up!
ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ha! Gagaling ka rito! Sasabihan kita kapag may mas magaganda na akong pagsasanay!

ds:336:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hehehe… I’ve got a lot of fun stuff planned…

ds:336:154:Dialogue Text.target: Natamaan mo pa rin ako nang isang beses!

ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]True, but I usually hit folks a lot more than that!
ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Totoo, pero karaniwang mas maraming beses kong natatamaan ang iba!

ds:336:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, I got ya a few times eh?
ds:336:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oooh, natamaan kita nang ilang beses, ano?

ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you could do better next time?
ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa tingin mo, kaya mong galingan pa sa susunod?

ds:336:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Rascal, mate, I’ll be honest. That was pathetic!

ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, you can only go up from here, right?
ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero uy, maaari ka na lang gumaling mula rito, di ba?

ds:336:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s give it another shot when you’re ready.
ds:336:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Subukan natin uli kapag handa ka na.

ds:336:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve got a fun lil’ routine set up.

ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perfect, so you should be familiar with how to move your body pretty well, yeah?
ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayos, kaya sanay ka nang igalaw ang katawan mo, ano?

ds:336:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oy! Ya ready to give this a shot?

ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! For now I’ve prepared this Practice Routine. Let’s get started!
ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayos! Sa ngayon, inihanda ko itong Panimulang Pagsasanay. Simulan natin!

ds:336:50:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gonna try to PELT YOU with ACORNS!

ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For this first round, we’ll just see how you fare for 30 seconds!
ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa unang round, tingnan muna natin kung kumusta ka sa loob ng 30 segundo!

ds:336:54:Dialogue Text.source: Uhhh, I don’t like the sound of this…
ds:336:54:Dialogue Text.target: Uhhh, parang ayoko ng naririnig ko…

ds:336:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Psssh, don’t worry mate, it’ll be fine!
ds:336:55:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Psssh, huwag kang mag-alala, pare, ayos lang 'yan!

ds:336:56:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know when you’re ready to get started!
ds:336:56:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabihin mo kapag handa ka nang magsimula!

ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I see, well, we just got this order in, so we’ll probably sit this one out.
ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ganoon, kararating lang ng order na 'to, kaya malamang hindi muna kami sasama.

ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s no rush!
You guys can join us.
ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.target:
Walang nagmamadali!
Puwede kayong sumama sa amin.

ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s okay Rascal, we can’t exactly all ride Penny anyways. We’ll head over once we’re finished here.
ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ayos lang, Rascal, hindi naman tayong lahat makasasakay kay Penny. Susunod kami kapag tapos na rito.

ds:337:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Yep. Besides… that place kind of gives me the creeps…
ds:337:15:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Oo. Isa pa… parang kinikilabutan ako sa lugar na 'yon…

ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, we’ll be sure to catch you two up then!
ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sige, ibabalita na lang namin sa inyong dalawa!

ds:337:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Come quick! There’s something going on at the ruins!

ds:337:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Whoa, what do you mean? Is something wrong?
ds:337:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Whoa, ano'ng ibig mong sabihin? May problema ba?

ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Augustus just told me to round up all the critters! He seemed very excited.
ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pinapakuha lang ni Augustus ang lahat ng nilalang! Mukhang sabik na sabik siya.

ds:338:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh! What could all this be about?
ds:338:12:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Naku! Tungkol saan kaya ang lahat ng 'to?

ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Do check on the other critters… they seem a bit more worried…
ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kumustahin mo ang ibang nilalang… mukhang mas nag-aalala sila…

ds:338:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow check this out! The symbols are glowing!
ds:338:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wow, tingnan mo 'to! Nagliliwanag ang mga simbolo!

ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No idea what this is about, but I’m pretty excited!
ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Wala akong ideya kung tungkol saan, pero medyo nasasabik ako!

ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly, nothing really happens here too often… So I’m a bit more excited than worried about it…
ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa totoo lang, bihirang may mangyari dito… Kaya mas nasasabik ako kaysa nag-aalala…

ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Besides! If anything bad happens, I can just fly away! See ya!
ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isa pa! Kung may masamang mangyari, puwede naman akong lumipad palayo! Paalam!

ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure nothing bad will come of this… Right?
ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sigurado akong walang masamang mangyayari rito… Di ba?

ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And if something bad happens… We’ll figure it out together! We’re a scrappy bunch!
ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]At kung may masamang mangyari… Sama-sama natin 'tong haharapin! Madiskarte tayo!

ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon love, there’s no need to get worked up just yet…
ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sige na, mahal, hindi pa kailangang mabagabag…

ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]*Sigh* I’m sorry dear, I’m just on edge… This is very strange…
ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]*Buntong-hininga* Pasensiya na, mahal, balisa lang ako… Napakakakaiba nito…

ds:339:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I know, love. But we’ll be ok…
ds:339:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Alam ko, mahal. Pero magiging ayos tayo…

ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh Rascal, I’m glad to see you here. Look at what’s happening!
ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oh, Rascal, natutuwa akong nandito ka. Tingnan mo ang nangyayari!

ds:339:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ve got a bad feeling about this…

ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm, I don’t mean to snip dear, but I’ve been here my whole life and haven’t seen anything like this.
ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mmm, ayokong maging masungit, mahal, pero buong buhay na akong narito at wala pa akong nakitang ganito.

ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]If there was ever a time for concern, this is a pretty good one…
ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kung may panahong dapat mag-alala, mukhang ito na 'yon…

ds:33:22:Dialogue Text.source: … Yeah, definitely not going in there.

ds:340:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope we didn’t do anything wrong…

ds:340:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tingnan mo nga naman ang lahat ng 'to…

ds:340:5:Dialogue Text.source: What do you think about it?

ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These ruins have been here for so long… and we don’t know enough about them… What if we did something wrong?
ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napakatagal nang nandito ang mga guhông 'to… at kulang ang alam natin sa mga 'to… Paano kung may nagawa tayong mali?

ds:341:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]What do you think it could be?? A sign? A warning?

ds:341:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I probably should be – but I’m so curious!

ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The rest of the critters say they’ve never seen this. They say it looks ominous. But I think it looks pretty!
ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sabi ng ibang nilalang, hindi pa nila nakita 'to. Mukha raw masamang pangitain. Pero sa tingin ko, maganda!

ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pare, manlalakbay man ako… Pero itinuturing ako ng mga nilalang na 'to na isa sa kanila. Ayokong may masamang mangyari sa kanila…

ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m doing well.
What do you make of all this?
ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.target:
Ayos naman ako.
Ano'ng masasabi mo sa lahat ng 'to?

ds:342:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I’m kinda scared… But also ready.
ds:342:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pare, medyo natatakot ako… Pero handa rin.

ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, I don’t know what’s coming up, but I’m prepared to do my part. Whatever needs to be done.
ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo, hindi ko alam kung ano ang darating, pero handa akong gawin ang bahagi ko. Anumang kailangan.

ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pare, manlalakbay man ako… Pero itinuturing ako ng mga nilalang na 'to na isa sa kanila. Ayokong may masamang mangyari sa kanila…

ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to tell them a few times now. I’m pretty sure there’s nothin to worry about.
ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ilang beses ko na silang sinabihan. Naniniwala akong walang dapat ikabahala.

ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, I recall stumbling across a writing that mentioned something like this.
ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Matagal na, naaalala kong may nabasa akong sulat na bumanggit sa ganitong pangyayari.

ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though the writing didn’t mention why, or what it meant – it definitely didn’t mention any cataclysmic events afterward.
ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Bagaman hindi binanggit ng sulat kung bakit, o ang kahulugan nito – tiyak na wala itong binanggit na kapahamakang sumunod.

ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perhaps this is just a temporary phenomenon. Perhaps it’s something much more…
ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Marahil pansamantalang kababalaghan lamang ito. Marahil higit pa rito…

ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I don’t think anything bad will come of it.
ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ngunit hindi ko iniisip na may masamang mangyayari dahil dito.

ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to calm the critters down, but some of them can be pretty creative and get themselves worked up, heh.
ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sinubukan kong pakalmahin ang mga nilalang, ngunit napakamalikhain ng isip ng ilan at sila mismo ang nagpapabagabag sa sarili nila, heh.

ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I figured my time would be better spent studying this while it’s happening.
ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Naisip kong mas makabuluhang gugulin ang oras ko sa pag-aaral nito habang nangyayari.

ds:343:17:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, I should get back to it!

ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It didn’t make too much sense at the time, I thought perhaps I misinterpreted it, or perhaps it was a metaphor.
ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hindi ito gaanong makatuwiran noon, akala ko'y mali ang pagkaunawa ko, o marahil ay isang talinghaga.

ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]This is truly a sight to behold! I’ve never seen anything like this!
ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tunay itong kamangha-manghang tanawin! Wala pa akong nakitang katulad nito!

ds:343:4:Dialogue Text.target: Alam mo kung ano ang nangyayari?

ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But there’s so much to gleam from all of this.
ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ngunit napakaraming matututuhan mula sa lahat ng ito.

ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Look, even the glyphs that are broken off of the monolith are glowing.
ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tingnan mo, maging ang mga glipong natapyas mula sa monolito ay nagliliwanag.

ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You should see my collection back home, so many little runes glowing ever so slightly. [pic=3]When I first saw it, I thought I was going mad!
ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dapat mong makita ang koleksiyon ko sa bahay, napakaraming maliliit na runang bahagyang nagliliwanag. [pic=3]Noong una kong makita, akala ko'y nasisiraan na ako ng bait!

ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.source:
A lot of the critters seem worried,
do you think this is a problem?
ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.target:
Mukhang nag-aalala ang maraming nilalang,
sa tingin mo, problema ba ito?

ds:344:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Rascal, what’s all the commotion going on?
ds:344:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Uy, Rascal, ano ang lahat ng kaguluhang 'yon?

ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s some stuff going on in the ruins.
You might wanna check it out!
ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.target:
May nangyayari sa mga guho.
Baka gusto mong tingnan!

ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ruins? I’ve never seen any ruins here… but that sounds pretty interesting…
ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Mga guho? Wala pa akong nakitang guho rito… pero mukhang kawili-wili…

ds:345:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll have to go see for myself.

ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard there’s some exciting things happening? I was about to go check it out.
ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Balita ko, may mga kapana-panabik na nangyayari? Papunta na ako para tingnan.

ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, the ruins have started glowing.
It’s pretty whacky.
ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.target:
Oo, nagsimulang magliwanag ang mga guho.
Kakaiba talaga.

ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hmm, that’s quite bizarre. I’ll have to go see for myself.
ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hmm, napakakakaiba nga. Kailangan kong makita mismo.

ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, I hear there’s some crazy stuff going on…
ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Uy, Red, balita ko may matitinding nangyayari…

ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, some of the ruins are glowing…
You should check it out!
ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.target:
Oo, nagliliwanag ang ilan sa mga guho…
Dapat mong tingnan!

ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep, just closing up the shop here first. Definitely gotta see this for myself…
ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oo, isasara ko lang muna ang tindahan. Kailangan ko talagang makita mismo…

ds:347:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, let’s make a trip out there soon…

ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, as I was saying – your sweater is all done!
ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basta, gaya ng sinasabi ko – tapos na ang sweter mo!

ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Wait… there’s still a couple pins here…
ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sandali… may mga dalawang aspili pa rito…

ds:347:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I agree! We did quite well with this one!
ds:347:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sang-ayon ako! Maganda talaga ang pagkakagawa natin dito!

ds:347:23:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sige na! Imodelo mo para sa amin!

ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.source: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)
ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.target: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)

ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There he is! Good timing too, we just finished!
ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ayan na siya! Tamang-tama, katatapos lang namin!

ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes, that’s pretty normal. This is your first time, right?
ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo, normal lang 'yan. Unang beses mo, di ba?

ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The fur can mingle with the cloth – but after a while it gets more comfortable
ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nahahalo ang balahibo sa tela – pero pagtagal, mas nagiging komportable

ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, when you look this fabulous, you can’t complain!
ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero uy, kapag ganito ka kaganda, wala ka nang reklamo!

ds:347:38:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, don’t worry – You can wear it when you need to.
ds:347:38:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basta, huwag kang mag-alala – Isuot mo kapag kailangan.

ds:347:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But uh, what was all that hubbub about?
ds:347:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero uh, tungkol saan ang lahat ng ingay na 'yon?

ds:347:40:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You won’t hurt our feelings by not wearing it.
ds:347:40:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi kami magtatampo kung hindi mo isusuot.

ds:347:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’d prefer to see you nude anyways.

ds:347:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let us know if any seams come loose.
ds:347:48:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sabihin mo kung may matastas na tahi.

ds:347:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All of our clothes have a life time guarantee!
ds:347:49:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Panghabambuhay ang garantiya sa lahat ng damit namin!

ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Something’s going on.
Some of the glyphs at the ruins are glowing.
ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.target:
May nangyayari.
Nagliliwanag ang ilan sa mga glipo sa mga guho.

ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah~ That was fun! We ought to do that again real soon!
ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah~ Ang saya noon! Ulitin natin sa lalong madaling panahon!

ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.source:
Definitely! Hopefully I can
last longer next time…
ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.target:
Siyempre! Sana
mas tumagal ako sa susunod…

ds:348:503:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Haha, huwag kang mag-alala, pare! Nangyayari talaga 'yon!

ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.source:
I think I have a soft spot
for you smaller critters…
ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.target:
Parang mahina talaga ako
sa inyong maliliit na nilalang…

ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Magic Mabel Touch! No one can resist it!
ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Mahika 'yan ng Haplos ni Mabel! Walang makakatanggi!

ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gotta say though, that tongue-bath was doin’ things for me.
ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero aaminin ko, may epekto talaga sa akin 'yong paligo ng dila.

ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s definitely a big button for me!
ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Talagang matindi ang tama sa akin niyan!

ds:348:514:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Whew! Well that was a productive day!

ds:348:515:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m going to head back and chill.

ds:348:518:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At salamat sa pagsama sa amin, Rascal!

ds:348:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes! We should do this again sometime!

ds:348:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Say big guy, you free for a bit?
ds:348:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Uy, malaking kaibigan, may oras ka ba sandali?

ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We were wondering if ya wanted to take us up on that romping we mentioned earlier…
ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Naisip namin kung gusto mong ituloy 'yong lampungang binanggit namin kanina…

ds:348:530:Dialogue Text.target: Akala ko hindi na ninyo itatanong!

ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been stretching all day! Now we can put some of that to the test!
ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Buong araw kaming nag-uunat! Masusubok na natin ang resulta!

ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not gonna lie, mate, always kinda wanted to have your claws riggling inside me…
ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aaminin ko, pare, matagal ko nang gustong maramdaman ang mga kuko mong gumagalaw sa loob ko…

ds:348:537:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That sounds great! Some good ole’ fashion finger blasting!
ds:348:537:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ang sarap niyan! Matinding pagpasok ng mga daliri!

ds:348:538:Dialogue Text.source:
An order of finger blasting,
coming right up!
ds:348:538:Dialogue Text.target:
Isang order ng pagpasok ng mga daliri,
ihahain na!

ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha ok you two, follow me. There’s a secluded area behind the bushes over there…
ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, sige, kayong dalawa, sundan ninyo ako. May tagong lugar sa likod ng mga palumpong doon…

ds:349:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ok Rascal! Lay on your back over there…
ds:349:322:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, Rascal! Humiga ka roon nang patihaya…

ds:349:323:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Now let’s climb on top of him.

ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.source: Damn mate, already flyin’ full mast eh?
ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.target: Grabe, pare, tayong-tayo ka na agad, ha?

ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.source: Alright, I think we’re ready… Watch those claws!
ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, handa na yata tayo… Mag-ingat ka sa paggamit ng mga kukong 'yan!

ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.source: This is so much better than our toys Mabel!
ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.target: Di-hamak na mas masarap 'to kaysa sa mga laruan natin, Mabel!

ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.source: You two are pretty dang loose! That stretching is paying off!
ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.target: Napakaluwag ninyong dalawa! May resulta ang pag-uunat ninyo!

ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.source: We’ve been working on depth too! I bet you can get two knuckles deep on me!
ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.target: Nagsasanay din kami sa lalim! Tiyak na maipapasok mo sa akin ang daliri mo hanggang sa ikalawang buko!

ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, don’t go much further for me, mate!
ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, huwag mo nang masyadong laliman sa akin, pare!

ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.source: You’re right up on my prostate-nnngawd it feels great!
ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.target: Nasa prosteyt ko na mismo-nnng, Diyos ko, ang sarap!

ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.source: Hey Dustin, gimme a hand with this guy. I wanna see him squirt~!
ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.target: Uy, Dustin, tulungan mo akong hawakan 'to. Gusto ko siyang makitang bumulwak~!

ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, that’s right mate, let it all out~
ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, 'yan nga, pare, ilabas mo lahat~

ds:349:357:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh Dustin, you got some on your face…
ds:349:357:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, Dustin, may tumama sa mukha mo…

ds:349:361:Dialogue Text.source: Come here, I can clean you two up…

ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.source: The very fibers of your being vibrate with joy.
ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.target: Nanginginig sa tuwa ang bawat himaymay ng pagkatao mo.

ds:34:23:Dialogue Text.source: It is… an extremely magnificent piece…

ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.source: Standing in the presence of this piece makes you feel complete. Nay, FULFILLED!
ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.target: Sa harap ng obrang ito, pakiramdam mo ay ganap ka. Hindi, LUBOS NA NASIYAHAN!

ds:350:37:Dialogue Text.source: This stone… It’s warm to the touch…

ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.source: You can feel an immense power flowing from within…
ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.target: Ramdam mo ang napakalaking kapangyarihang dumadaloy mula sa loob…

ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pasensiya na, Rascal, may ginagawa ako ngayon... Sandali lang...

ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pasensiya na, Rascal, may ginagawa ako ngayon... Sandali lang...

ds:352:49:Dialogue Text.source: A bit! Those ruins were quite something!

ds:352:51:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope they don’t scare ya off! I’ve grown used to your company!
ds:352:51:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sana hindi ka matakot at umalis! Nasanay na akong kasama ka!

ds:352:52:Dialogue Text.source: Nah, I’m here for the long run.

ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal! Good work again on the bridge! We appreciate your help!
ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Rascal! Muli, mahusay ang ginawa mo sa tulay! Nagpapasalamat kami sa tulong mo!

ds:352:56:Dialogue Text.source: No problem! We make a great team!

ds:352:58:Dialogue Text.source: Let me know if you guys need anything else!
ds:352:58:Dialogue Text.target: Sabihin mo kung may kailangan pa kayo!

ds:352:59:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ooh, hindi na kami makahihiling pa sa 'yo…

ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Our little town has some pretty interesting things going on huh?
ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]May mga kawili-wiling nangyayari sa munting bayan natin, ano?

ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok not gonna lie, things got a lot more interesting when you arrived…
ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa totoo lang, mas naging kawili-wili nang dumating ka…

ds:353:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey so… When are we going on a date?

ds:353:37:Dialogue Text.source: We can go right now if you’d like!
ds:353:37:Dialogue Text.target: Puwede na tayo ngayon kung gusto mo!

ds:353:39:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Bah, I’ve got a thing in a bit…

ds:353:40:Dialogue Text.source: No worries, you tell me when you’re ready!
ds:353:40:Dialogue Text.target: Walang problema, sabihin mo kapag handa ka na!

ds:354:96:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! Whattya think about those runes?
ds:354:96:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Ano'ng tingin mo sa mga runang 'yon?

ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s mysterious! Adventerous! I feel like I’m in a book or something!
ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mahiwaga! Puno ng pakikipagsapalaran! Parang nasa libro ako o ganoon!

ds:355:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though I feel like it was a bit more dull before…

ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just glad those runes stopped glowing!
ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Masaya lang akong huminto na sa pagliwanag ang mga runang 'yon!

ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s great to hear! Let us know if you need anything dear~!
ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Magandang marinig 'yan! Sabihin mo kung may kailangan ka, mahal~!

ds:356:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You should let us dress you up sometime.

ds:356:141:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not so sure about that one…

ds:356:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]What did you make of those ruins?

ds:356:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ninakaw ko ang isa sa mga bato…

ds:356:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I put it as an accent for my hat! It was spectacular while it was glowing!
ds:356:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ginawa kong palamuti sa sumbrero ko! Napakaganda habang nagliliwanag!

ds:356:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But when the glowing stopped, I ditched it.
ds:356:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero nang huminto ang pagliwanag, itinapon ko.

ds:356:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon Vi, you’re telling me you wouldn’t do the same?
ds:356:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sige na, Vi, sinasabi mong hindi mo gagawin ang pareho?

ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.source: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*
ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.target: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*

ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Those glowing glyphs gave me some wicked cool ideas.
ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May napakaastig akong mga ideya dahil sa nagliliwanag na mga glipong 'yon.

ds:357:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I’ll paint a series on it…
ds:357:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa tingin ko, gagawa ako ng serye ng mga larawan tungkol doon…

ds:357:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]About the stones? I mean, it’s pretty damn weird…

ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But uh, nothing bad seems to have happened.

ds:357:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Things sure are pickin’ up with you around.
ds:357:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sumisigla talaga ang mga bagay habang nandito ka.

ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Somethin’ tells me things are just getting started!
ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo! May kutob akong nagsisimula pa lang ang lahat!

ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Rascal! Gosh, I’ve been learning a lot of stuff here!

ds:358:163:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Do you know what’s going on?

ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve cross referenced a few things, and this has indeed happened before.
ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pinaghambing ko ang ilang sanggunian, at nangyari na nga ito dati.

ds:358:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But it was a VERY long time ago. Which is great news!

ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’d love to chat Rascal, but I’ve got a lot of stuff to look through.
ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Gusto kong makipagkuwentuhan, Rascal, ngunit napakarami kong susuriin.

ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now that stuff’s gettin’ a lil weird in the forest, training is more important than ever!
ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ngayong medyo nagiging kakaiba na ang mga bagay sa gubat, mas mahalaga kaysa dati ang pagsasanay!

ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve got a new routine set up if you’d like to give it a shot!
ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May bago akong pagsasanay kung gusto mong subukan!

ds:359:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Novice level! Whattya say, mate??
ds:359:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Antas ng Baguhan! Ano sa tingin mo, pare??

ds:359:215:Dialogue Text.target: Gawin natin ang Pagsasanay ng Baguhan!

ds:359:216:Dialogue Text.source: Actually let’s do the Training Routine.
ds:359:216:Dialogue Text.target: Ang Panimulang Pagsasanay na lang pala.

ds:359:217:Dialogue Text.source: On second thought, I’ll pass for now.
ds:359:217:Dialogue Text.target: Nagbago ang isip ko, hindi muna ngayon.

ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oooh, ya wanna try the Novice Track, eh? Great!
ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oooh, gusto mong subukan ang Hamon ng Baguhan, ano? Ayos!

ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So this one’s gonna be a lil different, mate, so pay attention!

ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]First, this one will be a bit longer. I’ve got a bit of a routine set up for ya!
ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Una, medyo mas mahaba 'to. May inihanda akong pagsasanay para sa 'yo!

ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Second, unlike the training, I’ll be going a lot harder are on ya, mate. So keep your eyes peeled!!
ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pangalawa, hindi gaya sa panimula, mas titindihan ko, pare. Kaya magmasid ka nang mabuti!!

ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That said, I don’t want to hurt you, so i’ll stop the training if you get hit more than 3 times!
ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero ayokong masaktan ka, kaya ihihinto ko ang pagsasanay kapag natamaan ka nang higit sa 3 beses!

ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.source: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*
ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.target: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*

ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.source: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*
ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.target: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*

ds:359:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…
ds:359:233:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Eh heh… Oo, pasensiya na roon, pare…

ds:359:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?

ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.source: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*
ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.target: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*

ds:359:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I got ya pretty good there, eh?
ds:359:241:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Malakas ang tama ko sa 'yo roon, ano?

ds:359:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You’ll have to be quicker next time!

ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But eh, sorry if I went a lil hard!
ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero eh, pasensiya kung medyo tinindihan ko!

ds:359:245:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Let me know if you want to try again!
ds:359:245:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sabihin mo kung gusto mong subukan uli!

ds:359:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!
ds:359:247:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Grabe, pare! Talagang gumagaling ka na rito!

ds:359:248:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m gonna have to really step it up!

ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next challenge I’ll have for ya will be really tough, just you wait!
ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Talagang mahirap ang susunod kong hamon sa 'yo, maghintay ka lang!

ds:359:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m impressed! Happy to call you my pupil!
ds:359:252:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hanga ako! Masaya akong tawagin kang estudyante ko!

ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Looks like I got ya a couple times. But still, you beat the challenge!
ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mukhang dalawang beses kitang natamaan. Pero nalampasan mo pa rin ang hamon!

ds:359:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…
ds:359:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Eh heh… Oo, pasensiya na roon, pare…

ds:359:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?

ds:359:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!
ds:359:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Grabe, pare! Talagang gumagaling ka na rito!

ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You win the personal satisfaction knowing your body and mind are growing healthier!
ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang premyo mo, ang kasiyahang malaman na mas lumulusog ang katawan at isip mo!

ds:359:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Well how about a romp in the bushes with your trainer?
ds:359:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Paano kung ligayang may kalikutan sa mga palumpong kasama ang tagapagsanay mo?

ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Whew! I don’t think I’m gonna be able to take that knot anytime soon…
ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hay! Sa tingin ko, hindi ko pa matatanggap ang buhol na 'yan sa lalong madaling panahon…

ds:359:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not sure if this is something practice can make happen…
ds:359:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hindi ako sigurado kung madadaan 'to sa ensayo…

ds:359:763:Dialogue Text.source: I’m impressed you can fit me at all!

ds:359:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah, well mate, you gotta give me some credit!
ds:359:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ha, pare, bigyan mo naman ako ng pagkilala!

ds:359:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m not your typical squirrel, after all.

ds:359:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Anyways, you keep up the good work!

ds:359:770:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next routine will be even more challenging!
ds:359:770:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mas mahirap pa ang susunod na pagsasanay!

ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, this looks like it’s going to be a long walk!
ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.target: Hmm, mukhang magiging mahaba ang lakarang 'to!

ds:360:62:Dialogue Text.source: A piercing cold shoots through your body.
ds:360:62:Dialogue Text.target: Tumagos sa katawan mo ang matalim na lamig.

ds:360:66:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I pulled a lot of the hues from the glowing runes!
ds:360:66:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Di ba? Marami sa mga kulay, kinuha ko sa nagliliwanag na mga runa!

ds:360:67:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’ve got this chilling quality to them, had to capture it!
ds:360:67:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May nakapangangatog silang katangian, kailangan kong makuha!

ds:360:69:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I wanted to capture this vast space.
ds:360:69:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Di ba? Gusto kong makuha ang malawak na espasyong 'to.

ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Something that’s been there all along. Undisturbed, for centuries!
ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isang bagay na naroon na sa simula pa. Hindi nagambala, sa loob ng mga siglo!

ds:360:72:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thanks buddy! Pretty proud of this one!

ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.source: A spacious illustration, featuring stunning crystal structures.
ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.target: Isang paglalarawan ng malawak na espasyo, may kamangha-manghang mga estrukturang kristal.

ds:360:76:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.
ds:360:76:Dialogue Text.target: Dumaan sa katawan mo ang lamig habang tinitingnan ang larawan.

ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.source: Where could such a place be? What could reside there?
ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.target: Nasaan kaya ang ganoong lugar? Ano kaya ang nakatira roon?

ds:361:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh not much. Just doing some shopping…

ds:362:321:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See! He’s right there! Ask him now!

ds:362:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I think I want to give it a go!
ds:362:336:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At sa tingin ko gusto ko nang subukan!

ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But the thing is… I wanna ease into it, with a lil private version, y’know?
ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Pero ang kaso… Gusto ko munang dahan-dahan, isang maliit at pribadong bersiyon, alam mo?

ds:362:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I’m a little strange when it comes to my intimate partners…
ds:362:342:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Medyo kakaiba kasi ako pagdating sa mga kapareha ko sa pagtatalik…

ds:362:343:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Either I know them very well like Scarlett here…
ds:362:343:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kailangan kilalang-kilala ko sila, gaya ni Scarlett dito…

ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Or it’s a lot easier to do something uh… "unique" like this with folks I don’t know too well…
ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]O mas madali para sa akin ang gumawa ng ano… "kakaiba" na gaya nito sa mga hindi ko masyadong kilala…

ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It can just be a lil awkward for me to try this with our other friends…
ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Medyo asiwa lang akong subukan 'to kasama ang iba nating kaibigan…

ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.source: Well yeah! I’ve been doing the same thing here.
ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.target: Oo naman! Ganoon din ang ginagawa ko rito.

ds:362:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See! I told you he’d be down!

ds:362:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Heh, salamat, Rascal… Malaking bagay sa akin!

ds:362:354:Dialogue Text.source: When and where is this all goin’ down?

ds:362:356:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you aren’t busy now, we can use my basement!
ds:362:356:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kung wala kang ginagawa ngayon, puwede tayong gumamit ng silong ko!

ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]No worries honey, we can take this as slowly as ya want!
ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Huwag kang mag-alala, mahal, puwede nating bagalan ayon sa gusto mo!

ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sometimes ya gotta push the bird out of the nest, y’know? Bawkaw!
ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Minsan kailangan mong itulak ang ibon palabas ng pugad, 'di ba? Bawkaw!

ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! Now bend over so I can get this harness around you…
ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Yumuko ka para maikabit ko ang harness sa 'yo…

ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.source: OK! I’m gonna put this ball gag on ya now, are ya ready?
ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.target: SIGE! Ilalagay ko na sa 'yo ang busal na may bola, handa ka na ba?

ds:363:586:Dialogue Text.source: Oh, do you want blinders on?
ds:363:586:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, gusto mo bang lagyan ng takip ang mga mata mo?

ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.source: No, not this time. I’d like to see!
ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi muna ngayon. Gusto kong makakita!

ds:363:591:Dialogue Text.source: How’s the view back there Rascal?
ds:363:591:Dialogue Text.target: Kumusta ang tanawin diyan sa likod, Rascal?

ds:363:593:Dialogue Text.source: Lookin’ great! Let me know when she’s ready!
ds:363:593:Dialogue Text.target: Napakaganda! Sabihin mo kapag handa na siya!

ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.source: Aww look how cute she is with that ballgag on.
ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.target: Aww, ang kyut niya habang suot ang busal na may bola.

ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.source: Oop, you’re drooling a bit, lemme get that for ya!
ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.target: Oop, medyo naglalaway ka, punasan ko para sa 'yo!

ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.source: I’m gonna start warming her up back here, is that ok!
ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.target: Sisimulan ko na siyang ihanda rito sa likod, puwede ba!

ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, that’s my girl! She’s my absolute favorite to play with for that very reason!
ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, ganyan siya! Kaya siya talaga ang paborito kong kalaro!

ds:363:612:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I’m gonna go for it.

ds:363:619:Dialogue Text.target: Aww, sarap na sarap siya rito!

ds:363:620:Dialogue Text.source: How are ya doin’ back there?

ds:363:623:Dialogue Text.source: Haven’t done this with a bird before!
ds:363:623:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi pa ako nakagawa nito sa ibon dati!

ds:363:628:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, she’s close, I can tell.
ds:363:628:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, malapit na siya, halata ko.

ds:363:639:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh Rascal, you were really gettin’ in there!
ds:363:639:Dialogue Text.target: Naku, Rascal, ang lalim ng naipasok mo!

ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya blame me? You’re so soft back here!
ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.target: Masisi mo ba ako? Napakalambot mo rito sa likod!

ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal… You know there’s two holes in there, right?
ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.target: Rascal… Alam mong may dalawang butas doon sa loob, 'di ba?

ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, y’know. I thought I felt something different every so often…
ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, alam mo. Parang may iba nga akong nararamdaman paminsan-minsan…

ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.source: You are my first bird. I hope I didn’t hurt you.
ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.target: Ikaw ang una kong ibon. Sana hindi kita nasaktan.

ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.source: No no, it was quite exciting! I didn’t know what to expect, and that’s the whole allure of this thing!
ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi, hindi, nakakakilig nga! Hindi ko alam ang aasahan, at 'yon mismo ang nakakaakit dito!

ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.source: Gah, dear you’re so cute when you’re satisfied, I simply must smooch you~
ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.target: Gah, mahal, napakakyut mo kapag nasiyahan ka, kailangan talaga kitang halikan~

ds:363:653:Dialogue Text.source: Baww haha, thanks for this you two…
ds:363:653:Dialogue Text.target: Baww haha, salamat dito, kayong dalawa…

ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.source: Think you’re ready to go public?
ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin mo handa ka na sa harap ng publiko?

ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.source: Haha that’s ok- Oh, I think she wants the gag out.
ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, ayos lang- Oh, mukhang gusto na niyang alisin ang busal.

ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.source: But I definitely want to do this again…

ds:363:666:Dialogue Text.source: I haven’t had a go with ya yet!

ds:363:667:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve got a few toys I think you’d love…
ds:363:667:Dialogue Text.target: May ilang laruan akong sa tingin ko'y magugustuhan mo…

ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, I’d love to see that! But gosh I’m beat.
ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, gustong-gusto kong makita 'yon! Pero naku, pagod na ako.

ds:363:672:Dialogue Text.source: I think I’ll leave you two to it!
ds:363:672:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin ko, iiwan ko na kayo!

ds:363:674:Dialogue Text.source: Aw, ok hun. Thanks for helping me out!
ds:363:674:Dialogue Text.target: Aw, sige, mahal. Salamat sa pagtulong sa akin!

ds:363:676:Dialogue Text.source: We’ll catch you up on our shenanigans later!
ds:363:676:Dialogue Text.target: Ikukuwento namin sa 'yo mamaya ang mga kalokohan namin!

ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks for warming her up for me!
ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.target: Salamat sa paghahanda mo sa kanya para sa akin!

ds:363:678:Dialogue Text.source: Now for the real fun to begin…
ds:363:678:Dialogue Text.target: Ngayon magsisimula ang tunay na saya…

ds:364:25:Dialogue Text.source: The entrance is a little bit of a squeeze…

ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.source: You can see a lot of miscellaneous cloth materials scattered about.
ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.target: Makikita mong nakakalat ang sari-saring materyales na tela.

ds:365:30:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like the path continues here…

ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.source: This must be where Augustus lives… But he’s not home at the moment…
ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.target: Dito siguro nakatira si Augustus… Pero wala siya sa bahay ngayon…

ds:366:34:Dialogue Text.source: You can make out a bunch of papers and rocks inside.
ds:366:34:Dialogue Text.target: Maaninag mo ang maraming papel at bato sa loob.

ds:367:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hmm… This one I didn’t quite finish…

ds:367:84:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Kinda got bored of it halway through.

ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Instead of wasting my time or paint, it’s a better idea to just stop and try something else.
ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa halip na sayangin ang oras o pintura, mas magandang huminto na lang at sumubok ng iba.

ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.source: A vast space, with a single illuminated rune.
ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.target: Isang malawak na espasyo, may nag-iisang nagliliwanag na runa.

ds:367:90:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll try this one again sometime.
ds:367:90:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa tingin ko, susubukan ko uli 'to minsan.

ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I had a striking idea in my head, but as I started painting, the idea kinda shifted to this.
ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]May napakatingkad akong ideya sa isip, pero habang nagpinta ako, parang naging ganito.

ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But it’s not as striking as I wanted it to be, so maybe next time.
ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero hindi kasingtingkad ng gusto ko, kaya baka sa susunod.

ds:367:97:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.
ds:367:97:Dialogue Text.target: Dumaan sa katawan mo ang lamig habang tinitingnan ang larawan.

ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.source: As you focus on the symbol, you could feel your vision tunneling…
ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.target: Habang tumutuon ka sa simbolo, pakiramdam mo ay kumikipot ang paningin mo…

ds:368:105:Dialogue Text.source: Looks spooky! Do you often to portraits?
ds:368:105:Dialogue Text.target: Nakakatakot! Madalas ka bang gumawa ng mga larawan ng mukha?

ds:368:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I don’t! Well, not for fun at least.
ds:368:106:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi! Buweno, hindi para sa kasiyahan, kahit paano.

ds:368:107:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I do the occasional study here and there.

ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I dreamt this figure up a bit ago. I had to try to capture it!
ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero napanaginipan ko ang anyong 'to noong nakaraan. Kailangan kong subukang makuha!

ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I don’t think I fully got it… but… still came out pretty well.
ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ko lubos na nakuha… pero… maganda pa rin ang kinalabasan.

ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.source:
Say, are there creatures
like that in this forest?
ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.target:
May mga nilalang bang
ganyan sa gubat na 'to?

ds:368:113:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Not that I’ve seen! But who knows.
ds:368:113:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Wala pa akong nakikita! Pero sino ang nakaaalam.

ds:368:115:Dialogue Text.source: A fierce creature peers back at you.
ds:368:115:Dialogue Text.target: Isang mabangis na nilalang ang nakatitig pabalik sa 'yo.

ds:368:117:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.
ds:368:117:Dialogue Text.target: Dumaan sa katawan mo ang lamig habang tinitingnan ang larawan.

ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.source: Its eyes are captivating… They seem to be analyzing everything about you…
ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.target: Nakabibighani ang mga mata nito… Parang sinusuri ang lahat tungkol sa 'yo…

ds:369:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s a few other critters that you’ve yet to meet.
ds:369:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May ilan ka pang hindi nakikilalang nilalang.

ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll go ahead and jot them down in your Quest Log - I’m sure you’ll meet them on your own. But you can read up on it there!
ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isusulat ko sila sa Talaan ng mga Misyon mo. Sigurado akong makikilala mo rin sila nang kusa, pero puwede mong basahin ang tungkol sa kanila roon!

ds:369:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Once you’ve met all the critters here, I’ll have a special request for ya!
ds:369:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kapag nakilala mo na ang lahat ng nilalang dito, may espesyal akong ipapagawa sa 'yo!

ds:36:17:Dialogue Text.source: this convo exists so we can ensure all quest steps have a nonnull db conversation (saves a heckton of null checks in the source code!)
ds:36:17:Dialogue Text.target: this convo exists so we can ensure all quest steps have a nonnull db conversation (saves a heckton of null checks in the source code!)

ds:370:580:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, mga kasama! Dito ang daan.

ds:370:585:Dialogue Text.source: He does, doesn’t he? That’s Rascal, he’s new around here.
ds:370:585:Dialogue Text.target: Oo nga, 'di ba? Si Rascal 'yan, bago siya rito.

ds:370:586:Dialogue Text.source: He heard about some of our lil parties, and wanted to be in the center of it!
ds:370:586:Dialogue Text.target: Narinig niya ang tungkol sa mga party natin, at gusto niyang siya ang nasa gitna!

ds:370:591:Dialogue Text.source: Mmmm, damn Claire… Get in there…
ds:370:591:Dialogue Text.target: Mmmm, grabe, Claire… Sige, pasok pa…

ds:370:595:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I like watchin’ this lil guy squirmin’ around!
ds:370:595:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, gusto kong panoorin 'tong munting lalaking namimilipit!

ds:370:597:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, mga kasama, magsimula na tayong magsalsal!

ds:370:599:Dialogue Text.source: That’s right! Let’s see who’s got the most spunk!
ds:370:599:Dialogue Text.target: Tama! Tingnan natin kung sino ang pinakamaraming tamod!

ds:370:601:Dialogue Text.source: I’d like to be in the center of him…
ds:370:601:Dialogue Text.target: Gusto kong nasa loob niya ako…

ds:370:603:Dialogue Text.source: Hold your horses, cowboy! This is just a squirt show.
ds:370:603:Dialogue Text.target: Dahan-dahan, koboy! Palabas lang 'to ng pagbulwak.

ds:370:606:Dialogue Text.source: But uh, give him my number later, yeah?
ds:370:606:Dialogue Text.target: Pero ano, ibigay mo ang numero ko sa kanya mamaya, ha?

ds:370:608:Dialogue Text.source: Ok ok. For now you go over there.

ds:370:609:Dialogue Text.source: And you over here. And you over there!
ds:370:609:Dialogue Text.target: At ikaw rito. At ikaw doon!

ds:370:611:Dialogue Text.source: You know who’s gonna win that Claire…
ds:370:611:Dialogue Text.target: Alam mo kung sino ang mananalo riyan, Claire…

ds:370:613:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, we had ya leaking from both ends last time…
ds:370:613:Dialogue Text.target: Oo, pinatulo ka namin mula sa magkabilang dulo noong huli…

ds:370:614:Dialogue Text.target: Gusto ko ring ipagitna si Rascal dito…

ds:370:628:Dialogue Text.source: Alright boys, let us have it!
ds:370:628:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, mga lalaki, ibigay ninyo sa amin!

ds:370:629:Dialogue Text.source: *Flash White, fade to Dude Bukkake with Cum*
ds:370:629:Dialogue Text.target: *Flash White, fade to Dude Bukkake with Cum*

ds:370:631:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, you’re all lookin’ cute covered in my spunk…
ds:370:631:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, ang kyut ninyong lahat na balot ng tamod ko…

ds:370:633:Dialogue Text.source: Alright tough guy, come and clean up your mess.
ds:370:633:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, matapang na lalaki, halika't linisin ang kalat mo.

ds:370:637:Dialogue Text.source: Let me get in on some of that!

ds:370:639:Dialogue Text.source: C’mon in boys, the waters warm!
ds:370:639:Dialogue Text.target: Pasok, mga lalaki, mainit ang tubig!

ds:370:642:Dialogue Text.source: Wheeeeew! Ok, I need some water. Damn, you guys are machines.
ds:370:642:Dialogue Text.target: Haaaay! Sige, kailangan ko ng tubig. Grabe, para kayong mga makina.

ds:370:644:Dialogue Text.source: Yeaaah, for once, I could use a break.
ds:370:644:Dialogue Text.target: Oooo, ngayon lang ako nangailangan ng pahinga.

ds:370:648:Dialogue Text.source: That was fun lil’ guy, hit us up if you want some time.
ds:370:648:Dialogue Text.target: Ang saya noon, munting kaibigan, tawagin mo kami kung gusto mo ulit minsan.

ds:371:656:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, mga babae, handa na ba kayo?

ds:371:660:Dialogue Text.source: How about you, Rascal, ya ready for this?
ds:371:660:Dialogue Text.target: Ikaw naman, Rascal, handa ka na ba rito?

ds:371:664:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, mga babae, narinig ninyo siya!

ds:371:668:Dialogue Text.source: Heh… Thanks for helping out… I’ve never done this sort of thing before…
ds:371:668:Dialogue Text.target: Heh… Salamat sa pagtulong… Hindi pa ako nakakagawa ng ganito dati…

ds:371:672:Dialogue Text.source: We can do some one on one later if you’re interested…
ds:371:672:Dialogue Text.target: Puwede tayong magsolo mamaya kung interesado ka…

ds:371:676:Dialogue Text.source: How’s the view down there Rascal?
ds:371:676:Dialogue Text.target: Kumusta ang tanawin diyan sa ibaba, Rascal?

ds:371:678:Dialogue Text.source: Amazing! I don’t think I’ve ever been in the middle of so many lovely ladies!
ds:371:678:Dialogue Text.target: Napakaganda! Parang ngayon lang ako napagitnaan ng ganito karaming magagandang babae!

ds:371:680:Dialogue Text.source: This is a first for me, that’s for sure!

ds:371:681:Dialogue Text.source: It’s nice to be on giving end for once, am I right ladies?
ds:371:681:Dialogue Text.target: Masarap ding tayo naman ang nagbibigay, tama ba, mga babae?

ds:371:683:Dialogue Text.source: Certainly less clean up on my end!
ds:371:683:Dialogue Text.target: Siguradong mas kaunti ang lilinisin sa akin!

ds:371:684:Dialogue Text.source: Though, can’t say I mind that part…
ds:371:684:Dialogue Text.target: Pero hindi ko naman ayaw ang bahaging 'yon…

ds:371:686:Dialogue Text.source: You ladies have some really interesting methods!

ds:371:689:Dialogue Text.source: It’s great on the wrists! For longer sessions, of course…
ds:371:689:Dialogue Text.target: Magaan sa mga pulsuhan! Para sa mahahabang sesyon, siyempre…

ds:371:692:Dialogue Text.source: Say Rascal, can ya do me a favor?

ds:371:696:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya lap up some of your pre?
ds:371:696:Dialogue Text.target: Puwede mo bang dilaan ang kaunti sa paunang likido mo?

ds:371:702:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah? Would you ladies like that?
ds:371:702:Dialogue Text.target: Oo? Gusto ba ninyo 'yon, mga babae?

ds:371:706:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, the least I could do for a show like this!
ds:371:706:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, 'yan man lang ang magagawa ko kapalit ng ganitong palabas!

ds:371:708:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, this gals starting to buck!

ds:371:710:Dialogue Text.source: Hahh- Sorry~! Just getting into it!

ds:371:712:Dialogue Text.source: Not at all sweetie, you enjoy yourself.

ds:371:713:Dialogue Text.source: The rest of you ladies though, let’s see if we can pick up the pace for Rascal’s first round!
ds:371:713:Dialogue Text.target: Kayong iba naman, mga babae, bilisan natin para sa unang round ni Rascal!

ds:371:717:Dialogue Text.source: Alright ladies, let’s not hold anything back~!
ds:371:717:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, mga babae, wala nang pagpipigil~!

ds:371:724:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh~ Look at that cum piling up on Rascal…
ds:371:724:Dialogue Text.target: Naku~ Tingnan ninyo ang tamod na naiipon kay Rascal…

ds:371:725:Dialogue Text.source: I’m calling dibs on cleaning him!
ds:371:725:Dialogue Text.target: Ako ang unang maglilinis sa kanya!

ds:371:727:Dialogue Text.source: No fair! I wanted in on that!
ds:371:727:Dialogue Text.target: Ang daya! Gusto ko ring sumali riyan!

ds:371:729:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, ladies, I’m absolutely drenched - there’s plenty to go around!
ds:371:729:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, mga babae, basang-basa ako—marami para sa lahat!

ds:371:731:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, this big ole cutie’s going for round 2 already!
ds:371:731:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, pang-2 na agad 'tong malaking kyut!

ds:371:733:Dialogue Text.source: Nnnfff~ I’m sorry! I can’t- *shudder* control it!
ds:371:733:Dialogue Text.target: Nnnfff~ Pasensiya na! Hindi ko- *panginginig* mapigilan!

ds:371:737:Dialogue Text.source: Right? Honey, please, keep it coming!
ds:371:737:Dialogue Text.target: 'Di ba? Mahal, sige lang, ituloy mo!

ds:371:739:Dialogue Text.source: Whattya gals say, anyone wanna start cleaning me up?
ds:371:739:Dialogue Text.target: Ano sa tingin ninyo, may gustong magsimulang maglinis sa akin?

ds:371:748:Dialogue Text.source: Please, my tongue is sore haha!
ds:371:748:Dialogue Text.target: Pakiusap, masakit na ang dila ko, haha!

ds:371:750:Dialogue Text.source: Yeaaah, my paws are getting pruney…
ds:371:750:Dialogue Text.target: Oooo, nangungulubot na ang mga lapa ko…

ds:371:752:Dialogue Text.source: That was, SO MUCH FUN! Thank you for inviting me!
ds:371:752:Dialogue Text.target: SOBRANG SAYA noon! Salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin!

ds:371:756:Dialogue Text.source: Hit us up for the next one!

ds:372:324:Dialogue Text.source:
Not too much!
Just seeing what you lovely ladies are up to!
ds:372:324:Dialogue Text.target:
Wala naman!
Tinitingnan ko lang ang ginagawa ninyong magagandang babae!

ds:372:326:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We were actually just making some plans for tonight.
ds:372:326:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nagpaplano lang talaga kami para mamayang gabi.

ds:372:329:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh, funny you ask. Are you free right now?
ds:372:329:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Heh, sakto ang tanong mo. Wala ka bang ginagawa ngayon?

ds:372:332:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! We wanted to take you up on your rain check!
ds:372:332:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayos! Gusto naming ituloy 'yong ipinagpaliban mong pagsama!

ds:372:333:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You remember that, right? You said you want in on the next bukkake!
ds:372:333:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naalala mo, 'di ba? Sabi mo gusto mong sumali sa susunod na bukkake!

ds:372:335:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well it just so happens we’ve got a few of our lady friends coming over in a bit…
ds:372:335:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagkataon kasing may ilang babaeng kaibigan kaming darating maya-maya…

ds:372:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well it just so happens we’ve got a few of our male friends coming over in a bit…
ds:372:336:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagkataon kasing may ilang lalaking kaibigan kaming darating maya-maya…

ds:372:340:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What do YOU say, are you in?
ds:372:340:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]IKAW, ano sa tingin mo, sasali ka?

ds:372:376:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That was a blast! You’re a good sport Rascal.
ds:372:376:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ang saya noon! Magaling kang makisama, Rascal.

ds:372:378:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! I’m honored to call you a Bukkake Buddy.
ds:372:378:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Totoo! Ikinararangal kong tawagin kang Kabarkada sa Bukkake.

ds:372:381:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh and uhh, if you wanted to try the other form of bukkake, let me know!
ds:372:381:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, at ano, kung gusto mong subukan ang kabilang uri ng bukkake, sabihin mo lang!

ds:372:385:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah we got some lady friends that are interested!
ds:372:385:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, may mga babaeng kaibigan kaming interesado!

ds:372:396:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah we got some dude friends that are interested!
ds:372:396:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, may mga lalaking kaibigan kaming interesado!

ds:373:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh? You wanna get into some shenanigans again?
ds:373:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh? Gusto mong gumawa uli ng kalokohan?

ds:373:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure we could get some friends together.
ds:373:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tiyak na makapagtitipon tayo ng ilang kaibigan.

ds:373:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kahit ano para sa 'yo, Kabarkada sa Bukkake!

ds:373:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So what’s on the menu? Ladies? Guys?
ds:373:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ano ang nasa menu? Mga babae? Mga lalaki?

ds:373:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You got it! Let me make some calls…

ds:373:365:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You got it! Let me make some calls…

ds:374:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though I feel like it was a bit more dull before…

ds:374:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just glad those runes stopped glowing!
ds:374:27:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Masaya lang akong huminto na sa pagliwanag ang mga runang 'yon!

ds:374:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s great to hear! Let us know if you need anything dear~!
ds:374:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Magandang marinig 'yan! Sabihin mo kung may kailangan ka, mahal~!

ds:375:699:Dialogue Text.source: OK Rascal! You lay down, and let me get comfy.
ds:375:699:Dialogue Text.target: SIGE, Rascal! Humiga ka, tapos aayos ako nang komportable.

ds:375:700:Dialogue Text.source: This position should let me get a bit more of ya in…
