ds:408:117:Dialogue Text.source: The heat was incredible, and he explored every inch of her on his way.
ds:408:117:Dialogue Text.target: Napakatindi ng init, at ginalugad niya ang bawat bahagi nito habang lumalalim.

ds:408:118:Dialogue Text.source: He wrapped his claws around her legs to bring her even closer. But his tongue had no where else to go.
ds:408:118:Dialogue Text.target: Ipinulupot niya ang mga kamay sa mga binti nito para ilapit pa. Pero wala nang ibang mapupuntahan ang dila niya.

ds:408:119:Dialogue Text.source: The dragon glanced up to see the wolf in bliss. Her back was arched, her tongue was flopping out.
ds:408:119:Dialogue Text.target: Tumingala ang dragon at nakitang lutang sa sarap ang lobo. Nakaarko ang likod, nakalaylay ang dila.

ds:408:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Have you heard of a book called Lyllith the Dragonslayer?
ds:408:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Narinig mo na ba ang librong Lyllith, Tirador ng Dragon?

ds:408:120:Dialogue Text.source: He jostled his tongue around, and her hips bucked in response.
ds:408:120:Dialogue Text.target: Iginalaw-galaw niya ang dila, at umigkas ang balakang nito bilang tugon.

ds:408:121:Dialogue Text.source: The familiar thrusting started as she let out a moan.
ds:408:121:Dialogue Text.target: Nagsimula ang pamilyar na pagbayo habang napaungol ito.

ds:408:122:Dialogue Text.source: The dragon’s tongue slipped in and out. Fluids ran down his jaw and neck.
ds:408:122:Dialogue Text.target: Dumudulas paloob at palabas ang dila ng dragon. Umagos ang mga likido sa panga at leeg niya.

ds:408:125:Dialogue Text.source: The wolf hadn’t been with a partner that truly satisfied her for a long time.
ds:408:125:Dialogue Text.target: Matagal nang hindi nakakasama ng lobo ang kaparehang tunay na nakapagbibigay sa kanya ng kasiyahan.

ds:408:128:Dialogue Text.source: By the time they were done, it was late, and they collapsed into a warm, panting heap.
ds:408:128:Dialogue Text.target: Nang matapos sila, gabi na, at napahandusay silang magkayakap, mainit at hinihingal.

ds:408:129:Dialogue Text.source: And though the sex was fantastic, Volkyn wanted nothing more than to stay in this moment…
ds:408:129:Dialogue Text.target: At kahit napakasarap ng pagtatalik, wala nang ibang gusto si Volkyn kundi manatili sa sandaling 'to…

ds:408:131:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to Game* *Camera close up on Charlotte*
ds:408:131:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to Game* *Camera close up on Charlotte*

ds:408:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I just loved this part of the book. So much passion and-
ds:408:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Gustong-gusto ko ang bahaging 'to ng libro. Ang daming pagnanasa at-

ds:408:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh… <pause>I just read some pretty raunchy stuff…<pause> That’s embarassing…

ds:408:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nonsense dear, that was a wonderful story!

ds:408:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Lyllith The Dragonslayer, right? She’s anything but embarassing!
ds:408:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lyllith, Tirador ng Dragon, 'di ba? Hindi siya nakakahiya!

ds:408:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m getting to it, I’m getting to it!

ds:408:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a spinoff from a larger series called Scales And Tails. It’s a bunch of books in a low fantasy world.
ds:408:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hiwalay itong kuwento mula sa mas malaking seryeng Kaliskis at Buntot. Maraming librong nasa isang mundong low fantasy.

ds:408:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I thought y’all were forming an angry mob to finally throw me out!
ds:408:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Akala ko nagtipon kayo para palayasin na rin ako sa galit ninyo!

ds:408:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Instead I got to hear about this hot story!
ds:408:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa halip, narinig ko ang mainit na kuwentong 'to!

ds:408:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Right? I gotta get my paws on these books!
ds:408:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]'Di ba? Kailangan kong makuha ang mga librong 'to!

ds:408:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh sure! Whenever Claire finishes, you can borrow that copy!
ds:408:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, sige! Kapag natapos na ni Claire, puwede mong hiramin ang kopyang 'yon!

ds:408:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Thank you for sharing that with us!

ds:408:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Would you guys…<pause> Be interested in another story some time?
ds:408:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Gusto ba ninyo…<pause> Ng isa pang kuwento minsan?

ds:408:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]All the books intertwine and tell a huge epic story filled with adventure, mystery, love, and death! It’s amazing!
ds:408:14:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Magkakaugnay ang lahat ng libro at bumubuo ng isang dambuhalang kuwento ng pakikipagsapalaran, misteryo, pag-ibig, at kamatayan! Napakaganda!

ds:408:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Great! I’ll be sure to find something fun!

ds:408:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See the title is also a play-on-words! Lyllith the Dragon SLAYER? or Lyllith the Dragon’s <bounce>LAYER!</bounce>
ds:408:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May laro rin sa salita ang pamagat! Lyllith, TIRADOR ng Dragon bilang tagapaslang? O Lyllith na <bounce>TUMITIRA sa dragon sa kama!</bounce>

ds:408:21:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Buuuut, she’s only been with one dragon so far… <pause>There’s a slew of other creatures for sure, so…
ds:408:21:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Perooo, isang dragon pa lang ang nakatalik niya… <pause>Marami namang ibang nilalang, kaya…

ds:408:22:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Maybe that’s just hinting at what’s to come.
ds:408:22:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Baka pahiwatig lang 'yon ng susunod na lalabas.

ds:408:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So as you can guess, Lyllith is the main character…
ds:408:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya gaya ng mahuhulaan mo, si Lyllith ang pangunahing tauhan…

ds:408:28:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith’s a wolf! She’s badass, justice-driven, and full of mom-energy!
ds:408:28:Dialogue Text.target: Lobo si Lyllith! Matapang, makatarungan, at napaka-maka-inang kumilos!

ds:408:30:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a sellsword and usually frequents taverns until she finds a job.
ds:408:30:Dialogue Text.target: Isa siyang mersenaryo at madalas sa mga taberna hanggang makahanap ng trabaho.

ds:408:31:Dialogue Text.source: A Job… Or a partner for the night.
ds:408:31:Dialogue Text.target: Trabaho… O kapareha para sa gabi.

ds:408:32:Dialogue Text.source: One particular night, she learns about a dragon that’s terrorizing a nearby town…
ds:408:32:Dialogue Text.target: Isang gabi, nabalitaan niya ang tungkol sa dragon na nananakot sa kalapit na bayan…

ds:408:34:Dialogue Text.source: Now Lyllith has taken on dragons before. They can be a bit spicy, but nothing she can’t handle.
ds:408:34:Dialogue Text.target: Nakaharap na si Lyllith ng mga dragon dati. Medyo matindi, pero walang hindi niya kayang harapin.

ds:408:36:Dialogue Text.source: But no amount of gear could’ve prepared her for this dragon…
ds:408:36:Dialogue Text.target: Pero walang kagamitang makapaghahanda sa kanya para sa dragon na 'to…

ds:408:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We were just passing by and got caught up in your story!
ds:408:42:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napadaan lang kami at naakit sa kuwento mo!

ds:408:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No no, it’s a book series I really like. I was just telling Rascal about it.
ds:408:44:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi, hindi, serye 'to ng mga librong gustong-gusto ko. Ikinukuwento ko lang kay Rascal.

ds:408:45:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh that’s great! Again, don’t mind us, we’re just here to listen.
ds:408:45:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, ang ganda! Ulit, huwag mo kaming pansinin, makikinig lang kami.

ds:408:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do go on! I love hearing about how couples meet!
ds:408:48:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ituloy mo! Gusto kong marinig kung paano nagkakakilala ang mga magkapareha!

ds:408:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ooooh! Yeah these two actually had some pretty rough beginnings!
ds:408:49:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ooooh! Medyo magulo nga ang simula ng dalawang 'to!

ds:408:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Are you ready for our book club?
ds:408:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Handa ka na ba sa samahan natin sa pagbabasa?

ds:408:50:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The entire second book was about the random circumstances they would cross eachother’s paths, and butt heads.
ds:408:50:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tungkol ang buong ikalawang libro sa mga pagkakataong nagkakasalubong sila at nagtatalo.

ds:408:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well…<pause> Rivals turned co-workers…<pause> Turned co-workers with benefits?
ds:408:53:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ano…<pause> Magkaribal na naging magkatrabaho…<pause> Na naging magkatrabahong nagtatalik?

ds:408:54:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There was a nice little Winter scene that sums up how their dynamic is…
ds:408:54:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May magandang munting eksena sa taglamig na nagpapakita ng samahan nila…

ds:408:58:Dialogue Text.source: It was a quiet night. Fresh snow danced around the sky before landing on their cheeks and snouts.
ds:408:58:Dialogue Text.target: Tahimik ang gabi. Sumayaw sa langit ang sariwang niyebe bago dumapo sa kanilang mga pisngi at nguso.

ds:408:5:Dialogue Text.source: Oh… Was I supposed to read something…?
ds:408:5:Dialogue Text.target: Oh… May dapat ba akong binasa…?

ds:408:60:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn (that’s the dragon) gives the wolf a pathetic look.
ds:408:60:Dialogue Text.target: Tumingin si Volkyn (siya ang dragon) sa lobo nang kaawa-awa.

ds:408:61:Dialogue Text.source: "Lyllith… <pause>P-please let me use your cloak… <pause>I’m so c-c-c-cold…"
ds:408:61:Dialogue Text.target: "Lyllith… <pause>P-pahiram naman ng balabal mo… <pause>G-g-g-ginaw na ginaw ako…"

ds:408:62:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith knows damn well that this weather is nothing for him.
ds:408:62:Dialogue Text.target: Alam na alam ni Lyllith na walang epekto sa kanya ang ganitong panahon.

ds:408:63:Dialogue Text.source: Not to mention her cloak would be like a napkin to a dragon.
ds:408:63:Dialogue Text.target: At saka, parang napkin lang sa dragon ang balabal niya.

ds:408:65:Dialogue Text.source: Regardless, she humors him and gives him the cloak.
ds:408:65:Dialogue Text.target: Gayunpaman, sinakyan niya ang biro at ibinigay ang balabal.

ds:408:66:Dialogue Text.source: This took him off guard, he thought for sure she souldn’t go through with it.
ds:408:66:Dialogue Text.target: Nagulat siya, sigurado siyang hindi nito itutuloy.

ds:408:67:Dialogue Text.source: But she did, and now he had to figure out how to tie this tiny thing around his neck.
ds:408:67:Dialogue Text.target: Pero ginawa nga niya, at ngayon kailangan niyang alamin kung paano itatali ang maliit na bagay na 'to sa leeg niya.

ds:408:69:Dialogue Text.source: And despite it being a joke at first…
ds:408:69:Dialogue Text.target: At kahit biro lang sa simula…

ds:408:70:Dialogue Text.source: It’s the little gestures that really get to him.
ds:408:70:Dialogue Text.target: Ang maliliit na kilos ang talagang nakakaantig sa kanya.

ds:408:73:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Aw! It’s the little genuine connections that do it!
ds:408:73:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aw! Nasa maliliit at tapat na ugnayan talaga 'yon!

ds:408:76:Dialogue Text.source: They’ve been here for a while.

ds:408:77:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, yeah we wanted to see what you guys were up to!
ds:408:77:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Heh, oo, gusto naming makita ang ginagawa ninyo!

ds:408:78:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah sorry! I didn’t mean to interrupt! I just got lost in the cuteness…
ds:408:78:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, pasensiya! Hindi ko sinasadyang sumabad! Nadala lang ako sa sobrang kyut…

ds:408:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve always wanted to be a part of a book club though!
ds:408:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero matagal ko nang gustong sumali sa samahan sa pagbabasa!

ds:408:80:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, it’s just a scene and some characters from a book!
ds:408:80:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, eksena at mga tauhan lang 'to mula sa libro!

ds:408:81:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal asked if I had any favorite books, and I was telling him about this one.
ds:408:81:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tinanong ni Rascal kung may paborito akong libro, at ikinukuwento ko sa kanya ang isang 'to.

ds:408:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah! Haha, I wasn’t expecting an audience heh!
ds:408:83:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo! Haha, hindi ko inasahang may manonood, heh!

ds:408:84:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How about… <pause>I turn up the heat and tell ya guys about one of the scenes between the two?
ds:408:84:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Paano kung… <pause>painitin ko at ikuwento sa inyo ang isa sa mga eksena nilang dalawa?

ds:408:85:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Blimey, between a Dragon and a Wolf?
ds:408:85:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Naku, sa pagitan ng Dragon at Lobo?

ds:408:86:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Masarap na laro sa agwat ng laki 'yan…

ds:408:88:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now close your eyes and imagine for a second…
ds:408:88:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ngayon, ipikit ninyo ang mga mata at isipin ninyo sandali…

ds:408:8:Dialogue Text.source: Ah! Maybe we can make one here!
ds:408:8:Dialogue Text.target: Ah! Baka puwede tayong bumuo rito!

ds:408:91:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s see… Ah! Here we are…

ds:408:94:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith let out a gasp. Her body was trembling. Every part of her was on fire, she wanted MORE.
ds:408:94:Dialogue Text.target: Napasinghap si Lyllith. Nanginginig ang katawan niya. Nag-aapoy ang bawat bahagi, gusto pa niya ng HIGIT.

ds:408:95:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn’s fingers slipped further inside her. He was gentle, but his strength and size was apparent.
ds:408:95:Dialogue Text.target: Dumulas nang mas malalim ang mga daliri ni Volkyn sa loob niya. Maingat ito, pero ramdam ang lakas at laki.

ds:408:96:Dialogue Text.source: As his fingers explored her, he gently nipped and licked at her neck.
ds:408:96:Dialogue Text.target: Habang ginagalugad siya ng mga daliri nito, marahan siyang kinagat-kagat at dinilaan sa leeg.

ds:408:97:Dialogue Text.source: "Nnf ahh~!" Lyllith moaned. She’d taken on many dragons before… But not like this…
ds:408:97:Dialogue Text.target: "Nnf ahh~!" ungol ni Lyllith. Marami na siyang nakaharap na dragon dati… Pero hindi nang ganito…

ds:408:99:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn’s muzzle met hers. Lyllith’s mouth was ajar, panting. He took that as an invitation.
ds:408:99:Dialogue Text.target: Nagdikit ang nguso ni Volkyn at ang sa kanya. Bahagyang nakabuka ang bibig ni Lyllith, hinihingal. Itinuring niya 'yon na paanyaya.

ds:409:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Hey Mel, would you please get me the cookies?
ds:409:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Uy, Mel, pakikuha naman ng mga kukis?

ds:409:728:Dialogue Text.source: *Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*
ds:409:728:Dialogue Text.target: *Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*

ds:409:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]M-Melody isn’t here right now, p-please come back later!
ds:409:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]W-wala rito si Melody ngayon, p-pakiusap, bumalik ka na lang mamaya!

ds:409:731:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*
ds:409:731:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*

ds:409:733:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal… I know we just met, but could I ask a favor?
ds:409:733:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Uy, Rascal… Alam kong kakakilala lang natin, pero puwede akong humingi ng pabor?

ds:409:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.
ds:409:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Matagal ko nang hindi nakikitang ganito kasabik si Charlotte.

ds:409:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?
ds:409:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Puwede mo bang gawin muna ang anumang hiling niya?

ds:409:738:Dialogue Text.source: I was planning on it anyways!

ds:409:740:Dialogue Text.source:
Errr, sorry I didn’t mean to scare you.
I’m just a visitor.
ds:409:740:Dialogue Text.target:
Errr, pasensiya, hindi ko sinasadyang takutin ka.
Bisita lang ako.

ds:409:742:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, I came to the forest a few days ago.
I’m new here.
ds:409:742:Dialogue Text.target:
Oo, ilang araw pa lang akong nasa gubat.
Bago ako rito.

ds:409:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I see… Do you just walk into critter’s houses where you come from?
ds:409:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ganoon pala… Basta ka na lang ba pumapasok sa bahay ng mga nilalang sa pinanggalingan mo?

ds:409:744:Dialogue Text.source: Well you don’t exactly have a door…

ds:409:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

ds:409:747:Dialogue Text.source:
Honestly I’m surprised you haven’t heard of me.
I thought gossip traveled fast in the forest…
ds:409:747:Dialogue Text.target:
Sa totoo lang, nagulat akong wala ka pang balita tungkol sa 'kin.
Akala ko mabilis kumalat ang balita sa gubat…

ds:409:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah, we’re kinda secluded up here… And I tend to keep to myself most of the times…
ds:409:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, medyo hiwalay kami rito sa itaas… At madalas akong mapag-isa…

ds:409:751:Dialogue Text.source: Um, I can leave if you want.
ds:409:751:Dialogue Text.target: Um, maaari akong umalis kung gusto mo.

ds:409:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh, no that’s ok. You just really caught me off guard.
ds:409:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ah, hindi, ayos lang. Talagang nabigla mo lang ako.

ds:409:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Nice to meet you. I see you aren’t from around here.
ds:409:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ikinagagalak kitang makilala. Mukhang hindi ka tagarito.

ds:409:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red Panda, right? The first time I’ve seen one!
ds:409:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Pulang panda, di ba? Ngayon lang ako nakakita!

ds:409:757:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s right! I’ve come to experience
"the love!" of the forest!
ds:409:757:Dialogue Text.target:
Tama! Naparito ako para maranasan
ang "pag-ibig!" ng gubat!

ds:409:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Well that’s much more Melody’s department…

ds:409:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And you can take all the time you need until you’re ready, darling.
ds:409:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At puwede kang maglaan ng lahat ng panahong kailangan mo hanggang handa ka na, mahal.

ds:409:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But really though, any day now would be great…
ds:409:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero sa totoo lang, kahit anong araw ngayon, ayos sana…

ds:409:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I see you’ve met a new friend?

ds:409:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I had to make sure you weren’t trying to hurt my poor little Charlotte.
ds:409:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kailangan kong siguraduhing hindi mo sinusubukang saktan ang kawawa kong munting Charlotte.

ds:409:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]As I’m sure you guessed, I’m Melody!
ds:409:780:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Gaya ng tiyak na nahulaan mo, ako si Melody!

ds:409:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We weren’t expecting guests, or I would have had tea prepared…
ds:409:781:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hindi namin inaasahang may darating na bisita. Kung alam namin, naghanda sana ako ng tsaa…

ds:409:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Now, what can we do for you?

ds:409:783:Dialogue Text.source: Do you happen to have Finley’s Stuff?
ds:409:783:Dialogue Text.target: Nasa inyo ba ang Mga Gamit ni Finley?

ds:409:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh yes, we put his stuff in a box.
ds:409:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo, inilagay namin sa kahon ang mga gamit niya.

ds:409:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We thought he’d come by to pick it up but…
ds:409:786:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Akala namin, dadaan siya para kunin, pero…

ds:409:787:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I guess we pushed him too far…

ds:409:789:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeaaaah we definitely took him for granted.

ds:409:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See Rascal, we were a bit of a handful as roommates…
ds:409:790:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kasi, Rascal, medyo mahirap kaming kasama sa tirahan…

ds:409:794:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But we definitely could’ve tried a little harder…
ds:409:794:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Pero kaya naman sana naming magsikap pa nang kaunti…

ds:409:796:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… You know, that gives me an idea!
ds:409:796:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Alam mo, may naisip akong ideya!

ds:40:253:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, Rascal! I was just out wandering!

ds:410:201:Dialogue Text.target: Baka naiwan ni Charlotte na bukas?

ds:410:203:Dialogue Text.target: Iba't ibang uri ng libro rito!

ds:410:204:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Looks like some adult titles?
ds:410:204:Dialogue Text.target: Oh? Mukhang may mga pamagat na pangmatanda?

ds:410:205:Dialogue Text.source: Ok this whole bottom section is erotic novels…
ds:410:205:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, puro erotikong nobela ang buong bahaging ito sa ibaba…

ds:410:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Oh uh! Melody is pretty picky about critters going into her room.
ds:410:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Oh, uh! Medyo mapili si Melody sa mga nilalang na pumapasok sa kuwarto niya.

ds:410:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]She doesn’t even let me in there that often…

ds:410:211:Dialogue Text.target: Sukat sa isang hayop na kaanak ng aso?

ds:411:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Can’t wait to cook with you sometime!
ds:411:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sabik na akong makapagluto kasama ka minsan!

ds:411:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Always happy to see you around here!

ds:412:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal, darling. I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.
ds:412:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Rascal, mahal. Matagal ko nang hindi nakikitang ganito kasabik si Charlotte.

ds:412:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?
ds:412:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Puwede mo bang gawin muna ang anumang hiling niya?

ds:412:749:Dialogue Text.source: I was planning on it anyways!

ds:412:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

ds:412:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can’t wait to see you go next!
ds:412:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabik na akong makitang ikaw naman ang sumabak!

ds:413:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Alright Rascal… I’ve got a plan, but I’ll need your help.
ds:413:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sige, Rascal… May plano ako, pero kailangan ko ng tulong mo.

ds:413:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I’ve been meaning to meet the critters of the forest, right?
ds:413:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Matagal ko nang balak makilala ang mga nilalang sa gubat, di ba?

ds:413:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And we also need to patch up our relationship with Finley, right?
ds:413:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At kailangan din naming ayusin ang samahan namin ni Finley, di ba?

ds:413:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I have a way to do both!
ds:413:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa tingin ko, may paraan ako para gawin ang dalawa!

ds:413:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I need you to help break the ice, what do you say?
ds:413:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero kailangan ko ng tulong mo para tunawin ang yelo sa pagitan namin, ano sa tingin mo?

ds:413:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No Rascal, I’m asking for your help. Please be serious!
ds:413:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi, Rascal, humihingi ako ng tulong sa 'yo. Seryosohin mo, pakiusap!

ds:413:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I like to bake, and I’m pretty good if I do say so myself.
ds:413:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mahilig akong mag-bake, at mahusay naman ako, kung ako ang tatanungin.

ds:413:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I’m not good at meeting new folks…

ds:413:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And the last time I tried, I scared them off by accident…
ds:413:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At noong huli kong subukan, hindi ko sinasadyang natakot sila…

ds:413:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m willing and really wanting to put in the work, but if you could help me out, I’d be very grateful!
ds:413:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Handa ako at gustong-gusto kong pagsikapan, pero kung matutulungan mo 'ko, lubos akong magpapasalamat!

ds:413:148:Dialogue Text.source: Why not have Melody do it?
ds:413:148:Dialogue Text.target: Bakit hindi si Melody ang gumawa?

ds:413:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She’s out going and great with people for sure… But we’re both basically strangers to the rest of the critters…
ds:413:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Palakaibigan siya at mahusay sa pakikitungo, tiyak… Pero pareho kaming halos di-kilala ng ibang nilalang…

ds:413:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This would just make things smoother, if you don’t mind!
ds:413:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mas mapapadali lang nito, kung ayos lang sa 'yo!

ds:413:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Great! Well first I need to get baking.

ds:413:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:154:Dialogue Text.source:
Of course I’ll help out!
Though I might charge a cookie tax…
ds:413:154:Dialogue Text.target:
Siyempre, tutulong ako!
Pero baka maningil ako ng buwis na kukis…

ds:413:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So why not break the ice with some extra special "friendship cookies"!
ds:413:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya bakit hindi tunawin ang yelo gamit ang espesyal na "mga kukis ng pagkakaibigan"!

ds:414:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bagong luto at handa na ang mga kukis na 'to!

ds:414:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and here’s that special one for Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!
ds:414:717:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ay, at heto ang espesyal para kay Finley… Siguraduhing alam niyang galing sa amin!

ds:414:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal, bagong luto at handa na ang mga kukis!

ds:414:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Give that special one to Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!
ds:414:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ibigay mo kay Finley ang espesyal… Siguraduhing alam niyang galing sa amin!

ds:414:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal, bagong luto at handa na ang mga kukis!

ds:414:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Be sure to give some to all the critters!

ds:415:717:Dialogue Text.source: This one’s from a new friend!

ds:415:719:Dialogue Text.source: Nope! Have ya met Charlotte and Melody?
ds:415:719:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi! Nakilala mo na ba sina Charlotte at Melody?

ds:415:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah! Yes the bear and fox up in the caves, right?
ds:415:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah! Oo, ang oso at soro sa mga kuweba sa itaas, di ba?

ds:415:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve seen them here and there, but very seldomely.

ds:415:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Akala ko nga, baka lumipat na sila…

ds:415:724:Dialogue Text.target: Si Charlotte ang gumawa ng karamihan. Pero oo!

ds:415:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Umm… Can I take a few more?
ds:415:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Umm… Maaari pa ba akong kumuha ng ilan?

ds:416:737:Dialogue Text.source: Actually, I have something for ya!
ds:416:737:Dialogue Text.target: Sa totoo lang, may dala ako para sa 'yo!

ds:416:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]'Yan ba ang masarap na amoy na 'yon?

ds:416:740:Dialogue Text.source: It is! I hope you like cookies!
ds:416:740:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Sana gusto mo ng mga kukis!

ds:416:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks Rascal! This is very nice of you!

ds:416:743:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually they’re from Charlotte and Melody!
I’m just the delivery boy.
ds:416:743:Dialogue Text.target:
Galing talaga kina Charlotte at Melody!
Tagahatid lang ako.

ds:416:745:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna be more active
with the critters down here.
ds:416:745:Dialogue Text.target:
Gusto nilang mas makihalubilo
sa mga nilalang dito sa ibaba.

ds:416:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m a bit familiar with them, but obviously they’re a little large to use my services.
ds:416:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Medyo kilala ko sila, pero siyempre medyo malaki sila para sa serbisyo ko.

ds:416:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And frankly, no one really goes up there - but there is a perch! That’s a part of my route!
ds:416:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]At sa totoo lang, wala namang gaanong umaakyat doon - pero may dapuan! Bahagi ng ruta ko!

ds:416:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Hmm, I don’t think I have a spare bell though… I really have to make more…
ds:416:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Hmm, wala yata akong sobrang kampana… Kailangan ko na talagang gumawa pa…

ds:416:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]They might have a spare one up there…
ds:416:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Baka may sobra sila roon sa itaas…

ds:416:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I mean, it’s not like they use the one I gave them!
ds:416:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kasi hindi naman nila ginagamit ang ibinigay ko!

ds:416:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]Oh wow! Ang sarap ng mga kukis na 'to!

ds:417:735:Dialogue Text.target: Uy, Dustin! May mga kukis ako!

ds:417:737:Dialogue Text.source: Have you met Melody and Charlotte?
ds:417:737:Dialogue Text.target: Nakilala mo na sina Melody at Charlotte?

ds:417:738:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The polar bear and the fox gal, right?
ds:417:738:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ang osong polar at babaeng soro, di ba?

ds:417:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But I have wanted to meet em!

ds:417:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Marunong ka bang magtago ng lihim?

ds:417:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ve got a thing for big ladies, mate!
ds:417:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]May gusto ako sa malalaking babae, pare!

ds:417:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]See lil’ guys like myself can uh… get in pretty deep if ya know what I’m sayin.
ds:417:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kasi kaming maliliit, kaya naming uh… makapasok nang malalim, kung alam mo ang ibig kong sabihin.

ds:417:746:Dialogue Text.source: I think I catch your drift.
ds:417:746:Dialogue Text.target: Nauunawaan ko yata ang ibig mong sabihin.

ds:417:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho a guy can dream! For now, toss one of those cookies over!
ds:417:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Basta, libre namang mangarap! Sa ngayon, ihagis mo rito ang isa sa mga kukis!

ds:417:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I gotta load up on carbs anyways, so this is perfect!
ds:417:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kailangan ko rin namang punuin ng carbs ang katawan, kaya tamang-tama!

ds:417:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa totoo lang, puwede ba ng ilan?

ds:418:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If it isn’t Rascal! How are you dear?

ds:418:737:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m good! And I’ve got
cookies for the two of you!
ds:418:737:Dialogue Text.target:
Ayos ako! At may dala akong
mga kukis para sa inyong dalawa!

ds:418:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hold on love! I’ll make sure they aren’t poison…

ds:418:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course, I’ll need to test yours as well…
ds:418:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siyempre, kailangan kong tikman din ang sa 'yo…

ds:418:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]If these are poison, it’ll just be the end of me!
ds:418:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kung may lason ang mga 'to, katapusan ko na lang!

ds:418:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Also, how dare you insinuate our lil’ Rascal would poison us!
ds:418:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isa pa, bakit mo ipinahihiwatig na lalasunin tayo ng munting Rascal natin!

ds:418:746:Dialogue Text.source: Actually they aren’t made by me!
ds:418:746:Dialogue Text.target: Sa totoo lang, hindi ako ang gumawa!

ds:418:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naku, ang sarap ng mga kukis na 'to!

ds:418:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll have to ask her for the recipe!

ds:418:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Mm, yes! It’s that depth of savory, but the hint of salty…
ds:418:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mm, oo! Ang lalim ng linamnam, pero may bahid ng alat…

ds:418:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m going to tell her you’re making these jokes.
ds:418:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sasabihin ko sa kanya ang mga biro mong 'yan.

ds:418:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Maybe there’s rabbit in these cookies…
ds:418:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Baka may kuneho sa mga kukis na 'to…

ds:418:761:Dialogue Text.source: Do you two know Charlotte and Melody?
ds:418:761:Dialogue Text.target: Kilala n'yong dalawa sina Charlotte at Melody?

ds:418:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes! The critters up North. They don’t frequent these parts too often.
ds:418:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, oo! Ang mga nilalang sa hilaga. Hindi sila gaanong dumadalaw rito.

ds:418:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve always wanted to make a trek up there and meet them. But it’s awfully cold up there!
ds:418:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Matagal ko nang gustong umakyat doon at makilala sila. Pero napakalamig sa itaas!

ds:418:767:Dialogue Text.source: Claire and Violet knitted me a sweater.
ds:418:767:Dialogue Text.target: Nagniting ng sweter para sa 'kin sina Claire at Violet.

ds:418:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! I bet you’re absolutely adorable in it!
ds:418:769:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh! Tiyak na napakakyut mo kapag suot 'yon!

ds:418:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Funny thing about those critters up north…
ds:418:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nakakatawang bagay tungkol sa mga nilalang sa hilaga…

ds:418:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I haven’t met them, but I was out scavenging, and the bear… Charlotte, was it?
ds:418:774:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ko pa sila nakilala, pero naghahanap ako ng mga mapapakinabangan, at ang oso… Charlotte ba?

ds:418:775:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She’s awfully quiet for how large she is!
ds:418:775:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napakatahimik niyang kumilos para sa laki niya!

ds:418:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She managed to sneak up on me, and I ended up having a bit of a fright!
ds:418:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nakalapit siya nang hindi ko napansin, at medyo natakot ako!

ds:418:777:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I didn’t quite realize who it was, so I bolted.
ds:418:777:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi ko naisip kung sino, kaya kumaripas ako.

ds:418:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It dawned on me later, but I never got the chance to mention it! It’d be a laugh now!
ds:418:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Saka ko lang naisip, pero wala akong pagkakataong banggitin! Mapagtatawanan na sana ngayon!

ds:418:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s right! You had quite a fright that day.
ds:418:780:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oo nga! Takot na takot ka noong araw na 'yon.

ds:418:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s not every day you see a bear in the woods!
ds:418:782:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ka naman araw-araw nakakakita ng oso sa gubat!

ds:418:788:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Or, did she poison these cookies to finish the job?!
ds:418:788:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… O nilagyan niya ng lason ang mga kukis para tapusin ang nasimulan?!

ds:418:793:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero seryoso, akin na ang mga kukis!

ds:419:736:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m delivering cookies!
Here ya go!
ds:419:736:Dialogue Text.target:
Naghahatid ako ng mga kukis!
Heto!

ds:419:739:Dialogue Text.source: This seems like a good problem to have.

ds:419:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can’t possibly eat this much! It’ll take a week to finish it!
ds:419:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi ko kayang kainin ang ganito karami! Isang linggo bago maubos!

ds:419:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Break me off a piece. You can have the rest of mine.
ds:419:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Putulan mo 'ko ng isang piraso. Sa 'yo na ang natitira sa akin.

ds:419:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Who made these? A frickin’ bear or something?
ds:419:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sino'ng gumawa nito? Isang lintik na oso o ano?

ds:419:744:Dialogue Text.source:
Yes actually! Have you
met Charlotte and Melody?
ds:419:744:Dialogue Text.target:
Oo nga! Nakilala mo na ba
sina Charlotte at Melody?

ds:419:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I haven’t! But I have heard about them.
ds:419:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi pa! Pero may narinig na 'ko tungkol sa kanila.

ds:419:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Osong polar at soro ng Artiko, di ba?

ds:419:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow, and they can bake? Oh these are great too!
ds:419:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wow, at marunong silang mag-bake? Ang sarap din ng mga 'to!

ds:419:749:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! They want to meet everyone.
ds:419:749:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Gusto nilang makilala ang lahat.

ds:419:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well they’re off to a great start! Gosh these cookies are killer!
ds:419:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Maganda ang simula nila! Naku, panalo ang mga kukis na 'to!

ds:41:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Perfect timing! I’ve been bored as hell.
ds:41:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sakto ang dating mo! Inip na inip na ako.

ds:41:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you’ve also met our boy, Ollie!
ds:41:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nakilala mo na rin pala ang kaibigan naming si Ollie!

ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.source: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)
ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.target: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)

ds:41:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, we’re fuck buddies. He’s always so bashful about it. It’s adorable.
ds:41:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Haha, magkakaibigan kaming nagkakantutan. Lagi siyang nahihiya kapag nababanggit 'yon. Ang kyut.

ds:41:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Claire, You’re gonna scare this new guy off.

ds:41:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]C’mon Vi, You can smell it, this boy’s been up to a lot already!
ds:41:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Naman, Vi. Naamoy mo naman, ang dami nang ginawa ng lalaking ito!

ds:41:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Of course I can smell it, I’m just being polite.

ds:41:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We’ll just see what the new guy thinks.

ds:41:231:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How about it new guy, are we scaring you?
ds:41:231:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ano, bagong dating? Natatakot ka ba sa amin?

ds:41:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh come on Vi, he’s clearly messing with us.
ds:41:236:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Naman, Vi. Malinaw na niloloko lang niya tayo.

ds:41:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s what I’m talking about! Look at him, this guy’s GOT it.
ds:41:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iyan ang sinasabi ko! Tingnan mo, may IBUBUGA ang isang ito.

ds:41:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Say… You came at a pretty good time.
ds:41:241:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alam mo… Maganda ang tiyempo ng pagdating mo.

ds:41:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maybe you can help us figure something out…
ds:41:242:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Baka matulungan mo kaming malaman ang isang bagay…

ds:41:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Haha, I don’t think so Vi, he’s already agreed to help us.
ds:41:247:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Haha, ayoko, Vi. Pumayag na siyang tulungan tayo.

ds:41:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Which one of us would make you cum faster?
ds:41:252:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sino sa aming dalawa ang mas mabilis magpapalabas sa 'yo?

ds:41:253:Dialogue Text.target: Akala ko hindi ka na magtatanong!

ds:41:254:Dialogue Text.source: Only one way to find out…
ds:41:254:Dialogue Text.target: Iisa lang ang paraan para malaman…

ds:41:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! I’m beat. Thanks for being the judge there.
ds:41:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Whew! Pagod na ako. Salamat sa pagiging hukom namin.

ds:420:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Huh? For me? Aren’t I the one who handles deliveries?
ds:420:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huh? Para sa 'kin? Hindi ba ako ang namamahala sa mga paghahatid?

ds:420:741:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?
ds:420:741:Dialogue Text.target: Kilala mo sina Charlotte at Melody?

ds:420:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, the fox and bear up north?
ds:420:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo, ang soro at oso sa hilaga?

ds:420:743:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s right! They wanna be more
friendly and active with you guys.
ds:420:743:Dialogue Text.target:
Tama! Gusto nilang maging mas
palakaibigan at makihalubilo sa inyo.

ds:420:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’d be great! I’d love to see them more often!
ds:420:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Napakaganda niyan! Gusto ko silang makita nang mas madalas!

ds:420:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Mmm~ These cookies rock too! Top tier cookies if I do say so myself.
ds:420:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Mmm~ Ang sarap din ng mga kukis na 'to! Pinakamataas na klase, kung ako ang tatanungin.

ds:420:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Remember that camera I was fiddling with?

ds:420:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well it’s good to go! Let me know if you meet any critters that might wanna do some modeling!
ds:420:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Handa na! Sabihin mo kung may makilala kang nilalang na gustong magmodelo!

ds:420:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maybe Charlotte or Melody would be interested!

ds:420:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo! Gumawa tayo ng mga sexy na bagay!

ds:420:753:Dialogue Text.source:
Isn’t that a little too forward
for new critters?
ds:420:753:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi ba medyo masyadong prangka
para sa mga bagong kakilala?

ds:420:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Folks don’t live around these parts and expect paid dinner and three dates!
ds:420:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hindi nakatira rito ang mga nilalang na umaasang may libreng hapunan at tatlong date muna!

ds:420:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’m sure you’ve realized that by now!

ds:420:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Atta’ boy! And gimme another cookie before you leave!
ds:420:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ayan! At bigyan mo pa 'ko ng kukis bago ka umalis!

ds:421:737:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Naghahatid ako ng mga kukis!

ds:421:740:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?
ds:421:740:Dialogue Text.target: Kilala mo sina Charlotte at Melody?

ds:421:742:Dialogue Text.source:
They live up north, but they haven’t
really come down here that often.
ds:421:742:Dialogue Text.target:
Nakatira sila sa hilaga, pero hindi
sila gaanong bumababa rito.

ds:421:744:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanted to be neighborly!
Break the ice, so to speak.
ds:421:744:Dialogue Text.target:
Gusto nilang makipagkapuwa!
Tunawin ang yelo, ika nga.

ds:421:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oooh I shoulda done that! Everyone likes food!
ds:421:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oooh, dapat ginawa ko rin 'yon! Lahat mahilig sa pagkain!

ds:421:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Gosh, it’s a little hard for someone like me to cook though…
ds:421:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Naku, medyo mahirap ngang magluto para sa isang tulad ko…

ds:421:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They seem like nice critters! I’ll be looking forward to meeting them!
ds:421:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mukha silang mababait na nilalang! Sabik na akong makilala sila!

ds:421:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh… And… Can I have another cookie?
ds:421:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh… At… Puwede pa ng isang kukis?

ds:422:735:Dialogue Text.target: Mga babae! Dala ko ang mga kukis!

ds:422:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Hmm, no. I smell other critters on him… Melody?
ds:422:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Hmm, hindi. May naaamoy akong ibang nilalang sa kanya… Melody?

ds:422:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ay GRABE, galing ba kay Charlotte ang mga 'to?

ds:422:743:Dialogue Text.source: Yep, that’s right! You know them?

ds:422:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We don’t really know her roommate, Charlotte. But we DO know her baking!
ds:422:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hindi namin gaanong kilala ang kasama niya sa tirahan, si Charlotte. Pero KILALA namin ang mga niluluto niya!

ds:422:748:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna get to know
the critters around here.
ds:422:748:Dialogue Text.target:
Gusto nilang makilala
ang mga nilalang dito.

ds:422:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s great! We’ve been trying to egg them on to do it for a while.
ds:422:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ang ganda! Matagal na naming sinusubukang hikayatin silang gawin 'yon.

ds:422:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But Finley used to be roommates with them. We’d all hang every so often.
ds:422:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero dating kasama nila sa tirahan si Finley. Nagsasama-sama kaming lahat paminsan-minsan.

ds:422:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’ll also join Melody on her excursions!
ds:422:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sinasamahan din namin si Melody sa mga lakad niya!

ds:422:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Those were usually to other parts of the forest though. Not in this neighborhood.
ds:422:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero karaniwan, sa ibang bahagi ng gubat. Hindi rito sa paligid.

ds:422:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’d go looking for random one night flings.
ds:422:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naghahanap kami ng kung sinong makakatalik nang isang gabi lang.

ds:422:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You should join us if we ever go again!

ds:422:767:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Habang wala pa, ibigay mo ang mga kukis!

ds:423:738:Dialogue Text.source:
And Charlotte made cookies!
This one’s for you specifically.
ds:423:738:Dialogue Text.target:
At gumawa si Charlotte ng mga kukis!
Para sa 'yo mismo ang isang ito.

ds:423:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, man, I do miss her baking…
ds:423:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oooh, pare, nami-miss ko ang mga niluluto niya…

ds:423:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Aw look, it says "We’re Sorry" heh… Looks like they’re trying, eh?
ds:423:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]O tingnan, sabi rito "We’re Sorry"—"Humihingi Kami ng Tawad," hehe… Mukhang nagsisikap sila, ano?

ds:423:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oooh, and look here, they cleaned all my belongings!
ds:423:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oooh, tingnan mo, nilinis nila ang lahat ng gamit ko!

ds:423:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nagkaroon ka na ba ng kasama sa tirahan, Rascal?

ds:423:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, not all critters have the same standards I suppose!
ds:423:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Siguro, hindi pare-pareho ang pamantayan ng lahat ng nilalang!

ds:423:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It was a weird lesson to learn, and we never really… concluded it too well together.
ds:423:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kakaibang aral 'yon, at hindi talaga namin… naayos nang maayos ang usapin.

ds:423:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]In the heat of the moment, it was very aggravating, but now I can see that not all critters are compatible in terms of living situations.
ds:423:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Noong kainitan ng gulo, nakakagalit talaga. Pero ngayon, alam ko nang hindi lahat ng nilalang ay magkasundo pagdating sa pagsasama sa tirahan.

ds:423:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]On the surface, it was mainly that they were really messy…
ds:423:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa unang tingin, ang pangunahing problema ay napakakalat nila…

ds:423:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Clothes and trash on the floor. Kitchen a total mess.
ds:423:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mga damit at basura sa sahig. Napakagulo ng kusina.

ds:423:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I was the one cleaning most of it, and I have hooves! Not an easy task!
ds:423:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ako ang naglilinis ng karamihan, at mga kuko ng tupa ang sa akin! Hindi madali 'yon!

ds:423:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Melody would even borrow my gear and forget to clean it! Yuck!
ds:423:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hinihiram pa ni Melody ang kagamitan ko tapos nakakalimutang linisin! Kadiri!

ds:423:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But what it really seemed to be, was a lack of respect. To me and their living space.
ds:423:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero ang tunay na problema, sa tingin ko, ay kawalan ng paggalang. Sa akin at sa tirahan nila.

ds:423:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean, you were up there, right? You probably saw the mess.
ds:423:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nakapunta ka sa itaas, di ba? Malamang nakita mo ang kalat.

ds:423:760:Dialogue Text.target: Nakasalansan ang mga pinggan, malinis ang mga counter.

ds:423:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Really?? And the clothes on the floor?
ds:423:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Talaga?? At ang mga damit sa sahig?

ds:423:762:Dialogue Text.source:
There was a clothing rack.
Didn’t see much on the floor.
ds:423:762:Dialogue Text.target:
May sabitan ng damit.
Wala akong gaanong nakita sa sahig.

ds:423:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And Charlottes books? Those had to be around right?
ds:423:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At ang mga libro ni Charlotte? Nakakalat ang mga 'yon, di ba?

ds:423:764:Dialogue Text.source:
Nope, on a book case.
Alphabetized I believe.
ds:423:764:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi, nasa estante ng libro.
Nakaalpabeto pa yata.

ds:423:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hah. Of course. They get their act together once I’m gone.
ds:423:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hah. Siyempre. Kung kailan wala na ako, saka nila inayos ang sarili nila.

ds:423:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah well, at least they seemed to have taken my complaints seriously…
ds:423:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah, kahit paano, mukhang sineryoso naman nila ang mga reklamo ko…

ds:423:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well. It’s not very becoming of me to let these petty things stack up and ruin some friendships. I should go talk to them.
ds:423:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi bagay sa akin na hayaang maipon ang maliliit na tampuhan at masira ang mga pagkakaibigan. Dapat ko silang kausapin.

ds:424:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh! Now what do we have here?

ds:424:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Gosh, I probably shouldn’t… I’ve eaten a lot of sweets lately…
ds:424:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh! Naku, hindi ko siguro dapat… Marami akong nakain na matamis nitong huli…

ds:424:738:Dialogue Text.source: Oh but these are friendship cookies!

ds:424:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh I see! Well then of course there’s room for a friendship cookie!
ds:424:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ah, ganoon! Kung ganoon, may puwang siyempre para sa kukis ng pagkakaibigan!

ds:424:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I didn’t peg you as a baker!

ds:424:741:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s because I’m not! These are
from the critters in the mountains!
ds:424:741:Dialogue Text.target:
Dahil hindi naman! Galing 'to
sa mga nilalang sa kabundukan!

ds:424:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah what was their names… Medley… Charlene?
ds:424:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, ano nga ang mga pangalan nila… Medley… Charlene?

ds:424:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah yes! That’s right. I did some work for them a bit ago.
ds:424:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah, oo! Tama. May ginawa ako para sa kanila noong nakaraan.

ds:424:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Some of my finer work! And it was my first time working in ice too! Tricky stuff!
ds:424:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ilan sa pinakamagaganda kong gawa! At unang beses ko ring gumawa gamit ang yelo! Mahirap hawakan!

ds:424:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I wonder if that’s still holding up…

ds:424:754:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I gotta go deliver more cookies.
ds:424:754:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, kailangan ko pang maghatid ng mga kukis.

ds:424:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sounds good! Pass my compliments to the chef!
ds:424:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ayos! Ipaabot mo ang papuri ko sa nagluto!

ds:424:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Puwede bang uh… makahingi pa ng isa?

ds:424:761:Dialogue Text.source:
Didn’t you say something about
having too many sweets lately?
ds:424:761:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi ba may sinabi kang
marami kang nakain na matamis nitong huli?

ds:424:763:Dialogue Text.source:
Well there’s always room
for Friendship Cookies!
ds:424:763:Dialogue Text.target:
Laging may puwang naman
para sa mga Kukis ng Pagkakaibigan!

ds:424:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha that’s right! I’ll be sure to savor this one!

ds:425:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.
ds:425:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, mahal! Bigyan mo 'ko ng ilang minuto at hahanapin ko ang mga gamit ni Finley.

ds:425:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.
ds:425:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, mahal! Bigyan mo 'ko ng ilang minuto at hahanapin ko ang mga gamit ni Finley.

ds:426:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll gather up Finley’s stuff.
ds:426:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, mahal! Bigyan mo 'ko ng ilang minuto at titipunin ko ang mga gamit ni Finley.

ds:427:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Here you go, darling! This box should be everything Finley left up here.
ds:427:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Heto na, mahal! Dapat nasa kahong 'to ang lahat ng iniwan ni Finley rito sa itaas.

ds:428:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yes, we took you for granted and were just terrible roommates!
ds:428:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oo, hindi ka namin pinahalagahan, at napakapangit naming mga kasama sa tirahan!

ds:428:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now now, I also have my fair share of the blame. I’ve never been good at confronting these things…
ds:428:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]O siya, may kasalanan din ako. Hindi ako magaling humarap sa mga ganitong usapin…

ds:428:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should have tried to communicate more before things blew up.
ds:428:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dapat sinubukan kong makipag-usap pa bago lumala ang lahat.

ds:428:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But if we didn’t suck, you wouldn’t have to communicate!
ds:428:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pero kung hindi kami gano'n kasama, hindi mo na kailangang makipag-usap!

ds:428:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]And we’re sorry we left things like this for so long.
ds:428:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]At patawad dahil hinayaan naming ganito ang mga bagay nang napakatagal.

ds:428:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]We felt awful after you left, and we weren’t sure how to make it up to you…
ds:428:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Napakabigat sa loob namin nang umalis ka, at hindi namin alam kung paano makakabawi sa 'yo…

ds:428:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]All we could do was hear your words and try to do better…
ds:428:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Ang nagawa lang namin ay pakinggan ang mga sinabi mo at sikaping magbago…

ds:428:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But we never knew how to fix things…
ds:428:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Pero hindi namin alam kung paano aayusin ang lahat…

ds:428:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s fine it’s fine. I should have come up sooner honestly.
ds:428:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ayos lang, ayos lang. Sa totoo lang, dapat matagal na akong umakyat dito.

ds:428:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Does… Does this mean you’ll come back?
ds:428:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ibig… Ibig sabihin ba babalik ka na?

ds:428:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Uhhh! Well. I think we all learned some important things about ourselves…
ds:428:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Uhhh! Sa tingin ko, may mahahalagang bagay tayong natutunan tungkol sa ating sarili…

ds:428:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think it’d be best for me to be on my own for now…
ds:428:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sa tingin ko, mas mabuting mamuhay muna akong mag-isa…

ds:428:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But… How about we do dinner together?
ds:428:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Pero… Paano kung magsalo tayo sa hapunan?

ds:428:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve got some new recipes I bet you two would enjoy.
ds:428:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May mga bago akong resipi na siguradong magugustuhan ninyong dalawa.

ds:428:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That sounds wonderful, Finley. We’ll happily have you over whenever you want.
ds:428:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Napakaganda niyan, Finley. Malugod ka naming tatanggapin dito kahit kailan mo gusto.

ds:428:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh uh. So I see you two have met Rascal, yeah?
ds:428:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]O ah. Mukhang nakilala na ninyong dalawa si Rascal, ano?

ds:428:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yes we have! Come on over dear, we see you!
ds:428:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo naman! Halika rito, mahal, nakikita ka namin!

ds:429:716:Dialogue Text.source: Sorry, I didn’t mean to intrude!

ds:429:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]On the contrary, dear! I think we owe you one for helping us patch things up!
ds:429:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sa kabaligtaran, mahal! Sa tingin ko, may utang kami sa 'yo sa pagtulong mong maayos ang samahan namin!

ds:429:719:Dialogue Text.source:
Pretty sure that was
the magic of Charlotte’s cookies.
ds:429:719:Dialogue Text.target:
Tiyak na dahil 'yon
sa mahika ng mga kukis ni Charlotte.

ds:429:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That’s true, I’m really just here for more cookies.
ds:429:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Totoo, nandito lang talaga ako para sa dagdag na kukis.

ds:429:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah! I knew it. I can’t blame you.
ds:429:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah! Alam ko na. Hindi kita masisisi.

ds:429:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, yes yes, my cookies are great.
ds:429:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Heh, oo na, oo na, masarap ang mga kukis ko.

ds:429:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But what is a cookie without a delivery service! That was all you Rascal!
ds:429:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero ano ang kukis kung walang tagahatid! Lahat 'yon ay dahil sa 'yo, Rascal!

ds:429:727:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s true.
I am a miracle worker.

ds:429:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! To thank Rascal, we should have him join us for dinner sometime!
ds:429:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ay! Para pasalamatan si Rascal, yayain natin siyang maghapunan kasama natin minsan!

ds:429:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hey uh Melody… regarding the toys you were borrowing…
ds:429:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Uy, uh, Melody… tungkol sa mga hinihiram mong laruan…

ds:429:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Forgive me for asking, but I’m awfully curious. Did the big one fit?
ds:429:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pasensiya na sa pagtatanong, pero gustong-gusto kong malaman. Nagkasya ba ang malaki?

ds:429:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh? Quite the nosy one Finley! I can’t believe you’d ask a gal something so personal…
ds:429:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh? Ang usisero mo, Finley! Hindi ako makapaniwalang itatanong mo sa isang babae ang ganoon kapersonal…

ds:429:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, ok cut the coy act! You know you’re doing that just because Rascal is here.
ds:429:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, sige, tigilan mo na ang pakipot! Alam mong ginagawa mo lang 'yan dahil nandito si Rascal.

ds:429:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]There’s no impression like the first impression, darling…

ds:429:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But yes. I hilted the whole thing.

ds:429:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But really, for however small of a part you had to play, we thank you.
ds:429:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero seryoso, gaano man kaliit ang papel mo, nagpapasalamat kami.

ds:429:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok for real though, where are those cookies?
ds:429:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, seryoso na, nasaan ang mga kukis?

ds:42:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Are those for me? That was fast!
ds:42:198:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O! Para sa akin ba 'yan? Ang bilis!

ds:42:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A deals a deal! Let me know when you’d like me to take you across the field!
ds:42:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Usapan ay usapan! Sabihin mo lang kung kailan mo gustong magpahatid sa kabilang panig ng kapatagan!

ds:430:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey! How did the cookie delivery go?

ds:430:715:Dialogue Text.source:
It went great!
Everyone loved them!

ds:430:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do you think it broke the ice enough?
ds:430:717:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa tingin mo, sapat na ang natunaw na yelo?

ds:430:718:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m not sure… you might need to
make more cookies to convince some…
ds:430:718:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi ako sigurado… baka kailangan mo pang
gumawa ng kukis para kumbinsihin ang ilan…

ds:430:720:Dialogue Text.source:
No I’m just kidding.
Everyone’s very excited to meet you!
ds:430:720:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi, biro lang.
Sabik na ang lahat na makilala ka!

ds:430:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oooh right... I guess the next step is to actually meet them...
ds:430:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oooh, oo nga... Ang susunod nga pala, makipagkilala talaga sa kanila...

ds:430:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ahhh! I'm not super great with meeting a lot of new critters at once...
ds:430:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ahhh! Hindi ako gaanong mahusay makipagkilala sa maraming bagong nilalang nang sabay-sabay...

ds:430:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve just got a lot of insecurities and anxieties…
ds:430:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Marami lang akong pangamba at alalahanin sa sarili…

ds:430:726:Dialogue Text.source:
Absolutely. The critters are
very excited to meet you!
ds:430:726:Dialogue Text.target:
Siyempre. Sabik na ang mga nilalang
na makilala ka!

ds:430:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m sure I can keep them in check, but I’m definitely nervous!
ds:430:727:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sigurado akong mapipigil ko naman, pero kinakabahan talaga ako!

ds:430:728:Dialogue Text.source:
Honestly, the critters are very talkative.
You could probably just listen and
nod your head and they’ll love you.
ds:430:728:Dialogue Text.target:
Sa totoo lang, madaldal ang mga nilalang.
Malamang, makinig ka lang at tumango
at mamahalin ka na nila.

ds:430:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll try to prepare myself mentally for now!
ds:430:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Susubukan ko munang ihanda ang isip ko!

ds:430:731:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Then we can do the next step later…
ds:430:731:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapos, saka natin gawin ang susunod na hakbang…

ds:431:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal Darling, what can I do for you?
ds:431:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Rascal, mahal, ano'ng magagawa ko para sa 'yo?

ds:431:716:Dialogue Text.source:
I couldn’t help but notice the clothes.
Would you like to model them?
ds:431:716:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi ko maiwasang mapansin ang mga damit.
Gusto mo bang imodelo?

ds:431:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Sure! Give me a second to get dressed!

ds:431:719:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually not for me. For a friend.
They’ve got a camera and
wanted to give it a run.
ds:431:719:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi talaga para sa 'kin. Para sa kaibigan.
May kamera siya at
gustong subukan.

ds:431:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Para sa isang tiyak na koleksiyon ng damit?

ds:431:723:Dialogue Text.source:
Oh nothing like that. I think it’s mainly
for fun and to mess with the camera.
ds:431:723:Dialogue Text.target:
Ah, walang ganoon. Sa tingin ko, para lang sa
kasiyahan at pagsubok ng kamera.

ds:431:725:Dialogue Text.source:
Pretty sure it might be explicit as well…
If you’re OK with that.
ds:431:725:Dialogue Text.target:
Malamang, may mga lantad na seksuwal na kuha rin…
Kung ayos lang sa 'yo.

ds:431:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh why didn’t you say so, darling!
ds:431:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ay, bakit hindi mo agad sinabi, mahal!

ds:431:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I won’t turn down an opportunity like that!

ds:431:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve got just the things I’ve been meaning to wear for such an occasion!
ds:431:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May mga kasuotan akong matagal ko nang gustong isuot sa ganitong pagkakataon!

ds:431:730:Dialogue Text.source: Maverick. He’s the town shop keep.
ds:431:730:Dialogue Text.target: Maverick. Siya ang tindero sa bayan.

ds:431:731:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Ah yes, I’m familiar with him. Perfect!

ds:431:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Give me a moment to get ready, and we can be on our way!
ds:431:732:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sandali lang at maghahanda ako, tapos maaari na tayong umalis!

ds:431:735:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Give me a moment to get ready, and we can be on our way!
ds:431:735:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sandali lang at maghahanda ako, tapos maaari na tayong umalis!

ds:432:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Melody’s in the back, she was asking if you were going to join us.
ds:432:716:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nasa likod si Melody, tinatanong niya kung sasali ka sa amin.

ds:432:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]We just finished up the clothed portion! I’ll show ya them later, some really nice shots!
ds:432:719:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Katatapos lang ng bahaging may suot! Ipapakita ko mamaya, may napakagagandang kuha!

ds:432:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But now we’re moving onto the spicy stuff, so I’m grabbing the video camera!
ds:432:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero ngayon, sa maiinit na tayo, kaya kinukuha ko ang kamerang pang-video!

ds:432:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Do you wanna use the photo camera?

ds:432:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Great! Grab that camera and come on back!
ds:432:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ayos! Kunin mo ang kamera at pumunta ka sa likod!

ds:433:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, Rascal, sa tingin ko handa na kami.

ds:433:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed, everything appears to be in order!
ds:433:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo nga, mukhang maayos na ang lahat!

ds:434:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naku, talagang GUSTONG-GUSTO ko ang mga kukis na 'yon!

ds:434:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Just ask Peter! I haven’t stopped talking about them!
ds:434:716:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tanungin mo pa si Peter! Hindi ako tumitigil sa pagkukuwento tungkol doon!

ds:434:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think she’s fallen out of love with me, and in love with those cookies.
ds:434:719:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa tingin ko, hindi na niya ako mahal, ang mga kukis na ang mahal niya.

ds:434:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She’s too good for me anyways. It was only a matter of time…
ds:434:724:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hindi naman ako karapat-dapat sa kanya. Darating din talaga sa ganoon…

ds:434:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hehe! Another marriage ended by my magnificent cookies…
ds:434:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hehe! Isa na namang pag-aasawang winakasan ng mga kahanga-hanga kong kukis…

ds:434:729:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]GOSH, I just love how huge you are!
ds:434:729:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]NAKU, gustong-gusto ko kung gaano ka kalaki!

ds:434:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Mabel dear, that’s a bit rude, don’t ya think?

ds:434:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So tell us about yourself, Charlotte. What do you like to do?
ds:434:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kuwentuhan mo kami tungkol sa sarili mo, Charlotte. Ano ang gusto mong gawin?

ds:434:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ooh, well, aside from baking. I really like reading!
ds:434:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ooh, bukod sa pagbe-bake. Gustong-gusto kong magbasa!

ds:434:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ya don’t say? What kind of reading?

ds:434:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Mostly novels and stories… Like, fantasy stuff.
ds:434:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Karaniwan, mga nobela at kuwento… Mga pantasya.

ds:434:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Augustus is our fellow book worm here. He’s by the lake! I’ll introduce you!
ds:434:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Si Augustus ang kapwa natin mahilig sa libro. Nasa lawa siya! Ipakikilala kita!

ds:434:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So Charlotte! What’s your secret for those cookies?
ds:434:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Charlotte! Ano ang sikreto mo sa mga kukis na 'yon?

ds:434:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]*Gasp*! Was I the side piece the whole time??
ds:434:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]*Singhap*! Ako pala ang kabit sa buong panahong 'yon??

ds:434:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I think I may have… scared the crap out of your husband a while ago…
ds:434:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa tingin ko, baka… tinakot ko nang husto ang asawa mo noong nakaraan…

ds:434:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Gosh! Look at the view from up here!
ds:434:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Naku! Tingnan mo ang tanawin mula rito sa itaas!

ds:434:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Is this what it’s like to be tall?

ds:434:779:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yep, that was me! Fleeing at top speed with my tail between my legs.
ds:434:779:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo, ako 'yon! Kumaripas ng takbo, nakasingit ang buntot sa mga binti.

ds:434:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hehe, I’m sorry, that was a hilarious day!

ds:434:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m glad my trauma can be your pleasure.
ds:434:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Masaya akong pinasasaya ka ng trauma ko.

ds:434:786:Dialogue Text.source:
Charlotte! Are these ferocious
critters bothering you??
ds:434:786:Dialogue Text.target:
Charlotte! Ginugulo ka ba ng
mababangis na nilalang na 'to??

ds:434:788:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes officer, they’re hassling me for my baking secrets!

ds:434:789:Dialogue Text.source:
I see… Well… I can probably help
you out… for some cookies…

Ganoon pala… Buweno… Matutulungan siguro
kita… kapalit ng ilang kukis…

ds:434:793:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think she wanted to familiarize herself with the setting.
ds:434:793:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa tingin ko, gusto niyang masanay sa lugar.

ds:435:19:Dialogue Text.source: A bunch of paperwork and receipts. Organized by date.

ds:435:25:Dialogue Text.source: They look quite healthy! Seems like they were recently watered too.

ds:436:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy! Don’t touch the set! It’s for actors only…
ds:436:36:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hoy! Huwag hawakan ang set! Para lang sa mga artista…

ds:436:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We can do a shoot for you some other time, dear.

ds:436:39:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang mamahalin ang mga ilaw na 'to…

ds:436:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You have no idea what I had to do to get those!

ds:439:822:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm sorry dear. I hope you don’t mind…

ds:439:834:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, I think it’s time we whip out a toy…
ds:439:834:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, sa tingin ko, oras nang maglabas tayo ng laruan…

ds:439:836:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I’m no stranger to a camera darling…
ds:439:836:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, sanay ako sa kamera, mahal…

ds:439:837:Dialogue Text.source: But do you think I’d have myself on display like this often?
ds:439:837:Dialogue Text.target: Pero sa tingin n'yo, madalas akong magpakita nang ganito?

ds:439:839:Dialogue Text.source: Oh… erm, I didn’t mean anything by that…
ds:439:839:Dialogue Text.target: Oh… erm, wala naman akong ibig sabihin doon…

ds:439:841:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, I’m joking. You boys aren’t the first to get a show like this.
ds:439:841:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, biro lang. Hindi kayo ang unang nakapanood ng ganitong palabas.

ds:439:843:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s move on, while I’m still worked up…

ds:43:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ooooh! I'm gonna suck you so hard...

ds:440:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]How about next time you two are the ones on the bed?
ds:440:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Paano kung sa susunod, kayong dalawa ang nasa kama?

ds:440:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh ho! Ano sa tingin mo, Red?

ds:440:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]You’ll be the support role though, I’m the star of this show after all!
ds:440:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Pero pansuportang papel ang sa 'yo, ako ang bida sa palabas na 'to!

ds:440:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course! I wouldn’t miss out on a performance like that!
ds:440:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siyempre! Hindi ko palalampasin ang ganoong pagtatanghal!

ds:440:729:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Think you two can follow up this act though?
ds:440:729:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero sa tingin n'yo, kaya n'yong pantayan ang palabas na 'to?

ds:441:133:Dialogue Text.source: So uh… I noticed those Erotic Novels?

ds:441:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Usually I cover up that bottom shelf if I’m expecting guests… but uh…
ds:441:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kadalasan tinatakpan ko ang istante sa ibaba kapag may inaasahan akong bisita… pero ano…

ds:441:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah I suppose the cat’s out of the bag now…

If this is too forward,
you don’t have to talk about it.
ds:441:141:Dialogue Text.target:
Kung masyadong personal,
hindi mo kailangang pag-usapan.

ds:441:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just trying to put it into words…

ds:441:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Like I might be shy about the topic…

ds:441:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean, I’ve had opportunities, but it’s always so scary in the moment! I just shy away.
ds:441:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagkaroon na ako ng mga pagkakataon, pero kapag nandoon na, nakakatakot! Umiiwas na lang ako.

ds:441:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But the books help me live it out!

ds:441:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They let me consider how I might act in those situations…
ds:441:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naiisip ko kung paano ako kikilos sa mga ganoong sitwasyon…

I get it! They help you live out what
some characters might be doing!

Naiintindihan ko! Nararanasan mo
ang ginagawa ng ilang tauhan!

ds:441:152:Dialogue Text.source:
But wouldn’t you rather
just try it for yourself?

Pero hindi mo ba gustong
subukan na lang mismo?

ds:441:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well… I wouldn’t want to try EVERYTHING I’ve read…

ds:441:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But there’s definitely some things that sound nice!

ds:442:133:Dialogue Text.source: What are some of your favorite stories?

ds:442:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, I suppose a lot of the stories aren’t anything too ground breaking…

Puwede mo ba akong iugnay sa kanya?

ds:456:710:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Meet me back here in a bit, and I’ll let you know!
ds:456:710:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Balikan mo ako rito maya-maya, at sasabihin ko sa 'yo!

ds:456:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I got a hold of him. He wants you to meet him at the lake!
ds:456:714:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Nakausap ko na siya. Gusto ka niyang makatagpo sa Lawa!

ds:456:715:Dialogue Text.source: Ok can do! Anywhere in particular?

ds:456:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, once you’re at the lake, head South East!
ds:456:716:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo, pagdating mo sa Lawa, pumunta ka sa Timog-Silangan!

ds:457:771:Dialogue Text.source: Hey, I see my message found you…
ds:457:771:Dialogue Text.target: Uy, mukhang nakarating sa 'yo ang mensahe ko…

ds:457:774:Dialogue Text.source: So what’s the plan this time?

ds:457:776:Dialogue Text.source: I’d like to return the favor.

ds:457:777:Dialogue Text.source: How about you fool around in me and we’ll see where it goes from there?
ds:457:777:Dialogue Text.target: Maglaro ka kaya sa loob ko, tapos tingnan natin kung saan tayo dadalhin?

ds:457:781:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Climb on top lil’ guy, show me what you got!
ds:457:781:Dialogue Text.target: Ayos! Umakyat ka, munting kaibigan, ipakita mo ang kaya mo!

ds:457:785:Dialogue Text.source: Been a while since I’ve been on the receiving end…
ds:457:785:Dialogue Text.target: Matagal na mula noong ako ang pinasukan…

ds:457:792:Dialogue Text.target: Ah- luwagan mo naman kung ganoon, grabe!

ds:457:795:Dialogue Text.source: Aw, but now you’re slipping out!
ds:457:795:Dialogue Text.target: Aw, pero nadudulas ka na palabas!

ds:457:797:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah but it feels so gooooood.

ds:457:798:Dialogue Text.source: But uh… Do squeeze when I’m gonna cum…
ds:457:798:Dialogue Text.target: Pero ano… higpitan mo kapag malapit na akong labasan…

ds:457:805:Dialogue Text.source: Well in that case… Time to squeeze!

ds:457:815:Dialogue Text.source: Y’know, you look pretty cute next to my meat.
ds:457:815:Dialogue Text.target: Alam mo, ang kyut mo sa tabi ng titi ko.

ds:457:816:Dialogue Text.source: How about you give it some attention?

ds:457:818:Dialogue Text.source: Big ole hunkin’ thing like this? Of course I’ll be giving it some attention!
ds:457:818:Dialogue Text.target: Ganito kalaking sandata? Siyempre bibigyan ko ng atensiyon!

ds:457:820:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, hard to imagine this thing was inside ya, eh?
ds:457:820:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, mahirap isiping nasa loob mo 'to dati, ano?

ds:457:822:Dialogue Text.target: Oh, masakit pa rin ang katawan ko.

ds:457:826:Dialogue Text.source: No worries, now it’s time for my revenge!
ds:457:826:Dialogue Text.target: Walang problema, ngayon oras ko nang gumanti!

ds:457:830:Dialogue Text.source: You won’t be able to walk straight for a week!
ds:457:830:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi ka makakalakad nang maayos sa loob ng isang linggo!

ds:457:832:Dialogue Text.source: Ok big guy, how about you put that mouth to work?
ds:457:832:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, malaking kaibigan, gamitin mo na kaya 'yang bibig mo?

ds:457:838:Dialogue Text.source: Lap up that pre while you’re at it…
ds:457:838:Dialogue Text.target: Dilaan mo na rin 'yang paunang likido…

ds:457:841:Dialogue Text.source: Big ole guy like you sensitive to a lil tongue like mine?
ds:457:841:Dialogue Text.target: Malaking lalaking tulad mo, sensitibo sa munting dila kong 'to?

ds:457:843:Dialogue Text.source: Hah, yeah I’ve got a soft spot for little cuties.
ds:457:843:Dialogue Text.target: Hah, oo, malambot ang puso ko pagdating sa maliliit na kyut.

ds:457:847:Dialogue Text.source: Alright, I’m about to lose it.

ds:457:848:Dialogue Text.source: Think you can wrap your mouth around me?
ds:457:848:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin mo kaya mong isubo ako?

ds:457:855:Dialogue Text.source: Gah, that’s it. Gulp it down…

ds:457:856:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, gutom na munting kaibigan, ha?

ds:457:863:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm yeah that was good… Aside from the mess you made…
ds:457:863:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, oo, masarap… Maliban sa kalat na ginawa mo…
