ds:518:1267:Dialogue Text.source: You said you didn’t want your mom and me…
ds:518:1267:Dialogue Text.target: Sabi mo, ayaw mong kami ng nanay mo…

ds:518:1268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, no worries! She won’t be there.

ds:518:1271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, it’s our job during these rituals. As Matriarch, she does a lot of chanting and me and a few other mice are there to assist however.
ds:518:1271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oo, tungkulin namin sa mga ritwal na 'to. Bilang Matriyarka, marami siyang pag-awit at pagbigkas, at naroon kami ng ilang daga para tumulong sa anumang paraan.

ds:518:1274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Don’t worry about me though, I’ve been on the fun side of these a ton.
ds:518:1274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero huwag mo 'kong alalahanin, maraming beses na 'kong nasa masayang panig nito.

ds:518:1278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah. <pause>The markings these mice have are symbolic. And all of the participants must have these markings.
ds:518:1278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo. <pause>Simboliko ang mga marka ng mga dagang 'to. At kailangang may mga markang 'to ang lahat ng kalahok.

ds:518:1279:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! I was going to ask you about those…
ds:518:1279:Dialogue Text.target: Oh! Itatanong ko sana sa 'yo ang mga 'yon…

ds:518:1280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah I’ll fill ya in later. We have to get started though, and they will need some time to paint you.
ds:518:1280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo, ikukuwento ko mamaya. Pero kailangan na nating magsimula, at kailangan nila ng oras para pintahan ka.

ds:518:1281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll have some mice help you, till then, can you drop off the jar by that stump?
ds:518:1281:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May mga daga akong ipapadala para tulungan ka, pero bago 'yon, puwede mong ilagay ang garapon sa tabi ng tuod?

ds:519:902:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I feel like I’m missing out, <pause>what’s happening?

ds:519:903:Dialogue Text.source: Scarlett’s going to help us meet the Wolf!
ds:519:903:Dialogue Text.target: Tutulungan kami ni Scarlett na makilala ang Lobo!

ds:519:905:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Ooooh, Scarlett, <pause>are YOU who I smell on him?
ds:519:905:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ooooh, Scarlett, <pause>IKAW ba ang naaamoy ko sa kanya?

ds:519:907:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Matalas pa rin ang mga pandama mo, Bucky! <pause>Tama.

ds:519:909:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Put in a good word for me!

ds:51:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a bit chilly for my tastes.

ds:51:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll stick to the lake…

ds:51:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a bit chilly for my tastes.

ds:51:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll stick to the lake…

ds:520:902:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ya guys aren’t trying to rob me, are ya?

ds:520:903:Dialogue Text.source:
Yep! Give us everything ya got!
Or we’ll sic mabel on ya!
ds:520:903:Dialogue Text.target:
Oo! Ibigay mo ang lahat ng mayroon ka!
Kung hindi, ipapasugod namin si Mabel sa 'yo!

ds:520:904:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ok ok! I surrender! <pause>I’ve seen what that lil’ mouse can do!
ds:520:904:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sige na, sige na! Sumusuko na ako! <pause>Nakita ko na ang kaya ng munting dagang 'yan!

ds:520:906:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gonna break the ice for these two with a friend of mine!
ds:520:906:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tutulungan kong makipagkilala ang dalawang 'to sa isang kaibigan ko!

ds:520:907:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This have to do with that wolf fella?

ds:520:911:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But that’s for another time, we should get going.
ds:520:911:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Pero sa ibang pagkakataon na 'yon, kailangan na naming umalis.

ds:521:902:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]How come you get all these babes hanging around you?
ds:521:902:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Bakit ikaw ang may kasamang mga seksing babae?

ds:521:903:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! <pause>I’m lending these two a hand with meeting a friend.
ds:521:903:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ha! <pause>Tinutulungan ko ang dalawang 'to na makilala ang isang kaibigan.

ds:521:907:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A bit of a grump, <pause>a bit of a loner, <pause>but a good guy.

ds:521:908:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We got to get going, but I’ll introduce you sometime!
ds:521:908:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kailangan na naming umalis, pero ipakikilala kita minsan!

ds:522:902:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=11]Do you all want rides?
I'll have to make two trips...
ds:522:902:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=11]Gusto n'yong lahat sumakay?
Kailangan kong magdalawang biyahe...

ds:522:904:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll be introducing these two to the wolf.

ds:522:905:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Bahawhaw! <pause>Y’know I had a hunch that you might’ve been who he’s been seeing!
ds:522:905:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bahawhaw! <pause>Alam mo, may kutob akong ikaw ang nakakatagpo niya!

ds:522:907:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nope! <pause>I just see all sorts of stuff when I’m flying about!
ds:522:907:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi! <pause>Kung anu-ano lang ang nakikita ko habang lumilipad!

ds:522:908:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So what’s up, why did you ring me then?
ds:522:908:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ano'ng balita, bakit n'yo ako tinawag gamit ang kampana?

ds:522:910:Dialogue Text.source: Oh. Uh… Yeah I’m not sure.
ds:522:910:Dialogue Text.target: Oh. Uh… Oo, hindi ako sigurado.

ds:528:922:Dialogue Text.target: “Salamat!” sabi ni Rascal, habang inaakay siya ng isa sa mga daga patungo sa siga. Dumami ang mga nagtitipong daga, nakamasid nang mabuti habang salit-salitang naghahagis ng iba't ibang bagay sa apoy ang mga matanda.

ds:528:924:Dialogue Text.source: Small paws move methodically over Rascal's body, tracing bold strokes and intricate swirls. The mice work in perfect harmony.
ds:528:924:Dialogue Text.target: Maingat at maayos na gumalaw ang maliliit na lapa sa katawan ni Rascal, gumuguhit ng matatapang na linya at masasalimuot na ikot. Ganap na magkakatugma ang paggawa ng mga daga.

ds:528:926:Dialogue Text.source: Across the clearing, the stump housing Mabel glows with a steady rhythm, each pulse casting vibrant light. With every burst of color, the campfire’s flames respond in unison.
ds:528:926:Dialogue Text.target: Sa kabilang panig ng maluwang na lugar, nagliliwanag sa tuloy-tuloy na ritmo ang tuod na kinaroroonan ni Mabel, bawat tibok ay nagpapalabas ng makulay na liwanag. Sa bawat pagsambulat ng kulay, sabay na tumutugon ang mga liyab ng siga.

ds:528:928:Dialogue Text.source: The elder mice's chants become louder! Pink flames and streaks explode out from the campfire! As this happens, the group of mice pair off and begin kissing.
ds:528:928:Dialogue Text.target: Lumalakas ang mga awit ng matatandang daga! Sumasabog mula sa siga ang rosas na mga liyab at guhit ng apoy! Habang nangyayari ito, nagpapares-pares ang grupo ng mga daga at nagsisimulang maghalikan.

ds:528:930:Dialogue Text.source: The flames die down as the ritual comes to an end. Exhausted and dripping mice motion for Rascal to follow them to a nearby creek.
ds:528:930:Dialogue Text.target: Humuhupa ang mga liyab sa pagtatapos ng ritwal. Pagod at tumutulo-tulo, sumesenyas ang mga daga kay Rascal na sumunod sa malapit na batis.

ds:528:932:Dialogue Text.source: Two mice climb on Rascal and begin exploring his snout. “I’ll just follow their lead” thinks Rascal, as they smooch around his lips. He lightly caresses the mice and brings them in closer.
ds:528:932:Dialogue Text.target: Dalawang daga ang umakyat kay Rascal at nagsimulang galugarin ang kanyang nguso. “Susunod na lang ako sa kanila,” naisip ni Rascal, habang hinahalikan nila ang paligid ng kanyang mga labi. Marahan niyang hinaplos ang mga daga at inilapit pa.

ds:528:934:Dialogue Text.source: They wash up and return to the campfire...
ds:528:934:Dialogue Text.target: Naghugas sila at bumalik sa siga...

ds:528:936:Dialogue Text.source: The three take turns making out and exploring each other. Rascal gets bolder with his tongue, and the mice reflect his energy. And then, the trees alight with a brilliant red. And the ritual begins...
ds:528:936:Dialogue Text.target: Salit-salitang naghalikan nang mapusok at ginalugad ng tatlo ang isa't isa. Naging mas matapang si Rascal sa paggamit ng dila, at tinapatan ng mga daga ang kanyang sigla. At pagkatapos, nagliwanag ang mga puno sa maningning na pula. At nagsimula ang ritwal...

ds:529:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The Blessing is one of our favorite traditions here in the forest!
ds:529:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ang Pagpapala ay isa sa mga paborito naming tradisyon dito sa gubat!

ds:529:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It's a big ole celebration we have during the Winter!
ds:529:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Malaking pagdiriwang ito na ginaganap namin tuwing taglamig!

ds:529:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For a few weeks, we decorate, give gifts, and share meals!
ds:529:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa loob ng ilang linggo, nagdedekorasyon kami, nagbibigay ng regalo, at nagsasalo sa pagkain!

ds:529:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Penny and Augustus could probably tell you more about the history of it all.
ds:529:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Malamang, mas marami pang maikukuwento sina Penny at Augustus tungkol sa kasaysayan ng lahat ng ito.

ds:529:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and if you’re out and about. Ask Mabel what she got up to last year…
ds:529:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ay, at kung maglilibot ka, tanungin mo si Mabel kung ano ang pinagkakaabalahan niya noong nakaraang taon…

ds:529:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It was a particularly crazy year for her!

ds:529:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Penny and Augustus could probably tell you more about the history of The Blessing.
ds:529:264:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Malamang, mas marami pang maikukuwento sina Penny at Augustus tungkol sa kasaysayan ng Pagpapala.

ds:529:267:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]While you’re out and about, you should ask Mabel what she got up to last year…
ds:529:267:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Habang naglilibot ka, tanungin mo si Mabel kung ano ang pinagkakaabalahan niya noong nakaraang taon…

ds:530:132:Dialogue Text.source: How is Penny able to carry critters all day?
ds:530:132:Dialogue Text.target: Paano nakakayang buhatin ni Penny ang mga nilalang buong araw?

ds:530:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well ya gotta be if you’re flyin’ around with a big ol’ bell every year!
ds:530:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kailangan naman, kung lumilipad-lipad ka na may malaking kampana bawat taon!

ds:530:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh shoot! That’s right, I keep forgetting!

ds:530:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The Blessing is a big ole celebration we have during the Winter!
ds:530:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang Pagpapala ay malaking pagdiriwang namin tuwing taglamig!

ds:530:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For a few weeks, we decorate, give gifts, and share meals!
ds:530:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa loob ng ilang linggo, nagdedekorasyon kami, nagbibigay ng regalo, at nagsasalo sa pagkain!

ds:530:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s usually a lot of drinks as well, that’s when the real fun happens…
ds:530:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Karaniwan, marami ring inumin, doon nagsisimula ang tunay na saya…

ds:530:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That’s true! Peter and I like to throw a big party every year. It can get pretty wild…
ds:530:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Totoo! Gusto naming magdaos ni Peter ng malaking handaan bawat taon. Maaari itong maging napakapusok…

ds:530:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Anywho, on the day of "The Blessing," Penny flies around with this giant bell ALL NIGHT LONG!
ds:530:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Basta, sa araw ng "Pagpapala," lumilipad-lipad si Penny na may higanteng kampana nang BUONG GABI!

ds:530:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You should ask her about it! Augustus too! They could probably tell you more about the history of it all.
ds:530:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dapat mong tanungin siya! Pati si Augustus! Malamang, marami pa silang maikukuwento tungkol sa kasaysayan ng lahat ng 'to.

ds:530:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and if you’re out and about. Ask Mabel what she got up to last year…
ds:530:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ay, at kung maglilibot ka, tanungin mo si Mabel kung ano ang pinagkakaabalahan niya noong nakaraang taon…

ds:530:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It was a particularly crazy year for her!

ds:531:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal! I just had the strangest dream...

ds:531:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]A bunch of us critters were all together, in a different time and place. But... that place was also here!
ds:531:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Marami kaming nilalang na magkakasama, sa ibang panahon at lugar. Pero... dito rin ang lugar na 'yon!

ds:531:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Everyone was busy searching for unusual stuff. We worked together to find it all!
ds:531:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Abala ang lahat sa paghahanap ng mga kakaibang bagay. Nagtulungan kaming hanapin ang lahat!

ds:531:262:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmm, maybe those veggies I ate last night were expired...
ds:531:262:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hmm, baka sira na ang mga gulay na kinain ko kagabi...

ds:532:705:Dialogue Text.source: Do you celebrate The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:532:705:Dialogue Text.target: Ipinagdiriwang mo ba ang Pagpapala ng mga Kampana?

ds:532:708:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Do I? Oh it’s one of my favorite times of the year!
ds:532:708:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kung ipinagdiriwang ko? Isa 'yan sa mga paborito kong panahon ng taon!

ds:532:709:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The friends, the food, the gifts, what’s not to love?
ds:532:709:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Mga kaibigan, pagkain, regalo, sino ba namang aayaw?

ds:532:710:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I particularly love sending out greeting cards to all the critters!
ds:532:710:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gustong-gusto kong magpadala ng mga kard ng pagbati sa lahat ng nilalang!

ds:532:711:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s a great way to stay in touch, but it’s an even better opportunity to look cute in front of the camera!
ds:532:711:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Magandang paraan para magkamustahan, pero mas magandang pagkakataon para magpakakyut sa harap ng kamera!

ds:532:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’d usually do a nice wholesome one for the families…
ds:532:714:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kadalasan gagawa ako ng magandang disenteng kard para sa mga pamilya…

ds:532:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And for the close friends, I’ll send them something spicy!
ds:532:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At para sa malalapit na kaibigan, magpapadala ako ng maanghang!

ds:532:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Gah! I wish I could show you the one we did last year… I don’t have any extras around…
ds:532:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Gah! Sana maipakita ko sa 'yo 'yong ginawa namin noong nakaraang taon… Wala akong sobrang kopya rito…

ds:532:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Actually, Penny was the one delivering them, perhaps she has an extra…
ds:532:719:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Si Penny pala ang naghatid, baka may sobra siya…

ds:532:720:Dialogue Text.source: Worth a shot! I’ll ask her.

ds:532:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Spoiler alert, not only did she deliver them, but she starred in it too!
ds:532:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isisiwalat ko na, hindi lang siya ang naghatid, siya rin ang bida!

ds:532:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Imagine that! Personally delivering such a revealing and saucy thing!
ds:532:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Isipin mo 'yon! Personal na inihahatid ang ganoon kalantad at malaswang bagay!

ds:532:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was quite surprised she wanted to deliver them!
ds:532:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagulat talaga akong gusto niya mismong maghatid!

ds:532:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But I also knew it’d be a thrill for her…
ds:532:724:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pero alam ko ring kikiligin siya roon…

ds:532:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been off and on messing around for the past few years.
ds:532:727:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Paminsan-minsan kaming naglalaro nitong mga nakaraang taon.

ds:532:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can tell you about it some other time though. You should really ask her about that greeting card!
ds:532:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa ibang araw ko na ikukuwento. Tanungin mo talaga siya tungkol sa kard ng pagbating 'yon!

ds:533:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Penny was the one delivering them, perhaps she has an extra…
ds:533:719:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Si Penny ang naghatid ng mga iyon, baka may sobra siya…

ds:533:720:Dialogue Text.source: Worth a shot! I’ll ask her.

ds:533:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Spoiler alert, not only did she deliver them, but she starred in it too!
ds:533:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Spoiler, hindi lang siya ang naghatid, bida rin siya roon!

ds:533:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Imagine that! Personally delivering such a revealing and saucy thing!
ds:533:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Isipin mo 'yon! Personal na maghatid ng ganoon kalantad at malaswang bagay!

ds:533:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was quite surprised she wanted to deliver them!
ds:533:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagulat talaga akong gusto niyang ihatid ang mga iyon!

ds:533:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But I also knew it’d be a thrill for her…
ds:533:724:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pero alam ko ring magiging kapana-panabik para sa kanya…

ds:533:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been off and on messing around for the past few years.
ds:533:727:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Paminsan-minsan kaming naglalaro nitong mga nakaraang taon.

ds:533:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can tell you about it some other time though. You should really ask her about that greeting card!
ds:533:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa ibang pagkakataon na lang kita kuwentuhan. Dapat mo talagang tanungin siya tungkol sa kard ng pagbati!

ds:533:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You know those greeting cards I made for critters during The Blessing?
ds:533:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Alam mo 'yung mga kard ng pagbating ginawa ko para sa mga nilalang noong Pagpapala?

ds:533:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You should really ask Penny about that greeting card!
ds:533:732:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dapat mo talagang tanungin si Penny tungkol sa kard ng pagbati!

ds:534:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naalala mo ang piitan namin sa ibaba?

ds:534:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well we aren’t finished with our renovations just yet, but we did get another area prepared for some fun!
ds:534:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hindi pa tapos ang pagsasaayos namin, pero may naihanda na kaming isa pang lugar para sa kasiyahan!

ds:534:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! We thought it’d be fun to invite you and some of the boys over to give it a test run!
ds:534:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tunay nga! Naisip naming masayang imbitahan ka at ang ilang lalaki para subukan!

ds:534:733:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Dustin and Bucky have been wanting to mess around, so can you let them know?
ds:534:733:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Matagal nang gustong maglaro nina Dustin at Bucky, kaya maaari mo silang sabihan?

ds:534:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Peter and I will finish preparations meanwhile!
ds:534:734:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Tatapusin muna namin ni Peter ang paghahanda!

ds:534:738:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Go round up the boys! We’ll be getting things prepped here.
ds:534:738:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Tipunin mo ang mga lalaki! Maghahanda kami rito.

ds:535:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naalala mo ang piitan namin sa ibaba?

ds:535:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well we aren’t finished with our renovations just yet, but we did get another area prepared for some fun!
ds:535:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hindi pa tapos ang pagsasaayos namin, pero may naihanda na kaming isa pang lugar para sa kasiyahan!

ds:535:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! We thought it’d be fun to invite you and some of the boys over to give it a test run!
ds:535:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tunay nga! Naisip naming masayang imbitahan ka at ang ilang lalaki para subukan!

ds:535:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let us know when you want to have a go!

ds:536:802:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]More like, a ton of elbow grease…

ds:536:803:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah what have you guys
been cleaning anyways?
ds:536:803:Dialogue Text.target:
Oo, ano nga ba ang
nililinis n'yo?

ds:536:804:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Uh… Well. Let’s just say it’s a long story.
ds:536:804:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Uh… Buweno. Sabihin na lang nating mahabang kuwento.

ds:536:805:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We can fill you in some other time.

ds:536:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For now, we’ve got another bench cleared off! So Scarlett and the ladies wanna take it for a spin!
ds:536:806:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa ngayon, may isa pa kaming nalinis na bangko! Kaya gustong subukan ni Scarlett at ng mga babae!

ds:536:807:Dialogue Text.source: Nice! Who should I round up this time?
ds:536:807:Dialogue Text.target: Ayos! Sino ang titipunin ko ngayon?

ds:536:808:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I promised Penny and Mabel first dibs!
ds:536:808:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ipinangako ko kina Penny at Mabel na sila ang unang makasusubok!

ds:536:809:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once you’ve gotten a hold of them, come back here and we can get started!
ds:536:809:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kapag nakausap mo na sila, bumalik ka rito at makapagsisimula na tayo!

ds:536:810:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, by the way. You can find them up north.
ds:536:810:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh, siya nga pala. Makikita mo sila sa hilaga.

ds:536:811:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think they were meeting up with Charlotte and Melody near the foot of the mountain.
ds:536:811:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa tingin ko, makikipagkita sila kina Charlotte at Melody malapit sa paanan ng bundok.

ds:536:813:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! Just the critter we wanted to see!
ds:536:813:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Rascal! Ikaw ang nilalang na gusto naming makita!

ds:536:815:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So we’ve shifted into overdrive and made even more progress on the basement!
ds:536:815:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya todo-kayod kami at mas malaki pa ang naiusad sa silong!

ds:536:817:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nothing that a bit of elbow grease couldn’t solve!

ds:536:818:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Once you’ve gotten a hold of Penny and Mabel, come back here and we can get started!
ds:536:818:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kapag nakausap mo na sina Penny at Mabel, bumalik ka rito at makapagsisimula na tayo!

ds:537:802:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]More like, a ton of elbow grease…

ds:537:803:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah what have you guys
been cleaning anyways?
ds:537:803:Dialogue Text.target:
Oo, ano nga ba ang
nililinis n'yo?

ds:537:804:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Uh… Well. Let’s just say it’s a long story.
ds:537:804:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Uh… Buweno. Sabihin na lang nating mahabang kuwento.

ds:537:805:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We can fill you in some other time.

ds:537:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For now, we’ve got another bench cleared off! So Scarlett and the ladies wanna take it for a spin!
ds:537:806:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa ngayon, may isa pa kaming nalinis na bangko! Kaya gustong subukan ni Scarlett at ng mga babae!

ds:537:813:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! Just the critter we wanted to see!
ds:537:813:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Rascal! Ikaw ang nilalang na gusto naming makita!

ds:537:815:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So we’ve shifted into overdrive and made even more progress on the basement!
ds:537:815:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya todo-kayod kami at mas malaki pa ang naiusad sa silong!

ds:537:817:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nothing that a bit of elbow grease couldn’t solve!

ds:537:818:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let us know when you're ready for another go!
ds:537:818:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabihin mo kapag handa ka nang subukan uli!

ds:538:20:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ano'ng balita, pare? Kayod nang kayod, malamang?

ds:538:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Mate! How fast do you think I can sprint to that tree and back?
ds:538:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pare! Sa tingin mo, gaano kabilis akong makatatakbo sa punong 'yon at pabalik?

ds:538:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Aight mate, I need a breather! Let’s talk later.
ds:538:27:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sige, pare, kailangan kong magpahinga! Usap tayo mamaya.

ds:539:819:Dialogue Text.source: The plant coils on itself and coos sweetly.
ds:539:819:Dialogue Text.target: Pumulupot sa sarili ang halaman at humuni nang malambing.

ds:539:820:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! Uh! Sorry if that hurt, Scarlett said-
ds:539:820:Dialogue Text.target: Oh! Uh! Pasensiya kung masakit, sabi ni Scarlett-

ds:539:821:Dialogue Text.source: Vines coil gently around Rascal, guiding him forward.
ds:539:821:Dialogue Text.target: Marahang pumulupot ang mga baging kay Rascal, ginagabayan siya palapit.

ds:539:822:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh self lubricating… Let’s give this a spin…
ds:539:822:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, may sarili nang pampadulas… Subukan natin…

ds:539:823:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal grabs the stump, and guides his member to the opening.
ds:539:823:Dialogue Text.target: Hinawakan ni Rascal ang tuod at itinapat ang ari niya sa bungad.

ds:539:824:Dialogue Text.source: Oh it’s warm! Mmm… Yeah… I can get used to this…
ds:539:824:Dialogue Text.target: Oh, mainit! Mmm… Oo… Masasanay ako rito…

ds:539:826:Dialogue Text.source: As Rascal plows away at the stump, the plant begins to drool from every orifice.
ds:539:826:Dialogue Text.target: Habang binabayo ni Rascal ang tuod, nagsimulang tumulo ang laway ng halaman mula sa bawat butas.

ds:539:827:Dialogue Text.source: The coos and churrs of the plant grow louder, the vines and petals quiver and tremble.
ds:539:827:Dialogue Text.target: Lumakas ang mga huni at dagundong ng halaman, kumibot at nanginig ang mga baging at talulot.

ds:539:828:Dialogue Text.source: Nnnf… D-damn… I’m really about to… cum in a plant…
ds:539:828:Dialogue Text.target: Nnnf… G-grabe… Malapit na talaga akong… malabasan sa loob ng halaman…

ds:539:830:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal lets out a small whimper as he goes in with a final thrust. The plant greedily milks load after load.
ds:539:830:Dialogue Text.target: Mahinang napaungol si Rascal habang ibinabaon ang huling bayo. Sakim na piniga ng halaman ang sunod-sunod na tamod.

ds:539:831:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal opens his eyes to see the panting plant gazing at him. It seems to want something.
ds:539:831:Dialogue Text.target: Iminulat ni Rascal ang mga mata at nakitang nakatingin sa kanya ang hinihingal na halaman. Mukhang may gusto ito.

ds:539:833:Dialogue Text.source: The plant gestures a vine toward Rascal’s bits, then rubs one of its oozing vines on the stump.
ds:539:833:Dialogue Text.target: Itinuro ng halaman ang isang baging sa ari ni Rascal, saka ikiniskis sa tuod ang isa sa mga baging nitong tumatagas.

ds:539:834:Dialogue Text.source: Like… You want me to pull out…

ds:539:835:Dialogue Text.source: The plant bobs its head, its tongue flopping about.
ds:539:835:Dialogue Text.target: Tumango-tango ang halaman, kumakaway-kaway ang dila nito.

ds:539:837:Dialogue Text.source: The plant’s head nods so furiously, saliva goes flying in every direction.
ds:539:837:Dialogue Text.target: Napakalakas ng pagtango ng halaman, tumalsik ang laway sa lahat ng direksiyon.

ds:539:840:Dialogue Text.source: As Rascal pulls out, the plant’s ooze runs down his legs and pools at his paws.
ds:539:840:Dialogue Text.target: Sa paghugot ni Rascal, umagos sa mga binti niya ang malapot na likido ng halaman at naipon sa mga lapa niya.

ds:539:841:Dialogue Text.source: The plant chirps at the sight as Rascal fires off a few loads.
ds:539:841:Dialogue Text.target: Humuni ang halaman habang pinapanood ang ilang bulwak ng tamod ni Rascal.

ds:539:842:Dialogue Text.source: You sure like a show, huh?

ds:539:843:Dialogue Text.source: The plant lays back with a pleased look. Its vines soften and relax. A low purr rumbles from inside the stump.
ds:539:843:Dialogue Text.target: Sumandal ang halaman na mukhang nasisiyahan. Lumambot at lumuwag ang mga baging nito. May mahinang dagundong mula sa loob ng tuod.

ds:539:846:Dialogue Text.target: Kailangan mo ba ng tulong? O…?

ds:539:848:Dialogue Text.source: Okay… Well… I’m gonna get cleaned up.

ds:539:849:Dialogue Text.source: The plant leans back and puts a twig in its mouth. The vines gesture to almost "shoo" Rascal away.
ds:539:849:Dialogue Text.target: Sumandal ang halaman at naglagay ng munting sanga sa bibig. Halos "itaboy" nito si Rascal sa pagsenyas ng mga baging.

ds:539:850:Dialogue Text.source: O-oh! R-right, yeah! Uh! I had a great time! C-Call me!
ds:539:850:Dialogue Text.target: O-oh! T-tama, oo! Uh! Ang saya noon! T-tawagin mo ako!

ds:539:851:Dialogue Text.source: The plant lazily nods its head and pushes Rascal away from the stump.
ds:539:851:Dialogue Text.target: Tamad na tumango ang halaman at itinulak si Rascal palayo sa tuod.

ds:539:862:Dialogue Text.source: At the center of the stump, a new receptacle awaits, pulsing softly as it oozes a honey-like substance.
ds:539:862:Dialogue Text.target: Sa gitna ng tuod, may bagong sisidlang naghihintay, marahang pumipintig habang nilalabasan ng parang pulot na likido.

ds:539:863:Dialogue Text.source: The plant quivers with eager anticipation…
ds:539:863:Dialogue Text.target: Nanginginig ang halaman sa sabik na paghihintay…

ds:539:864:Dialogue Text.source: The thick sticky fluid oozes out as he glides further in…
ds:539:864:Dialogue Text.target: Umaagos ang makapal at malagkit na likido habang dumudulas siya nang mas malalim…

ds:539:865:Dialogue Text.source: As Rascal utters those last words, the plant spasms and throws its head back.
ds:539:865:Dialogue Text.target: Habang sinasabi ni Rascal ang huling mga salitang 'yon, nangisay ang halaman at napatingala.

ds:539:866:Dialogue Text.source: Fluids gush from the nearby vines. The plant whines in bliss and ecstasy.
ds:539:866:Dialogue Text.target: Bumulwak ang mga likido mula sa kalapit na mga baging. Napaungol ang halaman sa matinding sarap.

ds:540:232:Dialogue Text.source: [A particularly large flower. It’s… moving… Is it asleep?]
ds:540:232:Dialogue Text.target: [Isang napakalaking bulaklak. Ito ay… gumagalaw… Tulog ba?]

ds:541:131:Dialogue Text.source: Adventures are unavailable during one of your active quests! Better try again later.
ds:541:131:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi maaaring mag-Pakikipagsapalaran habang ginagawa ang isa sa mga aktibo mong misyon! Subukan mo na lang mamaya.

ds:542:416:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Hey so… You remember
when ya asked me
if I was seeing anyone?
ds:542:416:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Uy… Naalala mo
noong tinanong mo ako
kung may kinikita ako?

ds:542:418:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]There's someone else... But it's kind of a long story... Let me know when you have some time and I can tell you about it...
ds:542:418:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]May iba pa... Pero medyo mahabang kuwento... Sabihin mo kapag may oras ka at ikukuwento ko...

ds:543:753:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=3]Ya know the photoshoot we did?
With Melody?
ds:543:753:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=3]Alam mo ang pagkuha natin ng mga litrato?
Kasama si Melody?

ds:543:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well before you arrived, we were doing a fashion-oriented shoot.
ds:543:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bago ka dumating, nakatuon sa moda ang pagkuha namin.

ds:543:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She’d throw on different outfits, and I’d snap some photos.
ds:543:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nagsusuot siya ng iba't ibang damit, at kumukuha ako ng mga litrato.

ds:543:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Of course…<pause> she was showing off a lot more than her clothes…
ds:543:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Siyempre…<pause> higit pa sa mga damit ang ipinapakita niya…

ds:543:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But during the shoot, I had placed some of the photos on the counter tops here…
ds:543:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero habang kumukuha, inilagay ko ang ilang litrato sa mga ibabaw ng mesang 'to…

ds:543:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And I think some of them flew out the window during the storm!
ds:543:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At sa tingin ko, lumipad ang ilan sa bintana noong bagyo!

ds:543:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Do you think you can keep an eye out for them?

ds:543:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]<bounce>Great!</bounce> If you find them all, let me know!
ds:543:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]<bounce>Ayos!</bounce> Kapag nakita mo na lahat, sabihin mo sa 'kin!

ds:543:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I’m missing 9 photos in total.
ds:543:767:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa tingin ko, 9 na litrato ang nawawala sa kabuuan.

ds:543:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh and<slow>, uh, </slow>my dong is in a few of them... <pause><slow>So...</slow> <pause>Enjoy.
ds:543:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ay, at<slow>, uh, </slow>kasama ang titi ko sa ilan... <pause><slow>Kaya...</slow> <pause>Magsaya ka.

ds:544:773:Dialogue Text.source: I think I found all of the photos!
ds:544:773:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin ko, nakita ko na ang lahat ng litrato!

ds:544:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm Yep! <pause>That looks like all of them!

ds:544:777:Dialogue Text.target: Gusto mo bang ibalik ko sa 'yo?

ds:544:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Actually I asked Melody if she wanted them back, and she said we could have them!
ds:544:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tinanong ko si Melody kung gusto niyang makuha uli ang mga 'yon, at sabi niya, sa atin na!

ds:544:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well, <pause>she said once we do our own photoshoot, <pause>she gets to keep those.
ds:544:781:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Buweno, <pause>sabi niya kapag tayo naman ang nagpakuha, <pause>sa kanya ang mga 'yon.

ds:544:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You can have the originals since you found em.
ds:544:783:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa 'yo na ang mga orihinal dahil ikaw ang nakakita.

ds:544:784:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Just give me a second while I try to snap a picture of them…
ds:544:784:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sandali lang habang sinusubukan kong litratuhan ang mga 'yon…

ds:545:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:546:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:547:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:548:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:549:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:550:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:551:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:552:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:553:132:Dialogue Text.target: May kung ano sa lupa rito…

ds:554:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s good! But you could never be too sure!
ds:554:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Mabuti! Pero hindi ka makatitiyak nang lubos!

ds:554:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I think I’ll stick in here for a bit.
ds:554:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sa tingin ko, dito muna ako sandali.

ds:554:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Come on in and warm up with us Rascal!
ds:554:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pasok ka at magpainit muna kasama namin, Rascal!

ds:555:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Still very new to this, <pause>“meeting critters” thing.

ds:555:756:Dialogue Text.target: Walang problema! Ayos lang ang katahimikan!

ds:556:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tunay nga! Malugod kang tatanggapin kahit kailan!

ds:556:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Peter, dear, we’ve been running low on some things around the kitchen.
ds:556:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Peter, mahal, nauubusan na tayo ng ilang bagay sa kusina.

ds:556:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah, I’ve been meaning to go out for a scavenge soon…
ds:556:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo, balak ko na ring lumabas para maghanap ng mapapakinabangan…

ds:557:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I gotta make sure the houses here weren’t leaking during that storm…
ds:557:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kailangan kong siguraduhing walang tumagas na bahay rito noong bagyo…

ds:557:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know Rascal, I feel like things have gotten kinda crazy since ya got here!
ds:557:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam mo, Rascal, parang medyo naging matindi ang mga bagay mula nang dumating ka!

ds:557:756:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! Well, I guess I’ll leave.
ds:557:756:Dialogue Text.target: Oh! Kung ganoon, aalis na lang ako.

ds:557:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha no no, good crazy! Good crazy!
ds:557:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, hindi, hindi, magandang kabaliwan! Magandang kabaliwan!

ds:558:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’m so excited with all of this stuff going on!
ds:558:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Sabik na sabik ako sa lahat ng nangyayari!

ds:558:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I sure am! But it’s just a theory for now!
ds:558:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo naman! Ngunit teorya pa lamang sa ngayon!

ds:558:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be sure to tell you once I’m certain!
ds:558:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sisiguraduhin kong sasabihin sa iyo kapag tiyak na ako!

ds:558:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m a bit busy at the moment!

ds:559:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Claire, some of the cloth got wet.
ds:559:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Claire, nabasa ang ilan sa mga tela.

ds:559:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I told you to keep it off the floor.

ds:559:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I have to give off the appearance that I’m the put-together one…
ds:559:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kailangan kong magmukhang ako ang maayos sa atin…

ds:55:131:Dialogue Text.source: Hm… Looks like there is something under the rug…
ds:55:131:Dialogue Text.target: Hm… Mukhang may kung ano sa ilalim ng alpombra…

ds:560:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I should try to paint that storm…

ds:560:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There was a pretty cool funnel forming near the lake!
ds:560:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May astig na hugis-imbudong nabubuo malapit sa lawa!

ds:560:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmm, so much has been happening recently…

ds:561:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So yeah! Now you’ve met my folks.
ds:561:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya oo! Nakilala mo na ang pamilya ko.

ds:561:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hope they aren’t too crazy for ya!
ds:561:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sana hindi sila masyadong baliw para sa 'yo!

ds:561:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They’re really greatful for all your help!
ds:561:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Talagang nagpapasalamat sila sa lahat ng tulong mo!

ds:562:206:Dialogue Text.source: Player is swimming in the lake
ds:562:206:Dialogue Text.target: Player is swimming in the lake

ds:562:210:Dialogue Text.source:
Uh sorta.
You bumped into me a bit ago.
ds:562:210:Dialogue Text.target:
Uh, medyo.
Nabunggo mo 'ko noong nakaraan.

ds:563:19:Dialogue Text.source: **Second Interact** (Available Act 2+, after the log is interacted with once)
ds:563:19:Dialogue Text.target: **Second Interact** (Available Act 2+, after the log is interacted with once)

ds:564:20:Dialogue Text.source: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)
ds:564:20:Dialogue Text.target: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)

ds:564:21:Dialogue Text.source: The masterpiece’s last piece has nearly been mastered.
ds:564:21:Dialogue Text.target: Ang huling bahagi ng obra maestra ay malapit nang maging ganap na obra.

ds:565:101:Dialogue Text.source: Uh… I think you should hold onto it.
ds:565:101:Dialogue Text.target: Uh… Sa tingin ko, dapat itago mo.

ds:565:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]YES! I was hoping you were going to say that!

ds:565:108:Dialogue Text.source:
Damn, you have some
really cool dreams!
ds:565:108:Dialogue Text.target:
Grabe, ang gaganda
ng mga panaginip mo!

ds:565:109:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, it’s rare! But when it happens, I run with it!
ds:565:109:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, bihira! Pero kapag nangyari, sinasakyan ko!

ds:565:110:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The dream had a few other critters too!
ds:565:110:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May ilan pang ibang nilalang sa panaginip!

ds:565:114:Dialogue Text.source: Striped tail! Is that a red panda?
ds:565:114:Dialogue Text.target: Guhit-guhit na buntot! Pulang panda ba 'yan?

ds:565:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Pretty sure at least. I didn’t see the face.
ds:565:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Medyo sigurado, kahit paano. Hindi ko nakita ang mukha.

ds:565:119:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There was two more that I saw in my dream.
ds:565:119:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May dalawa pa akong nakita sa panaginip ko.

ds:565:120:Dialogue Text.source: Have ya seen any critters like them?
ds:565:120:Dialogue Text.target: May nakita ka nang nilalang na katulad nila?

ds:565:67:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ha, salamat! Ganoon din ang naisip ko.

ds:565:68:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This one came to me in a dream.

ds:565:69:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once I woke up, I had to scribble it down!

ds:565:71:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nah nah, I just painted the edges of the canvas. Kinda sick huh?
ds:565:71:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi, hindi, pinintahan ko lang ang mga gilid ng kanbas. Medyo astig, ano?

ds:565:72:Dialogue Text.source:
Absolutely! Do you get a lot
of inspiration from dreams?
ds:565:72:Dialogue Text.target:
Siyempre! Madalas ka bang
makakuha ng inspirasyon sa panaginip?

ds:565:74:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I’ve been having some really vivid dreams recently!
ds:565:74:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero napakalinaw ng mga panaginip ko nitong huli!

ds:565:79:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]… Huh! Yeah I can see that!

ds:565:81:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I mean, I was just painting triangles.
ds:565:81:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Parang, mga tatsulok lang ang ipinipinta ko.

ds:565:82:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I can’t unsee it now that you mention it.
ds:565:82:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero hindi ko na maalis sa paningin ngayong nabanggit mo.

ds:565:88:Dialogue Text.source: Me? No way! I can’t paint!
ds:565:88:Dialogue Text.target: Ako? Imposible! Hindi ako marunong magpinta!

ds:565:89:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi ba… Ikaw ang nagpinta nito?

ds:565:93:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I mean… The colors are off but…

ds:565:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No, I had to run some errands, and when I came back, this was here.
ds:565:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi, may kailangan akong asikasuhin, at pagbalik ko, nandito na 'to.

ds:566:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anything can be done well too, so that makes it even harder…
ds:566:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maaaring masarap ang kahit ano kung mahusay ang pagkakagawa, kaya mas mahirap…

ds:566:756:Dialogue Text.source: What about like, sweet, or spicy?

ds:566:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But a lot of the magic happens when you combine them!
ds:566:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero marami sa mahika ang nangyayari kapag pinagsama mo sila!

ds:566:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Sweet and savory might be my all time favorite.
ds:566:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Matamis at malinamnam yata ang paborito ko sa lahat.

ds:566:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Probably why I enjoy baking so much!

ds:567:763:Dialogue Text.source: How does cooking work up here?
ds:567:763:Dialogue Text.target: Paano kayo nagluluto rito sa itaas?

ds:567:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Uh, like, the difference in baking in higher altitude?
ds:567:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Uh, parang, ang kaibahan ng pagbe-bake sa mataas na lugar?

ds:567:765:Dialogue Text.source:
I kinda meant more like…
Isn’t all that made of ice?
ds:567:765:Dialogue Text.target:
Ang ibig kong sabihin…
Hindi ba yelo ang lahat ng 'yon?

ds:567:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh, no it just looks like ice.

ds:567:768:Dialogue Text.target: Ano ang kalan at hurnong de-gas?

ds:567:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It just looks like ice, but it’s all normal cooking stuff!
ds:567:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mukha lang yelo, pero karaniwang mga gamit sa pagluluto lahat!

ds:568:775:Dialogue Text.source: Could I help you make something sometime?
ds:568:775:Dialogue Text.target: Puwede kitang tulungang gumawa ng pagkain minsan?

ds:568:779:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, well the actual cooking/baking part is usually where the high risk is.
ds:568:779:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sige, ang mismong pagluluto/pagbe-bake ang karaniwang mapanganib.

ds:568:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I can have you on prep!

ds:568:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Every ingredient usually needs some sort of preparation.
ds:568:782:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo! Kadalasan, kailangan ng bawat sangkap ng kung anong paghahanda.

ds:568:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s an important step! But not a huge problem if there’s errors.
ds:568:783:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mahalagang hakbang! Pero hindi malaking problema kung may pagkakamali.

ds:568:784:Dialogue Text.source:
That sounds perfect!
When do we start?

ds:568:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! Uh, yeah. I’ll have to get back to you on that.
ds:568:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh! Uh, oo. Kailangan kitang balikan tungkol diyan.

ds:568:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m running a little low on some ingredients at the moment.
ds:568:786:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Medyo nauubusan ako ng ilang sangkap ngayon.

ds:569:788:Dialogue Text.target: Kumusta ang pagsasama n'yo ni Finley sa tirahan?

ds:569:792:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, I kinda wished he’d move back in…
ds:569:792:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sa totoo lang, medyo gusto kong bumalik siya rito…

ds:569:793:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But we don’t have a lot of room here…

ds:570:795:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hmmm! There’s so many to choose from!

ds:570:799:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hm… <pause>You know, anything can be interesting if it’s written well enough!
ds:570:799:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hm… <pause>Alam mo, maaaring maging kawili-wili ang kahit ano kung maganda ang pagkakasulat!

ds:570:800:Dialogue Text.source: Could you tell me about one?

ds:570:802:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But let me think on it! There’s so many to choose from!

ds:571:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well can’t I only be a bottom? I don’t have a… a thing…
ds:571:806:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ba bottom lang ang maaari sa 'kin? Wala akong… isang bagay…

ds:571:809:Dialogue Text.source: It’s also more of a dynamic thing.

ds:571:810:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So it’s not just who is on top, or the bottom?
ds:571:810:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi lang kung sino ang nasa ibabaw o ilalim?

ds:571:811:Dialogue Text.source:
Right, because there are power-bottoms,
who generate the power from…
ds:571:811:Dialogue Text.target:
Tama, dahil may mga power bottom,
na lumilikha ng lakas mula sa…

ds:571:812:Dialogue Text.source:
Huh, you know…
Labels are supposed to help, but…
ds:571:812:Dialogue Text.target:
Huh, alam mo…
Dapat nakatutulong ang mga katawagan, pero…

ds:571:813:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah I think I’m more lost now!

ds:572:815:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yesssss! I love that time of year!

ds:572:816:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The snowy nights are a perfect time to cozy up with some hot chocolate and a good book!
ds:572:816:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tamang-tama ang mga gabing may niyebe para magpakakomportable sa mainit na tsokolate at magandang libro!

ds:572:819:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and the holiday is nice too.

ds:572:820:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The first big social gathering I went to was actually a Blessings party.
ds:572:820:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang unang malaking pagtitipong pinuntahan ko ay isang handaan ng Pagpapala.

ds:572:824:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I’ve started to have more fun going to them over the years!
ds:572:824:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero unti-unti akong mas nasiyahang pumunta sa mga 'yon sa paglipas ng mga taon!

ds:572:826:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And it’s a great excuse to make some tasty treats!
ds:572:826:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]At magandang dahilan para gumawa ng masasarap na pagkain!

ds:572:827:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Plus we get to hear Melody's lovely singing!
ds:572:827:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Isa pa, maririnig natin ang magandang pagkanta ni Melody!

ds:573:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s just something I’ve always had fun with since I was a kit.
ds:573:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bagay lang na lagi kong ikinasasaya mula noong batang soro pa ako.

ds:574:756:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Claire and Violet?
ds:574:756:Dialogue Text.target: Kilala mo sina Claire at Violet?

ds:574:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course! Those girls and I go way back!
ds:574:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siyempre! Matagal na kaming magkakilala ng mga babaeng 'yon!

ds:574:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I threw a party a while ago that she attended.
ds:574:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nagdaos ako ng handaan noong nakaraan na pinuntahan niya.

ds:574:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]There’s usually a lot of critters at my parties, but when you see another canine wearing a hat?
ds:574:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Karaniwan, maraming nilalang sa mga handaan ko, pero kapag may nakita kang kapwa kaanak ng aso na nakasumbrero?

ds:575:763:Dialogue Text.target: Ikaw ang gumagawa ng mga damit mo?

ds:575:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Sometimes! But I really like working with other critters!
ds:575:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Minsan! Pero gustong-gusto kong magtrabaho kasama ng ibang nilalang!

ds:575:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]For example, Claire and Violet’s designs are very functional, and designed with the wearer in mind!
ds:575:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Halimbawa, napakapraktikal ng mga disenyo nina Claire at Violet, at iniisip ang magsusuot!

ds:575:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Or if Finley sketches out a design, it’s usually full of really fun shapes!
ds:575:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O kung gumuhit si Finley ng disenyo, karaniwang puno ng napakasasayang hugis!

ds:575:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Charlotte likes incorporating a story in the design.
ds:575:767:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gusto ni Charlotte na maglagay ng kuwento sa disenyo.

ds:575:768:Dialogue Text.source:
Huh! There’s more to
clothes than I thought…
ds:575:768:Dialogue Text.target:
Huh! Mas marami pa palang dapat malaman
tungkol sa mga damit kaysa sa akala ko…

ds:576:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah! I used to throw a lot of parties.
ds:576:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oo! Madalas akong magdaos ng mga handaan noon.

ds:576:773:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? I figured that wouldn’t be her thing.
ds:576:773:Dialogue Text.target: Oh? Akala ko, hindi niya hilig 'yon.

ds:576:775:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She was an absolute mess, it was adorable.

ds:576:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I ended up being her party buddy, and well, I guess here we are!
ds:576:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Naging kasama niya ako sa mga handaan, at heto na nga tayo ngayon!

ds:576:777:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi na siya umalis sa handaan!

ds:577:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I guess I’m whatever the situation calls for.
ds:577:782:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kung ano ang hinihingi ng sitwasyon, siguro.

ds:578:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Why, yes... I've been known to dabble...

ds:578:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hah! Once she’s had a couple drinks, you can’t get her to shut up!
ds:578:790:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ha! Kapag nakainom na nang kaunti, hindi mo na mapatahimik!

ds:579:756:Dialogue Text.target: Napakaraming nilalang ang iba ang akala!

ds:579:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Not exactly "a first date" sort of topic.

ds:57:1:Dialogue Text.source: Well… You didn’t quite last as long as I hoped…
ds:57:1:Dialogue Text.target: Ano… Hindi ka tumagal gaya ng inaasahan ko…

ds:57:2:Dialogue Text.source: Not that I can blame you. Not a lot of critters last long with me…
ds:57:2:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi naman kita masisisi. Hindi nagtatagal ang karamihan ng nilalang kapag ako ang kasama…

ds:57:306:Dialogue Text.source: Come on in honey. Take a seat on the bed…
ds:57:306:Dialogue Text.target: Pasok ka, mahal. Maupo ka sa kama…

ds:57:307:Dialogue Text.source: Ooh, are we doing sex stuff?
ds:57:307:Dialogue Text.target: Ooh, may gagawin ba tayong malaswa?

ds:57:308:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, yes. How’s that for a proper thank you?
ds:57:308:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, oo. 'Yan ang maayos na pasasalamat, ano?

ds:57:310:Dialogue Text.source: But I’m probably a bit too big for you…
ds:57:310:Dialogue Text.target: Pero malamang masyado akong malaki para sa 'yo…

ds:57:311:Dialogue Text.source: Hah, Rascal… The critters here will surprise you with what they are capable of.
ds:57:311:Dialogue Text.target: Hah, Rascal… Magugulat ka sa kayang gawin ng mga nilalang dito.

ds:57:312:Dialogue Text.source: That said, I’ll just be doing some mouth stuff.
ds:57:312:Dialogue Text.target: Pero bibig ko lang naman ang gagamitin ko.

ds:57:313:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve been wanting to see what ya got going on down there…
ds:57:313:Dialogue Text.target: Matagal ko nang gustong makita kung anong meron ka diyan sa ibaba…

ds:57:314:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, and look how excited you are already…
ds:57:314:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, at tingnan mo, sabik na sabik ka na…

ds:57:315:Dialogue Text.source: Ah hah… I blame the recent plant activities…
ds:57:315:Dialogue Text.target: Ah hah… Dahil 'to sa mga ginawa namin ng halaman kamakailan…

ds:57:316:Dialogue Text.source: Lay back, let me get a taste…

ds:57:317:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal lays back and lets the eager bunny get to work…
ds:57:317:Dialogue Text.target: Humiga si Rascal at hinayaang magsimula ang sabik na kuneho…

ds:57:3:Dialogue Text.source: Though… judging by this knot, I’d guess I have about a half an hour?
ds:57:3:Dialogue Text.target: Pero… Kung pagbabatayan ang buhol na 'to, may mga kalahating oras pa yata ako?

ds:57:4:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s not waste any more time then…
ds:57:4:Dialogue Text.target: Huwag na tayong magsayang ng oras kung ganoon…

ds:580:764:Dialogue Text.source: Have ya had any critters you were close with?
ds:580:764:Dialogue Text.target: May mga nilalang na bang naging malapit sa 'yo?

ds:580:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I consider Scarlett and Peter my closest friends. Family even.
ds:580:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Itinuturing kong pinakamalapit na kaibigan sina Scarlett at Peter. Pamilya pa nga.

ds:580:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I had a lot of friends when I was younger.
ds:580:767:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Marami akong kaibigan noong mas bata ako.

ds:581:770:Dialogue Text.source: What do ya do day to day?

ds:581:774:Dialogue Text.target: Parang, paninilip sa mga nilalang na nagtatalik?

ds:581:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But uh… <pause>Maybe I’ll keep an eye out for you…

ds:582:777:Dialogue Text.source: Did you see the Glowing Runes?
ds:582:777:Dialogue Text.target: Nakita mo ang Nagliliwanag na mga Runa?

ds:582:779:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good, I thought I was going crazy.

ds:583:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Most of the time I’m a top.

ds:583:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve bottomed a couple times… It was… Fine.
ds:583:782:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ilang beses na rin akong nag-bottom… Ayos… Naman.

ds:583:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I’d rather be doing the filling.
ds:583:783:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero mas gusto kong ako ang nagpupuno.

ds:584:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It’s always a nice time of year.

ds:584:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]The winter nights are so still, and the bells ring out far.
ds:584:786:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Napakatahimik ng mga gabi ng taglamig, at umaabot sa malayo ang tunog ng mga kampana.

ds:584:788:Dialogue Text.source:
But you haven’t done
a celebration here?
ds:584:788:Dialogue Text.target:
Pero hindi ka pa nakasali
sa pagdiriwang dito?

ds:584:790:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero sino ang nakaaalam, baka balang araw.

ds:585:753:Dialogue Text.source: What’s the significance of the body paint?
ds:585:753:Dialogue Text.target: Ano ang kabuluhan ng pintura sa katawan?

ds:585:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The Elder mice paint the others before these ceremonies.
ds:585:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pinipintahan ng matatandang daga ang iba bago ang mga seremonyang 'to.

ds:585:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s supposed to remove the sense of ego, and allows us to become one. Emotionally, and physically.
ds:585:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Dapat nitong alisin ang pakiramdam ng sariling ako, at payagan kaming maging isa. Sa damdamin at katawan.

ds:585:757:Dialogue Text.target: Inaalis ang pakiramdam ng sariling ako?

ds:585:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah! The markings are pretty prominent, and usually stand out against our fur.
ds:585:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo! Litaw ang mga marka, at karaniwang kitang-kita sa balahibo namin.

ds:585:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So in low light, they’re kinda the most prominent thing?
ds:585:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya kapag madilim, sila ang parang pinakakapansin-pansin?

ds:585:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sa totoo lang, hindi ako gaanong sigurado…

ds:585:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can ask and give you a better explanation later.
ds:585:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maaari akong magtanong at bigyan ka ng mas magandang paliwanag mamaya.

ds:586:763:Dialogue Text.source: So where did you go during the ceremony?
ds:586:763:Dialogue Text.target: Saan ka nagpunta habang may seremonya?

ds:586:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]While you guys are off having fun, me, my mother, and some of the elders do the actual ritual.
ds:586:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Habang nagsasaya kayo, kami ng nanay ko at ilan sa mga matanda ang gumagawa ng mismong ritwal.

ds:586:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah, we are trying to commune with the spirits. You guys basically supply the energy.
ds:586:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oo, sinusubukan naming makipag-ugnayan sa mga espiritu. Kayo ang nagbibigay ng enerhiya.

ds:586:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah, I don’t really know. Energy isn’t the right word, but it’s about as close as it gets.
ds:586:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oo, hindi ko talaga alam. Hindi enerhiya ang tamang salita, pero 'yon ang pinakamalapit.

ds:586:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But you guys supply the "energy," then our ritual is supposed to commune with whomever.
ds:586:769:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero kayo ang nagbibigay ng "enerhiya," tapos dapat makipag-ugnayan ang ritwal namin sa kung sino man.

ds:586:770:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Not that I’ve ever seen this work.
ds:586:770:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi naman sa nakita ko nang gumana 'to.

ds:586:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly, I think the whole thing is bogus.
ds:586:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa totoo lang, sa tingin ko, kalokohan ang lahat.

ds:586:772:Dialogue Text.source:
Well, it’s definitely bogus that
you can’t join in on the fun!
ds:586:772:Dialogue Text.target:
Tiyak na kalokohang
hindi ka puwedeng sumali sa saya!

ds:586:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]<size=10><color=#878375>At the same time, I’m glad I won’t have to see my mother getting railed.</color></size>
ds:586:774:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]<size=10><color=#878375>Kasabay noon, masaya akong hindi ko kailangang makitang tinitira ang nanay ko.</color></size>

ds:587:777:Dialogue Text.source: I think she’s been making advances on me…
ds:587:777:Dialogue Text.target: Sa tingin ko, nilalandi niya ako…

ds:587:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]<size=18>NOPE! I SAID DON’T TELL ME ABOUT IT!<size=18>
ds:587:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]<size=18>HINDI! SABI KO, HUWAG MONG IKUWENTO SA 'KIN!<size=18>

ds:588:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh yeah you just hold onto them!

ds:588:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They’ll be entertained there for a while, don’t worry.
ds:588:781:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Magiging masaya sila riyan nang matagal-tagal, huwag mag-alala.

ds:589:20:Dialogue Text.source: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)
ds:589:20:Dialogue Text.target: **Third Interaction** (Available Act 3+, after the log is interacted with twice)

ds:589:21:Dialogue Text.target: Ang panghuling anyo. Ang Obra Maestra.

ds:590:294:Dialogue Text.source: In an instant, roots and vines wrap around Rascal, bringing him closer to the stump.
ds:590:294:Dialogue Text.target: Sa isang iglap, pumulupot kay Rascal ang mga ugat at baging at inilapit siya sa tuod.

ds:590:295:Dialogue Text.source: W-whoa! Uh? I’m here for the uh… fertilizer?
ds:590:295:Dialogue Text.target: W-whoa! Uh? Nandito ako para sa ano… pataba?

ds:590:296:Dialogue Text.source: The plant bobs up and down excitedly. Purple bulbs unravel and reveal a dripping fleshy mass.
ds:590:296:Dialogue Text.target: Sabik na tumalbog pataas-pababa ang halaman. Bumuka ang mga lilang umbok at lumantad ang tumutulong mala-lamang bahagi.

ds:590:297:Dialogue Text.source: Ah I see… Let’s uh, go a little easy?
ds:590:297:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, ganoon pala… Ano, dahan-dahan lang tayo?

ds:590:298:Dialogue Text.source: The fleshy mass teases Rascal’s rear. Viscous fluids ooze down his cheeks and tail.
ds:590:298:Dialogue Text.target: Tinukso ng mala-lamang bahagi ang puwit ni Rascal. Umagos ang malapot na likido sa mga pisngi ng puwit at buntot niya.

ds:590:299:Dialogue Text.source: The tip pushes gently on his rear, slipping inside…
ds:590:299:Dialogue Text.target: Marahang dumiin ang dulo sa puwit niya at dumulas paloob…

ds:590:302:Dialogue Text.source: The plant cuddles and coos Rascal as he makes to leave the stump.
ds:590:302:Dialogue Text.target: Niyakap at hinunihan ng halaman si Rascal nang paalis na siya sa tuod.

ds:590:303:Dialogue Text.source: W-whew~ I could see why Scarlett’s a fan!
ds:590:303:Dialogue Text.target: H-hay~ Naiintindihan ko kung bakit paborito 'to ni Scarlett!

ds:590:304:Dialogue Text.source: O-Okay… So I guess I’M the mode of transportation for this fertilizer…
ds:590:304:Dialogue Text.target: S-sige… Mukhang AKO pala ang sasakyan ng patabang 'to…

ds:590:305:Dialogue Text.source: I better not make any sudden movements…
ds:590:305:Dialogue Text.target: Mas mabuting huwag akong biglang gumalaw…

ds:590:306:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal steadies himself, fluids running down his legs…
ds:590:306:Dialogue Text.target: Pinatatag ni Rascal ang sarili, umaagos ang mga likido sa mga binti niya…

ds:591:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tunay nga! Malugod kang tatanggapin kahit kailan!

ds:591:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Peter, dear, we’ve been running low on some things around the kitchen.
ds:591:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Peter, mahal, nauubusan na tayo ng ilang bagay sa kusina.

ds:591:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah, I’ve been meaning to go out for a scavenge soon…
ds:591:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo, balak ko na ring lumabas para maghanap ng mapapakinabangan…

ds:592:752:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith’s a wolf! She’s badass, justice-driven, and full of mom-energy!
ds:592:752:Dialogue Text.target: Lobo si Lyllith! Matapang, makatarungan, at napaka-maka-inang kumilos!

ds:592:754:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a sellsword and usually frequents taverns until she finds a job.
ds:592:754:Dialogue Text.target: Isa siyang mersenaryo at madalas sa mga taberna hanggang makahanap ng trabaho.

ds:592:755:Dialogue Text.source: A Job… Or a partner for the night.
ds:592:755:Dialogue Text.target: Trabaho… O kapareha para sa gabi.

ds:592:756:Dialogue Text.source: One particular night, she learns about a dragon that’s terrorizing a nearby town…
ds:592:756:Dialogue Text.target: Isang gabi, nabalitaan niya ang tungkol sa dragon na nananakot sa kalapit na bayan…

ds:592:758:Dialogue Text.source: Now Lyllith has taken on dragons before. They can be a bit spicy, but nothing she can’t handle.
ds:592:758:Dialogue Text.target: Nakaharap na si Lyllith ng mga dragon dati. Medyo matindi, pero walang hindi niya kayang harapin.

ds:592:760:Dialogue Text.source: But no amount of gear could’ve prepared her for this dragon…
ds:592:760:Dialogue Text.target: Pero walang kagamitang makapaghahanda sa kanya para sa dragon na 'to…

ds:592:762:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith’s a wolf! She’s badass, justice-driven, and full of mom-energy!
ds:592:762:Dialogue Text.target: Lobo si Lyllith! Matapang, makatarungan, at napaka-maka-inang kumilos!

ds:592:764:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a sellsword and usually frequents taverns until she finds a job.
ds:592:764:Dialogue Text.target: Isa siyang mersenaryo at madalas sa mga taberna hanggang makahanap ng trabaho.

ds:592:765:Dialogue Text.target: Trabaho… O kapareha para sa gabi.

ds:592:770:Dialogue Text.source: But no amount of gear could’ve prepared her for this dragon…
ds:592:770:Dialogue Text.target: Pero walang kagamitang makapaghahanda sa kanya para sa dragon na 'to…

ds:592:773:Dialogue Text.source: It was a quiet night. Fresh snow danced around the sky before landing on their cheeks and snouts.
ds:592:773:Dialogue Text.target: Tahimik ang gabi. Sumayaw sa langit ang sariwang niyebe bago dumapo sa kanilang mga pisngi at nguso.

ds:592:775:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn (that’s the dragon) gives the wolf a pathetic look.
ds:592:775:Dialogue Text.target: Tumingin si Volkyn (siya ang dragon) sa lobo nang kaawa-awa.

ds:592:776:Dialogue Text.source: "Lyllith… <pause>P-please let me use your cloak… <pause>I’m so c-c-c-cold…"
ds:592:776:Dialogue Text.target: "Lyllith… <pause>P-pahiram naman ng balabal mo… <pause>G-g-g-ginaw na ginaw ako…"

ds:592:777:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith knows damn well that this weather is nothing for him.
ds:592:777:Dialogue Text.target: Alam na alam ni Lyllith na walang epekto sa kanya ang ganitong panahon.

ds:592:778:Dialogue Text.source: Not to mention her cloak would be like a napkin to a dragon.
ds:592:778:Dialogue Text.target: At saka, parang napkin lang sa dragon ang balabal niya.

ds:592:780:Dialogue Text.source: Regardless, she humors him and gives him the cloak.
ds:592:780:Dialogue Text.target: Gayunpaman, sinakyan niya ang biro at ibinigay ang balabal.

ds:592:781:Dialogue Text.source: This took him off guard, he thought for sure she souldn’t go through with it.
ds:592:781:Dialogue Text.target: Nagulat siya, sigurado siyang hindi nito itutuloy.

ds:592:782:Dialogue Text.source: But she did, and now he had to figure out how to tie this tiny thing around his neck.
ds:592:782:Dialogue Text.target: Pero ginawa nga niya, at ngayon kailangan niyang alamin kung paano itatali ang maliit na bagay na 'to sa leeg niya.

ds:592:784:Dialogue Text.source: And despite it being a joke at first…
ds:592:784:Dialogue Text.target: At kahit biro lang sa simula…

ds:592:785:Dialogue Text.source: It’s the little gestures that really get to him.
ds:592:785:Dialogue Text.target: Ang maliliit na kilos ang talagang nakakaantig sa kanya.

ds:592:799:Dialogue Text.target: At kahit biro lang sa simula…

ds:592:800:Dialogue Text.target: Ang maliliit na kilos ang talagang nakakaantig sa kanya.
