interesado talaga ang lahat sa libro!

ds:593:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ah hah… When I think about speaking to everyone, my heart starts racing.
ds:593:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ah, hah… Kapag naiisip kong magsalita sa harap ng lahat, kumakabog ang dibdib ko.

ds:593:738:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But it was easy just reading from the book!
ds:593:738:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero ang dali lang magbasa mula sa libro!

ds:593:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi na ako makapaghintay basahin ang librong 'yon!

ds:593:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Huh! I wouldn’t have pegged ya as a reader!
ds:593:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Huh! Hindi ko aakalaing mahilig kang magbasa!

ds:593:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m not! But this seems like a great place to start!

ds:593:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let me know when you get it! I want to read it too!
ds:593:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sabihin mo kapag nakuha mo! Gusto ko ring basahin!

ds:593:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That was great. I’m really excited for the next story time!
ds:593:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ang ganda noon. Sabik na talaga ako sa susunod na oras ng kuwento!

ds:593:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you want more Lyllith the Dragonslayer? Or something else?
ds:593:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gusto mo pa ng Lyllith, Tirador ng Dragon? O iba naman?

ds:593:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I am curious…<pause> Does Lyllith ever… <pause><breath>Take</breath> the dragon?
ds:593:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero gusto kong malaman…<pause> Kailanman ba'y… <pause><breath>Tinatanggap</breath> ni Lyllith ang dragon sa loob?

ds:593:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, I guess you’ll just have to see at the next story time!
ds:593:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Haha, abangan mo na lang sa susunod na oras ng kuwento!

ds:593:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]<size=10><color=#878375>I know it’s somewhere… Just gotta find it…</color></size>
ds:593:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]<size=10><color=#878375>Alam kong nandiyan lang 'yon… Kailangan ko lang hanapin…</color></size>

ds:593:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]<size=10><color=#878375>We’re gonna have some angry critters on our doorstep unless you find that book.</color></size>
ds:593:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]<size=10><color=#878375>May mga galit na nilalang na darating sa pintuan natin kung hindi mo makita ang librong 'yon.</color></size>

ds:593:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Baka dapat magtinda ako ng mga libro…

ds:593:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Whattya think love, wanna renact some of those scenes?
ds:593:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ano sa tingin mo, mahal, gusto mong gayahin ang ilan sa mga eksenang 'yon?

ds:594:804:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey! Remember when you asked about my favorite book?
ds:594:804:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Uy! Naalala mo noong tinanong mo ang paborito kong libro?

ds:594:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I thought of the perfect one to tell you about!

ds:594:807:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But it’s kind of a whole thing, and it might be funner to talk about over drinks or something.
ds:594:807:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero medyo mahaba, at baka mas masayang pag-usapan habang umiinom o ano.

ds:594:808:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So do you want to meet me by the tables near Maverick’s later?
ds:594:808:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya gusto mo bang makipagkita sa akin mamaya sa mga mesang malapit sa tindahan ni Maverick?

ds:596:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Salamat uli sa lahat ng tulong mo!

ds:597:232:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?
ds:597:232:Dialogue Text.target: May kilala kang naghahanap ng pala?

ds:597:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Bawha! You betcha! It was Dustin for sure!

ds:597:234:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I was just giving him a ride a second ago! He’s here at the lake.
ds:597:234:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kahahatid ko lang sa kanya! Nandito siya sa lawa.

ds:59:283:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kumusta, Rascal. Dala mo ang lana namin?

ds:59:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Man, poor ole’ Finley must’ve been dying.
ds:59:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Grabe, kawawa namang si Finley, halos mamamatay na siguro sa init.

ds:59:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It has been a while since we last made it out there…
ds:59:288:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Matagal na rin mula nang huli namin siyang napuntahan…

ds:59:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Probably doesn’t help that SOMEONE lost the sheers.
ds:59:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Malamang hindi rin nakatulong na may ISANG nawalan ng gunting.

ds:59:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’ll have this sweater made in a jiffy!
ds:59:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mabilis lang naming magagawa ang sweter na ito!

ds:59:296:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I just settled on a design for you.
ds:59:296:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nakapagpasya na ako sa disenyo para sa 'yo.

ds:59:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Give us a bit and we’ll have it ready!
ds:59:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bigyan mo kami ng kaunting oras at magiging handa na!

ds:59:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huwag kang mag-alala, hindi ito sobrang matingkad.

ds:59:304:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Let us work, Rascal! Vi gets distracted easily!
ds:59:304:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pabayaan mo kaming magtrabaho, Rascal! Madaling magambala si Vi!

ds:59:307:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You’re the one who won’t stop talking.

ds:5:18:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like an impressive yield this season.
ds:5:18:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang kahanga-hanga ang ani ngayong panahon.

ds:60:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Isang kahila-hilakbot na aksidente kamakailan, talagang kahila-hilakbot!

ds:60:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Now, the critters have been managing, thanks to Maverick.
ds:60:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nakakaraos naman ang mga nilalang, salamat kay Maverick.

ds:60:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But it’s up to me to fix it and get this town in shape again!
ds:60:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero ako ang bahalang magkumpuni at mag-ayos muli ng bayang ito!

ds:60:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Now, I normally wouldn’t ask anything of a guest, especially one I just met…
ds:60:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Karaniwan, hindi ako humihingi ng anuman sa bisita, lalo na sa kakikilala ko pa lang…

ds:60:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]BUT I figured you’ll be out and about, right?
ds:60:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]PERO naisip kong maglilibot ka rin naman, di ba?

ds:60:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal! I’ve got a pretty big favor to ask of ya.
ds:60:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kumusta, Rascal! May medyo malaki akong pabor na hihingin sa 'yo.

ds:60:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, part of the issue with the last bridge was the material I used.
ds:60:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kasi, bahagi ng naging problema sa dating tulay ang materyales na ginamit ko.

ds:60:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This time, I’d like to use a much stronger wood for the foundation…
ds:60:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa pagkakataong ito, gusto kong gumamit ng mas matibay na kahoy para sa pundasyon…

ds:60:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I know exactly where to find it too!
ds:60:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alam ko rin mismo kung saan makakahanap!

ds:60:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just to the West is a big ole lake. There’s tons of choice wood along the shores!
ds:60:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May napakalaking lawa sa Kanluran. Napakaraming de-kalidad na kahoy sa baybayin!

ds:60:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thing is, I never finished gathering it up, and well…
ds:60:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang problema, hindi ko natapos tipunin, at ano…

ds:60:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s just say I haven’t had the opportunity to go back.
ds:60:166:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabihin na lang nating hindi pa ako nagkakaroon ng pagkakataong bumalik.

ds:60:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You pick up the wood pieces, and I’ll be able to use it for the bridge!
ds:60:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kunin mo ang mga piraso ng kahoy, at magagamit ko ang mga ito para sa tulay!

ds:60:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Magaling! May utang akong loob sa 'yo, Rascal!

ds:60:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We’ll need about 24 pieces. Think you can handle that?
ds:60:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mga 24 na piraso ang kailangan. Kaya mo ba 'yon?

ds:60:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s actually quite handy you came by!

ds:60:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The bridge went out just yesterday so I’ve been fashioning up the blueprint for a new one.
ds:60:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kahapon lang nasira ang tulay, kaya gumagawa ako ng plano para sa bago.

ds:60:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s just about done, so I should be ready to build when you get back!
ds:60:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Halos tapos na, kaya handa na akong magtayo pagbalik mo!

ds:60:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This sturdier material will be a real game changer!
ds:60:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Malaki ang maibabago ng mas matibay na materyales na ito!

ds:60:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It will easily accomodate the larger critters of the forest!
ds:60:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Madali na nitong makakayanan ang mas malalaking nilalang sa gubat!

ds:60:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I never expected a donkey or a bear to cross it!
ds:60:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ko inasahang may asno o osong tatawid doon!

ds:60:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This new structure could even support a DRAGON!
ds:60:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kaya pa ngang pasanin ng bagong estrukturang ito ang isang DRAGON!

ds:60:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]OK be on your way now. I’ve got plans to finish up.
ds:60:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, lakad ka na. May mga plano pa akong tatapusin.

ds:61:152:Dialogue Text.source: camera shifts to gator in the water. (and or Red walks over)
ds:61:152:Dialogue Text.target: camera shifts to gator in the water. (and or Red walks over)

ds:61:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’m just over on the island if you need anything.
ds:61:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Nandoon lang ako sa isla kung may kailangan ka.

ds:61:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I recall seeing a bell northwest of here.
ds:61:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Natatandaan kong may nakita akong kampana sa hilagang-kanluran mula rito.

ds:61:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Give it a ring on the other side of the lake, that’ll be your ticket back.
ds:61:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Patunugin mo sa kabilang panig ng lawa. Iyon ang paraan para makabalik ka.

ds:61:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Paalam, manlalakbay. Mag-usap tayong muli sa lalong madaling panahon.

ds:61:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah why not! There’s still some fun left in these bones.
ds:61:193:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo, bakit hindi! May natitira pang sigla sa mga butong ito.

ds:61:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! Fair enough, little one. Fair enough.
ds:61:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hah! May punto ka, munting kaibigan. May punto ka.

ds:61:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]The water level’s a lot higher than usual, otherwise you’d be able to walk that.
ds:61:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Mas mataas kaysa karaniwan ang tubig ngayon. Kung hindi, malalakad mo sana 'yan.

ds:61:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]If you make it quick, you can hop on my snout to get across.
ds:61:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kung mabilis ka lang, puwede kang sumakay sa nguso ko para makatawid.

ds:61:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You don’t seem terribly heavy, should be fine.
ds:61:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Parang hindi ka naman napakabigat. Ayos lang siguro.

ds:61:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi ba karaniwang magagaling lumangoy ang mga pulang panda?

ds:61:212:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like the path has flooded over. Perhaps there is another way.
ds:61:212:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang nalubog sa baha ang daan. Baka may ibang paraan.

ds:61:213:Dialogue Text.source: This is a good spot to enter the water… If you could swim.
ds:61:213:Dialogue Text.target: Magandang lugar ito para lumusong sa tubig… Kung marunong ka lang lumangoy.

ds:61:217:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was watching from afar, and couldn’t help but notice…
ds:61:217:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Nagmamasid ako mula sa malayo, at hindi ko maiwasang mapansin…

ds:61:230:Dialogue Text.source: Definitely looks like you can't go this way...
ds:61:230:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang talagang hindi ka makakadaan dito...

ds:61:231:Dialogue Text.source: Maybe you should look for another route.
ds:61:231:Dialogue Text.target: Baka dapat kang humanap ng ibang ruta.

ds:62:245:Dialogue Text.source: Bird drops off Red, and lands on the perch.
ds:62:245:Dialogue Text.target: Bird drops off Red, and lands on the perch.

ds:62:246:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks for choosing Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom!
ds:62:246:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Salamat sa pagpili sa Penny Plume: Sakay at Zoom!

ds:62:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I hope you had an enjoyable flight, and we’ll see you again real soon!
ds:62:247:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sana nasiyahan ka sa paglipad. Magkita ulit tayo sa lalong madaling panahon!

ds:62:249:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The perch is just on the other side of the river.
ds:62:249:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nasa kabilang panig lang ng ilog ang dapuan.

ds:62:250:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So until that bridge is fixed, I’ll be dropping critters off here.
ds:62:250:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kaya habang hindi pa naaayos ang tulay, dito ko muna ibababa ang mga nilalang.

ds:62:251:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This is off the record, and against policy, so don’t tell my boss!
ds:62:251:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lihim ito at labag sa patakaran, kaya huwag mong sabihin sa amo ko!

ds:62:335:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Each of the bells are in their own key and ring out a specific jingle that helps me figure out where you are!
ds:62:335:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May kanya-kanyang tonalidad ang bawat kampana at may partikular na himig na tumutulong sa akin para malaman kung nasaan ka!

ds:62:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I only offer pick up and drop off at the designated perches! It’s all part of the terms and services! (also apparently emergency rescue services…)
ds:62:336:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa mga itinakdang dapuan lang ako nagsasakay at nagbababa! Kasama lahat 'yan sa mga tuntunin ng serbisyo! (at mukhang pati sa mga serbisyo ng pagsagip sa emerhensiya…)

ds:62:337:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Finally, by riding Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom you accept any and all accidental damages that can happen and may result in permanent damage, and or death!
ds:62:337:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]At sa huli, sa pagsakay sa Penny Plume: Sakay at Zoom, tinatanggap mo ang anuman at lahat ng aksidenteng pinsalang maaaring mangyari at magdulot ng permanenteng pinsala, at/o kamatayan!

ds:62:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]OK With that all out of the way, where would you like to go?
ds:62:339:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, tapos na ang mga paliwanag. Saan mo gustong pumunta?

ds:62:353:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I bet you’re wondering what’s with this bell you rang, eh?
ds:62:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siguro nagtataka ka kung para saan ang kampanang pinatunog mo, ano?

ds:62:355:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See, I run a little business here! Would you like to hear my lil’ spiel?
ds:62:355:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kasi, may maliit akong negosyo rito! Gusto mong marinig ang munting patalastas ko?

ds:62:358:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Welcome to Penny Plume’s, Ride and Zoom!
ds:62:358:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maligayang pagdating sa Penny Plume: Sakay at Zoom!

ds:62:359:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The name’s Penny, as you know, and I’ll be your flight attendant today!
ds:62:359:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Penny ang pangalan ko, gaya ng alam mo, at ako ang mag-aasikaso sa paglipad mo ngayon!

ds:62:360:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… And every other day. I’m the only one who works at Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom.
ds:62:360:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… At sa lahat ng iba pang araw. Ako lang ang nagtatrabaho sa Penny Plume: Sakay at Zoom.

ds:62:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me explain how it works! I’ve given these bells to everyone in the forest, and when a critter needs a ride, they can ring the bell and I’ll pick them up!
ds:62:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ipapaliwanag ko kung paano! Binigyan ko ng mga kampanang ito ang lahat sa gubat. Kapag may nilalang na kailangang sumakay, patutunugin niya ang kampana at susunduin ko siya!

ds:62:362:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She can go mama-bear sometimes, but she means well.
ds:62:362:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Minsan, para siyang inang osong nagtatanggol, pero mabuti ang hangad niya.

ds:62:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Trust me, I’ve had my fair share of scolds from her!
ds:62:363:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Maniwala ka, ilang beses na rin niya akong napagalitan!

ds:62:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh! Looks like we’re here! Hold on tight!
ds:62:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]O! Mukhang nandito na tayo! Kumapit ka nang mahigpit!

ds:62:367:Dialogue Text.source: Uh, Yeah! … Sorry, do I know you?
ds:62:367:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, oo! … Pasensiya, kilala ba kita?

ds:62:368:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You probably weren’t conscious at the time… but I was the one who found you.
ds:62:368:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Malamang wala kang malay noon… pero ako ang nakakita sa 'yo.

ds:62:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was flying my normal routes, and I saw you collapsed on the ground!
ds:62:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Lumilipad ako sa karaniwan kong ruta at nakita kitang nakabulagta sa lupa!

ds:62:371:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I didn’t know how to help, so I took you to Scarlett immediately.
ds:62:371:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hindi ko alam kung paano tutulong, kaya dinala agad kita kay Scarlett.

ds:62:372:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve been busy working, so I couldn’t stop by to see how you were doing. It’s been plaguing me all day!
ds:62:372:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Abala ako sa trabaho kaya hindi ako nakadaan para kumustahin ka. Buong araw akong binabagabag no'n!

ds:62:373:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I’m so happy to see you are doing ok!
ds:62:373:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero masayang-masaya akong makitang ayos ka na!

ds:62:375:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Baww, no worries dear. Again, just glad to see you’re okay.
ds:62:375:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Baww, walang anuman, mahal. Basta masaya akong ayos ka.

ds:62:377:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know if this is too much for you right now! I know you might not be feeling well.
ds:62:377:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sabihin mo lang kung sobra na ito para sa 'yo ngayon! Alam kong baka hindi pa maganda ang pakiramdam mo.

ds:62:380:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh look, that’s the clearing where I found you.
ds:62:380:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O tingnan mo, iyan ang bakanteng lugar sa gubat kung saan kita natagpuan.

ds:62:382:Dialogue Text.source: … I, uh… Didn’t get a lot of sleep…
ds:62:382:Dialogue Text.target: … Ako ay, ah… Hindi gaanong nakatulog…

ds:62:384:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hah! I’m guessing Scarlett gave you an earful already?
ds:62:384:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hah! Siguro napagalitan ka na nang husto ni Scarlett?

ds:62:436:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See, sounds echo quite aimlessly up in the sky, so this helps speed up the process!
ds:62:436:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kasi, kung saan-saan umaalingawngaw ang tunog sa himpapawid. Kaya napapabilis nito ang proseso!

ds:63:101:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What did you say it was for? The mouse right?
ds:63:101:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Para saan nga ang sabi mo? Para sa daga, di ba?

ds:63:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… O-oh! Oh my! Tying herself up?? Pardon me asking!
ds:63:102:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… O-oh! Naku! Igagapos ang sarili niya?? Pasensiya sa pagtatanong!

ds:63:103:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… I’ve… actually been a bit curious of that sort of thing myself…
ds:63:103:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]… Ako ay… medyo mausisa rin sa ganoong bagay…

ds:63:104:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Maybe I’ll find another use for these ropes…
ds:63:104:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Baka may mahanap akong ibang gamit ng mga taling 'to…

ds:63:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A string you say… Can’t say I keep any around!
ds:63:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pisi, sabi mo… Wala yata akong nakatabi!

ds:63:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s awfully thin stuff for these big ole’ paws... I do have plenty of rope though!
ds:63:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napakanipis niyan para sa malalaking lapang 'to... Pero marami akong lubid!

ds:63:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Very thick gauge! I tie it to tree trunks and other heavy objects to haul.
ds:63:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napakakapal! Itinatali ko sa mga katawan ng puno at ibang mabibigat na bagay para hilahin.

ds:64:82:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Red! Hey I got a favor to ask.

ds:64:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard of a rope-oriented bondage that I’d like to try out!
ds:64:83:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May narinig akong paggapos na gumagamit ng tali na gusto kong subukan!

ds:64:85:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Problem is I can’t seem to find any ropes that are my size, but comfortable enough.
ds:64:85:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang problema, wala akong makitang taling bagay sa laki ko pero sapat na komportable.

ds:64:86:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you can keep an eye out for me?

ds:64:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Any luck on that rope? I’d imagine something like a yarn… or twine…
ds:64:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May suwerte ka ba sa taling 'yon? Iniisip ko, parang sinulid… o pisi…

ds:64:88:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I tried fishing-wire, that wasn’t a great idea…
ds:64:88:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sinubukan ko ang linya ng pamingwit, hindi magandang ideya 'yon…

ds:66:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll let you know how this goes.

ds:66:101:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maybe you can give me a hand with it later~?

ds:66:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh look at that! And reinforced tips so the string won’t unravel! This is top-notch!
ds:66:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oooh, tingnan mo! At may pinatibay na mga dulo para hindi makalas ang pisi! Napakaganda nito!

ds:67:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Also, if he needs a paw, let him know I’m more than happy to help!
ds:67:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At kung kailangan niya ng tulong, sabihin mong masayang-masaya akong tutulong!

ds:67:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]In any case, he can give those a shot!

ds:67:103:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But to be honest, they always smell of urine, so I’m assuming they’re for something else.
ds:67:103:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero sa totoo lang, lagi silang amoy-ihi, kaya ipinapalagay kong para sa ibang bagay.

ds:67:104:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know our tribe actually has these metal rods we use for combat and ritual purposes!
ds:67:104:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alam mo, may mga baras na metal ang tribo namin na ginagamit sa labanan at mga ritwal!

ds:67:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Y’know, being a small gal, I’ve messed around with a few big critters in that way before!
ds:67:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Alam mo, bilang maliit na babae, nakapaglaro na ako sa ilang malalaking nilalang sa ganoong paraan!

ds:67:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Not my thing, but fun to see those boys squirm~!
ds:67:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hindi ko hilig, pero masayang makita ang mga lalaking 'yon na namimilipit~!

ds:68:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I can definitely lend you a copy, but they are in my cave…
ds:68:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Maaari kitang pahiramin ng kopya, pero nasa kuweba ko…

ds:68:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See I promised the Bunny that I’d sit and watch guard here.
ds:68:102:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ipinangako ko sa Kuneho na uupo at magbabantay ako rito.

ds:68:103:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We heard some… concerning reports of a suspicious creature back there…
ds:68:103:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May narinig kaming… nakababahalang balita tungkol sa isang kahina-hinalang nilalang doon sa likod…

ds:68:104:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Fortunately, nothing should cause problems while I’m here!
ds:68:104:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Buti, walang dapat magdulot ng problema habang nandito ako!

ds:68:105:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But alas, I can’t move from my post… Not yet at least.
ds:68:105:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero hindi ako makaalis sa puwesto ko… Hindi pa, kahit paano.

ds:68:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maybe ask the Bunny how long she’d like me here.
ds:68:106:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Baka puwede mong tanungin ang Kuneho kung hanggang kailan niya ako kailangan dito.

ds:68:107:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]… Y’know… I really hope there’s not something big and scary back there…
ds:68:107:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]… Alam mo… Sana talaga walang malaki at nakakatakot doon sa likod…

ds:68:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m more of a Lover than a Fighter… And that’s totally not true either, I’m more of a reader!
ds:68:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mas mangingibig ako kaysa mandirigma… At hindi rin talaga totoo 'yon, mas mambabasa ako!

ds:68:110:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]*she looks over her shoulder, eyes darting left to right.*
ds:68:110:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]*lumingon siya sa likuran, palipat-lipat ang tingin sa kaliwa at kanan.*

ds:68:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Playbear? Yes! Of course I’ve heard of it. I’m quite familiar actually.
ds:68:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Playbear? Oo! Siyempre narinig ko na. Talagang pamilyar ako.

ds:68:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve collected a lot of the issues over the decades! 2 copies for each issue!
ds:68:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Marami akong nakolektang isyu sa loob ng mga dekada! 2 kopya sa bawat isyu!

ds:68:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]One for my mint collection, and the other for… well… you know.
ds:68:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Isa para sa koleksiyon kong walang bahid, at ang isa para sa… buweno… alam mo na.

ds:68:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… What? You can’t exactly blame me! There’s not a whole lot of other bears in these parts!
ds:68:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]… Ano? Hindi mo naman ako masisisi! Hindi marami ang ibang oso rito!

ds:69:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You should have it as soon as she’s back.

ds:69:103:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So after a firm scolding, I actually got her to fetch the magazine for me!
ds:69:103:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya pagkatapos ng matinding sermon, nautusan ko siyang kunin ang magasin para sa 'kin!

ds:69:104:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gosh, that girl. She’s gonna be the death of me one day.
ds:69:104:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naku, ang babaeng 'yon. Ikamamatay ko siya balang araw.

ds:69:105:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Can’t live with her, can’t live without her, that’s for sure.
ds:69:105:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mahirap siyang kasama, pero hindi ko rin kayang mawala siya, tiyak 'yon.

ds:69:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She should be back momentarily, Red! Come back in a bit.
ds:69:106:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Babalik na siya maya-maya, Red! Balik ka sandali.

ds:69:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh hey Red! Good news! Sort of.

ds:69:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]My infuriating roommate decided to pull a prank on me, and POUNCE ON ME JUST A MINUTE AGO.
ds:69:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naisipan ng nakakainis kong kasama sa tirahan na biruin ako, at LUNDUHAN AKO KANINA LANG.

ds:69:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]CAN YOU BELIEVE THAT? I almost swatted that fox across this clearing.
ds:69:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]MAKAPANIWALA KA BA RO'N? Muntik ko nang maihampas ang sorong 'yon hanggang sa kabila ng maluwang na lugar.

ds:69:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t ever scare a bear, let me tell you!
ds:69:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Huwag na huwag kang manakot ng oso, sinasabi ko sa 'yo!

ds:6:18:Dialogue Text.source: You could easily climb over it too…

ds:6:19:Dialogue Text.source: In fact, you could just squeeze between those posts and the trees if you really wanted…
ds:6:19:Dialogue Text.target: Sa katunayan, maaari ka lang sumingit sa pagitan ng mga posteng 'yon at ng mga puno kung gusto mo talaga…

ds:6:20:Dialogue Text.source: BUT EVEN STILL! No going back!

ds:6:21:Dialogue Text.source: Shut tight. No going back anymore.
ds:6:21:Dialogue Text.target: Mahigpit ang pagkakasara. Hindi na makababalik.

ds:6:22:Dialogue Text.source: Shut tight. No going back anymore.
ds:6:22:Dialogue Text.target: Mahigpit ang pagkakasara. Hindi na makababalik.

ds:6:23:Dialogue Text.source: … Well… actually there’s not a lock on this…

ds:70:113:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gosh, what a gorgeous day! You should hop to it while the sun is high in the sky~!
ds:70:113:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naku, napakagandang araw! Sumabak ka na habang mataas ang araw~!

ds:70:114:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Huwag mong paghintayin ang mga kapitbahay, Red!

ds:70:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let me know when you are done!

ds:70:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks again for volunteering to help out today, the critters and I really appreciate it!
ds:70:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Salamat uli sa pagboboluntaryong tumulong ngayon, talagang nagpapasalamat kami ng mga nilalang!

ds:70:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Best start making the rounds~! You know where to find me if ya need something!
ds:70:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Magsimula ka nang maglibot~! Alam mo kung saan ako makikita kung may kailangan ka!

ds:71:135:Dialogue Text.source: Hah! You’re a lil’ thirsty aren’t ya?

ds:71:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well a tall-glass such as yourself is flaunting around all day, can ya blame me?
ds:71:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May isang malaking basong tulad mo na pakalat-kalat buong araw, masisisi mo ba ako?

ds:71:137:Dialogue Text.source: Ok but really, how would we even… Y’know.
ds:71:137:Dialogue Text.target: Sige, pero seryoso, paano nga ba tayo… Alam mo na.

ds:71:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Come on Rascal! It’s the Forest of Love! I’ve been messing with critters of all shapes and sizes for a while now~!
ds:71:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sige na, Rascal! Ang Gubat ng Pag-ibig 'to! Matagal na akong nakikipaglaro sa mga nilalang na iba-iba ang hugis at laki~!

ds:71:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]In fact, my previous boy-toy was a lot like you!
ds:71:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa katunayan, parang ikaw ang dati kong laruang lalaki!

ds:71:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And yeah, we were pretty dang active…

ds:71:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, be that as it may, I’ve been warming up ever since you’ve arrived…
ds:71:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, ganoon man, nagpapainit na ako mula nang dumating ka…

ds:71:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be ready when it’s our time.
ds:71:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Handa na ako kapag panahon na natin.

ds:71:146:Dialogue Text.source: I’ll be looking forward to it!

ds:71:148:Dialogue Text.source: We haven’t talked much. Do you need help with anything?
ds:71:148:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi pa tayo gaanong nag-uusap. May kailangan kang tulong?

ds:71:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Pff, you don’t need to help me to talk to me, silly!
ds:71:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pff, hindi mo kailangang tulungan ako para makausap ako, loko!

ds:71:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m more than happy to chat it up and get to know you!

ds:71:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Besides… from down here, I get a pretty good view…
ds:71:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Isa pa… mula rito sa ibaba, maganda ang tanawin…

ds:71:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I’ve done SO much more since then.
ds:71:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At NAPAKARAMI ko pang nagawa mula noon.

ds:71:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So yes Rascal, I think I can handle someone like you!
ds:71:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya oo, Rascal, sa tingin ko, kaya kong tanggapin ang tulad mo!

ds:71:155:Dialogue Text.source:
Y’know, I’ve got different
assets than a raccoon…
ds:71:155:Dialogue Text.target:
Alam mo, may iba akong
mga katangian kaysa sa raccoon…

ds:71:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ooooh, we got a real “big guy” over here, eh?
ds:71:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ooooh, may tunay na “malaking lalaki” tayo rito, ano?

ds:72:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A string? Yes! I keep a spool of it for crafting!
ds:72:36:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pisi? Oo! May karete ako para sa paggawa!

ds:72:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ooooh but I did just run out during my last project… Hmm…
ds:72:37:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ooooh, pero naubusan ako sa huli kong proyekto… Hmm…

ds:72:39:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]If you end up finding some, let me know!
ds:72:39:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kung may makita ka, sabihin mo sa 'kin!

ds:73:57:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I know the coyotes are quite the tailors, but the bridge is still out…
ds:73:57:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam kong mahuhusay na mananahi ang mga coyote, pero sira pa rin ang tulay…

ds:73:58:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You won’t be able to get to them… What’s this for exactly?
ds:73:58:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi ka makararating sa kanila… Para saan ba talaga 'to?

ds:73:61:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Bondage?  Oh well in that case, I have a bunch of chains you can borrow!
ds:73:61:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Paggapos?  Kung ganoon, marami akong kadenang puwede mong hiramin!

ds:73:62:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haven’t used them in ages, but they still work for sure!
ds:73:62:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Napakatagal ko nang hindi ginagamit, pero tiyak na gumagana pa!

ds:73:64:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]OH for the mouse! How cute! Chains definitely won’t work in that case…
ds:73:64:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]AY, para sa daga! Ang kyut! Tiyak na hindi uubra ang mga kadena kung ganoon…

ds:73:65:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Unfortunately, I don’t have any string… I can keep an eye out though!
ds:73:65:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa kasamaang-palad, wala akong pisi… Pero maaari akong maghanap!

ds:74:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, I don’t have any string on hand or at the shop.
ds:74:44:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam mo, wala akong hawak na pisi o nasa tindahan.

ds:74:46:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I did find a pair of paw-covers floatin’ down the river!
ds:74:46:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero may nakita akong pares ng panakip sa lapa na lumulutang pababa ng ilog!

ds:74:47:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah the Beaver took them to study! Somethin’ about the craftsmanship…
ds:74:47:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oo, kinuha ng Beaver para pag-aralan! May kinalaman sa pagkakagawa…

ds:74:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, probably worth mentioning, those paw covers have lil’ strings in them.
ds:74:48:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, dapat banggitin, may maliliit na pisi ang mga panakip sa lapang 'yon.

ds:74:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You might be able to use those!

ds:75:18:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Panakip sa lapa? Ano ang panakip sa la-

ds:75:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]These things are a work of art really!

ds:75:20:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Didja know humans don’t even walk around outside unless they have some of these on their paws?
ds:75:20:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alam mo bang hindi man lang naglalakad sa labas ang mga tao kung wala silang suot na ganito sa lapa?

ds:75:21:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There ya are! There’s one for each shoe. Hope it helps!
ds:75:21:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Heto! May isa para sa bawat sapatos. Sana makatulong!

ds:75:22:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It ain’t no string, but it’s similar enough! Give me just a second…
ds:75:22:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi pisi, pero sapat ang pagkakatulad! Sandali lang…

ds:75:23:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh I see, you’d like the shoe laces.
ds:75:23:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, naiintindihan ko, gusto mo ang mga sintasin.

ds:76:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Have you any news on that toy?

ds:76:105:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I don’t mean to be a nuisance, Red, but I’m getting kind of desperate!
ds:76:105:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayokong maging istorbo, Red, pero medyo desperado na ako!

ds:76:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Just the critter I wanted to see!
ds:76:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ikaw ang nilalang na gusto kong makita!

ds:76:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok, I need a new toy, but not just ANY toy, it has to NOT look like a toy. Understand?
ds:76:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sige, kailangan ko ng bagong laruan, pero hindi KAHIT ANONG laruan, kailangang HINDI mukhang laruan. Nauunawaan mo?

ds:76:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]To be perfectly clear, I mean a toy of the sexual variety.
ds:76:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Para malinaw, laruang pangseks ang ibig kong sabihin.

ds:76:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Something for a big girl like myself, but doesn’t LOOK like a toy… Hmm…
ds:76:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Para sa malaking babaeng tulad ko, pero HINDI mukhang laruan… Hmm…

ds:77:101:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But you might be able to shape it into somethin’ else, y’know what I mean?
ds:77:101:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pero baka kaya mong hubugin sa ibang bagay, alam mo ang ibig kong sabihin?

ds:77:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A toy huh? Big enough for a bear?
ds:77:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Laruan, ano? Sapat ang laki para sa oso?

ds:77:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok, I definitely don’t have anything that big…

ds:77:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I did happen to find a very large piece of drift wood floatin’ around!
ds:77:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero may nakita akong napakalaking kahoy na inanod na lumulutang!

ds:77:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I ain’t sayin’ she stick that in her fluffy bum.
ds:77:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hindi ko sinasabing ipasok niya 'yon sa mabalahibo niyang puwit.

ds:78:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]… A dildo… that doesn’t look like a dildo?

ds:78:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Like… a chair? But also a dildo? Or a table? That’s a… Huh…
ds:78:102:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Parang… upuan? Pero dildo rin? O mesa? Na isang… Huh…

ds:78:103:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know sonny, I ain’t got the foggiest clue here. My brains not what it used to be.
ds:78:103:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam mo, iho, wala talaga akong ideya rito. Hindi na gaya ng dati ang utak ko.

ds:78:104:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Tell ya what, you give me the idea, and I’ll do the sculptin’!
ds:78:104:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ganito na lang, ikaw ang magbigay ng ideya, at ako ang mag-uukit!

ds:78:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What do we have here… a big ole chunk of driftwood! My favorite!
ds:78:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ano'ng mayroon tayo rito… malaking piraso ng kahoy na inanod! Paborito ko!

ds:78:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Very light, very malleable, but with a bit of curing and lacquer this can be a very solid piece of something!
ds:78:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Napakagaan, madaling hubugin, pero sa kaunting pagpapatuyo at barnis, napakatibay nitong magagawang bagay!

ds:79:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, back on my family’s farm, I used to fool around with the vegetable yield all the time!
ds:79:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam mo, sa bukid ng pamilya ko, lagi akong naglalaro noon gamit ang mga gulay na ani!

ds:79:101:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hid them right in plain sight so no one was the wiser!
ds:79:101:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Itinatago ko sa kitang-kita kaya walang nakakahalata!

ds:79:104:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nothin’ says interior decor quite like a strange, left-field, wooden sculpture in the living room!
ds:79:104:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Walang mas angkop na dekorasyon sa loob kaysa sa isang kakaiba at di-inaasahang eskulturang kahoy sa sala!

ds:79:105:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But what if she got a sculpture OF a vegetable!
ds:79:105:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero paano kung kumuha siya ng eskultura NG gulay!

ds:79:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now, vegetables aren’t exactly accessible for our big gal up in the mountains.
ds:79:106:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hindi naman madaling makakuha ng gulay ang babaeng oso natin sa kabundukan.

ds:79:107:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I was quite the crafty lady back in the day!

ds:79:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It took a lot longer to find my husband than I thought, so I had needs to take care of, y’know?!
ds:79:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mas matagal bago ko nahanap ang asawa ko kaysa sa akala ko, kaya may mga pangangailangan akong dapat tugunan, alam mo?!

ds:79:109:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]What did I do with the vegetables afterward?
ds:79:109:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ano'ng ginawa ko sa mga gulay pagkatapos?

ds:79:114:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]and I was rough on those eggplants…
ds:79:114:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]at pinahirapan ko rin ang mga talong na 'yon…

ds:79:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm, an object that doesn’t LOOK like a dildo, but can definitely be used as a dildo…
ds:79:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmm, bagay na HINDI mukhang dildo, pero tiyak na magagamit na dildo…

ds:79:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]and it’ll be made out of wood eh… and it’s gotta be big enough for a bear…
ds:79:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]at gawa sa kahoy, ano… at kailangang sapat ang laki para sa oso…

ds:936:825:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We, however, are really big on the Fall festivities!
ds:936:825:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kami naman, gustong-gusto namin ang mga pagdiriwang ng taglagas!

ds:936:827:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]As you know, I’m from a farm. In fact our whole community was a bunch of farmers!
ds:936:827:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam mong galing ako sa bukid. Sa katunayan, mga magsasaka ang buong pamayanan namin!

ds:936:828:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]This time of year is especially important in agriculture!
ds:936:828:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Napakahalaga ng panahong 'to ng taon sa pagsasaka!

ds:936:829:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s when a lot of our crops need to be harvested and prepped for Winter! So we’d all help each other out, neighbor to neighbor!
ds:936:829:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Panahon na para anihin ang marami sa mga pananim at ihanda para sa taglamig! Kaya nagtutulungan kaming lahat, magkakapitbahay!

ds:936:830:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Once all was said and done, we’d have a TON of food stocked, so we’d throw a feast!
ds:936:830:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kapag tapos na ang lahat, NAPAKARAMI naming nakaimbak na pagkain, kaya nagpipiging kami!

ds:936:831:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Over the years, that feast became much more. Critters would host activities, stories, and games! Not to mention a buffet of delicious treats!
ds:936:831:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa paglipas ng mga taon, lumawak ang piging na 'yon. Nag-organisa ang mga nilalang ng mga aktibidad, kuwentuhan, at laro! At siyempre, napakaraming masasarap na pagkain!

ds:936:833:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It is! Peter fell in love with it. So we’ve brought the spirit with us to the critters here.
ds:936:833:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Masaya nga! Gustong-gusto ni Peter. Kaya dinala namin ang diwang 'yon sa mga nilalang dito.

ds:936:834:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Of course, We do tweak some of the activities to be a bit more… Adult oriented…
ds:936:834:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Siyempre, binabago namin ang ilang aktibidad para maging mas… Pangmatanda…

ds:936:835:Dialogue Text.source: Hah! Why am I not surprised.

ds:936:837:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So, each year, we put on a show featuring a critter from popular myths around this time.
ds:936:837:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya bawat taon, nagtatanghal kami tungkol sa isang nilalang mula sa mga alamat na sikat sa panahong 'to.

ds:936:838:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Back in the day we would keep it spooky and scary for the little ones, as this time of year is popular for ghastly and supernatural stories!
ds:936:838:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Noon, nakakatakot ang mga palabas para sa mga bata, dahil sikat sa panahong 'to ang mga kuwentong multo at kababalaghan!

ds:936:839:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Surprisingly, there’s a lot of stories of critters contacting the dead, or traveling to the underworld!
ds:936:839:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Nakakagulat, maraming kuwento ng mga nilalang na nakikipag-ugnayan sa mga patay, o naglalakbay sa ilalim na daigdig!

ds:936:841:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! But it’s just some fun for the kids.
ds:936:841:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo nga! Pero katuwaan lang para sa mga bata.

ds:936:842:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But in OUR VERSIONS, we like to take some *ahem* "creative liberties."
ds:936:842:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero sa MGA BERSIYON NAMIN, gusto naming *ahem* "magdagdag ayon sa imahinasyon."

ds:936:843:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]For example, last year was about Aubergine The Wicked!
ds:936:843:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Halimbawa, noong nakaraang taon, tungkol kay Aubergine na Masama!

ds:936:845:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She was supposedly a Witch with great magical power!
ds:936:845:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Isa raw siyang mangkukulam na may matinding kapangyarihan!

ds:936:846:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It is said she regularly crossed over to the land of the dead, and made deals with demons!
ds:936:846:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sinasabing madalas siyang tumawid sa daigdig ng mga patay at makipagkasundo sa mga demonyo!

ds:936:847:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She was constantly on a quest for power, and in our version, pleasure!
ds:936:847:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lagi siyang naghahanap ng kapangyarihan, at sa bersiyon namin, ng sarap!

ds:936:849:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah! So turns out Peter is a bit of a wiz when it comes to props and practical effects!
ds:936:849:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo! Magaling pala si Peter sa mga props at epektong aktuwal na ginagamit sa entablado!

ds:936:850:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So we go all out! We’ll put on a bit of a play telling the story of the character. Then there’s usually a fun raunchy grand finale!
ds:936:850:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kaya todo kami! Nagtatanghal kami ng maikling dula tungkol sa tauhan. Tapos kadalasan may masaya at malaswang malaking pagtatapos!

ds:936:853:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So last year I had the honor to play as Aubergine!
ds:936:853:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya noong nakaraang taon, nagkaroon ako ng karangalang gumanap bilang Aubergine!

ds:936:854:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Long story short, Aubergine would sacrifice critters to appease some demons. And in exchange, they would pleasure her!
ds:936:854:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sa madaling sabi, naghahandog si Aubergine ng mga nilalang para palugurin ang ilang demonyo. At kapalit noon, bibigyan nila siya ng sarap!

ds:936:857:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I wish you coulda saw it Rascal, it was really somethin’…
ds:936:857:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sana nakita mo, Rascal, ibang klase talaga…

ds:936:858:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Bahaha, it was a great show though! Everyone loved it!
ds:936:858:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bahaha, pero ang ganda ng palabas! Gustong-gusto ng lahat!

ds:936:860:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It was! And we do a different show every year.
ds:936:860:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maganda nga! At iba ang palabas namin bawat taon.

ds:936:861:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know what this year will be?
ds:936:861:Dialogue Text.target: Alam mo na kung ano ngayong taon?

ds:936:862:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I do! You’ll have to see for yourself though!

ds:936:863:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s going to be a hoot! You have to come!

ds:937:576:Dialogue Text.source: Peter did a bang up job on a bunch of tentacles! Turns out he’s got a real knack for crafts!
ds:937:576:Dialogue Text.target: Napakahusay ng pagkakagawa ni Peter ng maraming galamay! Magaling pala talaga siya sa mga likhang-kamay!

ds:937:577:Dialogue Text.source: I remember he stayed up for weeks painting and putting these things together…
ds:937:577:Dialogue Text.target: Naalala kong ilang linggo siyang nagpuyat para pinturahan at buuin ang mga 'yon…

ds:937:578:Dialogue Text.source: But when the lights were out and it was showtime?
ds:937:578:Dialogue Text.target: Pero noong patay na ang mga ilaw at oras na ng palabas?

ds:937:580:Dialogue Text.source: Wow, that was something else! They looked real, everything looked so magical!
ds:937:580:Dialogue Text.target: Wow, ibang klase! Mukhang totoo, parang mahiwaga ang lahat!

ds:937:582:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I think I got off a good couple of times on stage. Y’know me, loving that spotlight!
ds:937:582:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, parang ilang beses akong nilabasan sa entablado. Alam mo ako, gustong-gusto ang atensiyon!

ds:937:583:Dialogue Text.source: I do recall being pretty sore afterward… Though it looked great, the materials weren’t exactly meant for "extended" use…
ds:937:583:Dialogue Text.target: Naalala kong masakit ang katawan ko pagkatapos… Kahit maganda ang hitsura, hindi talaga para sa "matagalang" paggamit ang mga materyales…

ds:938:701:Dialogue Text.source: Were you and Penny a thing?

ds:938:703:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]No, I wouldn’t say that. We weren’t a thing, just friends with benefits!
ds:938:703:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hindi, hindi ko masasabing ganoon. Hindi naging kami, magkaibigang nagtatalik lang!

ds:938:704:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We still have those benefits, might I add!

ds:938:706:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She’s adorable! Let me tell you how we first met!
ds:938:706:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napakakyut niya! Ikuwento ko kung paano kami unang nagkakilala!

ds:938:708:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So as you know, Penny often flies critters around the forest.
ds:938:708:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Alam mo namang madalas maglipad si Penny ng mga nilalang sa paligid ng gubat.

ds:938:709:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]She was one of the first to welcome us to our home up in the mountain. She gave us a bell, and had a perch created right by our home.
ds:938:709:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Isa siya sa mga unang tumanggap sa amin sa bahay namin sa bundok. Binigyan niya kami ng kampana at nagpagawa ng dapuan sa tabi mismo ng bahay.

ds:938:710:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Of course, Charlotte and I are far too large to use Penny’s services, but she insisted we keep the bell and the perch! I suppose for other critters to visit.
ds:938:710:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siyempre, masyado kaming malaki ni Charlotte para gamitin ang serbisyo ni Penny, pero ipinilit niyang itago namin ang kampana at dapuan! Para siguro makabisita ang ibang nilalang.

ds:938:711:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Well, I always fancied her personality, and I kind of assumed she "got around" literally and metaphorically.
ds:938:711:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Gusto ko na talaga ang ugali niya, at inakala kong marami siyang "napupuntahan," literal at sa pagtatalik.

ds:938:712:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So one night, I was feeling a bit adventerous, I decided to give her a ring.
ds:938:712:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kaya isang gabi, gusto kong sumubok ng bago, pinatunog ko ang kampana niya.

ds:938:713:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]As she arrived, there I layed on my back, a toy in each hole and a big ole egg-plug next to me. For her, of course.
ds:938:713:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pagdating niya, nakatihaya ako, may laruan sa bawat butas at isang malaking hugis-itlog na pampasak sa tabi ko. Para sa kanya, siyempre.

ds:938:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Little did I know, she is quite shy with that stuff! She was so huffy and blushing, it was adorable. But also I could tell she was uncomfortable.
ds:938:714:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hindi ko alam, mahiyain pala siya sa mga ganoon! Hingal at namumula siya, napakakyut. Pero halata ko ring hindi siya komportable.

ds:938:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Being friends with Charlotte for so long, I understand that not everyone’s as forward as I, so I took the toys out and apologized.
ds:938:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Dahil matagal ko nang kaibigan si Charlotte, alam kong hindi lahat kasingdirekta ko, kaya inalis ko ang mga laruan at humingi ng tawad.

ds:938:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She was still quite bewildered. She awkwardly made an excuse and flew away.
ds:938:716:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Litung-lito pa rin siya. Asiwa siyang nagdahilan at lumipad palayo.

ds:938:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I thought I blew it! I didn’t think I’d see her ever again!
ds:938:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Akala ko nasira ko na ang lahat! Akala ko hindi ko na siya makikita ulit!

ds:938:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But sure enough, I’d actually catch her spying on me a few times.
ds:938:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pero ilang beses ko talaga siyang nahuling palihim akong pinapanood.

ds:938:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]At first it was a glance here and there.

ds:938:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But then I noticed she’d be flying around a bit more.
ds:938:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pero napansin kong mas madalas siyang lumilipad sa paligid.

ds:938:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Then I kid you not, she peeped on me a few times while I was having a go!
ds:938:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tapos hindi ako nagbibiro, ilang beses niya akong sinilipan habang pinapaligaya ko ang sarili ko!

ds:938:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]She’s lucky I’m into that sort of thing, or we’d have a serious talk!
ds:938:724:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mabuti na lang mahilig ako sa ganoon, kung hindi, seryoso kaming mag-uusap!

ds:938:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I also think she underestimated my ability to smell and hear her. I’m a fox, after all! Don’t hunt a hunter!
ds:938:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Parang minaliit din niya ang kakayahan kong maamoy at marinig siya. Soro ako, kung tutuusin! Huwag mong habulin ang mangangaso!

ds:938:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Or maybe that was her cute way of getting found out, because obviously, mid rub, I called her out!
ds:938:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]O baka kyut niyang paraan 'yon para mahuli, dahil siyempre, habang humihimas, tinawag ko siya!

ds:938:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, haha, she was caught quite off guard.

ds:938:729:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That night, we talked until the sun came out. Just about all sorts of stuff.
ds:938:729:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Noong gabing 'yon, nag-usap kami hanggang sumikat ang araw. Tungkol sa kung anu-ano lang.

ds:938:731:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But yeah! Long story short, we really clicked and she’s been a good friend ever since!
ds:938:731:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero oo! Sa madaling salita, nagkasundo kami at mabuti ko na siyang kaibigan mula noon!

ds:938:733:Dialogue Text.target: Parang may paulit-ulit na mga ibon…

ds:938:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hah! What can I say? I’ve always had a thing for poultry!
ds:938:734:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hah! Ano'ng magagawa ko? Mahilig talaga ako sa manok!

ds:938:735:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m kidding, I’m kidding! Don’t tell her I said that!
ds:938:735:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Biro lang, biro lang! Huwag mong sasabihing sinabi ko 'yon!

ds:938:736:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, your secret is safe with me!
ds:938:736:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, ligtas sa akin ang lihim mo!

ds:939:705:Dialogue Text.source: Do you celebrate The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:939:705:Dialogue Text.target: Ipinagdiriwang mo ba ang Pagpapala ng mga Kampana?

ds:939:708:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Do I? Oh it’s one of my favorite times of the year!
ds:939:708:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kung ipinagdiriwang ko? Isa 'yan sa mga paborito kong panahon ng taon!

ds:939:709:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The friends, the food, the gifts, what’s not to love?
ds:939:709:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Mga kaibigan, pagkain, regalo, sino ba namang aayaw?

ds:939:710:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I particularly love sending out greeting cards to all the critters!
ds:939:710:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Gustong-gusto kong magpadala ng mga kard ng pagbati sa lahat ng nilalang!

ds:939:711:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s a great way to stay in touch, but it’s an even better opportunity to look cute in front of the camera!
ds:939:711:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Magandang paraan para magkamustahan, pero mas magandang pagkakataon para magpakakyut sa harap ng kamera!

ds:939:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’d usually do a nice wholesome one for the families…
ds:939:714:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kadalasan gagawa ako ng magandang disenteng kard para sa mga pamilya…

ds:939:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And for the close friends, I’ll send them something spicy!
ds:939:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At para sa malalapit na kaibigan, magpapadala ako ng maanghang!

ds:939:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Gah! I wish I could show you the one we did last year… I don’t have any extras around…
ds:939:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Gah! Sana maipakita ko sa 'yo 'yong ginawa namin noong nakaraang taon… Wala akong sobrang kopya rito…

ds:93:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We have our bird flying above the trees, she’ll let us know if there’s any shady critters about!
ds:93:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lumilipad ang ibon natin sa itaas ng mga puno, ibabalita niya kung may kahina-hinalang nilalang!

ds:93:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Till then, our wonderful friend should remain where she is.
ds:93:102:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hanggang noon, dapat manatili ang mabuti nating kaibigan sa kinaroroonan niya.

ds:93:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well, we haven’t heard from our scout yet.
ds:93:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Wala pa tayong balita sa tagamanman natin.

ds:93:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once we know what kinda critter’s runnin’ around out there, we can decide the next course of action.
ds:93:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kapag alam na natin kung anong nilalang ang pagala-gala roon, saka natin mapagpapasiyahan ang susunod na gagawin.

ds:93:98:Menu Text.source: How long should the bear stand guard?
ds:93:98:Menu Text.target: Hanggang kailan dapat magbantay ang oso?

ds:93:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No ifs or buts! This is for the safety of our community, y’here?
ds:93:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Walang kung o pero! Para 'to sa kaligtasan ng pamayanan natin, naririnig mo?

ds:940:721:Dialogue Text.source: Actually, I’m just here to chat!
ds:940:721:Dialogue Text.target: Sa totoo lang, nandito lang ako para makipagkuwentuhan!

ds:940:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Sure, I can talk for a bit. What’s on your mind?
ds:940:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sige, puwede akong makipag-usap sandali. Ano'ng nasa isip mo?

ds:940:723:Dialogue Text.source:
I was talking to Melody and
she mentioned you and her
did some Greeting Cards last year!
ds:940:723:Dialogue Text.target:
Kinausap ko si Melody at
nabanggit niyang gumawa kayo
ng mga Kard ng Pagbati noong isang taon!

ds:940:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We sure did! It was a really cute one! She dressed us up and we took it in front of a big ole pine tree!
ds:940:724:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oo nga! Napakakyut noon! Binihisan niya kami at kinunan sa harap ng malaking punong pino!

ds:940:725:Dialogue Text.source:
She also mentioned there was
a more… saucy version…
ds:940:725:Dialogue Text.target:
Nabanggit din niyang may
mas… mapang-akit na bersiyon…

ds:940:728:Dialogue Text.source:
She said you might have
extra copies laying around?
ds:940:728:Dialogue Text.target:
Sabi niya, baka may
sobra kang mga kopya?

ds:940:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I did have extras, but Dustin actually requested to have them.
ds:940:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mayroon sana akong sobra, pero hiningi na ni Dustin.

ds:940:731:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It was only a few, so I figured why not.
ds:940:731:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ilan lang naman, kaya naisip kong bakit hindi.

ds:941:721:Dialogue Text.source:
No, actually. I was wondering
if you could help me out.
ds:941:721:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi, sa totoo lang. Naisip ko
kung matutulungan mo ako.

ds:941:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well that depends! What’s on your mind?

ds:941:723:Dialogue Text.source:
Penny and Melody told me about some
spicy holiday cards. Are you familiar?
ds:941:723:Dialogue Text.target:
Ikinuwento nina Penny at Melody ang ilang maiinit
na kard ng pagdiriwang. Alam mo ba 'yon?

ds:941:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I just about blew my load when I saw Penny handing these out!
ds:941:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Muntik na akong labasan nang makita kong ipinamimigay ni Penny ang mga 'to!

ds:941:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Two of my favorite gals, showing their fannys!
ds:941:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Dalawa sa mga paborito kong babae, ipinapakita ang mga pribadong bahagi nila!

ds:941:727:Dialogue Text.source:
Ooo! You don’t happen to have
a spare laying around, do you?
ds:941:727:Dialogue Text.target:
Ooo! Baka sakaling may
sobra ka riyan?

ds:941:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well as a matter of fact… I did happen to snag a few!
ds:941:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa katunayan… Nakakuha nga ako ng ilan!

ds:941:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]One copy for when I’m having a wank!

ds:941:733:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]A back up, incase I mess on my wank-copy…
ds:941:733:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Isang reserba, kung sakaling makalat ko ang kopyang pangjakol…

ds:941:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And I did have a backup for the backup… But I guess I can give it to you!
ds:941:734:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]At may reserba rin ako para sa reserba… Pero maibibigay ko naman sa 'yo!

ds:941:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]No problem! Try not to mess on it!

ds:942:807:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! Who should I round up this time?
ds:942:807:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Sino ang titipunin ko ngayon?

ds:942:808:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I promised Penny and Mabel first dibs!
ds:942:808:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ipinangako ko kina Penny at Mabel na sila ang unang makasusubok!

ds:942:809:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once you’ve gotten a hold of them, come back here and we can get started!
ds:942:809:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kapag nakausap mo na sila, bumalik ka rito at makapagsisimula na tayo!

ds:942:810:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, by the way. You can find them up north.
ds:942:810:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh, siya nga pala. Makikita mo sila sa hilaga.

ds:942:811:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think they were meeting up with Charlotte and Melody near the foot of the mountain.
ds:942:811:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sa tingin ko, makikipagkita sila kina Charlotte at Melody malapit sa paanan ng bundok.

ds:945:850:Dialogue Text.source: Don’t worry about me, mate! I’m quite disciplined!

ds:945:854:Dialogue Text.source: Now quit doddlin’ and give it to her already!

ds:945:856:Dialogue Text.source: You ready Scarlett? This toy looks nuts…

ds:945:860:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, these knots are pretty huge!

ds:945:862:Dialogue Text.source: Yes dear, a thousand times yes.

ds:945:863:Dialogue Text.target: Medyo natagalan lang kaming nakaupo, kapag naipasok na ang una, ayos na, makikita mo!

ds:945:866:Dialogue Text.source: Alright then! Let me get a better angle… andddd…

ds:945:870:Dialogue Text.source: Whoa, I felt you like, kinda pulling it…
ds:945:870:Dialogue Text.target: Whoa, naramdaman kong parang hinihila mo…

ds:945:871:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah we’re good to go now!

ds:945:872:Dialogue Text.source: Get the second and third one in there and you can start pumping them in and out!

ds:945:875:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! You were right, those went in easier!

ds:945:877:Dialogue Text.target: Pero kailangan pa nating paluwagin ang butas ko para sa huling buhol na 'yan.

ds:945:878:Dialogue Text.source: So start pushing and pulling on that thing!
ds:945:878:Dialogue Text.target: Kaya simulan mo nang itulak at hilahin 'yan!

ds:945:885:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, you’re definitely loosening up now…

ds:945:893:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh damn, she’s squirting with these knots…
ds:945:893:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, grabe, napapabuga siya sa mga buhol na 'to…

ds:945:895:Dialogue Text.source: I bet she’s ready for that last knot now…
ds:945:895:Dialogue Text.target: Tiyak na handa na siya sa huling buhol ngayon…

ds:945:896:Dialogue Text.source: Gaaah hahhh! Go for it Rascal, push hard!

ds:945:905:Dialogue Text.source: But I’m not cleaning up your spunk…

ds:945:907:Dialogue Text.source: Whew! That’s a real workout for the arm!

ds:945:909:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah I’m sure I’ll be feeling this tomorrow.

ds:945:910:Dialogue Text.source: But for now, I feel fantastic.
ds:945:910:Dialogue Text.target: Pero sa ngayon, napakasarap ng pakiramdam ko.

ds:945:912:Dialogue Text.source: You look like a mess right now haha.

ds:945:914:Dialogue Text.source: But that’ll be later. Penny needs some attention!
ds:945:914:Dialogue Text.target: Pero mamaya na 'yon. Kailangan ni Penny ng pansin!

ds:945:918:Dialogue Text.source: I was just about to fall asleep!

ds:945:919:Dialogue Text.source: Hah! Don’t lie, you’re loving these shows.
ds:945:919:Dialogue Text.target: Ha! Huwag kang magsinungaling, gustong-gusto mo ang mga palabas.

ds:945:920:Dialogue Text.source: I am. Rascal’s a trooper for tending to all of us at once!
ds:945:920:Dialogue Text.target: Oo. Ang tatag ni Rascal sa pag-asikaso sa aming lahat nang sabay-sabay!

ds:945:921:Dialogue Text.source: We’re gonna have to repay him later…
ds:945:921:Dialogue Text.target: Kailangan nating bumawi sa kanya mamaya…

ds:945:922:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, well first thing is first.

ds:945:924:Dialogue Text.target: May kailangan ba akong malaman muna? O basta simulan ko na?

ds:945:926:Dialogue Text.target: Sige! May paraan ba para, uh… masigurong sa isang tiyak na butas papasok?

ds:945:927:Dialogue Text.target: Oh, hah, wala. Ang ganyang kalaki, sa isang lugar lang papasok…

ds:945:928:Dialogue Text.source: Hah, ok. Let’s start gettin’ this guy in there…
ds:945:928:Dialogue Text.target: Ha, sige. Simulan na nating ipasok 'to…

ds:945:929:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh damn, this thing is HEAVY.

ds:945:930:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not sure I’ll be able to pump this one like the last…
ds:945:930:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi ako sigurado kung maibobomba ko 'to gaya ng nauna…

ds:945:931:Dialogue Text.source: Oh no worries, I don’t need much motion. Just the size of that thing can really push me over…
ds:945:931:Dialogue Text.target: Oh, walang problema, hindi ko kailangan ng maraming galaw. Ang laki lang niyan, kaya na akong itulak sa sukdulan…

ds:945:932:Dialogue Text.source: … What are you doing back there?

ds:945:933:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I’m just rubbing the head around.
ds:945:933:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, ikinikiskis ko lang paikot ang ulo.

ds:945:934:Dialogue Text.target: Kakaiba ang mga butas ng ibon!

ds:945:935:Dialogue Text.target: Ehem! Kloaka, hindi butas ng ibon!

ds:945:940:Dialogue Text.source: The head of this toys a little blunt…

ds:945:949:Dialogue Text.source: It’s after that ring! It gets reaaaally thick, not to mention the depth!

ds:945:952:Dialogue Text.source: Oh it’s not for him, honey, it’s for me~

ds:945:953:Dialogue Text.source: She’s been thirsting after that donkey for a while now.

ds:945:956:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! I’ve basically hilted this thing before, so I know I can take it.

ds:945:966:Dialogue Text.source: H-Hold it there if you can!

ds:945:967:Dialogue Text.target: Sinusubukan ko! Talagang idinidiin ko na!

ds:945:968:Dialogue Text.source: Gaaaaww! I can take… a bit… more…
ds:945:968:Dialogue Text.target: Gaaaaww! Kaya ko pa… nang kaunti… mas malalim…

ds:945:969:Dialogue Text.source: Damn girl, new record for sure!

ds:945:970:Dialogue Text.source: That’s gonna be a happy donkey!

ds:945:972:Dialogue Text.source: Hooo-gosh. I-I think that’s all I can handle…
ds:945:972:Dialogue Text.target: Hooo-naku. I-ito na yata ang lahat ng kaya ko…

ds:945:974:Dialogue Text.source: Yesss, you an let it out…

ds:945:975:Dialogue Text.source: Bawwwww… gawwwsh that feels amaaaazing coming out…

ds:945:977:Dialogue Text.source: Good timing too, that thing was heavy!

ds:945:978:Dialogue Text.target: Gawww, nanginginig ang mga pakpak ko…

ds:945:979:Dialogue Text.source: Can I peek around in there?

ds:945:980:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like a good opportunity to get to know how this thing works…
ds:945:980:Dialogue Text.target: Mukhang magandang pagkakataon para malaman kung paano 'to gumagana…

ds:945:982:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh… Ok I see now… There’s that other hole…
ds:945:982:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh… Sige, nakikita ko na… Ayan ang isa pang butas…

ds:945:983:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh Penny, I had no idea you could take so much…
ds:945:983:Dialogue Text.target: Naku, Penny, wala akong ideyang kaya mong tanggapin ang ganoon karami…

ds:945:984:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I’ve laid a lot of eggs in my years…
ds:945:984:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, marami na akong naitlog sa mga taon ko…

ds:945:988:Dialogue Text.source: Well I’m spent. Who’s next ladies?
ds:945:988:Dialogue Text.target: Ubos na ang lakas ko. Sino'ng susunod, mga babae?

ds:945:997:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! I didn’t think it was coming out!
ds:945:997:Dialogue Text.target: Oo! Akala ko, hindi na mahuhugot!

ds:946:133:Dialogue Text.source: Oliver told me about your midnight rendezvous…
ds:946:133:Dialogue Text.target: Ikinuwento ni Oliver ang pagkikita ninyo sa hatinggabi…

ds:946:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes, we’ve been meeting pretty regularly for the past few months…
ds:946:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo, madalas kaming nagkikita nitong mga nakaraang buwan…

ds:946:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]He’s been helping me blow off some steam… and… Well his assets are…
ds:946:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tinutulungan niya akong magpalabas ng naipong libog… at… Ang mga ari-arian niya kasi…

ds:946:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Erm… Forgive me, did you have a question or something?
ds:946:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Erm… Pasensiya, may tanong ka ba o ano?

ds:946:140:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah! Oliver mentioned specifically
that you give some pretty good head…

Oo! Partikular na binanggit ni Oliver
na magaling ka raw sumubo…

ds:946:142:Dialogue Text.source:
So I was wondering if I might be able
to watch next time. It sounds pretty hot!
ds:946:142:Dialogue Text.target:
Kaya naisip kong baka puwede
akong manood sa susunod. Mukhang nakakalibog!

ds:946:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well, who am I to turn down an oppurtunity like that?
ds:946:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sino ba ako para tanggihan ang ganoong pagkakataon?

ds:946:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]In fact… I’m in the mood now…

ds:946:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]We could find Oliver and put on a show, how does that sound?
ds:946:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Puwede nating hanapin si Oliver at magpalabas, ano sa tingin mo?

ds:946:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m glad you spoke to me, Rascal! We need to have more fun together…
ds:946:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mabuti't kinausap mo ako, Rascal! Kailangan pa nating magsaya nang magkasama…

ds:946:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Maybe next time… I’ll be tasting you…
ds:946:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Baka sa susunod… Ikaw naman ang titikman ko…

ds:946:152:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, well I’m definitely not as long as Oliver…
ds:946:152:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, hindi talaga ako kasinghaba ni Oliver…

ds:946:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]There’s plenty I can do with my mouth. You’ll see!
ds:946:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Marami akong kayang gawin sa bibig ko. Makikita mo!

ds:947:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean… I’m looking at you right now…

ds:947:136:Dialogue Text.source:
Naw, I mean, are you in
a relationship with anyone.
ds:947:136:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi, ang ibig kong sabihin, may
karelasyon ka ba.

ds:947:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No, I haven’t really been looking for big commitments or anything…
ds:947:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wala, hindi naman ako naghahanap ng seryosong pananagutan o ano…

ds:947:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah! For now that’s working out for me pretty well…
ds:947:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo! Sa ngayon, maayos naman para sa akin…

ds:947:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I have been… seeing someone more often than others though…
ds:947:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pero may… isang mas madalas kong makita kaysa sa iba…

ds:947:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It kinda started a while back… I was wondering the forest at night, trying to find a decent spot to take care of… well… some pent up energy.
ds:947:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nagsimula noong medyo matagal na… Naglalakad ako sa gubat isang gabi, naghahanap ng magandang puwesto para ilabas… ano… ang naipong libog.

ds:947:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’s this nice spot by the lake, private, relaxing, you can hear the water running.
ds:947:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]May magandang lugar sa tabi ng lawa, pribado, nakakarelaks, maririnig mo ang agos ng tubig.

ds:947:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once I got there though, Augustus saw me, and headed over.
ds:947:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero pagdating ko, nakita ako ni Augustus at lumapit siya.

ds:947:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I can’t exactly… hide my bits when they are like that, but I tried.
ds:947:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hindi ko talaga… maitago ang ari ko kapag ganoon, pero sinubukan ko.

ds:947:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He ended up offering his services… I guess he needed to blow off some steam as well.
ds:947:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nag-alok siya ng serbisyo niya… Kailangan din siguro niyang magpalabas ng naipong libog.

ds:947:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Haha! Yeah, I mean… He’s the first time I’ve been in a reptile. Their bodies are quite strange!
ds:947:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Haha! Oo… Siya ang unang reptilyang napasukan ko. Kakaiba ang mga katawan nila!

ds:947:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It was a lil tough to get our positions just right…
ds:947:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Medyo mahirap maipuwesto ang mga katawan namin nang tama…

ds:947:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]After a quick wash up, we went our separate ways…
ds:947:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Pagkatapos maghugas nang mabilis, naghiwalay kami ng landas…

ds:947:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I came back the next night, and pretended to "run into him" again…
ds:947:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pero bumalik ako nang sumunod na gabi, at nagkunwaring "nakasalubong ko siya" ulit…

ds:947:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And again the next night… And again the night after that…
ds:947:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At muli nang sumunod na gabi… At muli nang kasunod pa…

ds:947:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Fast forward to some months later, we still meet up regularly!
ds:947:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lumipas ang ilang buwan, regular pa rin kaming nagkikita!

ds:947:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]He likes to do a lot of mouth stuff… I’m kinda the perfect size though, so I can’t blame him!
ds:947:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mahilig siya sa mga gawaing pangbibig… Sakto naman ang laki ko, kaya hindi ko siya masisisi!

ds:947:160:Dialogue Text.source: That sounds hot! I’d love to see that!
