ds:956:443:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But how do you know about this donkey business?
ds:956:443:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pero paano mo nalaman ang negosyong asnong 'to?

ds:956:444:Dialogue Text.source:
I heard it straight from the horse’s mouth!
Er well, donkey.
ds:956:444:Dialogue Text.target:
Mula mismo sa bibig ng kabayo!
Er, asno pala.

ds:956:446:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Supplier AND marketing. That guy deserves a raise!
ds:956:446:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tagasuplay AT tagapagsulong. Nararapat siyang dagdagan ng sahod!

ds:956:447:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually, he doesn’t know
what you’re up to either.
ds:956:447:Dialogue Text.target:
Sa totoo lang, hindi rin niya alam
ang ginagawa mo.

ds:956:448:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No way! I definitely pitched it to him!

ds:956:449:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It was on a Sunday… I made rounds to a bunch of the larger critters here.
ds:956:449:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Linggo 'yon… Inikot ko ang marami sa mas malalaking nilalang dito.

ds:956:450:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Chatted with some friends nearby, then I hit up Augustus, and then…
ds:956:450:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nakipagkuwentuhan ako sa ilang kaibigan sa malapit, tapos kay Augustus, tapos…

ds:956:452:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That means… He just lets me milk him for no reason?
ds:956:452:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ibig sabihin… Pinapabayaan lang niya akong gatasan siya nang walang dahilan?

ds:956:455:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’re talking like, GALLONS of the stuff.

ds:956:457:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Huh… Well that explains why he hasn’t been asking for his cut…
ds:956:457:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Huh… Kaya pala hindi niya hinihingi ang bahagi niya…

ds:956:458:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hm, maybe I don’t have to pay him now…
ds:956:458:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hm, baka hindi ko na kailangang bayaran siya ngayon…

ds:956:459:Dialogue Text.source: No, you definitely have to pay him.
ds:956:459:Dialogue Text.target: Hindi, kailangan mo talaga siyang bayaran.

ds:956:460:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m kidding, I’m kidding! Of course I’ll pay him!
ds:956:460:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Biro lang, biro lang! Siyempre babayaran ko siya!

ds:956:461:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Besides… He is making us a ton of coin!
ds:956:461:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]At saka… Ang laki ng kinikita namin dahil sa kanya!

ds:956:462:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Dang though… I wish he’d have said something. I can’t imagine what he was thinking after I’d collect…
ds:956:462:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Grabe… Sana nagsabi siya. Hindi ko maisip kung ano ang iniisip niya pagkatapos kong mangolekta…

ds:956:464:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok well, I gotta make that right. I’ll go talk to him.
ds:956:464:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sige, kailangan kong itama 'yon. Kakausapin ko siya.

ds:956:465:Dialogue Text.source: Wait, but what are you doing with it?
ds:956:465:Dialogue Text.target: Sandali, pero ano ang ginagawa mo roon?

ds:956:466:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh uhh, it’s a whole thing. Go ask Mabel, she’ll fill ya in!
ds:956:466:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ah, uhh, mahabang kuwento. Tanungin mo si Mabel, ipapaliwanag niya!

ds:957:436:Dialogue Text.source:
Maverick just told me about
some thing you two are doing?
ds:957:436:Dialogue Text.target:
May sinabi si Maverick tungkol
sa ginagawa ninyong dalawa?

ds:957:437:Dialogue Text.source: Something with a lot of donkey cum?
ds:957:437:Dialogue Text.target: Tungkol sa maraming tamod ng asno?

ds:957:438:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha! Yessir, you came to the right place!
ds:957:438:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Haha! Oo, sir, nasa tamang lugar ka!

ds:957:439:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Ya trying to get frisky with the critters?

ds:957:440:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Or if you’re looking to relax, we’ve got plenty of treatment options!
ds:957:440:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]O kung gusto mong magrelaks, marami kaming opsyon sa pagpapaganda!

ds:957:441:Dialogue Text.source: I actually have no idea what this is.
ds:957:441:Dialogue Text.target: Wala talaga akong ideya kung ano 'to.

ds:957:443:Dialogue Text.source:
No, he had to go.
He told me you’d fill me in.
ds:957:443:Dialogue Text.target:
Hindi, kailangan niyang umalis.
Sabi niya ikaw ang magpapaliwanag.

ds:957:445:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]This is a pretty recent endeavor Maverick and I’ve cooked up!
ds:957:445:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Bago-bago lang 'tong negosyong naisip namin ni Maverick!

ds:957:446:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]As ya know, I have a lot of connections with some of the smaller critters of the forest.
ds:957:446:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Alam mo namang marami akong kakilala sa maliliit na nilalang ng gubat.

ds:957:447:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Not only the rodents, but the birds too! There’s a whole network of us lil’ guys!
ds:957:447:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hindi lang mga daga, pati mga ibon! May buong samahan kaming maliliit!

ds:957:448:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Wouldn’t ya know it, they are just as horny as you guys, in fact, probably more so!
ds:957:448:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Alam mo ba, kasinglibog ninyo sila, baka mas malibog pa nga!

ds:957:450:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See most of the smaller critters don’t really experience things with larger critters. Maybe occasionally with someone your size.
ds:957:450:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Karamihan ng maliliit na nilalang, hindi talaga nakakaranas kasama ang mas malalaki. Baka paminsan-minsan, sa kasinlaki mo.

ds:957:452:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That went even better than I expected!
ds:957:452:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mas maganda pa kaysa sa inaasahan ko!

ds:957:453:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks for being such a willing participant!

ds:957:454:Dialogue Text.source:
Anytime! Really that’s
quite the charming bunch!
ds:957:454:Dialogue Text.target:
Kahit kailan! Talagang
kaaya-aya silang kasama!

ds:957:455:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Right? That’s some of our regulars, and some of my long time friends too!
ds:957:455:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]'Di ba? Ilan sila sa mga suki namin, at matatagal ko na ring kaibigan!

ds:957:456:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Actually, a few asked if I could arrange some one on one time with you…
ds:957:456:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May ilan ngang nagtanong kung puwede kong ayusin na makasama ka nang kayong dalawa lang…

ds:957:459:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]One thing at a time though… First I’ve got to chat with Oliver!
ds:957:459:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pero isa-isa lang muna… Kailangan ko munang kausapin si Oliver!

ds:957:460:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But someone like Oliver? No that’s quite rare!

ds:957:461:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Some of the smaller critters are quite afraid of larger ones, though you and I know they are harmless.
ds:957:461:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]May ilang maliliit na nilalang na takot sa mas malalaki, kahit alam nating hindi sila nananakit.

ds:957:462:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So I thought, here we go. This can be an opportunity to help bridge that gap!
ds:957:462:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kaya naisip ko, ito na. Pagkakataon 'to para ilapit sila sa isa't isa!

ds:957:463:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Why not share some of the “experiences” a small critter can have when paired up with a much larger partner!
ds:957:463:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bakit hindi ibahagi ang mga “karanasang” maaaring makuha ng maliit na nilalang kasama ang kaparehang di-hamak na mas malaki!

ds:957:464:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Thus, the Critter Cum Spa was born!
ds:957:464:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kaya isinilang ang Spa ng Tamod para sa mga Nilalang!

ds:957:465:Dialogue Text.target: Spa ng Tamod para sa mga Nilalang?!

ds:957:466:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah! Don’t worry, the name grows on ya.
ds:957:466:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo! Huwag kang mag-alala, magugustuhan mo rin ang pangalan.

ds:957:468:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Maverick collects the spunk! Then we mix it with some additives just to keep it from getting funky over time.
ds:957:468:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kinokolekta ni Maverick ang tamod! Tapos hinahaluan namin ng ilang sangkap para hindi bumaho sa pagtagal.

ds:957:469:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Then we fill up baths, set up heated channels to keep things nice and warm.
ds:957:469:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pinupuno namin ang mga paliguan, naglalagay ng mga pinainit na daluyan para manatiling mainit-init.

ds:957:470:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And the critters are free to join as they please!
ds:957:470:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]At puwedeng sumali ang mga nilalang kung kailan nila gusto!

ds:957:472:Dialogue Text.source:
Whoa, that sounds like
quite the operation!

ds:957:473:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah, we’ve got some friends who helped set the whole thing up. I’m sure you’ll meet them later.
ds:957:473:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oo, may mga kaibigan kaming tumulong buuin ang lahat. Siguradong makikilala mo sila mamaya.

ds:957:474:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Anyways, it started as an aphrodisiac sorta experience. But some of the regulars swear by the beauty benefits.
ds:957:474:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Basta, nagsimula itong parang pampalibog na karanasan. Pero may mga suking naniniwala talaga sa pakinabang nito sa pagpapaganda.

ds:957:476:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah! It helps moisturize the fur and keep your coat lively!
ds:957:476:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oo! Nakakatulong itong panatilihing may sapat na halumigmig ang balahibo at masigla ang hitsura!

ds:957:477:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some critters swear by it! They say their skin is much tighter and rejuvenated!
ds:957:477:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]May mga nilalang na tiwalang-tiwala rito! Sabi nila, mas banat at mas sariwa ang balat nila!

ds:957:478:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think they just wanna have cum on their face, but who am I to judge.
ds:957:478:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sa tingin ko, gusto lang nilang may tamod sa mukha, pero sino ba ako para manghusga.

ds:957:481:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The smaller critters have really taken to it. But we haven’t yet moved onto step two of the project…
ds:957:481:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Gustong-gusto na ng maliliit na nilalang. Pero hindi pa namin nagagawa ang ikalawang hakbang ng proyekto…

ds:957:483:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well, the whole point is to help integrate smaller and larger critters.
ds:957:483:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ang buong layunin kasi ay paglapitin ang maliliit at malalaking nilalang.

ds:957:484:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So we want to eventually bring in the larger critters.
ds:957:484:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kaya gusto naming magpasok ng mas malalaking nilalang balang araw.

ds:957:485:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Fresher product, hands on experience, safe and secure integration!
ds:957:485:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mas sariwang produkto, aktuwal na karanasan, ligtas at panatag na pagsasama!

ds:957:486:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]At least, that’s the plan. We just haven’t pulled the trigger yet…
ds:957:486:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]'Yon ang plano. Hindi pa lang namin nasisimulan…

ds:957:488:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think I’m just a little nervous… Some of these smaller critters are quite skiddish.
ds:957:488:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Medyo kinakabahan lang ako… Madaling magulat ang ilan sa maliliit na nilalang na 'to.

ds:957:489:Dialogue Text.source:
Maybe you should give
them a bit more credit?
ds:957:489:Dialogue Text.target:
Baka dapat mas magtiwala ka
sa kakayahan nila?

ds:957:490:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It’s just a little different when a larger critter is actually in the picture…
ds:957:490:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Medyo iba kasi kapag may malaking nilalang na nandoon talaga…

ds:957:492:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They were a bit scared of him at first, but they’ve definitely warmed up.
ds:957:492:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Medyo takot sila noong una, pero naging komportable na rin sila.

ds:957:493:Dialogue Text.source:
How about I go next? I’m sure
the more critters they meet,
the easier it will become!
ds:957:493:Dialogue Text.target:
Ako kaya ang sumunod? Siguradong
habang mas marami silang nakikilala,
mas dadali rin!

ds:957:495:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Come with me, I’ll see what I can do!
ds:957:495:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Sumama ka, tingnan ko kung ano ang magagawa ko!

ds:95:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh! My magazine! Let’s see… Issue 68, good good.
ds:95:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oh! Ang magasin ko! Tingnan natin… Isyu 68, ayos, ayos.

ds:95:101:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I actually remember when this one came out!

ds:95:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]My favorite was the week just after this, but this one’s good too.
ds:95:102:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ang paborito ko, 'yung linggo pagkatapos nito, pero maganda rin 'to.

ds:95:104:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Mmmm, see this Grizzly? Hoo-wheee~! What a hunk!
ds:95:104:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mmmm, kita mo ang Grizzly na 'to? Hoo-wheee~! Ang kisig!

ds:95:105:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’re makin’ out and… what do you kids call it these days?
ds:95:105:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Naghahalikan sila nang mapusok at… ano nga ang tawag n'yong mga bata ngayon?

ds:95:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]mmm… I’d love to be sandwiched between those two…

ds:95:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh… I’ve got a thing for the Asian critters…
ds:95:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Heh… May gusto ako sa mga nilalang na Asyano…

ds:95:110:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oooh… I forgot, this issue has a large section on Pandas…
ds:95:110:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oooh… Nakalimutan ko, maraming pahina tungkol sa mga Panda ang isyung 'to…

ds:95:111:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]They’ve got this double feature of this polar bear and a black bear!
ds:95:111:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May dalawahang tampok dito ng osong polar at itim na oso!

ds:95:113:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Aren’t you an Asian critter? Huh!
ds:95:113:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh! Hindi ba Asyano kang nilalang? Huh!

ds:95:114:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And check out the balls on this Brown!
ds:95:114:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]At tingnan ang mga bayag ng Osong Kayumangging 'to!

ds:96:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think she’d mind if I watch her try the toy out?
ds:96:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sa tingin mo, ayos lang sa kanya kung panoorin ko siyang subukan ang laruan?

ds:96:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So the Bear liked my eggplant idea?
ds:96:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nagustuhan ng Oso ang ideya kong talong?

ds:96:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll have to share more of my advice with her…
ds:96:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kailangan kong ibahagi pa sa kanya ang mga payo ko…

ds:96:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hm… y’know… she’s the only one I’m not… intimately familiar with…
ds:96:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hm… alam mo… siya lang ang hindi ko… lubos na kilala sa kama…

ds:97:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We swung with the couple a few times~! Let me tell ya, that bear had stamina!
ds:97:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ilang beses kaming nagpalitan ng kapareha sa magkasintahang 'yon~! Sinasabi ko sa 'yo, napakatibay ng osong 'yon!

ds:97:101:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once you’ve seen a bear carry a beaver, you’ve seen it all, trust me!
ds:97:101:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kapag nakakita ka na ng osong bumubuhat ng beaver, nakita mo na ang lahat, maniwala ka!

ds:97:102:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Nothin’ quite like being handled by a bear…
ds:97:102:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Walang katulad ang paghawak sa 'yo ng oso…

ds:97:103:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Phew, ok, I’ve gotta get my head out of the clouds, I’ve got work to do!
ds:97:103:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hay, sige, kailangan kong bumalik sa realidad, may trabaho pa ako!

ds:97:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The Beaver just told me about the Playbear you got him!
ds:97:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kakakuwento lang ng Beaver tungkol sa Playbear na kinuha mo para sa kanya!

ds:97:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That takes me way back! We used to drool over the hunks in these magazines for fun!
ds:97:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Napabalik ako sa nakaraan! Nilalawayan namin noon ang mga matipunong lalaki sa mga magasing 'to para sa kasiyahan!

ds:97:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Somethin’ tells me we won’t be seeing our beaver for a bit~
ds:97:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]May kutob akong hindi natin makikita ang beaver natin nang ilang panahon~

ds:97:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know way back in the day, he used to be seeing a great big grizzly!
ds:97:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Alam mo, noong araw, nakikipag-date siya sa isang napakalaking grizzly!

ds:98:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oooh, I heard you helped the mouse find her string!
ds:98:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oooh, balita ko tinulungan mo ang daga na mahanap ang pisi niya!

ds:98:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She told me all about her plans, and I am so excited to see her tie herself up!
ds:98:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ikinuwento niya ang lahat ng plano niya, at sabik na akong makitang igapos niya ang sarili!

ds:98:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]… Oh actually… She’ll probably need some help, I’ll offer an extra pair of paws next time I see her.
ds:98:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]… Oh, sa katunayan… Malamang kailangan niya ng tulong, mag-aalok ako ng dagdag na pares ng lapa sa susunod kong pagkakita sa kanya.

ds:98:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She’s gonna be just the cutest lil’ wrapped up thing~!
ds:98:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siya na ang magiging pinakakyut na munting nakabalot~!

ds:99:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… On second thought, maybe I’ll give those rods another go…
ds:99:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Kung iisipin ko uli, baka subukan ko uli ang mga baras na 'yon…

ds:99:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Sounding huh? That’s what he ended up liking?
ds:99:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pagpasok sa uretra, ano? 'Yon ang nagustuhan niya sa huli?

ds:99:98:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well heck, I’ve got some spare rods, can’t say I was ever a fan of that…
ds:99:98:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Naku, may mga sobra akong baras, pero hindi ko masasabing naging mahilig ako roon…

ds:9:18:Dialogue Text.source: Something is carved in the tree here…

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source: Oliver's been romping around lately with other forest critters. Who else has he been seeing?
managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target: Kamakailan, nakikipagharutan si Oliver sa ibang nilalang sa gubat. Sino-sino pa kaya ang nakakatagpo niya?

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source: What exactly is "The Blessing"? Find out what the forest critters know about the celebration!
managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target: Ano nga ba ang "Pagpapala"? Alamin kung ano ang nalalaman ng mga nilalang sa gubat tungkol sa pagdiriwang!
Mga Pagbati sa Panahon ng Pagdiriwang

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source: Melody made spicy greeting cards for last year's Blessing of the Bells. Maybe she has an extra?
managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target: Gumawa si Melody ng mga seksing kard ng pagbati para sa Pagpapala ng mga Kampana noong nakaraang taon. Baka may sobra pa siya?

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source:
Scarlett had a strange dream!
A bunch of critters were together in a different time and place, searching for unusual stuff...
managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target:
May kakaibang panaginip si Scarlett!
Magkakasama ang isang grupo ng mga nilalang sa ibang panahon at lugar, naghahanap ng mga di-pangkaraniwang bagay...

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source: The bunnies are renovating their basement dungeon and just prepared another area. Recruit some critters to join the fun!
managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target: Nirerenovate ng mga kuneho ang piitan sa silong ng kanilang bahay at katatapos lang maghanda ng isa pang lugar. Mag-aya ng ilang nilalang para makisaya!

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source: The bunnies upgraded their basement dungeon and want to host more critters. This time, recruit some female critters to join the fun!
managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target: Pinaganda ng mga kuneho ang piitan sa silong ng kanilang bahay at gusto nilang tumanggap ng mas marami pang nilalang. Sa pagkakataong ito, mag-aya ng ilang babaeng nilalang para makisaya!

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source: Take me high above the clouds
This gossip is blocked during Blessing of the Bells
managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target: Hindi magagamit ang kuwentuhang ito habang may Pagpapala ng mga Kampana

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.source: Say hi to four more critters.
You’ve got a whole lot of it.

managed:Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll:Syst.target:

Nabuksan ang Kuwentuhan
para sa LAHAT NG NILALANG!

sharedassets2.assets:13924/m_text.source: You got the purple bell! Now you can travel to the Mountains.
sharedassets2.assets:13924/m_text.target: Nakuha mo ang lilang kampana! Makakapaglakbay ka na sa Kabundukan.

sharedassets2.assets:13926/m_text.source:
You found a blue bell! Wonder what it's for...
Maybe you should ring it at the perch!
sharedassets2.assets:13926/m_text.target:
Nakahanap ka ng asul na kampana! Para saan kaya ito...
Baka dapat mo itong patunugin sa dapuan!

sharedassets2.assets:13927/m_text.source: You got the red bell! Now you can travel to the Plains.
sharedassets2.assets:13927/m_text.target: Nakuha mo ang pulang kampana! Makakapaglakbay ka na sa Kapatagan.

sharedassets2.assets:13930/m_text.source: You found a green bell! Now you can summon Penny to the Central Forest fast travel perch.
sharedassets2.assets:13930/m_text.target: Nakahanap ka ng berdeng kampana! Maaari mo nang tawagin si Penny sa dapuan ng mabilisang paglalakbay sa Gitnang Gubat.

sharedassets2.assets:13932/m_text.source:
You've seen all the content we have prepared so far! Feel free to keep exploring and interacting/gossiping with the critters! 

Please report any bugs through our built in bug report tool in the Start Menu and Pause Menu.

Nakita mo na ang lahat ng nilalamang naihanda namin sa ngayon! Malaya kang magpatuloy sa pagtuklas at pakikipag-ugnayan/pakikipagkuwentuhan sa mga nilalang! 

Iulat ang anumang bug gamit ang nakapaloob naming sistema ng pag-uulat ng bug sa Panimulang Menu at Menu ng Pag-pause.

You can select a quest and it’ll be tracked 
on the top-left of the screen!
sharedassets2.assets:14440/m_text.target:
Nasa Talaan ng mga Misyon ang lahat ng kasalukuyan at natapos mong misyon!
Maaari kang pumili ng misyong susubaybayan 
sa kaliwang itaas ng iskrin!

sharedassets2.assets:14482/m_text.source: Are you sure you want to quit?
sharedassets2.assets:14482/m_text.target: Sigurado ka bang gusto mong lumabas?

sharedassets2.assets:14489/m_text.source:
As you meet more and more critters, their information will be jotted down in the Critter Log!

Lots of details are hidden. Talk with the critters and explore the world to reveal them!
sharedassets2.assets:14489/m_text.target:
Habang dumarami ang nakikilala mong nilalang, isusulat sa Talaan ng mga Nilalang ang impormasyon nila!

Maraming detalyeng nakatago. Kausapin ang mga nilalang at tuklasin ang mundo para ibunyag ang mga ito!

sharedassets2.assets:14506/m_text.source: Are you sure you want to forfeit the match?
sharedassets2.assets:14506/m_text.target: Sigurado ka bang gusto mong sumuko sa laban?

sharedassets2.assets:14517/m_text.source: When critters are “on a date” – They won’t be able to do Quests, OR gossips. You will need to locate them in their normal locations for that. Besides… it would be quite rude to bother them during their date!
sharedassets2.assets:14517/m_text.target: Kapag “nakikipagtipan” ang mga nilalang, hindi sila maaaring gumawa ng mga Misyon O makipagkuwentuhan. Kailangan mo silang hanapin sa karaniwan nilang mga lugar para roon. Saka… bastos naman kung aabalahin mo sila habang nakikipagtipan!

sharedassets2.assets:14523/m_Text.target: Pindutin ang [Escape] o ang [B] sa joystick kapag tapos na!

sharedassets2.assets:14539/m_text.source: When critters are “on a date” – They won’t be able to do Quests, OR gossips. You will need to locate them in their normal locations for that. Besides… it would be quite rude to bother them during their date!
sharedassets2.assets:14539/m_text.target: Kapag “nakikipagtipan” ang mga nilalang, hindi sila maaaring gumawa ng mga Misyon O makipagkuwentuhan. Kailangan mo silang hanapin sa karaniwan nilang mga lugar para roon. Saka… bastos naman kung aabalahin mo sila habang nakikipagtipan!

sharedassets2.assets:14544/m_text.source: Progress will be lost, but you can restart it later.
sharedassets2.assets:14544/m_text.target: Mawawala ang usad, pero maaari mo itong simulan muli mamaya.

sharedassets2.assets:14590/m_text.source:
While in Adventures:
- Critters may be LOCKED OUT of gossips/dates. They might
   also move to new locations.
- All other quest progress will be put on hold.
- You can abandon the adventure using the Pause menu.
sharedassets2.assets:14590/m_text.target:
Habang nasa Pakikipagsapalaran:
- Maaaring HINDI MAKASALI ang mga nilalang sa kuwentuhan/pakikipagtipan. Maaari rin
   silang lumipat ng lugar.
- Pansamantalang ihihinto ang usad ng lahat ng ibang misyon.
- Maaari mong iwan ang pakikipagsapalaran gamit ang Menu ng Pag-pause.

sharedassets2.assets:14609/m_text.source:
Now you can explore the darkest depths of the world!

Much like the Sweater, or the Swimfloaties, this will activate automatically.


Be careful though, you can't Dodge-Roll while holding this. The Fireflies wouldn't appreciate it...
sharedassets2.assets:14609/m_text.target:
Matutuklasan mo na ang pinakamadilim na kalaliman ng mundo!

Gaya ng Sweter o ng mga Salbabidang Isinusuot, kusa itong gagana.


Pero mag-ingat, hindi ka makakaiwas sa pamamagitan ng paggulong habang hawak ito. Hindi matutuwa ang mga Alitaptap...

sharedassets2.assets:14611/m_text.source:
Rascal will automatically equip certain items when they’re needed.

This is one of them. 
Just walk next to water and watch him do the rest!

He’ll only swim in areas with calmer water.
sharedassets2.assets:14611/m_text.target:
Kusang isusuot ni Rascal ang ilang gamit kapag kailangan.

Isa ito sa mga iyon. 
Lumapit ka lang sa tubig at siya na ang bahala!

Lalangoy lang siya sa mga bahaging mas kalmado ang tubig.

sharedassets2.assets:14614/m_text.target: Mawawala ang usad na hindi nai-save!

sharedassets2.assets:14634/m_text.source:
You got the Lantern!
Now you can explore the deepest darkest woods.
sharedassets2.assets:14634/m_text.target:
Nakuha mo ang Parol!
Matutuklasan mo na ang pinakamalalim at pinakamadilim na bahagi ng gubat.

sharedassets2.assets:14635/m_text.source: The Critters of the area are inspired by your promiscuity! Occasionally, critters will show up in pairs by Maverick’s Shop and be hanging out! Be sure to talk with them and see how they are doing!
sharedassets2.assets:14635/m_text.target: Inspirado ang mga Nilalang dito sa pakikipagtalik mo sa iba't ibang kapareha! Paminsan-minsan, may mga nilalang na magpapakita nang pares sa tabi ng Tindahan ni Maverick at magtatambay! Kausapin sila at alamin kung kumusta na sila!

sharedassets2.assets:14637/m_text.source:
You got the Swim Floaties!
Now nothing can stop you!
Or, at least, calm waters can’t stop you…
sharedassets2.assets:14637/m_text.target:
Nakuha mo ang mga Salbabidang Isinusuot!
Wala nang makapipigil sa iyo!
O kahit paano, hindi ka na mapipigilan ng kalmadong tubig…

sharedassets2.assets:14638/m_text.source:
Some stories are best experienced in a closed environment!

During an adventure, many interactions will be limited to keep the story in focus!
sharedassets2.assets:14638/m_text.target:
Mas magandang maranasan ang ilang kuwento sa isang limitadong kapaligiran!

Habang nasa pakikipagsapalaran, lilimitahan ang maraming pakikipag-ugnayan para manatiling nakatuon sa kuwento!

sharedassets2.assets:15544/m_text.source:
You got the Swim Floaties!
Now nothing can stop you!
Or, at least, calm waters can’t stop you…
sharedassets2.assets:15544/m_text.target:
Nakuha mo ang mga Salbabidang Isinusuot!
Wala nang makapipigil sa iyo!
O kahit paano, hindi ka na mapipigilan ng kalmadong tubig…

sharedassets2.assets:15545/m_text.source:
Some stories are best experienced in a closed environment!

During an adventure, many interactions will be limited to keep the story in focus!
sharedassets2.assets:15545/m_text.target:
Mas magandang maranasan ang ilang kuwento sa isang limitadong kapaligiran!

Habang nasa pakikipagsapalaran, lilimitahan ang maraming pakikipag-ugnayan para manatiling nakatuon sa kuwento!

sharedassets2.assets:15646/m_text.source:
You got the Lantern!
Now you can explore the deepest darkest woods.
sharedassets2.assets:15646/m_text.target:
Nakuha mo ang Parol!
Matutuklasan mo na ang pinakamalalim at pinakamadilim na bahagi ng gubat.

sharedassets2.assets:15659/m_text.source:
While in Adventures:
- Critters may be LOCKED OUT of gossips/dates. They might
   also move to new locations.
- All other quest progress will be put on hold.
- You can abandon the adventure using the Pause menu.
sharedassets2.assets:15659/m_text.target:
Habang nasa Pakikipagsapalaran:
- Maaaring HINDI MAKASALI ang mga nilalang sa kuwentuhan/pakikipagtipan. Maaari rin
   silang lumipat ng lugar.
- Pansamantalang ihihinto ang usad ng lahat ng ibang misyon.
- Maaari mong iwan ang pakikipagsapalaran gamit ang Menu ng Pag-pause.

sharedassets2.assets:15680/m_text.source: Are you sure you want to quit?
sharedassets2.assets:15680/m_text.target: Sigurado ka bang gusto mong lumabas?

sharedassets2.assets:15712/m_text.target: Mawawala ang usad na hindi nai-save!

sharedassets2.assets:15735/m_text.source:
As you meet more and more critters, their information will be jotted down in the Critter Log!

Lots of details are hidden. Talk with the critters and explore the world to reveal them!
sharedassets2.assets:15735/m_text.target:
Habang dumarami ang nakikilala mong nilalang, isusulat sa Talaan ng mga Nilalang ang impormasyon nila!

Maraming detalyeng nakatago. Kausapin ang mga nilalang at tuklasin ang mundo para ibunyag ang mga ito!

sharedassets2.assets:15767/m_text.target: Hindi Matatalo sa Munting Laro ni Dustin:

sharedassets2.assets:15772/m_text.target: Mawawala ang usad na hindi nai-save!

sharedassets2.assets:15775/m_Text.target: Pindutin ang [Escape] o ang [B] sa joystick kapag tapos na!

sharedassets2.assets:15815/m_text.source:
All of your current and finished quests will be stored in the Quest Log!
You can select a quest and it’ll be tracked 
on the top-left of the screen!
sharedassets2.assets:15815/m_text.target:
Nasa Talaan ng mga Misyon ang lahat ng kasalukuyan at natapos mong misyon!
Maaari kang pumili ng misyong susubaybayan 
sa kaliwang itaas ng iskrin!

sharedassets2.assets:16280/m_text.source: When critters are “on a date” – They won’t be able to do Quests, OR gossips. You will need to locate them in their normal locations for that. Besides… it would be quite rude to bother them during their date!
sharedassets2.assets:16280/m_text.target: Kapag “nakikipagtipan” ang mga nilalang, hindi sila maaaring gumawa ng mga Misyon O makipagkuwentuhan. Kailangan mo silang hanapin sa karaniwan nilang mga lugar para roon. Saka… bastos naman kung aabalahin mo sila habang nakikipagtipan!

sharedassets2.assets:16281/m_text.source: Are you sure you want to forfeit the match?
sharedassets2.assets:16281/m_text.target: Sigurado ka bang gusto mong sumuko sa laban?

or on the game's website tfol.info

Ipadala ang iyong puna mula sa bersiyong pang-desktop
o sa website ng laro na tfol.info

After completing an adventure, you can play it again
any time from the Pause menu.

kahit kailan mula sa Menu ng Pag-pause.

sharedassets2.assets:16559/m_text.source: Dates are unlocked over time. Some may require certain quests or gossips to unlock. Some dates will continue over multiple meets!

sharedassets2.assets:16787/m_text.source: You got the purple bell! Now you can travel to the Mountains.
sharedassets2.assets:16787/m_text.target: Nakuha mo ang lilang kampana! Makakapaglakbay ka na sa Kabundukan.

sharedassets2.assets:16789/m_text.source:

Maybe you should ring it at the perch!
sharedassets2.assets:16789/m_text.target:

Baka dapat mo itong patunugin sa dapuan!

sharedassets2.assets:16790/m_text.source: You got the red bell! Now you can travel to the Plains.
sharedassets2.assets:16790/m_text.target: Nakuha mo ang pulang kampana! Makakapaglakbay ka na sa Kapatagan.

sharedassets2.assets:16793/m_text.source: You found a green bell! Now you can summon Penny to the Central Forest fast travel perch.
sharedassets2.assets:16793/m_text.target: Nakahanap ka ng berdeng kampana! Maaari mo nang tawagin si Penny sa dapuan ng mabilisang paglalakbay sa Gitnang Gubat.

sharedassets2.assets:18496/m_text.target: Pigilan ang Pagtulo sa Munting Laro ng Halaman:

sharedassets2.assets:18576/m_text.source:
While in Adventures:
- Critters may be LOCKED OUT of gossips/dates. They might
   also move to new locations.
- All other quest progress will be put on hold.
- You can abandon the adventure using the Pause menu.
sharedassets2.assets:18576/m_text.target:
Habang nasa Pakikipagsapalaran:
- Maaaring HINDI MAKASALI ang mga nilalang sa kuwentuhan/pakikipagtipan. Maaari rin
   silang lumipat ng lugar.
- Pansamantalang ihihinto ang usad ng lahat ng ibang misyon.
- Maaari mong iwan ang pakikipagsapalaran gamit ang Menu ng Pag-pause.

sharedassets2.assets:18769/m_text.source:
You got the Lantern!
Now you can explore the deepest darkest woods.
sharedassets2.assets:18769/m_text.target:
Nakuha mo ang Parol!
Matutuklasan mo na ang pinakamalalim at pinakamadilim na bahagi ng gubat.

sharedassets2.assets:18770/m_text.source: The Critters of the area are inspired by your promiscuity! Occasionally, critters will show up in pairs by Maverick’s Shop and be hanging out! Be sure to talk with them and see how they are doing!
sharedassets2.assets:18770/m_text.target: Inspirado ang mga Nilalang dito sa pakikipagtalik mo sa iba't ibang kapareha! Paminsan-minsan, may mga nilalang na magpapakita nang pares sa tabi ng Tindahan ni Maverick at magtatambay! Kausapin sila at alamin kung kumusta na sila!

sharedassets2.assets:18772/m_text.source:
You got the Swim Floaties!
Now nothing can stop you!
Or, at least, calm waters can’t stop you…
sharedassets2.assets:18772/m_text.target:
Nakuha mo ang mga Salbabidang Isinusuot!
Wala nang makapipigil sa iyo!
O kahit paano, hindi ka na mapipigilan ng kalmadong tubig…

sharedassets2.assets:18773/m_text.source:
Some stories are best experienced in a closed environment!

During an adventure, many interactions will be limited to keep the story in focus!
sharedassets2.assets:18773/m_text.target:
Mas magandang maranasan ang ilang kuwento sa isang limitadong kapaligiran!

Habang nasa pakikipagsapalaran, lilimitahan ang maraming pakikipag-ugnayan para manatiling nakatuon sa kuwento!

sharedassets2.assets:18796/m_text.source:
As you meet more and more critters, their information will be jotted down in the Critter Log!

Lots of details are hidden. Talk with the critters and explore the world to reveal them!
sharedassets2.assets:18796/m_text.target:
Habang dumarami ang nakikilala mong nilalang, isusulat sa Talaan ng mga Nilalang ang impormasyon nila!

Maraming detalyeng nakatago. Kausapin ang mga nilalang at tuklasin ang mundo para ibunyag ang mga ito!

sharedassets2.assets:18807/m_text.source:
All of your current and finished quests will be stored in the Quest Log!
You can select a quest and it’ll be tracked 
on the top-left of the screen!
sharedassets2.assets:18807/m_text.target:
Nasa Talaan ng mga Misyon ang lahat ng kasalukuyan at natapos mong misyon!
Maaari kang pumili ng misyong susubaybayan 
sa kaliwang itaas ng iskrin!

sharedassets2.assets:18820/m_text.source: Do you want to cancel the adventure?
sharedassets2.assets:18820/m_text.target: Gusto mo bang kanselahin ang pakikipagsapalaran?

sharedassets2.assets:18836/m_text.source: Watch it again in the Start Menu Gallery!
sharedassets2.assets:18836/m_text.target: Panoorin itong muli sa Galeriya sa Panimulang Menu!

sharedassets2.assets:18904/m_text.source: Dates are unlocked over time. Some may require certain quests or gossips to unlock. Some dates will continue over multiple meets!
sharedassets2.assets:18904/m_text.target: Nabubuksan ang mga Pakikipagtipan sa paglipas ng panahon. Maaaring kailanganin muna ng ilan ang ilang misyon o kuwentuhan bago mabuksan. May mga pakikipagtipang tumutuloy sa maraming pagkikita!
